title: Rental Supervisor - Power
description:
Hunton Services, a division of the Hunton Group, is seeking a Rental Power Supervisor to oversee the daily leadership, maintenance, readiness, deployment, and field support of its rental power generation fleet. This position leads Power Field Technicians, Power Shop Technicians, and Power Utility Technicians while ensuring generators and associated electrical equipment are inspected, maintained, tested, and prepared for reliable customer use.

Come work for an industry leader that has been recognized both locally and nationally as one of the Top Places to Work!

Responsibilities

  • Provide daily leadership and direction to Power Technicians and Utility Technicians, communicating work priorities, project requirements, and safety expectations.
  • Coordinate with Operations to support technician assignments, manpower needs, equipment availability, dispatch priorities, delivery and pickup requirements, and project schedules.
  • Monitor technician productivity, workmanship, documentation, and job completion; provide technical coaching and hands-on training.
  • Identify training needs and assist management with performance evaluations, development plans, recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and skills assessments.
  • Oversee inspection, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and testing of diesel and natural-gas generators and associated rental power equipment.
  • Maintain fleet readiness for portable, towable, and large mobile generators, load banks, automatic transfer switches, transformers, distribution panels, breakers, disconnects, cables, cable ramps, cam-lock equipment, spider boxes, fuel systems, battery chargers, and generator controls.
  • Establish and maintain equipment check-in and check-out standards, ensuring that the equipment is clean, properly labeled, inspected, tested, fueled as required, and documented before dispatch.
  • Prioritize repairs based on fleet demand and upcoming projects; coordinate parts, major repairs, warranty work, and outside vendor support as needed.
  • Provide technical oversight for engine, alternator, fuel, cooling, battery, charging, emissions, voltage regulation, breaker, control, and communication-system diagnostics.
  • Review technician findings, determine appropriate repair actions, maintain equipment service history, and escalate major failures to technical or fleet leadership.
  • Support temporary power projects from preparation through installation, startup, commissioning, service, and decommissioning.
  • Review generator capacity, voltage, phase, frequency, load requirements, cable sizing and quantities, distribution equipment, breaker protection, transformers, grounding, fuel needs, redundancy, equipment placement, and site access.
  • Verify temporary power configurations are appropriate for the application and coordinate review by qualified engineering personnel when required.
  • Confirm equipment and accessories are prepared before dispatch and provide field leadership during complex or high-risk deployments.
  • Ensure installations follow company procedures, manufacturer requirements, project specifications, and applicable safety requirements.
  • Oversee startup and commissioning inspections, including fluid levels, batteries, fuel systems, controls, voltage, frequency, phase rotation, breakers, grounding, cables, and connections.
  • Verify operational testing, required load-bank testing, alarm and shutdown checks, commissioning documentation, and customer operating orientation are completed before equipment enters service.
  • Provide remote and on-site technical support for equipment failures, alarms, shutdowns, electrical distribution problems, and customer operating concerns.
  • Support emergency response, prioritize service needs based on customer impact and operational risk, and participate in after-hours and on-call coverage as required.
  • Perform equipment audits, review completed repairs, investigate repeat failures, and implement corrective actions to improve fleet reliability.
  • Enforce company safety policies, electrical safety practices, lockout/tagout procedures, personal protective equipment requirements, and job hazard assessments; stop work when unsafe conditions exist.
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of inspection forms, maintenance records, repair work orders, time entries, service tickets, parts requests, commissioning records, load-bank reports, and equipment damage reports.
  • Communicate equipment status and significant repair needs to Operations and Fleet Management.
  • Provide technical support to Sales regarding equipment capabilities, generator applications, installation requirements, and field conditions. Sales retains responsibility for customer ownership and commercial terms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

description:

Bring your flavor

Competencies:

  • Performance metric tracking and continuous improvement

  • Operational standards, food safety, and compliance execution

Knowledge:

We also provide a variety of benefits including:

title: Compliance - Technology Operational Risk Management (Technology Development) – Vice President
description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities.

As Vice President Technology Development Risk Lead in Technology and Cybersecurity Operational Risk Management, you form an independent view of whether the controls over software delivery still hold now that a large share of code is written by artificial intelligence agents. You will use data-first approaches to show what is actually happening across the engineering estate, challenge the first line on what that data reveals, and report a position that senior management and regulators can rely on. You will do this as an individual contributor, close enough to the technology to stay credible with the engineers you challenge.

Your role offers the opportunity to join the Tech and Cyber Operational Risk Management team, responsible for the successful implementation and execution of the Compliance, Conduct, and Operational Risk framework within JPMorgan. You will provide Second Line of Defense challenge and oversight to our technology and cybersecurity partners. We are looking for someone who has built software and can hold their own with the engineers they challenge, and who will raise the analytical bar of the people around them without managing them.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform independent risk assessments of the controls governing how software is planned, written, reviewed, tested, and released, using data-first approaches and advanced analytics.

  • Challenge the first line on the control model applied to artificial intelligence coding assistants and agentic development tooling, covering human review of generated code, attribution of authorship, and the audit trail behind every change.

  • Evaluate the entitlements and credentials granted to development tooling and autonomous agents, and whether access controls still hold when a machine rather than a person initiates a change.

  • Assess whether observability and telemetry across the engineering estate is sufficient to detect data loss, misuse, and unexpected agent behaviour.

  • Utilize Python and SQL to analyze large engineering data sets, and build dashboards and reports that make development risk visible to senior management.

  • Define and test statistical hypotheses to identify thematic risks in software delivery from key risk indicator and key performance indicator performance.

  • Develop and maintain the annual oversight plan for this domain, and report an independent view to senior management, control committees, internal audit, and regulators.

  • Assess the prioritization and treatment of control findings, and monitor first line remediation to closure.

  • Coach and develop junior data scientists and risk professionals, raising the analytical bar of the function.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5-10 years of experience in technology risk, technology audit, software engineering, or application security within financial services.

  • Hands-on software development experience in Python.

  • Experience querying and analyzing data in SQL.

  • Hands-on experience with the software delivery toolchain, including source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, and automated testing.

  • Experience assessing or testing technology controls such as change management, access management, or secure software development.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior DevSecOps EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * *

The Opportunity:
Join a high-performing DevSecOps team supporting our DoD/AF customer in delivering, securing, and operating cloud-native enterprise platforms. This role centers on Kubernetes platform engineering, Big Bang deployment and sustainment, Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and secure CI/CD automation across mission-critical environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Deploy, configure, and sustain Kubernetes-based platforms and mission applications using Big Bang, Helm, and GitOps deployment practices.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes resources, networking, IAM, and platform services.
  • Build, secure, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including reusable pipeline templates, automated testing, and controlled release promotion.
  • Triage, prioritize, remediate, and validate infrastructure, container, and application security findings in accordance with established vulnerability-management SLAs.
  • Implement and maintain hardened Kubernetes and cloud configuration baselines aligned with DISA STIGs, NIST 800-53, RMF, and organizational security requirements.
  • Manage Kubernetes security controls, including RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, admission controls, secrets management, and secure ingress/egress configurations.
  • Maintain GitOps workflows using Git as the authoritative source for infrastructure and platform configuration; ensure deployed environments remain aligned with approved code.
  • Monitor CI/CD platforms, runners, deployments, and Kubernetes workloads; troubleshoot build, deployment, performance, and availability issues.
  • Develop automated patching, configuration management, and compliance-validation processes to reduce manual effort and configuration drift.
  • Produce security and operational documentation, including architecture diagrams, implementation procedures, scan evidence, remediation plans, and POA&M updates.
  • Support RMF and ATO lifecycle activities by collecting control evidence, addressing assessment findings, and maintaining continuous-monitoring artifacts.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • U.S Citizen with eligibility for Secret Clearance
  • At least 7 years of relevant professional experience with a related degree
  • Strong experience developing and maintaining Terraform modules and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns for cloud, network, and Kubernetes resources.
  • Experience implementing GitOps workflows with tools such as Argo CD, Flux, GitLab, GitHub, or similar platforms.
  • 3–5 years experience designing and deploying Kubernetes-based solutions; Big Bang is a plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and secure DevSecOps practices.
  • Strong familiarity with DISA STIGs, RMF, NIST SP 800-53, ATO processes, POA&M management, continuous monitoring, and security compliance evidence generation.

Desired:


  • 5–10 years of experience in DevSecOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, SRE, or software delivery roles.
  • Experience with CAC authentication, PIV tokens, and client-side PKI certificate handling.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services, including EKS, IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, load balancers, and security services.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go, or similar languages for automation, tooling, and operational support.
  • Relevant certifications such as CKA, CKAD, CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS certifications, Security+, CISSP, or CCSP.
  • Experience with ATO/accreditation processes.
  • Familiarity with scanning and compliance tools like RMF, ACAS, Twistlock, Prisma Cloud.
  • Proven ability to work across multi-tenant identity services, supporting thousands of users and integrating with microservices.

title: Division Chief of Pediatric Pulmonology
description:
Why Join Us

Children's Hospital of Michigan has been a cornerstone of pediatric care since 1886 — the first and largest children's hospital in the state and a nationally ranked institution recognized by U.S. News & World Report. As a proud member of the Detroit Medical Center, CHM carries an international reputation in pediatric medicine, surgery, and research, training more pediatricians than any other facility in Michigan.

Position Highlights

The Department of Pediatrics at Children’s Hospital of Michigan and Central Michigan University (CMU) invite applications and nominations for the position of Division Chief of Pediatric Pulmonology. This prestigious role offers a visionary leader the opportunity to advance our clinical, educational, and research missions while guiding an established, comprehensive respiratory team.

The Division of Pediatric Pulmonology features a robust clinical footprint, serving a large outpatient and inpatient pediatric pulmonary care. The division is staffed four board-certified pediatric pulmonologists and one physician assistant (PA). The multidisciplinary team also included four dedicated nurses, a clinical social worker (SW), and a registered dietitian.

The Pulmonary Medicine division has a Cystic Fibrosis Foundation accredited Cystic Fibrosis (CF) Center and has a close collaboration with the adult CF center at Harper University Hospital. Together, we are an active member of the national Cystic Fibrosis Therapeutics Development Network (TDN).

Advanced Sleep Program: Features a high-volume, dynamic Sleep Center that includes a multidisciplinary sleep clinic and two dedicated pediatric sleep labs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership: Provide administrative oversight, financial management, and strategic direction for the division and its specialized clinics.

  • Clinical Excellence: Maintain and expand high-quality inpatient and outpatient pediatric pulmonary and sleep services.

  • Academic Development: Mentor and support the professional growth of junior faculty, advanced practice providers, residents, and medical students under the academic framework of the CMU College of Medicine.

  • Research Innovation: Foster clinical and translational research initiatives.

What We Offer

  • Malpractice insurance provided with tail coverage

  • Health, dental, life, plus additional insurance options

  • 401(k) and profit sharing

  • Reimbursement license fees

Candidate Requirements

  • MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree.

  • Board Certification in Pediatric Pulmonology is required.

  • Board Certification in Sleep Medicine is preferred but not required.

  • Eligibility for an unrestricted state medical license in Michigan.

  • Academic credentials qualifying for appointment at the rank of Associate Professor or Professor

  • Proven track record of academic accomplishment and leadership experience within a multidisciplinary environment.

Why Detroit

Detroit is a city in full stride — a revitalized urban core with world-class dining, a thriving arts and music scene, and major sports anchoring community pride year-round. Neighborhoods like Midtown, Corktown, and Royal Oak offer distinct personalities and genuinely affordable housing compared to most major metro markets, making it an easy place to put down roots. The broader metro area provides strong public and private school options, and proximity to the Great Lakes means outdoor recreation is never far away. For physicians who want the energy of a major city without the cost of living to match, Detroit consistently delivers.

title: Senior Director, Property & Operations Analytics (Eastern or Central Time Zones)
description:
Position Overview

The Senior Director, Property & Operations Analytics is a key leader within Marriott’s Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI (D&AI) organization, responsible for elevating analytics, measurement practices, and decision support across the end‑to‑end property and hotel operations lifecycle. This role partners closely with Global Operations, Brand & Lodging Product, Quality, Owner & Franchise Services and Continent teams to drive performance, improve guest experience, and inform enterprise and owner decisions.

This leader owns analytics that support hotels and above‑property leaders across on‑property execution, quality and standards, renovation and compliance, service delivery, labor and cost efficiency, and operational performance. A core expectation is to bring innovation - introducing modern measurement approaches, strengthening experimentation and pilot measurement, and continuously raising the analytical maturity of the Property & Operations analytics portfolio.

As an Analytics Guild Leader in the D&AI operating model, the role leads multiple agile pods, sets standards across Operations Analytics, and ensures end‑to‑end progress on enterprise priorities, data debt reduction, and flagship initiatives such as ITR Drivers, hotel decisioning tools (e.g., QPower), and the evolution of guest satisfaction measurement.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

1. Strategic & Innovative Leadership – Property & Operations

• Define and execute the analytics vision for Property & Operations in alignment with enterprise priorities and D&AI strategy.

• Introduce innovative measurement practices, frameworks, and analytical approaches that elevate how Global Operations decisions are informed.

• Act as a thought leader on how property condition, service execution, staffing, and operational trade‑offs influence guest experience, brand health, and owner value.

2. Measurement & Decision Support

• Own measurement strategy for operations pilots, initiatives, and field tests - ensuring clear success metrics, learning agendas, and post‑pilot recommendations.

• Translate pilot and initiative results into crisp insights and decision guidance for senior leaders, operations forums, and owners.

• Continuously assess whether current KPIs and scorecards are fit‑for‑purpose, recommending changes where needed to improve decision quality.

3. Operations Analytics (End‑to‑End)

• Provide Analytics oversight across Global Ops domains, including Rooms, F&B, Spa, Engineering, Staffing/Labor, and Service Operations.

• Lead development of robust measurement frameworks for complex areas such as Food & Beverage and other operations‑heavy disciplines.

• Deepen team expertise in relevant systems, data sources, and operational dynamics across Global Operations functions.

• Ensure analytics reflect real operational realities and are trusted by field, continent, and corporate leaders.

4. Advanced Analytics & Insight Delivery

• Lead analyses and models assessing hotel performance drivers, including renovation impact, standards compliance, service execution, and operational effectiveness.

• Synthesize across GuestVoice/ITR, brand standards, quality audits, property attributes, financial signals, and operational KPIs.

• Deliver executive‑ready insights that clearly communicate what matters, why it matters, and what actions leaders should take.

5. Guild, Pod & Enterprise Leadership (D&AI Model)

• Serve as Analytics Guild Leader for Property & Operations, setting standards, best practices, and capability roadmaps.

• Work closely with other guild leaders and pod teams to ensure coordinated progress on shared priorities, enterprise initiatives, and data debt items.

• Drive alignment and momentum across large cross‑pod efforts, including ITR Drivers, hotel decisioning tools (e.g., QPower), and modernization of guest satisfaction measurement (including assessing how ITR is measured and complemented by other metrics).

6. Cross‑Functional Partnership & Influence

• Serve as the primary analytics partner to Global Operations, Quality, Asset Management, Brand Operations, Development, and Continent leadership teams.

• Embed analytics into operational planning, performance reviews, renovation prioritization, and standards governance.

• Influence leaders through strong relationships, credibility, and clear data‑driven storytelling.

7. Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Lead, mentor, and inspire a senior team of analytics leaders and practitioners.

• Elevate team capabilities in measurement design, causal analysis, experimentation, and operational decisioning.

• Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, or related field required.

• Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Experience

• 10+ years of progressive experience in analytics, strategy, operations, or related disciplines, with significant leadership responsibility.

• Proven experience driving measurement and analytics for complex operational environments. This may include KPI frameworks and decisioning for an assigned business domain.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive adoption of analytics in business decision‑making.

• Hospitality, lodging operations, quality, or asset‑focused experience required.

Skills & Knowledge

• Deep understanding of hotel operations, service delivery, and operational drivers of guest experience.

• Strong analytical, conceptual, and systems thinking skills.

• Demonstrated experience communicating with and influencing senior executives and driving enterprise‑level analytics adoption.

• Experience operating in agile, product‑oriented analytics models.

This role plays a critical part in modernizing how Marriott measures, pilots, and optimizes property‑level execution—translating analytics into stronger guest experiences, better operational decisions, and long‑term value for owners and the enterprise.

Location

  • Must be able to consistently work Eastern or Central time zone business hours, with a strong preference for Eastern time zone alignment.

title: Digital Content Coordinator
description:
This competition is open to all applicants however; internal applicants will be given priority consideration based on minimum qualifications, or a combination of experience, skills, and abilities before external applicants are considered.

This position has a term length of one year plus one day from the date of hire.

Location - This role is hybrid with a mix of remote and in-person. Work primarily takes place at Enterprise Square, Edmonton.

Reporting to the Manager, Content Strategy, the Digital Content Coordinator works with a team to add and maintain web content on ualberta.ca for various colleges, faculties, departments and administrative units. This work involves laying out provided web content to create web pages following best practices in user experience and SEO. These tasks require knowledge of HTML and CSS, and the ability to use CSS libraries like Bootstrap 5 to create well-designed pages that improve the experience of web users.

The Digital Content Coordinator is also responsible for the day-to-day maintenance and editing of top-level University of Alberta pages and pages owned by External Relations. These activities may include building new web pages, editing current content or redesigning existing pages based on user data and good content design. The Digital Content Coordinator also supports other CMS users by responding to support tickets and contributing to a knowledge base about using the CMS. They will also participate in implementing institution-wide standards to the university web environment, including improvements to SEO, accessibility, page performance, design and user experience. Therefore, the ideal candidate would not only have experience with web content creation, but strong demonstrable experience with website management and web page design using HTML and CSS.

Web Content Management and Design (60%)

  • Manage and process support requests for updates and changes, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders and adherence to content strategy guidelines.
  • Design and update web pages using HTML and CSS, including utilizing Bootstrap 5 for responsive layouts that work on both mobile and desktop.
  • Collaborate with designers, communications partners, and content contributors to manage, lay out, and optimize web content based on best practices in user experience, SEO, and accessibility.
  • Regularly build, edit, and redesign web pages for various university units, focusing on improving page performance, responsiveness, and user engagement.

Institutional Digital Content Performance (20%)

  • Ensure content accuracy and timeliness through the use of CMS tools for scheduling reviews and updates.
  • Support large-scale projects to enhance the university's web environment, ensuring alignment with SEO, accessibility, and site performance standards.

Web CMS Support and Training (20%)

  • Respond to help desk requests from CMS users, providing troubleshooting support and guidance.
  • Develop and share help documentation and best practices for SEO, usability, and design with CMS users across campus to enhance web content quality.
  • Collect and analyze feedback from CMS users to propose improvements to the CMS and overall web environment.
  • A diploma or an undergraduate degree in digital media, communications, marketing or web design, or equivalent education in a similar field.
  • 2 years of combined experience in web page creation, web content management, SEO, and copyediting, preferably in a post-secondary or government environment.
  • Demonstrable experience building web pages and structuring websites using HTML and CSS.
  • Expert knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems.
  • Expert knowledge of best practices for web design, including responsive design, SEO and accessibility.
  • Intermediate knowledge of CSS Frameworks such as Bootstrap.
  • Working knowledge of Google Analytics and other digital analytics/reporting tools.
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace tools (documents, sheets, slides, Gmail, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of photo editing tools to crop and compress images.

Click "Apply Now" to submit your resume and cover letter.

This position is subject to all applicable terms and conditions of the collective agreement between the Governors of the University of Alberta and the Non-Academic Staff Association (NASA).

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Nuclear Reactor Engineering and Safety - UTK
description:
This position involves computational research on nuclear power plant operation, design, and safety. Focusing on flexible operation of nuclear energy by improving integration with other energy sources, including advancing the technology readiness of control capable of dividing thermal and electrical power to support electricity grids while increasing plant revenue.

The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, and partners like other universities and National Laboratories to support nuclear engineering programs. The appointment would be a limited term appointment, approximately 1 year with the possibility of renewal for future years. The end goal after the appointment would be for you to secure a permanent position that is compatible with your interest.

Development and evaluation of models for nuclear power plants and systems using open information. The work includes developing and applying general and plant-specific light water computational tools that can be used to help design, test, and optimize dynamic thermal energy extraction and delivery and electricity dispatch. This includes normal operation, anticipated operational occurrences, and accident scenarios. Work with multi-disciplinary teams to apply modeling and simulation techniques for flexible operation of nuclear power plants. Publishing papers in high-quality refereed journals. Actively collaborating with industry, academia, government labs, and applications developers in a variety of venues.

Required Qualifications: Position requires a Ph.D. degree in Nuclear Engineering, or an equivalent field. A well-established track record of research in nuclear engineering.

Preferred Qualifications: Programming experience for workflow development, scientific computing, and data analysis and visualization. Excellent interpersonal skills, oral and written communication skills. Motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and to participate creatively in collaborative teams across the laboratory. Ability to function well in a fast-paced research environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to ever changing needs.

  • Onsite

  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

The Department of Nuclear Engineering at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, established in 1957, was the first of its kind and is considered one of the most prestigious in the United States. title: PT MEDICAL ADVOCATE
description:
PAY RATE: $53.00/hr

OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF JOB:

Dauphin County Prison is currently accepting applications for the part-time position of Medical Advocate. This position is responsible to perform specialized, strategic, high-level medical advocacy to address the complex medical needs of the residents of Dauphin County Prison and assist the Warden and the Deputy Warden of Operations in maintaining effective collaboration with the medical department. This position will serve as health care / mental health advocate for residents entrusted to the department’s care. This involves formulating, reviewing, and updating policies and programming relevant to health care services, including mental health care services. The Medical Advocate will communicate directly with residents and their family members or support system regarding available services and provide program assistance and technical support for complex care needs for residents with serious medical diagnoses and/or mental illness and those identified as being medically and psychologically compromised. This position will maintain partnerships with county staff and outside agencies to find placement and treatment options for residents who have been identified as complex mental health cases and who are nearing their release date. Dauphin County Prison desires to ensure proper care is continued during and after incarceration to drastically reduce the chances of reincarceration due to lapses in access to mental health services and resources.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF JOB:

  1. Offers support and guidance to residents suffering medical and/or mental health diagnosis’ by helping to analyze and interpret medical information in a way that is clear and understandable.

  2. Interviews residents to identify any issues or gaps in care prior to and during incarceration.

  3. Acts as a liaison between the Medical Department and Administration Office and develops a collaborative relationship with other internal and external County departments and agencies.

  4. Works with the Warden, Deputy Warden of Operations and other leadership to formulate, review, and update policies and programming relevant to health care services including mental health services.

  5. Participates in health care services audits, investigates complaints, and maintains records

  6. Partners with public health officials to assist with obtaining critical medical services for residents nearing the end of their incarceration

  7. Gathers treatment records to assist with assessment, treatment, and service planning.

  8. Interviews and identifies residents that may require new or continued mental health services.

  9. Maintains an accurate tracking system of care strategies, evolutions, and outcomes.

  10. Collaborates regularly with the Medical Department including mental health providers and outside healthcare providers and agencies for referrals, etc., to address ongoing treatment needs.

  11. Coordinates wellness checks when deemed necessary and follows up with Administration, Medical, and the resident and/or the resident’s family when appropriate.

  12. Reviews service and treatment plans and provides alternative recommendations when necessary.

  13. Prepares summaries, special reports and memos as necessary.

  14. Maintains current knowledge base of best practices and relevant developments in medical and mental health treatments and strategies.

  2. Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Warden, Deputy Warden of Operations and/or designee.

SUPERVISION GIVEN:

  1. In coordination with the Deputy Warden of Operations, the Medical Advocate may oversee any medical personnel insomuch as they have duties related to health care and/or mental health services or treatment.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  1. Works in limited workspace but with adequate lighting, ventilation and fluctuating temperatures.

  2. Normal exposure to noise, disruptions and stress.

  3. Normal indoor exposure to dust/dirt.

  4. Potential exposure to blood borne pathogens and/or communicable diseases.

  5. Works in conditions of potential outbursts or aggressive behavior of clients.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL CONDITIONS:

  2. Must be able to sit, stand for long periods, with intermittent walking, driving and occasional climbing stairs, twisting stooping, grasping or reaching to carry out job duties.

  3. Dexterity requirements range from simple to coordinated movements of fingers/hand; feet/legs; torso as necessary to carry out job duties.

  4. Light work, with occasional lifting/carrying of objects with maximum weight of twenty pounds.

  5. Must demonstrate emotional stability.

  6. Must be able to cope with the physical and mental stress of the position.

  7. Must be able to move frequently throughout the workday.

  8. Must be able to pay close attention to details and concentrate on work.

  9. Must be able to work with clients who carry or may carry active hepatitis, HIV or other infectious diseases.

QUALIFICATIONS

A.EDUCATION/TRAINING:

  1. Bachelor's degree preferred in Nursing, Healthcare Administration, Social Work or a related field with experience in mental health. Formal education may be substituted by significant work experience in the field of social work and/or other related experience for a period not less than 2 years.

    B.WORK EXPERIENCE:

    1. 2 to 3 years’ experience in the field of nursing, social work, counseling and/or providing therapeutic services to individuals in need of mental health services.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  1. Must maintain sufficient skills in conducting clinical-setting interviews to determine appropriate referral services or options.

  2. Must be able to review and interpret medical charts, hospital discharge paperwork and other medical documentation and identify potential red flags.

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Department of Chemistry - UTK
description:
The Department of Chemistry at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Associate whose appointment will be divided between serving as the Department’s X-ray Scientist and conducting synthetic chemistry research in Dr. David Jenkins’s group (X-ray/ICP center director). The X-ray Scientist responsibilities will include operation and maintenance of the department’s single-crystal X-ray diffractometer, structural analysis and service crystallography, and training and supporting departmental users. The research component will involve independent and collaborative research in organic, inorganic, or organometallic synthesis, with projects spanning areas such as homogeneous catalysis, porous frameworks, and surface modification. The position is open to candidates who have completed and submitted their PhD dissertation before the start of employment.

Approximately 50% of job as the department’s X-ray scientist includes:

  • Operating and maintaining a Bruker single crystal X-ray diffractometer.

  • Training members of the department on the use of the Bruker single crystal diffractometer.

  • Mounting crystals, collecting data, and solving crystal structures for members of the department (i.e., service structures for PIs).

  • Repairing the instrument (when feasible). Working with technicians to ascertain what repairs are required.

  • Maintaining the X-ray facility in the Department of Chemistry, including safety protocols, logbooks, and user lists (for compliance with Radiation Safety).

  • Billing PIs and maintaining the X-ray cost center. Communicating with relevant accounting personnel about surplus or deficits.

Approximately 50% of job as chemist in Dr Jenkins group includes:

  • Expertise in organic, organometallic, or inorganic synthesis is required.

  • Ability to contribute to one or more current research projects within the Jenkins group.

  • Analytical skills that match synthetic areas of expertise (e.g. NMR, MS, PXRD or similar).

Required Qualifications

  • Education: By first day of appointment, earned a PhD in Chemistry or closely related field
  • Experience:

    • Strong knowledge of small molecule single crystal X-ray diffractometry

    • Expertise in organic, organometallic, or inorganic synthesis is required.

    • An excellent track record of productive and creative research demonstrated by publications in peer reviewed journals.

    • The postdoctoral candidate must have strong verbal and writing skills. The candidate must be willing to work independently and collaboratively with group members, and preferably also with experimental collaborators. The candidate must also be willing to mentor the graduate students in the group from time to time.

    • Motivated and safety conscious.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Ability to set priorities, multi-task and adapt to ever changing needs with the proven ability to function well in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience: Knowledge of powder X-ray diffraction techniques is advantageous. Proficiency with air-free synthesis is highly valuable.

Work Location

  • Knoxville, TN

  • Onsite

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $50,000
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

Since the position primarily entails a strong requisite knowledge of small molecule single crystal X-ray diffractometry, candidates should submit:

  • CV

  • Cover letter

  • A list of published crystal structures that have been solved and their references. Knowledge of powder X-ray diffraction techniques or ICP is highly advantageous but not required. Applicants who have a background only in powder X-ray diffraction or ICP will not be considered.

The position is a contract for one year and is renewable (based on performance) for at least one additional year. The position begins on December 1, 2026 or on a mutually agreeable later date.

Questions about the position can be directed to Dr. Jenkins at djenki15@utk.edu. For full consideration, candidates must submit the requested documents via the UTK HR website.

Please be prepared to have 2-3 letters of recommendation submitted upon request. Formal review of applications begins on November 1, 2026 and will continue until the position is filled.

About The Department

The University of Tennessee in Knoxville is the flagship educational institution in the State of Tennessee, and the Department of Chemistry is its oldest PhD granting Department. We offer a long-standing tradition of excellence in chemical research and education, stretching from 1947, when the department granted the University’s first PhD degree, to the present. We have people from diverse cultures providing an international business environment.

The city of Knoxville is a hidden gem with a beautiful and walkable downtown, a diverse music scene, active neighborhoods, unique restaurants, and a robust offering of outdoor and cultural activities. UTK is located within easy driving distance to Asheville, Nashville, Atlanta, and the Great Smoky Mountains; and a day’s drive to Memphis, Chicago and Washington D.C. Knoxville and the surrounding counties have a statistical area population of over 850,000 people. The Knoxville region houses many leading corporations, including Bush Brothers & Company, Discovery Inc., Tennessee Valley Authority, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

title: Compliance & Governance Analyst - India
description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title

Compliance & Governance Analyst – India

About us

flydocs is an asset management solution provider with the aviation industry’s most comprehensive solution for creating value out of aircraft maintenance data. We offer the tools and expertise that allow all industry stakeholders to drive sustainable innovation to help build the future of the commercial aviation asset lifecycle. Recognised as a global leader in digital records management, we were founded in 2007 and are 100% owned by Lufthansa Technik.

Purpose of role.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Compliance & Governance Analyst to join the flydocs team in India.

With a significant part of our workforce based in India, maintaining a strong understanding of the Indian legislative, regulatory and governance landscape is fundamental to our business. This role will provide dedicated local compliance expertise, helping flydocs India understand and meet its obligations, respond effectively to regulatory change and maintain appropriate governance, policies, controls and procedures.

You will act as a key point of knowledge for Indian regulatory and governance requirements, working closely with stakeholders across the business to identify applicable obligations, understand their impact and support their effective implementation.

The role will also support flydocs' wider compliance, assurance and enterprise risk management frameworks. Previous risk management experience is beneficial, but we are particularly interested in candidates who bring strong knowledge and practical experience of the Indian regulatory and governance environment.

Work arrangement:

We are more interested in what you bring to our team than where you are located, so this role can be performed remotely from anywhere in India.

You will regularly collaborate with colleagues through Microsoft Teams and other digital channels. There may also be occasional requirements to visit our office in Vadodara, Gujarat and attend other business locations where required.

Location: India

Who you will be working with:

flydocs is a values-driven organisation, with Transparency, Respect and Collaboration forming key enablers of our success.

We are on an exciting journey where collaboration with our colleagues, customers and partners is fundamental to our current and future success. We are open-minded, attentive and always looking for solutions that support our people, customers and business.

The Compliance & Governance Analyst will work closely with stakeholders across flydocs India and the wider organisation and will report directly to the Compliance & Governance Lead – Digital Ecosystem.

You will help the organisation understand its regulatory obligations, maintain effective governance and compliance arrangements, identify potential gaps and provide appropriate guidance, challenge and assurance.

How will you contribute to the business?

A key part of this role will be developing and maintaining our understanding of the regulatory and governance requirements applicable to our operations in India.

You will:

  • Act as a key point of knowledge for Indian legislative, regulatory and governance requirements.
  • Monitor developments in Indian legislation and regulation, assess their potential impact on the business and coordinate appropriate actions with relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain an India compliance obligations framework and compliance calendar, ensuring applicable requirements, responsibilities, actions and evidence are clearly documented and regularly reviewed.
  • Support compliance with applicable Indian data protection and privacy requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act) and associated Rules, working with relevant privacy, HR, IT and business stakeholders.
  • Support and coordinate corporate and secretarial compliance for flydocs India, including Board and general meeting requirements, statutory filings, resolutions and associated governance activities.
  • Work closely with functions including HR, Finance, IT, Information Security and operational teams to identify regulatory obligations and support their effective implementation.
  • Manage and monitor entity-level registrations, licences and renewals, ensuring associated compliance requirements are maintained.
  • Identify actual or potential compliance gaps and provide appropriate recommendations, challenge and escalations where required.
  • Provide regular reporting on India compliance activities, regulatory developments, identified issues and remediation actions.
  • Support and undertake internal compliance and management-system audits, including monitoring agreed corrective and improvement actions.
  • Help ensure appropriate controls, policies and procedures are established, maintained, communicated and periodically reviewed.
  • Build strong professional relationships across the business to encourage effective cooperation, communication and a positive compliance culture.
  • Support supplier compliance and due-diligence activities, including reviewing supplier contracts and NDAs and compliance considerations for new and existing suppliers.
  • Support and promote the existing India Risk Management Guild and help stakeholders understand their responsibilities for identifying and managing risk.
  • Contribute to wider compliance, governance and risk projects across flydocs and the Digital Ecosystem as required.
  • Provide wider support to the Compliance & Governance Lead – Digital Ecosystem.

Your first 30 days:

We will support you throughout your onboarding so you can understand our business, build relationships and begin adding value quickly.

During your first 30 days, you will:

  • Develop an understanding of flydocs, our business model, customers and product portfolio.
  • Become familiar with flydocs India's structure and key business functions.
  • Meet key stakeholders across India and the wider organisation and understand how compliance interacts with their areas of responsibility.
  • Become familiar with our existing compliance and governance framework, policies, procedures and documentation.
  • Understand our ISO-certified management systems and how they support the wider compliance environment.
  • Become familiar with our existing India regulatory obligations and current compliance activities.
  • Understand our Enterprise Risk Management framework and India Risk Management Guild.
  • Ask lots of questions – we encourage curiosity and constructive challenge.

Your first 90 days:

By around 90 days, you will:

  • Have established effective working relationships with key stakeholders across flydocs India.
  • Begin acting as a local point of contact for India compliance and governance matters.
  • Proactively monitor relevant Indian regulatory and legislative developments.
  • Review existing India compliance obligations and help identify any areas requiring further attention or improvement.
  • Begin maintaining the India compliance obligations framework and regulatory calendar.
  • Support and undertake internal audit and assurance activities.
  • Begin providing meaningful updates on compliance activities, regulatory developments, risks and actions.
  • Become increasingly confident supporting the company's established risk management processes.

At Around 180 days and beyond:

You will:

  • Have developed strong partnerships with key stakeholders responsible for maintaining compliance across flydocs India.
  • Maintain effective oversight of the India compliance framework and provide proactive guidance, challenge and assurance to relevant stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify regulatory developments and help the business understand and respond to their impact.
  • Maintain oversight of applicable Indian regulatory obligations and compliance status.
  • Support stakeholders in addressing identified compliance gaps and monitor agreed actions through to completion.
  • Provide clear and meaningful compliance and governance reporting to relevant stakeholders.
  • Independently support internal audit, governance and assurance activities.
  • Confidently support the existing Enterprise Risk Management framework and Risk Management Guild.
  • Continuously assess existing activities and processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Take ownership of new compliance and governance projects as the business and regulatory environment evolve.
  • Be inquisitive, resilient and comfortable providing constructive challenge while developing practical solutions.

Requirements

We would be really happy if you had:

  • Practical experience in a compliance, governance, legal, company secretarial, regulatory or similar role within India.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Indian legislative, regulatory and corporate governance environment.
  • The ability to research, interpret and clearly communicate legislative and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience monitoring regulatory developments and translating changes into practical business actions.
  • Knowledge of Indian data protection and privacy requirements, particularly the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
  • Experience maintaining compliance registers, regulatory calendars, governance records, policies and procedures.
  • Strong analytical and organisational skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex matters clearly and practically.
  • Confidence building relationships and working with stakeholders at different levels of an organisation.
  • The ability to provide constructive challenge and appropriately escalate compliance concerns.
  • Experience creating, adapting or implementing policies, procedures and controls.
  • The ability to understand and interpret relevant contractual terms and conditions.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and adapt to change.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills.

Experience of internal audit, ISO management systems, enterprise risk management or supplier due diligence would be advantageous but is not essential. We can support the right candidate in developing their knowledge and experience in these areas.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who is curious, proactive and willing to take ownership – someone who wants to understand why a requirement exists, what it means for our business and what we need to do about it.


Benefits

What we offer you:

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
  • Generous leave policy, 25 annual leaves, 7 sick leaves plus maternity & paternity options.
  • Inclusive medical insurance, For you, plus your spouse and up to two children.
  • Group personal accident policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and telehealth.
  • Term life insuranace.
  • Opportunities to learn and develop through both practical experience and formal learning where this benefits you and the business.
  • The opportunity to develop broad experience across compliance, governance, risk and assurance within an international organisation.
  • The opportunity to work collaboratively with colleagues across India, the UK and the wider Lufthansa Technik Digital Ecosystem.

title: Market Operations Associate (Latin America, Fully Remote)
description:
About Wingz, Inc.

Wingz is a rideshare platform focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). Our network of compassionate, credentialed drivers helps vulnerable populations gain access to the care they need.

About the role

  • Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward.

What you'll do

If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

  • Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application
  • Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and decide who advances
  • Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections
  • Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared
  • Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip
  • Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers

If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

  • Build driver schedules and assign trips against them
  • Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered
  • Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output
  • Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves
  • Notify drivers of schedule changes

If assigned to OTP Specialist

  • Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after
  • Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution
  • Keep clients informed before they have to ask
  • Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue

If assigned to Routing Specialist

  • Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability
  • Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup
  • Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap
  • Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete

If assigned to Market Associate

  • Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market
  • Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market
  • Flag early which area is about to break

Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

  • Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked
  • Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off
  • Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend
  • Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch
  • Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet
  • Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area
  • Bring us patterns, not just incidents

What you'll need

  • 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue
  • Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you
  • Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to decide quickly and defend the call
  • Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it
  • Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any
  • Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers
  • Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned
  • Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly
  • Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls

Bonus Points

  • NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience
  • Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background
  • Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience
  • Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding
  • Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

Why Wingz?

  • Mission-driven work that makes a tangible difference in people’s lives.
  • 100% remote work culture
  • A small, agile team where your impact is felt every day.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

title: University Partnership Liaison (Co-PI-ready Research Scientist)
description:
About AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL)

The AlphaHire Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL) is an applied research initiative studying how workforce conditions influence delivery of mission-critical investments and public programs. WIL builds methodology-transparent workforce intelligence and university partnership capacity for STEM education and workforce sponsored research — connecting institutional hosts with WIL research and delivery teams on grant packages.

Learn more:

We engage experienced researchers and practitioners for both full-time employment and project-based contract roles, depending on the award and staffing model. Engagements are remote-first with travel as required for partner campuses, school districts, and field sites. We build ready teams for live grant and sponsored-research pursuits — not speculative staffing banks.

This opportunity is contingent upon grant or sponsored-project award and final staffing approval. Permission will be requested before including a candidate's name or resume in a proposal or funding package.

WIL is seeking a University Partnership / Sponsored Research Liaison (Co-PI-ready Research Scientist) to connect WIL research capacity with university and community-college hosts — including sponsored programs offices, colleges of education, engineering education units, and technician-education centers — on STEM education and workforce sponsored projects.

What you'll do:
Map and advance university and community-college partnership pathways for STEM education and workforce sponsored projects
Coordinate with institutional sponsored programs, research development, and faculty PIs on roles, scopes, and proposal timelines
Support research design, evaluation framing, and partnership documentation suitable for NSF-style and related education packages
Facilitate introductions among K-14, community-college, industry, and university partners when the project design calls for it
Contribute specialist qualifications and citeable past projects to WIL grant and sponsored-research packages when permissioned

Requirements

Required:

Demonstrated experience in university sponsored research, research development, academic–industry or academic–K14 partnership, or Co-PI / senior-personnel roles on STEM education or workforce projects
Strong written communication for proposals, scopes of work, and partner correspondence
Ability to navigate IHE sponsored-programs processes and faculty collaboration norms
Open to full-time employment or project-based contract engagement; remote-first with travel as partner work requires

Nice to have:

Prior NSF, ATE, RET, RIEF, IUSE, or related sponsored-project experience
Familiarity with community-college technician education or engineering education research communities
Prior projects you can cite (agency or institution, your role, year)

title: Administrative Associate - Office of Research, Innovation & Economic Development  - UTK
description:
The Administrative Associate II within the Division of Research Administration Support Services (DRASS) team in the Office of Research, Innovation, & Economic Development (ORIED), at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville (UTK), provides operational and financial administrative support for the work of the 80+ people within DRA, and coordinates closely with the rest of the team in support of ORIED personnel. DRASS takes a shared services approach to supporting the operational and financial needs of the division, and the team has the flexibility to refocus support to respond to current and emerging needs and priorities. This position also serves as the primary archivist for digitizing and managing SPA award information previously stored in physical folders.

Invoicing and Audit Support

• Compile and organize supporting documentation required for invoicing and audits (e.g., purchase support, travel receipts/backup, service documentation). Ensure files are complete, clearly labeled and ordered in accordance with sponsor requirements, and provided within required timelines. Maintain proficiency with various DASH modules where source documents reside.

• Electronically submit invoices and financial reports to sponsors during peak periods and/or when the primary employee is absent to ensure deadlines are met and cash flow is optimized.

• Review all incoming audit requests with the Fiscal Assurance Manager to assign tasks and deadlines necessary for effective project management.

• Create and maintain a shared inventory of all audits, award details, findings, responses, corrective action, and key personnel involved.

• Coordinate with faculty, departmental financial personnel, and the SPA team to collect all required records set forth in the audit request. Create a shared digital site to compile and organize these documents.

• Coordinate with departments to ensure corrective action responses are received timely, reviewed by the Fiscal Assurance Officers for appropriateness, and submitted to the auditor by deadline.

• Assist Fiscal Assurance Officers with planning, organizing, and performing departmental reviews to support and encourage compliance in high-risk areas such as effort certification, subrecipient monitoring, and cost transfers.

• Prepare, modify, and maintain oversight of CANVAS, monitor quizzes and initiate the awarding of certificates when all modules are completed and passed.

• Maintain an inventory of internal control questionnaires and other relevant institutional records to streamline audit responses and promote consistency.

Data Integrity and Operational Support

• Generate and maintain data validation reports which include, but are not limited to, setup validation reports, labor distribution error reports, and task end date mismatch reports. These reports must be analyzed daily/weekly to monitor data quality across key functions. Coordinate with the award set-up team to ensure account errors are corrected in a timely manner. Departments will not be able to post expenses to awards otherwise.

• Assist with daily management of multiple central e-mail accounts: spa@utk.edu, spa awards@utk.edu, sfc@utk.edu, spacompliance@utk.edu, and FMC-AR@utk.edu to ensure incoming items are routed accurately and timely.

• Update PI information in DASH utilizing the TDX ticketing system in proper format to facilitate mass updates. • Update grant administrator information in DASH utilizing the TDX ticketing system in proper format to facilitate mass updates.

• Maintain master bookkeeper data to support automated account notification process.

• Administer sponsor portals to facilitate SPA user privileges.

• Coordinate with the Communications team to update the SPA website to ensure information is current.

• Prepare training materials (e.g., slide decks, quick guides, checklists, and process documentation) and manage Q&A during training sessions, ensuring participants receive clear guidance and follow up resources.

• Produce metrics and status reports (e.g., backlog volume, missing documentation trends, audit readiness checklists).

• Create and maintain standard operating procedures for validation processes to promote audit readiness.

• Manage digital records and document lifecycle processes, ensuring compliant organization, storage, archiving, retention, and secure disposition.

• Maintain and enforce recordkeeping systems and standards across SharePoint, Teams, and shared drives, including structure, metadata, version control, and data quality.

• Support users and operations through quality assurance, training materials, and guidance, and oversee sponsored project record archiving, including audit and retention requirements.

SUPPORT DRA STAFF AND OTHER ORIED UNITS

INCLUDING ON-SITE ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT All DRASS team members provide on-site administrative support for ORIED’s CM-based staff (not limited to DRA staff). This support includes, but is not limited to:

• Answers the door and welcomes guests to ORIED’s CM suite.

• Manages reservations for CM conference rooms and workspaces.

• Manages parking tag reservations.

• Interfaces with ORIED business staff and CM building manager on facilities concerns.

• Manages incoming and outgoing mail and package and service deliveries. All DRASS team members serve as backup for each other’s work functions to ensure continuity of support available to other DRA units in the event of a temporary leave or vacancy. This support includes, but is not limited to:

• Develops and updates written work process guides associated with the position’s assigned support functions.

• Performs regular cross-training on tasks assigned to other DRASS team members.

• Provides flexible coverage across functional areas as part of the shared services team.

OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED

• Support human resources and operational processes, including coordinating staff searches, onboarding, and related documentation to ensure efficient hiring and integration of new employees.

• Contribute to process improvement and departmental initiatives by supporting procedure development, research, and implementation of best practices to enhance operations and customer service.

• Provide administrative and analytical support across functions, including committee participation, stakeholder coordination, and delivery of high-quality customer service to internal and external partners.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: High School diploma or GED
  • Experience: One year of prior experience in an office environment
  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: MS Office skills; ability to solve problems; ability to learn new software and processes; ability to improve processes through critical thinking; ability to effectively communicate with diverse faculty, staff, and sponsors; ability to multi-task, organize a high-volume of work, and pay strict attention to detail; ability to work independently with minimal supervision; ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment; ability to be dependable, punctual, and a team player; exceptional customer service approach to all interactions with UT faculty, staff, administrators and external stakeholders; commitment to supporting the workload of the entire team in a positive, equitable, and flexible manner.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without need now or in the future for sponsorship for employment-based visa status.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree
  • Experience: Archiving, accounting, or business experience
  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: knowledge of OneDrive; knowledge of archiving processes; knowledge of DASH (Oracle), Cayuse, and Huron; knowledge of Uniform Guidance and Federal Acquisition Regulations

Work Location

  • Location: Knoxville, TN
  • Hybrid with occasional in-person requirements
  • Applicant must live in Knoxville or within a commutable distance

Compensation and Benefits

UT market range: MR05

Anticipated hiring range:

  • Find more information on the UT Market Range structure here
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

To express interest, please submit an application with the noted below attachments.

  • Resume
  • Cover Letter

About The College/Department/Division

Here at the University of Tennessee, thousands of world-class faculty, staff, students and postdoctoral fellows are engaged in research, scholarship and creative work on a daily basis. With a shared commitment to creating a more just, prosperous, and sustainable world for the citizens of Tennessee and communities far beyond, the UT community is creating new knowledge and generating solutions to some of the most challenging issues of our time.

The Office of Research, Innovation & Economic Development is here to support you, our community of researchers, scholars and creatives, from ideation to impact. Our dedicated team is here to help you develop competitive proposals and sources of support for your work, seed investments in promising new areas, nurture new and established multidisciplinary communities of scholars and support and sustain a strong culture of research integrity.

The university’s strategic relationships with corporate, venture, community, non-profit and government partners help extend the impact of our community’s work across the state and around the world. In collaboration with these partners, we are working to establish Tennessee as a go-to destination for cutting-edge research, innovation and a skilled workforce.

We understand that a creative, productive, and empowered community of researchers, scholars, and creatives is critical to the university’s future as a world-renowned research institution.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Java, Angular
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Job overview and responsibilities

The Senior Full Stack Developer will design, build, and support modern capabilities for Crew Pay, a business-critical pay platform. This role combines hands-on application development with cloud-native engineering across AWS, event-driven services, streaming, data processing, and relational databases. The successful candidate will deliver secure, resilient, observable, and maintainable solutions while partnering with product owners, engineers, architects, quality engineering, DevOps, and business stakeholders.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support end-to-end full stack features for the Pilot Pay product
  • Build cloud-native services using AWS ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, SNS, S3, and RDS
  • Develop event-driven workflows that consume, process, publish, and replay business events reliably
  • Create and maintain Kafka producers, consumers, topics, schemas, error-handling patterns, and operational controls
  • Develop and optimize Apache Spark jobs for scalable data transformation and pay-processing workloads
  • Build responsive user experiences and secure APIs that provide clear business workflows, validation, and auditability
  • Engineer for resilience through idempotency, retry strategies, dead-letter handling, failure recovery, and graceful degradation
  • Implement automated unit, integration, component, regression, and end-to-end tests as part of CI/CD pipelines
  • Improve production readiness through logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, runbooks, and root-cause analysis
  • Participate in Agile delivery practices, code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, and continuous improvement

Technical environment

  • Messaging and events: Kafka, SQS, and SNS
  • Data and storage: S3, RDS, Aurora, and SQL
  • Data processing: Apache Spark and EMR
  • Application development: Microservices, APIs, and modern web user interfaces
  • Engineering: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and observability
  • AI-enabled delivery: AI coding assistants, agents, and agentic workflows

Success in this role

  • Delivers reliable features that improve pay-processing accuracy, transparency, and operational efficiency
  • Reduces production risk through strong engineering controls, automated validation, and actionable observability
  • Improves delivery speed and code quality through reusable patterns, automation, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering
  • Takes ownership from design through production support and continuously improves the product and engineering system

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, including ownership of production applications
  • Strong back-end development experience using Java, Python, or a comparable enterprise language and framework
  • Front-end development experience using a modern JavaScript or TypeScript framework such as React, Angular, or Vue
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and asynchronous processing
  • Practical experience with AWS ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, SNS, S3, and RDS
  • Experience developing event-driven solutions using Kafka or a comparable streaming platform
  • Experience building, troubleshooting, and optimizing Apache Spark jobs
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, relational data modeling, transactions, and performance tuning
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and secure software development practices
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex production issues across applications, messaging, data, and cloud infrastructure layers
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business teams

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience supporting payroll, crew pay, financial, or other high-accuracy transaction-processing systems
  • Experience with Amazon MSK, EMR or EMR Serverless, Aurora MySQL, container orchestration, and serverless architectures
  • Knowledge of event schemas, data lineage, reconciliation, replay controls, and audit-trail design
  • Experience applying observability, performance engineering, cost optimization, and operational automation in AWS
