title: Senior Software Engineer, Voice AI
description:
Cloaked is building a cyber expert at your side - one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through.

We've protected 10M+ identities, screened 50M+ calls, and removed 1B+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action - for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people.


About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Call Guard team and help build the next generation of our real-time voice AI. You'll own major parts of the stack, from voice agent design and conversational latency to adversarial robustness and the infrastructure underneath. As Cloaked grows, you'll have room to contribute to how we build AI-native consumer products across engineering.

Call Guard is Cloaked's AI call screening product. It intercepts unknown callers, holds a real-time AI conversation with them, and only rings the user through if the call is legit. Spam, scams, and voice-cloned callers get stopped before they reach your phone. We've screened 50M+ calls to date.


What will you do?

  • Design and ship production voice agents that talk with unknown callers, classify intent, and block scams autonomously

  • Own key components of Call Guard's real-time voice AI stack and contribute to its architecture and technical direction

  • Drive down end-to-end conversational latency across STT, agent reasoning, and TTS

  • Build defenses against adversarial AI callers, including voice-cloning attacks targeting our users

  • Evaluate and integrate frontier models (LLMs, speech models, agent frameworks) for production use

  • Build and maintain telephony, VoIP routing, and the cloud infrastructure the voice agent runs on

  • Partner with product, design, and mobile to ship voice experiences that feel effortless

  • Raise the team's bar on quality through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing

  • Use AI tools daily to move faster


What skills and experiences will help you?

  • 5+ years building production software, ideally real-time or distributed systems

  • Hands-on experience shipping voice or conversational AI products in production

  • Fluency with modern voice AI stacks: STT (Whisper, Deepgram), TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia), and real-time orchestration (LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar)

  • Production experience with LLMs and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalents)

  • Experience optimizing for low latency in real-time systems

  • Strong Python and/or Go, with experience building scalable, secure backend systems and APIs

  • Solid cloud infrastructure experience (AWS or GCP, containerized deployments)

  • Experience shipping consumer products at scale

  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex) with good judgment on when and how to use them


What's nice to have?

  • Telephony, VoIP, SIP, or carrier-level call routing experience

  • WebRTC or real-time media infrastructure experience

  • Background in speech recognition, signal processing, or audio engineering

  • Familiarity with adversarial ML, AI safety, or anti-fraud systems

  • Experience handling PII and sensitive data

  • Prior work on consumer privacy or security products


What do we like?

  • Passion for security, privacy, and internet ethics

  • Curiosity about the frontier of voice AI and applied ML

  • Strong ownership and a bias to act

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Thrives on a high-velocity team and enjoys learning from and teaching others

  • Startup or growth-stage experience

What we offer

Cloaked is a well-funded Series B startup based out of NYC.

Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. We have two floors of our building, with two state of the art kitchens packed with drinks, snacks and everything else you'd need to get through the day.

The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials!

Compensation and Benefits

We offer above market rate pay and equity based off of the market's best commercially available data. Your compensation will be a combination of salary, bonus and equity.

For full-time US employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package: medical, dental and vision with Cloaked covering the majority of employee premiums, company-paid basic life, and a 401(k) with company match.

We offer flexible work arrangements and the ability to work remotely as needed. Cloaked provides a home office stipend in addition to a new company laptop (and other tech depending on the role).

Perks

🌴 Competitive PTO: PTO, floating holidays and sick days - and we push people to actually use them. We see time off as a preventative burnout measure, not a balance to hoard.

👶 Parental Leave: Paid leave for all new parents - birth, adoption, or foster placement - because the people building privacy deserve time with their families.

🤸 Monthly wellness & meals stipend: Used for any kind of physical, mental or emotional care you'd like to take for yourself, be it a gym membership, a meditation app, or time with a personal trainer - plus lunch and coffee during the workday.

🧠 Professional Growth: Opportunities for career development and personal growth are provided to all employees who seek to further their knowledge and capabilities through an unlimited professional development fund. Additionally team members are encouraged to regularly attend conferences and industry events.

We are really excited about having you join our mission-driven team and help us build the future of online privacy!

title: Executive Director - Cybersecurity and IT Operations
description:
Overview

General Summary of the Position

The Director of Cybersecurity and IT Operations leads cybersecurity, technology infrastructure, service delivery, cloud and on-premises platforms, and information systems across the Diocese of Dallas. The role protects information, maintains reliable operations, directs technology initiatives, and promotes responsible stewardship for the Pastoral Center, Parishes, Catholic Schools, and other Diocesan entities.

In collaboration with the Diocesan Leadership Team, the Director establishes policies and standards governing the appropriate use of technology, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence across all Diocesan entities. The Director is responsible for the security, reliability, performance, and strategic direction of the Diocese's technology environment. Services may be delivered by internal staff, managed service providers, contractors, consultants, or other partners; however, the Director monitors performance, manages risk and retains accountability for results. The Director fulfills these responsibilities in accordance with the teachings, mission, values, and stewardship principles of the Catholic Church and the Diocese of Dallas.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities of the Position

title: Model Risk Governance and Review Associate for Corporate Aligned - Model Risk Program Associate
description:
Bring your Expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient.   • Document validation processes and results, communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders
  • Design model performance metrics and evaluate model performance on a regular basis.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interface with other functional areas in the firm on model-related issues and write high quality technical reports.
  • Deep understanding of standard statistical techniques as well as AI/ML methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to implement benchmarking models in Python, R, or equivalent
  • Risk- and control-oriented mindset: ability to ask incisive questions, assess the materiality of model issues, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Familiarity with generative AI models
  • Advanced proficiency in programming languages
  • Experience with model governance frameworks

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Department of Chemistry - UTK
description:
The position of Postdoctoral Research Associate is open in the research group of Prof. Konstantinos Vogiatzis in the Department of Chemistry at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, in collaboration with the Y-12 National Security Complex. The researcher will perform atomistic simulations of materials for catalytic applications. All candidates must have successfully defended and submitted their dissertation before their employment date. The search starts immediately and continues until the position is filled.

The researcher will be responsible to develop, test, and deploy computational workflows for atomistic modeling of chemical processed on material surfaces related to catalytic applications and collaborate with researchers from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville and Y-12 National Security Complex. Research will involve feedback loops between theory and experiment, evaluating chemical reaction networks and catalytic mechanisms. Position may require security clearance.

  • The Vogiatzis Group focuses on the development and application of novel computational modeling methods that interface classical mechanics, quantum mechanics, and artificial intelligence.

  • The ideal postdoctoral research associate candidate will work on assigned research projects as well as on mentoring of undergraduate and graduate students.

  • The postdoctoral research associate candidate must be knowledgeable and experienced in classical simulations, quantum chemical methods, materials science, catalysis, surface chemistry, and/or artificial intelligence and machine learning.

  • Responsible for presenting and reporting research results and publishing scientific results in peer reviewed journals in a timely manner.

  • Ensure compliance with environment, safety, health and quality program requirements.

  • Maintain strong commitment to the implementation and perpetuation of values and ethics.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Must have successfully defended and submitted dissertation by hire date, Ph.D. in chemistry, physics, materials science, chemical engineering, or closely related field.
  • Experience:

    • An excellent track record of productive and creative research demonstrated by publications in peer reviewed journals.

    • Strong verbal and writing skills.

    • The candidate must be willing to work independently and collaboratively with group members, and preferably also with experimental collaborators.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Ability to set priorities, multi-task and adapt to ever changing needs with the proven ability to function well in a fast-paced environment.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without need now or in the future for sponsorship for employment-based visa status.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience: Research experience in atomistic modeling, AIMD, MLIPs, catalysis.
  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Scientific programming

Work Location

  • Knoxville, TN,

  • On site, and will travel for work at Y-12 National Security Complex.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $60,000 - $65,000
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

Please complete the on-line application (https://hr.utk.edu/staff-positions) for full consideration. For best consideration, provide the following in the application file before November 1, 2026:

  • Cover letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Transcript

  • List of three references (with current e-mail address and phone number/s) in the application file. One reference must be your current supervisor.

A review of all applications will begin immediately.

About The Department

The University of Tennessee in Knoxville is the flagship educational institution in the State of Tennessee, and the Department of Chemistry is its oldest PhD granting Department. We offer a long-standing tradition of excellence in chemical research and education, stretching from 1947, when the department granted the University’s first PhD degree, to the present. We have people from diverse cultures providing an international business environment.

The city of Knoxville is a hidden gem with a beautiful and walkable downtown, a diverse music scene, active neighborhoods, unique restaurants, and a robust offering of outdoor and cultural activities. UTK is located within easy driving distance to Asheville, Nashville, Atlanta, and the Great Smoky Mountains; and a day’s drive to Memphis, Chicago and Washington D.C. Knoxville and the surrounding counties have a statistical area population of over 850,000 people. The Knoxville region houses many leading corporations, including Bush Brothers & Company, Discovery Inc., Tennessee Valley Authority, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

title: Sr Education Researcher & Technical Assistance (TA) Specialist (part time)
description:
Overview

SRI Education staff support ECE practitioners, program administrators, and policy leaders to identify and implement evidence practices that promote equitable child and family outcomes. We provide rigorous research and evaluation services, develop innovative solutions to current education and human services challenges, and provide training and technical assistance to strengthen learning outcomes for all young children and families and the systems that serve them. Our work covers a range of topics: early learning and development, disability, and inclusion, supporting multilingual learners, student behavior and well-being, teaching quality, digital learning, STEM and computer science, and literacy and language arts, and college and career pathways.

We are seeking an experienced professional —Senior Education Researcher & Technical Assistance (TA) Specialist—who can develop and deliver state-of-the-art TA that addresses education and human services priorities by conducting needs assessments and strategic planning; planning and delivering tailored and responsive services and supports; delivering training; facilitating workgroups and communities of practice; developing toolkits, briefs, and other dissemination products; and providing evaluation and analytic support. The successful candidate will communicate effectively with philanthropic and state leaders, TA participants, clients, and colleagues inside and outside of SRI. The position will require completion of a wide range of TA, research and evaluation, project management and support activities, working closely with project directors, clients, and other senior staff.

This is a part-time temporary position 15-20 hours per week and can work fully remotely.

Responsibilities

Technical assistance activities may include the following:

  • Examining evidence-based practices in many topics relevant to early childhood care and education systems, including data use and continuous quality improvement, and policies and practices that promote equity.
  • Using best practices in TA provisions, support states’ implementation of comprehensive early childhood education systems.
  • Providing a range of TA activities/strategies/approaches to address the wide variety of TA needs (i.e., universal, targeted, and intensive) and adult learning principles.
  • Establishing and maintaining data governance structures and processes across a variety of data assets (e.g., federal and state administrative data, survey data); facilitating data linking processes; and promoting advanced levels of data use.
  • Generating well-structured, clear and concise TA products and technical reports.

Research activities may include the following:

  • Leading and carrying out moderately complex data collection and analysis tasks and developing summary reports.
  • Developing research designs, using quantitative and qualitative research methods, to investigate the impacts of policy and practice.
  • Analyzing data, including state- and federal-level administrative data, and using effective data visualization techniques to communicate results to interested parties.

Project management activities will include the following:

  • Prior experience leading successful projects and proposals (of any size) for state and/or federal agencies (e.g., Department of Education, Department of Health and Human Services’ Administration for Children and Families), foundations, or commercial clients.
  • Establishing and meeting project timelines, within budget constraints.

Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Education, Psychology, human services, public policy administration, or other social science field (e.g., social work) with a minimum of 3 years of related experience or a Master’s degree and 6 years of related TA and research experience preferred.

Desired Qualifications:The ideal candidate for this position has demonstrated ability to lead tasks on large projects; contributes independent recommendations related to project activities; is able to adapt to changes in client priorities; is comfortable with technology; and takes individual responsibility to complete work assigned with minimal supervision. The candidate has experience providing technical assistance around evaluation and data collections through the data lifecycle; demonstrated organizational skills; the ability to manage multiple tasks and work with many team members; experience working with marginalized and multi-lingual populations, and excellent verbal and written communication skills.

The salary range is: $50-$66/hr. Salary ranges will vary and are based on several factors, including geographic location, market competitiveness and equity amongst internal employees in similar roles. Positions may also qualify for SRI's Pay for Outstanding Performance program or the annual Performance Based Compensation program. SRI also has a competitive benefits package, to view details please go to https://www.sri.com/resources/benefits/. SRI will accept applications until the position is filled.

SRI is an independent nonprofit research institute headquartered in Menlo Park, Calif., with a rich history of supporting government and industry. We create and deliver world-changing solutions for a safer, healthier, and more sustainable future. title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Department of Chemistry - UTK
description:
The research projects of Prof. Yingwen Cheng’s Group focuses on developing new chemical principles to explain and control electrochemical processes for inter conversion of electrical and chemical energy. Outcomes of our work contribute to electricity-driven chemical manufacturing and storage of renewable electricity for transportation and smart power grid. We are especially interested in studying well-defined materials with systematically tunable variables to extract fundamental insights. Major topics for the near future include: 1) solid active motifs design for electrocatalytic conversion of small molecules; 2) new electrochemical interfaces for extreme batteries; 3) new ways to modulate electrochemical processes via external forces and 4) synthesis of novel nanostructures with predictable functions.

  • The ideal postdoctoral research associate candidate will work on assigned research projects as well as mentor graduate and undergraduate students.

  • The postdoctoral research associate candidate must be knowledgeable and experienced in electrochemistry, analytical chemistry and materials chemistry.

  • Responsible for presenting and reporting research results and publishing scientific results in peer reviewed journals in a timely manner.

  • Ensure compliance with environment, safety, health and quality program requirements.

  • Maintain strong commitment to the implementation and perpetuation of values and ethics.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Must have successfully defended and submitted dissertation by hire date, Ph.D. in chemistry or closely related field.
  • Experience:

    • An excellent track record of productive and creative research demonstrated by publications in peer reviewed journals.

    • The postdoctoral candidate must have strong verbal and writing skills. The candidate must be willing to work independently and collaboratively with group members, and preferably also with experimental collaborators. The candidate must also be willing to mentor the graduate students in the group from time to time.

    • Motivated and safety conscious.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Ability to set priorities, multi-task and adapt to ever changing needs with the proven ability to function well in a fast-paced environment.

Work Location

  • Knoxville, TN, on site

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $60,000.00
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Transcript
  • List of at least three references (with current e-mail address and phone number/s) in the application file. One reference must be your current supervisor.

A review of all applications will begin immediately.

About The Department

The University of Tennessee in Knoxville is the flagship educational institution in the State of Tennessee, and the Department of Chemistry is its oldest PhD granting Department. We offer a long-standing tradition of excellence in chemical research and education, stretching from 1947, when the department granted the University’s first PhD degree, to the present. We have people from diverse cultures providing an international business environment. The city of Knoxville is a hidden gem with a beautiful and walkable downtown, a diverse music scene, active neighborhoods, unique restaurants, and a robust offering of outdoor and cultural activities. UTK is located within easy driving distance to Asheville, Nashville, Atlanta, and the Great Smoky Mountains; and a day’s drive to Memphis, Chicago and Washington D.C. Knoxville and the surrounding counties have a statistical area population of over 850,000 people. The Knoxville region houses many leading corporations, including Bush Brothers & Company, Discovery Inc., Tennessee Valley Authority, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Department of Earth, Environmental, and Planetary Sciences - UTK
description:
As part of the Earth and Planetary Materials Group led by PI Nicholas Dygert, and a NASA-funded lunar science research consortium, the successful applicant will investigate the Moon’s evolutionary history. Avenues of exploration may include but are not limited to differentiation, magmatism, and petrogenesis. The candidate will also pursue research related to planet Mercury’s differentiation and evolution. The initial appointment will be for one year, with reappointment contingent upon sufficient progress as assessed in performance evaluations. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

The candidate will pursue lunar and Mercurian research as directed by the PI or as practicable, of their own design, present new results at science meetings, publish in peer-reviewed journals, and seek external employment. The candidate is expected to contribute to a positive and dynamic research climate in the group and department by enthusiastically participating in events, seminars and symposia. Responsibilities may include student mentorship.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Doctorate in Geoscience or a related field at the time of appointment or have completed all their doctoral degree requirements, and a record of at least one peer-reviewed publication.
  • Experience:
    • A publication record in planetary geoscience, broadly defined (including studies relevant to Earth).
    • Experience running high-pressure, high-temperature experiments.
    • Background in experimental petrology.

Work Location

Knoxville, Tennessee, onsite

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $65,000
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

For best consideration applicants should submit the below materials before October 15th, 2026

  • Cover letter,

About The Department

The Department of Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences maintains a dynamic research climate and has been at the forefront of Lunar and Planetary Sciences for decades. The Department has abundant experimental and analytical resources including a new electron probe microanalyzer and LA-QQQ-ICP-MS system. Knoxville is in the foothills of the Smoky and Blue Ridge mountains; in addition to mountains, East Tennessee has abundant inland waterways and pristine state and national parks. Knoxville is a thriving city with vibrant indoor and outdoor entertainment venues, restaurants, shops, and cultural offerings.

title: Communications Lead
description:
About Mind:

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

About the team and the role:

We're looking for a senior communications leader to serve as our first dedicated comms hire and primary partner to our CEO. You will own both his public profile as it relates to Mind Robotics – earned media, podcast placements, press interviews, and executive voice – and the company's internal communications as we scale. You are a builder who can operate without a team, move fast, and do the work. This role will shape the narrative and public opinion for Mind Robotics’ next phase of growth.

Responsibilities:

CEO & Executive Communications

  • Serve as the CEO's day-to-day communications partner: briefing docs, media prep, talking points, and message development for all public appearances.

  • Drive a proactive earned media strategy—pitch and secure placements on high-impact podcasts, business and tech press, and conference stages.

  • Own the CEO's editorial output: op-eds, public statements, and investor-facing communications.

  • Build and maintain relationships with journalists, podcast producers, and editors on the CEO's behalf.

External & Corporate Communications

  • Develop and own the company's messaging architecture, narrative positioning, and crisis communications framework.

  • Lead all media relations: serve as primary press contact, manage inbound inquiries, and produce press materials for key milestones.

  • Support fundraising and product launch communications in partnership with leadership, finance, and legal.

Internal Communications

  • Design and run the company's internal communications infrastructure: all-hands formats, leadership updates, and the cadences that keep a growing team aligned.

  • Write company-wide announcements, organizational change communications, and culture moments in a consistent, on-brand voice.

  • Partner with HR and People Ops on employee experience communications as the team scales.

Requirements:

External

  • CEO media strategy: Develop a 6-month earned media roadmap with target outlets, podcast targets, and placement calendar within first 30 days.

  • Press kit & messaging house: Build a foundational messaging architecture and press kit (company backgrounder, CEO bio, boilerplate, FAQs) within first 45 days.

  • First placements: Secure at least 2–3 meaningful CEO media placements (podcast appearances or press features) within the first 90 days.

  • Launch playbook: Partner with Rivian's communications team to co-develop artifacts, playbooks, and SOPs for initial operator deployments — establishing a repeatable framework for all future launch communications.

Internal

  • All-hands framework: Audit existing all-hands format and deliver a redesigned structure—agenda, narrative arc, CEO prep guide—within first 30 days.

  • Internal comms cadence: Stand up a recurring internal newsletter or leadership update channel (Slack, email, or equivalent) by day 60.

  • New hire communications: Develop onboarding communications materials that orient new employees to company mission, culture, and leadership voice.

  • Cultural moment coverage: Own communications around at least one major internal milestone (hiring milestone, product update, company offsite) end-to-end within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 8–12+ years in communications, with significant in-house experience at a technology company; Director-level or equivalent.

  • Proven track record managing executive communications for a founder-CEO or senior leader with an active public profile.

  • Strong media relationships across tech and business press; existing podcast producer and digital media contacts a strong plus.

  • Exceptional writer across all formats—press releases, executive narrative, internal memos, and editorial content.

  • Startup builder mentality: comfortable owning a function end-to-end, creating structure from ambiguity, and operating without a team.

  • Experience in deep tech, robotics, automotive, or adjacent industries preferred.

title: Video Streaming & Real-Time Media Architect

title: Director of Community Services, North
description:

description:

At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

title: Event Security Officer
description:
Job Description

Part-Time; Event BasedWage & Pay Grade: $23.36/hr. (PG 41) plus 10% in lieu of Benefits and VacationDate Posted: October 5, 2026

Who we are…

The Pacific National Exhibition is an iconic institution in BC, famous for bringing generations of people together to celebrate and build memories. This 116-year-old, non-profit organization has an annual operating budget of over $70 million dollars and generates revenue through four activity streams: the 15-day annual summer Fair which averages more than 700,000 people annually, Playland amusement park which welcomes 400,000 guests annually including Fright Nights, and a busy year-round portfolio of events including concerts, trade shows and film, cultural and community events. In total we bring over 2 million people through the site each year. The fourth activity stream is park care and facility maintenance. The PNE is proud of the work it does at Hastings Park and has a vibrant team that is passionate about events, guest experience and delivering memorable experiences.

At the PNE, we strive to create an environment that reflects our organization’s core values: Enthusiasm, Excellence and Evolution. With a focus on these core values, we are committed to achieving our mission which is to “Deliver Memorable Experiences” for all who interact with the PNE whether it is our guests, our employees, or the community.

We are looking for diligent and talented individuals to join our PNE Public Safety Team and help us maintain a safe environment for all guests and team members. Event Security Officers of the Public Safety team will work under the direction of the Manager, Public Safety & Guest Experience.

The Public Safety Team provides services to a wide variety of events such as tradeshows, concerts, and fairs in various PNE Venues including:

  • Pacific Coliseum
  • PNE Forum
  • PNE Amphitheater
  • Rollerland
  • Playland
  • The PNE Fair
  • Fright Nights

Why join our Team?

  • Exhilarating and fun-loving culture
  • Opportunity for free or discounted tickets to shows, events, sports games, and much more.
  • Staff discounts for Playland, The Fair, and Fright Nights, as well as all PNE Food Stands
  • Opportunity to create lasting memories and friendships!
  • Free staff parking *Excluding Fair-Time Parking
  • Opportunity for professional development

What will you do this year?

In your role as an Event Security Officer, your primary accountabilities will be to:

  • Provide exceptional and friendly guest service.
  • Greet and assist guests and staff in a friendly and courteous manner.
  • Ensure a safe environment for the enjoyment of guests and staff.
  • Deal with loud and unruly guests in a calm and diplomatic manner
  • Mediate disputes on-site and remove unruly or dangerous guests from the premises.
  • Search for lost guests and items as required.
  • Ensure that PNE Uniform and Appearance policy is always adhered to.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What else?

  • Must have successful completion of grade 12.
  • Must have a valid BC Security License
  • Previous security experience is required; event security experience is preferred.
  • Must have basic knowledge of applicable laws, legal rights, and responsibilities associated with security personnel.
  • Must possess sufficient physical strength, stamina, and coordination to perform the assigned tasks.
  • Must be highly motivated and able to work alone.
  • Must be capable of reading, writing, and speaking in English for the purposes of written or oral instructions.
  • Must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively deal with a variety of situations while maintaining a calm and flexible demeanour.
  • Must be able to work a variety of shifts, primarily Thursday to Sunday
  • Ability to work evenings, late nights, and weekends is preferred.
  • Advanced security training and supervisory experience considered an asset.
  • Occupational First Aid Level I considered an asset.
  • Successful candidates must undergo a Criminal Record Check.

Who are you?

  • Organized
  • Methodical
  • Proactive
  • Skillful communicator
  • Critical thinker
  • Committed to striving for excellence.

Where and when to APPLY?

Applications can be submitted via the PNE website at www.pne.ca/jobs and will be accepted until the role is filled.

Preference will be given to candidates who submit their resume/cover letter before Sunday, October, 18th. We look forward to hearing from you!

The PNE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive workforce that reflects the diverse community we proudly serve. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or age. If you require any support or accommodations throughout any stage of the recruitment process, please contact the People & Culture Department at hr@pne.ca.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Overview

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will work with our team and our clients to analyze mission and business needs, gather and refine requirements, and translate complex information into clear, actionable requirements for project teams. You will review and interpret technical, programmatic, and other project documentation to understand requirements, identify dependencies and gaps, and support successful solution delivery.

We are looking for an experienced analyst with strong communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills who can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Contributions

  • Lead requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and refinement activities with clients, stakeholders, and project teams.
  • Review, interpret, and analyze technical, programmatic, and business documentation to identify and understand requirements.
  • Translate business and mission needs into clear, actionable functional and technical requirements.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders, customers, developers, and other technical team members to clarify requirements and support solution development.
  • Identify requirements gaps, dependencies, risks, and areas requiring additional stakeholder clarification.
  • Facilitate requirements discussions, workshops, and working sessions to develop a shared understanding of project needs and priorities.
  • Break down complex requirements into well-defined features, user stories, and acceptance criteria to support development teams.
  • Support Agile planning and delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and other requirements-focused ceremonies.
  • Maintain requirements documentation and traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Communicate complex technical and business concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support project teams in evaluating proposed solutions against documented requirements.
  • You will contribute to the growth of our team and support successful delivery of mission-focused solutions.

Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst supporting technical projects and solutions.

  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and technical requirements.

  • Experience reviewing and interpreting technical, programmatic, and business documentation to understand and define requirements.

  • Experience translating complex business and mission needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and support solution delivery.

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with an ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills with a customer-centric approach.

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience supporting AI-related projects.

The Qualified Professional provides Intensive In-Home case management and rehabilitative services for children and adolescents with behavioral and mental health needs. Services are delivered primarily in the client's home and community and are guided by each individual's Person-Centered Plan. This position works collaboratively with the licensed therapist, family members, schools, and other providers to ensure coordinated, quality care.

This position is compensated on a per-contact (billable service) basis. Qualified Professionals have the flexibility to manage their schedules while meeting the needs of assigned families and maintaining productivity expectations.

At Youth Haven Services, you'll become part of a team committed to helping children and families thrive. We value collaboration, integrity, and compassionate care while providing opportunities to make a meaningful impact every day.

title: Solution Architect, Technical/Infrastructure Projects
description:
At E Source, we help utilities make sense of complexity in a rapidly changing landscape, and we’re looking for a Solution Architect to help shape how that impact shows up in the world.

E Source is a research, data/analytics, and technology focused professional services firm focused exclusively on the utility industry in the US and Canada. We help utilities target and serve their customers more effectively, enhance and optimize their grid, and leverage operating best practices and technologies to manage their business more effectively. Headquartered in Texas, we have 450+ employees across the US and Canada. Learn more at

As a Solution Architect, you’ll play a key role in assessing, designing, and implementing the network and infrastructure systems behind technical and infrastructure projects, including cybersecurity and operational technology (OT) network work. You’ll work closely with a program manager, project managers, and technical teams to shape how networks, servers, databases, applications, and workstations come together, helping ensure our work is not only smart, but clear, relevant, and actionable. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of IT infrastructure, network architecture, and OT security, brings strong judgment to complex problems, and wants to contribute to work that shapes real-world decisions in the energy industry.

In this role, you will:

  • Assess current network design, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless systems, segmentation, and monitoring tools, and recommend changes

  • Review architecture documentation remotely, and provide onsite support to gather network topology information for systems that can’t be accessed remotely

  • Identify critical gaps, legacy systems, and technical debt across business and technical environments, and recommend improvements

  • Translate business and technical requirements into architectural blueprints, and document all solution architecture design and analysis work

  • Support the design and implementation of technical and infrastructure systems for cybersecurity and OT network projects

  • Implement network routes that allow monitoring tools to communicate between sites

  • Support the deployment and integration of physical and virtual servers, databases, and workstations, from configuration through operational readiness

  • Coordinate with network, server, database, security, application, and operations teams to make sure every part of the solution is properly integrated

  • Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, access, and performance issues across new, existing, and legacy systems, including systems no longer supported by the original manufacturer

  • Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, network drawings, implementation plans, and operational and support documentation

  • Provide onsite or remote support during testing, cutover, stabilization, and handoff to operations teams

You’re likely a great fit if you:

  • Have a strong general understanding of both modern and legacy technology stacks

  • Can troubleshoot across interconnected network, server, application, database, and security environments

  • Turn business and technical requirements into infrastructure solutions that can be implemented

  • Communicate clearly, in writing and in conversation, with project managers, technical and cybersecurity teams, vendors, and business stakeholders

  • Work well as part of a project team led by a program or project manager

And even better if you:

  • Have experience working with or around utilities, energy, consulting, research, or adjacent fields

  • Understand IT/OT network architecture, segmentation, security zones, and defense-in-depth principles, including the Purdue Model and IT/OT demilitarized zone (DMZ) architecture

  • Are familiar with industrial control system (ICS) and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) environments, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human-machine interfaces (HMIs), remote terminal units (RTUs), historians, and engineering workstations

  • Know industrial protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC/OPC UA, and EtherNet/IP

  • Are familiar with cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST SP 800-82, ISA/IEC 62443, or the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework

  • Can assess legacy or unsupported OT technologies and recommend appropriate compensating controls

  • Have hands-on experience with tools such as Cisco, Juniper, or Aruba networking; Palo Alto or Fortinet firewalls; Wireshark, SolarWinds, or PRTG; Splunk, QRadar, or Microsoft Sentinel; Dragos, Claroty, or Nozomi; VMware or Hyper-V; Active Directory or Entra ID; and PowerShell, Python, or Ansible

Experience and Skills to Qualify Include:

  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, infrastructure architecture, network engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical role

  • Experience assessing, designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network and infrastructure environments

  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, firewalls, virtual local area networks (VLANs), network segmentation, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, virtual private networks (VPNs), and network monitoring

  • Experience across servers, databases, applications, workstations, virtualization, and network infrastructure

  • Experience developing network and architecture diagrams, technical designs, implementation plans, and operational documentation

  • Experience supporting both legacy and modern technology environments, including integration and compatibility needs

At E Source, you’ll work alongside people who are thoughtful, curious, and deeply knowledgeable about utility and energy systems. We value clarity over jargon, substance over flash, and collaboration over ego. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and help shape a company that plays a real role in how the energy future unfolds.

What you can expect

  • Excellent insurance options, including medical, dental, and vision plans; company-paid life insurance; company-paid long- and short-term disability insurance; medical and dependent-care flexible spending plans, and paid parental leave.

  • A flexible time off (FTO) policy that provides paid time away from work, approved by your manager, while ensuring business needs, workload commitments, and appropriate coverage are maintained.

  • A 401(k) plan with a 3% employer match.

The budgeted salary for this position is $100,000 to $125,000 USD + annual bonus. Actual pay will be adjusted based on experience.

This role will be remote, with onsite support at project sites as needed (up to 25%).

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US or Canada. We’re unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas or Labour Market Impact Assessments (Cdn) at this time.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employees of E Source are encouraged to apply. To foster a positive work environment and company culture, we support our employees in their career growth at E Source. If you are interested in similar job opportunities in the future, visit the E Source careers page for a listing of all open positions and contact Human Resources.

We contact applicants directly via email using only our designated company email addresses with the domain of @. Please do not provide personal information to anyone over email and be wary of other accounts impersonating businesses.

title: Director of Room Operations
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the strategic business leader of the property's Rooms Operations. Areas of responsibility include Front Office, Recreation/Health Club and Housekeeping. Position works with direct reports (department heads) to develop and implement departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures Rooms Operations meet the brand’s standards, targets customer needs, ensures associate satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

Managing Profitability

• Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.

• Analyzes service issues and identifies trends.

• Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

• Works with Rooms management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.

Managing Revenue Goals

• Monitors Rooms operations sales performance against budget.

• Reviews reports and financial statements to determine Rooms operations performance against budget.

• Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.

Leading Operations and Department Teams

• Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the Rooms leadership teams.

• Develops systems to enable associates to understand guest satisfaction results.

• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

Managing the Guest Experience

• Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

title: Dietitian
description:
Our Company

Rehab Without Walls Neuro Rehabilitation

Overview

Rehab Without Walls is seeking an experienced Registered Dietitian (RD) in Irving, TX to join our team. You'll provide personalized nutrition support and education to patients recovering from a neurological diagnsosis, such as TBI/CVA. If you thrive with schedule flexibility, clinical autonomy, and a supportive team environment, apply today!

The RWW Difference:

  • Flexible Schedule Created by You
  • Paid per hour (not just per visit)
  • In-Person, 1:1 therapy with indirect services completed from home (documentation/communication)
  • Continuity of Care as the Primary Therapist from Eval to Discharge
  • Team collaboration & Co-Treats
  • Drive Time reimbursed at your clinical rate + Mileage Reimbursement
  • No weekend shifts
  • Educational Program Access
  • Growth/Advancement Opportunities

Responsibilities

  • Provides professional nutritional services in compliance with state practice act(s)/professional standards to meet the individual needs of patients. Ensures adherence with applicable government laws/regulations, company policies/procedures and healthcare standards. Works under general supervision
  • Interviews patients and assesses/evaluates their nutritional status. Determines the patients' dietary needs and advises the patient's physician/nursing personnel
  • Confers with the patient's physician to establish dietary treatments/requirements. Prepares and calculates therapeutic diets to meet the specific requirements of patients
  • Provides guidance/assistance/explanations to patients and family members to help them understand, accept, and follow dietary modifications ordered by the physician. Instructs patients and family members on dietary restrictions and drug/nutrient interactions as appropriate
  • Observes patients' responses to dietary treatment, notes changes in their condition and advises physicians/Nurse Supervisors and/or Clinical Coordinators. Revises nutritional plan as appropriate based on patients' condition and physician’s orders
  • Ensures the confidentiality of patients' files and documentation
  • Maintains/enhances clinical practice skills by attending, participating in/conducting staff development/ continuing education programs.
  • Participates in quality assessment and improvement activities as assigned. Communicates information that enables data collection/root cause analysis to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Maintains the highest standards of professional conduct in relation to information that is confidential in nature. Shares information only when recipient's right to access is clearly established and sharing of such information is in the best interest of the patient
  • Adheres to and participates in Company’s mandatory Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act privacy program/practices and Business Ethics and Compliance programs/practices
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Degree in Nutrition required, or the equivalent
  • Current Registered Dietician licensure/certification in the state(s) of practice required by individual states(s)
  • Minimum of six months related experience generally required

About our Line of Business

Rehab Without Walls, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, is a revolutionary neurorehabilitation program that moves individuals outside the walls of institutional settings and into their natural home and community environment through a continuum of care. It is designed to significantly help people who have primarily experienced a brain injury, spinal cord injury, or stroke/CVA through accident or illness regain functional capabilities. By providing care in the home, community, workplace, or school, Rehab Without Walls promotes greater health through the recovery process, all with industry-leading outcomes that dramatically improve functional skills and independence for patients. For more information, please visit www.rehabwithoutwalls.com. Follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn.

title: Strategic Buyer
description:
Position Summary

The Buyer is responsible for managing a designated group of supplier accounts based on product type or commodity and supporting the Purchasing Department’s organizational and operational objectives.

This role manages key aspects of the supplier relationship and sourcing process, including identifying and evaluating new suppliers, developing and managing sourcing strategies, obtaining and analyzing quotations, negotiating costs and terms, monitoring supplier delivery and quality performance, and supporting new product development and launch activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, evaluate, audit, and recommend new suppliers based on their ability to provide products or services that are strategically aligned with the current and future needs of Viking Corporation.
  • Request, obtain, and analyze quotations from qualified suppliers to ensure product design and sourcing requirements are met.
  • Coordinate with Viking’s Research & Development and Quality departments to ensure suppliers meet required product design and quality standards.
  • Negotiate supplier costs, terms, and other commercial conditions to support overall cost targets.
  • Manage and monitor supplier on-time delivery performance.
  • Implement necessary corrective actions to address supplier performance issues.
  • Manage total landed cost for assigned product types or commodities, including raw material costs, supplier processing costs, inventory costs, freight costs, and other applicable expenses.
  • Monitor raw material cost trends and utilize market information to support supplier cost negotiations.
  • Partner with suppliers to identify and implement Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce costs and improve efficiency. Examples may include establishing consignment inventory programs, developing Kanban programs, and utilizing blanket orders with multiple releases to improve inventory turns.

title: Substation Technician A (GTC)
description:
Position Summary: Substation Technician- A is a non-exempt position in the construction, maintenance and repair of substation equipment / systems. Substation Technician- A has a 6-8 year continuous working knowledge of 525 kv and below substation equipment, apparatus, and wiring. This position requires work in confined spaces and in elevated work areas, and works with various pieces of construction equipment specific to the trade. A Substation Technician A may work independently or with others, occasionally work long hours during emergency conditions. This position should be able to lead/coach subordinates on the crew. This position works at various locations. The position may also be required to travel to another state depending on customer demands.

**NOTE: TRAVEL TO OTHER STATES/LOCATIONS IS REQUIRED

Essential Functions:

  • Works safely while performing new construction, maintenance or repair, testing, adjusting and troubleshooting work of substation equipment/systems which includes, but is not limited to, work involving the following:
  • Concrete Foundations, ground grids, and steel erection
  • Buswork (High and Low Voltage)
  • Airbreak / Hookstick Switches
  • Control Cable
  • Terminations (High / Low Voltage)
  • Control Buildings
  • Conduit and duck banks
  • Capacitor bank installations 23kv- 230 kv
  • Transformers, regulators and circuit breakers
  • Circuit Switchers, motor-operated and manual switches
  • Responsible for maintaining Company vehicles, test equipment and tools in good working conditions
  • Frequently works with energized high voltage systems requiring skill and care to protect the lives of themselves and others.

Minimum Responsibilities:

  • Able to perform rigorous physical labor.
  • Must be capable of climbing and working at heights up to 125 feet above ground.
  • Must possess a Commercial Drivers’ License.
  • Must supply own personal hand tools required by the company for this work.
  • Must supply own safety toed work boots.
  • Must be capable of lifting in excess of 50 lbs.
  • Must be capable of working in confined spaces/areas.
  • Must be able to work independently or with others.
  • Operational experience of various types of heavy equipment :
  • Bucket, derrick and boom trucks
  • Backhoes, excavators and skid steer loaders
  • Articulating Man-lifts
  • Pressure Diggers
  • Trenchers
  • Track Crawler Loader/Backhoe
  • Rough Terrain Telescopic Forklifts
  • Willing to work over-time or long hours during emergency conditions and/or when requested. Schedules can change frequently and with short notice.
  • 90% Travel Required
  • Capable of following Company safety rules and policies.
  • Must have extensive knowledge of construction standard practices, techniques, quality requirements, applicable codes and standards.
  • Must be capable of working in close proximity of energized substation equipment.
  • Must interpret substation structural drawings (i.e. elevations, plan views, section views, grounding details, and foundation plans) and communicate with customers and subordinates.
  • Ability to accurately appraise technical situations and recommend resolutions to problems.
  • Ability to lead/coach subordinates on the crew.
  • Ability to develop and interpret a material list.
  • Ability to trace out phasing in a substation and verify to the three line diagrams.
  • Proficient knowledge in all aspects of substation systems.
  • Ability to determine the proper phase shift and rotation in paralleling transformer banks.
  • Capable of running the job during the absence of the Foreman
  • Ability to establish grade, elevations, and layout of foundations and cable trough in new and existing stations.
  • Willing to work over-time when requested.
  • Willing to work outside of the normal work schedule including weekends, holidays, and overtime as required for the position.

The employee is occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. title: Part-Time Dance Educator
description:
Overview

Part-Time Dance Educator Days: Tuesday Hours: 7:55am-11:25am Pay: $30 per hour Founded in 1997, Think Together partners with schools to change the odds for kids by providing award-winning programs during and outside the school day. We’re one of California’s largest nonprofits working in school districts from San Diego to San Francisco. Whether you’re interested in early learning, elementary, middle or high school, you can invest in your community by working at a local school or working within our home office providing support!

JOB SUMMARY:

Under the direction of the Coordinator of Teaching and Learning, Supplemental, the Dance

Teacher provides specialized expertise in Dance through the Visual and Performing Arts (VAPA) Content Standards and Framework for California Public Schools. Supports sequential, standards based instruction for students, fostering a positive environment for learning, creativity, and personal growth. Builds effective rapport with students, collaborates with staff and families, and helps students develop skills and knowledge that provide a foundation for future participation in the arts.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Teach lessons aligned to the California VAPA Content Standards in Dance.
  • Provide sequential instruction using discipline-specific techniques, tools, and practices (e.g., movement, choreography, and performance technique).
  • Develop and support partnerships with community organizations to enrich VAPA education and to expand access to resources, foster community engagement, and advance organizational impact.
  • Collaborate with staff and administration to plan and organize performances, showcases, or exhibitions.
  • Attend staff meetings, parent conferences, and evening school programs, which may include school performances, that require student supervision.
  • Instruct students in citizenship, basic communication skills, and other elements of the course of study specified in state law and District Administrative Regulations and procedures.
  • Develop lesson plans and instructional materials and provide scaffolded lessons in order to adapt the curriculum to the needs of each student.
  • Translate lesson plans into learning experiences to best utilize the available time for instruction.
  • Establish and maintain standards of student behavior needed to achieve a functional learning atmosphere in the classroom.
  • Report progress of students to classroom teachers and parents as needed in accordance with VAPA standards.
  • Maintain clear, consistent, and meaningful communication with parents and guardians through a variety of channels to keep families informed, build strong relationships, and support student success.
  • Identify and respond to individual student needs by collaborating with families and multidisciplinary staff to create supportive, inclusive learning environments that promote students’ well-being, engagement, and academic success. Create and maintain an effective, inclusive environment that supports student learning, engagement, and participation.
  • Collaborate with site administration to establish appropriate, organized, and accessible storage for program-specific equipment and materials (e.g., dance attire, costumes, and sound equipment).
  • Maintains professional competence through participation in service education activities provided by the district, school, and/or in self-selected professional growth activities.
  • Perform attendance accounting and business services as required.
  • Plan and coordinate the work of instructional assistants and other paraprofessionals.
  • Perform other duties as required.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  • 2+ years of practical/professional experience in area of dance concentration.
  • Successful experience teaching in grades TK-8 is preferred.

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Must pass Live Scan (criminal background check via fingerprinting).
  • Provide a clear TB test.
  • Reliable transportation is required to meet the needs of the position. Must be able to drive from administrative office to school sites.
  • Employees who operate a personal or company vehicle related to work location requirements must maintain, and provide Human Resources, proof of a valid driver’s license and automobile insurance.

KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:

KNOWLEDGE OF:

  • Recognized expertise in standards-based instruction, curriculum design, effective instructional strategies and techniques, assessment tools and professional development delivery systems specifically in the visual and performing arts disciplines.
  • Effective classroom management techniques.
  • Social emotional needs of students, along with an understanding of how to support student social emotional development needs.
  • Strong knowledge of culturally responsive and culturally relevant teaching.
  • Effective strategies for meeting the needs of various learners, to include English language learners.
  • Curriculum, instruction, and assessment processes and how they should operate in an effective school.
  • Applicable sections of State Education Code and other applicable state publications, such as curriculum frameworks.
  • Technology and computer software applications relative to instruction and administration.
  • California Standards for the Teaching Profession.

ABILITY TO:

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively teach dance to students by providing age appropriate instruction and demonstrating proper techniques and choreography.
  • Stimulate and motivate students to learn.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative relationships with students, school personnel, parents, coworkers, and the public.
  • Communicate effectively in the English language, both orally and in writing.
  • Disposition to connect with parents who speak another language than English, not allowing language barriers to get in the way of communication.
  • Meet schedules and timelines.
  • Work independently with appropriate direction.
  • Engage in collaborative teamwork in an effort to improve student achievement.
  • Analyze situations accurately and adopt an effective course of action.
  • Learn and use technology and computer software applications as appropriate to the ever-changing work environment.
  • Use tact, patience, and courtesy when dealing with people.
  • Use initiative and judgment in discussing problems with the public and district staff, involving office practices and policies.
  • Understand and be sensitive to those of culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds by being culturally competent.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

ENVIRONMENT:

  • Indoor/outdoor Classroom and Playground environment.

title: Project Manager
description:

Owns contract performance, cost, schedule and government relationships on federal and military roofing and wall panel projects. • CPARS ratings of Very Good or Exceptional on every project

• Monthly pay requests approved on first submittal
• Changes and REAs priced, negotiated and executed as bilateral modifications

Schedule

• Track long-lead items and installation constraints (access windows, mission impacts, weather)

Cost and payment
• Own the budget, cost-to-complete forecasts and margin
• Prepare monthly pay requests in PIEE (formerly WAWF) with schedule update, certified payrolls and as-builts

Labor compliance
• Enforce Davis-Bacon wage determinations for all trades, including subcontractors
• Collect and submit weekly certified payrolls (WH-347 or LCPtracker)

Team oversight and government relations
• Support the QC Manager's independence and the SSHO's stop-work authority
• Attend weekly QC and safety meetings and monthly progress meetings with the COR

Closeout
• Punch list, final inspection, as-builts, O&M data, warranties (incl. manufacturer NDL) and DD Form 1354 data
• Release of claims, final payment and lessons learned
• 5+ years managing commercial roofing or building envelope projects
• 3+ years on federal or military construction contracts
• Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS, Davis-Bacon, change and REA processes
• OSHA 30-Hour Construction
• RMS (contractor mode), PIEE and SAM.gov proficiency
• Primavera P6 scheduling
• Able to pass a background check and obtain installation access

PREFERRED
• CQM-C (Construction Quality Management for Contractors), current — required on many contracts
• EM 385-1-1 training (40-hour course)
• PMP, DBIA or CCM
• Bachelor's in construction management, engineering or related field

AUTHORITY
Signs subcontracts, purchase orders and change proposals within company limits; holds budget and schedule authority; may not override the QC Manager's or SSHO's stop-work decisions.

title: Branch Operations Lead - Century City - Los Angeles, CA
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Branch Operations Lead in a Chase Branch, you'll be at the heart of our branch operations, working closely with the Branch Manager, branch employees, and our team of experts. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our clients' financial transactions are handled with precision and care, all while adhering to our policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Your leadership will ensure that our branch not only meets but exceeds control expectations, setting a positive tone for everyone who walks through our doors.

Job responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Branch Manager to create a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere in the branch, ensuring every client enjoys an exceptional experience and feels part of a dynamic community.
  • Greet clients warmly as they enter the branch, making them feel valued and appreciated. Demonstrate genuine care and concern during interactions, assisting with transactions, managing lobby flow, and scheduling meetings to build trusted relationships.
  • Engage clients with clear, polite communication to understand and help them effectively. Anticipate their needs while checking them into the waiting queue, ensuring a smooth visit.
  • Lead branch operations, including managing cash devices like the cash vault and ATM. Resolve any client issues quickly and effectively, paying attention to detail and striving for consistency while adhering to all bank policies and procedures.
  • Introduce clients to our friendly branch team, who collaborate to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity. Work together to build lasting relationships and assist with any specialized financial needs, elevating the client experience.
  • Simplify clients' banking experience by sharing self-service options, allowing them to access their accounts anytime, day or night.
  • Work closely with the Branch Manager to support all aspects of branch operations, including maintaining high standards for loss control, compliance, and audits, ensuring the branch operates smoothly and securely.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You take pride in adhering to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.
  • You are committed to maintaining a keen eye for detail and staying organized, which helps you juggle multiple tasks effectively.
  • You are proud of your leadership skills and operational proficiency, ensuring transaction accuracy while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
  • You have a strong passion for educating the branch team and partners, helping them stay connected and informed.
  • You excel at building meaningful connections and engaging with clients, always ready to educate them and refer them to our team of experts when needed.
  • You have 1+ years of retail banking experience.
  • You have a high school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent.
  • You have the ability to work branch hours including weekends and evenings.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You have 6+ months of Associate Banker (Teller) experience.
  • You have a college degree or military equivalent.
Training and Travel Requirement
  • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.
  • You’ll need to be able to travel as required for in-person training and meetings.

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

title: Senior Project Manager - Professional Services
description:

As a Senior Project Manager in Avalara's Professional Services organization, you will lead the planning, governance, and end-to-end execution of large, complex, and high-visibility enterprise implementations for Avalara’s Excise platforms (AvaTax for Energy, Returns for Energy, AvaTax for Tobacco and Returns for Tobacco).

You will serve as a trusted advisor to customer executives, foresee and resolve critical escalations with limited management support, drive rigorous scope and risk management, and help mentor project managers across the practice.
#LI-Remote

Enterprise Program & Project Execution
  • Plan and execute large, strategic, and high-risk customer implementation programs from initial handoff through post-go-live hypercare and final project sign-off.

  • Provide strong leadership and direction to multi-disciplinary project teams (Senior Implementation Consultants, Technical Architects, Data Specialists, and Partner Consultants).
  • Proactively manage critical path activities, complex ERP dependencies (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle, PDI Enterprise), and customer cutover plans to ensure on-time delivery.
Proactive Risk Management & Executive Escalation
  • Identify, quantify, and mitigate complex program risks, technical constraints, and organizational bottlenecks before they impact project velocity.
  • Take proactive vs. reactive steps to guide and manage enterprise customer expectations, maintaining alignment across executive sponsors, Tax Directors, and IT leadership.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point on project health; resolve difficult customer disputes, timeline pushbacks, and priority conflicts with minimal managerial intervention.
  • Maintain rigorous scope control and lead commercial change order negotiations when requirements expand beyond the initial SOW.
Practice Leadership & Operational Excellence
  • Eligible to earn and serve with the distinction of Team Lead, mentoring, coaching, and onboarding Associate PMs and Project Managers
  • Champion operational best practices, contribute to the evolution of PSA workflows (Salesforce PSA / CPQ), and optimize revenue recognition and resource utilization reporting.
  • Lead post-project retrospectives, translating lessons learned into reusable delivery frameworks, playbooks, and standardized templates.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Required
  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive project/program management experience in enterprise SaaS implementations, professional services, or management consulting.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Operations, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Enterprise Delivery Mastery:
  • Proven track record of independently leading large, enterprise-grade software implementations from initiation to successful go-live.
  • Deep expertise in managing project scope, schedules, multi-stream budgets, risk registers (RAID), and formal change management procedures.
  • Advanced proficiency in Professional Services Automation (PSA) and collaboration platforms (e.g., Salesforce PSA, FinancialForce, Jira, Confluence).
  • Executive Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills with demonstrated experience presenting to VP- and C-level customer leadership.
AI Expectations
AI is deeply embedded in how we work, solve problems, and deliver for our customers. In this role, you will:
  • Apply AI Daily: Leverage AI tools and technologies in your daily workflow to materially increase speed, delivery quality, and problem-solving scale.
  • Drive Efficiency & Automation: Proactively identify opportunities to automate routine tasks, streamline implementation workflows, and reduce project backlog.

  • Learn & Share: Stay curious about emerging AI trends, adopting new capabilities and sharing best practices across the team.
  • Operate Responsibly: Ensure all AI usage strictly adheres to security, privacy, and data governance standards.
Preferred:
  • Domain knowledge in fuel/tobacco/excise tax compliance, energy supply chains, or enterprise ERP ecosystems (SAP, Oracle Cloud, PDI Enterprise).
  • Experience managing hybrid delivery models involving external delivery subcontractors and partner ecosystems.

description:

The Sr. Associate, Member Claim Processing leads the organization's operational execution of member claim processing for our Medicare Advantage business. You'll oversee a function at the intersection of operations, compliance, and member experience—responsible for compliant, accurate, and timely member claim processing.


Your Responsibilities will include:

Required skills and experience:

Desired skills and experience:

title: Licensed Professional Counselor - Outpatient
description:
Performs clinical interventions with patients (children through older adults), families/significant others, staff, outside organizations and providers in order to coordinate patient care, implement treatment and perform discharge planning.
