Essential Functions and Responsibilities

1. Demonstrates service excellence and patient and family centered care by showing respect, honesty, fairness and a positive attitude toward all customers.
2. Maintains confidentiality.
3. Demonstrates dependability, to include attendance and punctuality.
4. Is accountable - takes initiative and ownership of issues.
5. Displays a professional demeanor. Represents hospital in a positive way. Has a compassionate working relationship with patients and families.
6. Assumes personal responsibility for 2-way communication. Communicates and listens effectively with patients, families, coworkers, other departments, physicians/providers and community.
7. Supports coworkers, initiatives and a patient and family centered philosophy; pitches in; does own part and helps others.
8. Works to continuously improve work environment/processes (Performance Improvement). Demonstrates a patient and family centered focus when considering/developing improvement solutions.
9. Represents willingness/enthusiasm to create, embrace and facilitate change.
10. Develops self and others; supports a learning environment; leads by example. Encourages patients and families to give feedback and suggestions for improvement.
11. Develops working relationships critical to the organization including patients, families, coworkers, other departments, physicians/providers and community.
12. Encourages others by providing recognition and support.


1. Thinks critically; utilizes sound judgment; promptly reports potential risks.
2. Maintains state of art knowledge of area of specialty, healthcare trends and practice, populations served.
3. Maintains a level of computer literacy appropriate to their role.
4. Meets and maintains current all unit specific and organizational skills/competencies, certifications/licensures, as required.
5. Completes hospital-required reviews, e.g. HIPAA, safety, health screening,
care concerns, and others as assigned.
6. Adheres to National Patient Safety Goals.

Job Class Specifics

1. Clinical knowledge and skills remain current to meet the needs of all age/population groups served. Demonstrates understanding of age- appropriate behavior and psychosocial development for children through older adults.
2. Communicates plan of care based on assessment of patients and family; keeps appropriate people aware of pertinent changes or problems in a timely manner.
3. Participates productively in treatment team meetings and ensures attendance on a regular basis.
4. Consistently attends and participates in staff meetings at least 50% and other committee meetings.
5. Achieves minimum thresholds for productivity on a consistent basis.
6. Meets required thresholds for chart review and documentation.
7. Utilizes therapeutic communication skills with patients and family.
8. Responds appropriately to emergency situations.

Inpatient Job Specifics:
1. Provides individual, group, and family therapy utilizing a wide range of techniques designed to treat mental illness, emotional problems, social and interpersonal problems, and functional deficits.
2. Assists in developing and executing individual treatment plans for patients.
3. Supports day-to-day oversight of all therapeutic activities.
4. Maintains an awareness of significant patient history, present status, and any precautions in effect. Collaborates with other staff to provide input into treatment plans for individual patients.
5. Orients family members to nature of therapeutic services and the specific program.
6. Increases other family members understanding of patient needs and progress.
7. Exhibits clinically appropriate relational (e.g., accurate empathy, active listening) skills.
8. Manage behavioral crises including 1:1 observation, redirection, and crisis team interventions.
9. Writes behavioral management and safety plans for acute patients in cooperation with treatment team recommendations.
10. Completes assessments as needed.
11. Communicates relevant client progress and participates in weekly treatment team planning.
12. Maintains on-going professional relationships with personnel from public agencies and mental health/drug and alcohol treatment facilities.
13. Conducts inter-agency meetings as necessary.
14. Collaborates in appropriate treatment and discharge planning with client, supports, and community agencies.
15. Assists in the implementation of education and training experiences for interns or other designated students.

Outpatient Job Specifics:
1. Effectively performs intake assessments as scheduled and documents appropriately. Is flexible and responsive in rearranging schedule to accommodate emergent cases.
2. Ensures that admission assessments for clients contain the following documented components: Background information, current mental status, treatment recommendations, discharge planning needs, target problems for treatment, expected patient outcomes.
3. Appropriately utilizes standardized tools and scales to assess and reassess patient functioning. Uses the appropriate tool for the age/population of the patient being assessed (e.g., adolescent and geriatric depression scales, GAF, etc.)
4. Assumes appropriate responsibility and accountability for the development, review and revision of the plan of care for outpatients: completes within 2 visits.
5. Expected outcomes/target objectives and interventions measurable and are developed with recognition given to expected age-related variations in the baseline psychosocial and developmental functional capacity of the individual (child to older adult).
6. Incorporates patient/family teaching into plan of treatment; including patient identified target symptoms with severity ratings.
7. Documents discharge plan, revisions to the Plan of Care, and final discharge instructions and linkages community services, as per current policy.
8. Accurately assesses interventions made and reassesses data to plan further interventions throughout the therapeutic process in a responsive and timely manner, in order to meet patient needs and third-party payor requirements.
9. Effectively implements the treatment modalities appropriate to age/population served.
10. Markets the therapeutic value of therapy group participation and solicits referrals from appropriate sources.
11. Implements, facilitates and maintains therapy group(s) participation, the majority of the calendar year.
12. Effectively and consistently demonstrates the successful ability to facilitate a therapy group.
13. Accurately maintains attendance and participation documentation as required by licensors regulations.
14. Plans for education needs of students assigned for supervision of internship and assumes responsibility for communication with hospital staff regarding the student's plan of internship.

The following requirements are expected of all employees:
Annual Health Screening with Infection Control and Blood Borne Pathogens Education
Safety Awareness: Hospital Fire, Safety, and Disaster Procedures
Confidentiality: Maintains Employee and Patient Confidentiality.
Attendance: Regular attendance is an essential function of the position
Job Performance: Results Orientation, Customer Focus, Decision Making, Awareness
Interpersonal Skills: Communication, Relationship-building, Team Player, Celebration
Innovation: Breakthrough Thinking, Knowledge-Building/Sharing, Coaching/Empowering, System Vision & Management


Reporting Structure:
A. Formal Reporting and Chain of Command - Outpatient reports to Clinical Manager of Outpatient Behavioral Health Services or delegated supervisor. Inpatient reports to Assistant Manager of Behavioral Health Services or delegated supervisor.
B. Informal Reporting and Relationships - Establishes and maintains harmonious, productive relationships with all levels of mental health personnel, other hospital personnel, physicians, patients, patients families, and the general public.


Qualifications and Standards
Education: Graduate of an accredited Master's degree program in counseling, psychology or other mental health field.

Experience: Experience applying customer service behaviors and communication skills required. A minimum of two (2) years clinical experience in the mental health field including the provision of psychotherapy to individuals, families, couples, and/or groups is required. Play therapy experience required as applicable. Two years post licensure experience preferred. Evidence of participation in educational programs to update and maintain knowledge and clinical skills.

Certifications/Licensure: Licensed as a Professional Counselor (LPC) in Pennsylvania. Current CPR certification required. Child Abuse History Clearance and Criminal Background Check required.

title: Foreman - Overhead (Sawnee EMC)
description:
Position Summary

The Foreman is a safety focused professional with the ability to lead a crew to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the General Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Must be experienced with coaching and training lower classification employees in safe and productive work procedures.

  • Oversee work related to each project and assume full responsibility for its quality and completion deadline.

  • Install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines while using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent overhead line experience.

  • Proficient in basic computer operations including Microsoft Word and other Microsoft Office applications.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

title: Opetushoitaja Ortopedian ja traumatologian yksikköön
description:
Haluatko olla mukana varmistamassa, että koko hoitohenkilökunta ja opiskelijat onnistuvat työssään – ja kehittää samalla omaa osaamistasi vaativassa erikoissairaanhoidossa?

Siltasairaalan ortopedis-traumatologinen osasto S5A etsii opetushoitajaa. Osastomme erikoisalana on vaativa selkä- ja luutuumorikirurgia sekä HUS-piirin akuuttivaiheen selkäydinvammautuneiden hoito. Potilaistamme noin puolet tulee päivystyksen kautta, mikä tekee työstä monipuolista ja merkityksellistä.

Opetushoitajan työnkuva

Opetushoitajana suunnittelet, koordinoit ja kehität uusien työntekijöiden perehdytystä ja osaamisen varmistamista. Seuraat perehdytyksen etenemistä, tuet perehtyjiä ja perehdyttäjiä sekä osallistut osaamisen arviointiin. Varmistat yhdessä esihenkilön ja perehdyttäjien kanssa, että perehdyksessä huomiodaan yksilölliset osaamistarpeet. Perehdytät henkilöstöä yksikön toimintatapoihin ja tuet koulutus- ja osaamissuunnitelmien toteutumista. Lisäksi vastaat yhdessä esihenkilön kanssa yksikön vuosittaisen koulutussuunnitelman toimeenpanosta ja toteutumisen seurannasta. Odotamme sitoutumista HUSin yhteisiin toimintamalleihin ja arvoihin sekä kykyä toimia rakentavana suunnannäyttäjänä muutostilanteissa ja uusien toimintatapojen jalkauttamisessa. Opetushoitaja toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä yksikön osastonhoitajan ja apulaisosastonhoitajan kanssa.

Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät hoitotyön laatu, osaamisen kehittäminen ja pedagoginen tuki – pääset vaikuttamaan sekä potilaiden hoitoon että hoitohenkilökunnan ja tulevien hoitajien ammattitaidon kehittymiseen. Kliininen hoitotyö muodostaa puolet työajastasi ja on keskeinen osa opetushoitajan tehtävää: opetushoitajuus näkyy myös kliinisessä työssäsi ohjauksena, osaamisen tukemisena ja hyvän hoitotyön käytäntöjen vahvistamisena.

Millaista osaamista toivomme

Tehtävässä tarvitset pedagogista ja vahvaa kliinistä osaamista, hyviä vuorovaikutus-, yhteistyö- ja digitaitoja sekä kykyä ohjata, antaa palautetta ja arvioida osaamista. Arvostamme joustavaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta. Kokemus kirurgisesta hoitotyöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn näyttöön perustuvan potilashoidon ja yksikön osaamisen kehittämisen parissa. Saat tehtävääsi perehdytystä ja tarpeisiisi räätälöityä täydennyskoulutusta sekä joustavan moniammatillisen työyhteisön kehittämismahdollisuuksineen. Saat myös sinua kannustavan esihenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa. Opetushoitajana saat tueksesi HUSin opetushoitajaverkoston, jossa voit jakaa kokemuksia, kehittää osaamistasi ja saada vertaistukea tehtävääsi.

Lisäksi HUSin työntekijänä sinulla on laajat koulutusmahdollisuudet ja ammatillisen kehittymisen edellytykset. HUS tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuolisia työsuhde-etuja, kuten ePassin, mahdollisuuden hakea HUSin vuokra-asuntoja, vuokrattavia lomamökkejä, alennuksia liikunta- ja kulttuuriharrastusten parissa sekä monia muita etuja. Lisäksi HUS tarjoaa työntekijälle tuettua työpaikkaruokailua. HUSin työntekijöille poliklinikkamaksut ovat maksuttomia.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3595,56 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilö. Soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja soveltuva kokemus tai alempi korkeakoulututkinto täydennettynä opetushoitajan tehtävään soveltuvilla opinnoilla ja soveltuva kokemus tai alan opistoasteen tutkinto täydennettynä opetushoitajan tehtävään soveltuvilla opinnoilla ja soveltuva kokemus.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

title: Senior Change Analyst
company: Ministry for Cities, Environment, Regions and Transport
description:
About us

The Ministry for Cities, Environment, Regions and Transport (MCERT) takes a long-term view of how New Zealand’s towns, cities and regions grow and change. We work across housing, transport, the environment, urban development, infrastructure and investment, and partner closely with local government.

MCERT is leading the implementation of the Planning System Transformation Programme, a significant, long-term programme to support the shift to a new planning system. The transformation will affect a wide range of people and organisations across the planning system and requires practical, coordinated change support.

About the role

We’re looking for two Senior Change Analysts to join the People, Readiness and Change function within the programme. These roles will support the delivery of practical, well-managed change activity for the people and organisations that will work within the new planning system.

You’ll work as part of a team supporting change analysis, readiness, engagement, capability, transition and adoption activity across a complex programme. You’ll help identify what is changing, who is affected, what support is needed, and how change activity can be planned and delivered at the right time.

What you’ll do

Working across the programme, you will support change activity from early analysis and preparation through to implementation, transition and adoption.

You will:

  • identify, document and validate change impacts for affected groups, including people readiness, capability, support and adoption considerations

  • support the development and delivery of practical change and transition plans aligned with wider initiative delivery plans

  • gather, analyse and present evidence to support change planning, readiness assessment and decision-making

  • work with engagement, communications, learning and other specialist teams to make sure change activity is coordinated and practical

  • support workshops, interviews and engagement with stakeholders to understand impacts, risks, readiness and support needs

  • help identify capability and learning needs and support the development of responses that prepare people and organisations for change

  • track change risks, issues, dependencies and readiness measures, and help ensure they are visible and managed

  • support adoption activity by using feedback, evidence and readiness information to adjust change activity as needs emerge

  • prepare clear, practical material for delivery teams, senior leaders and affected groups.

  • You will be expected to take a lead role in shaping analysis, advising on change responses, and supporting the integration of change management into delivery planning. You will bring confidence working with senior stakeholders and the ability to guide practical change activity in a complex delivery environment.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for practical, collaborative change practitioners who can work well in complexity and turn information into clear action. You’ll be comfortable working across multiple priorities, building strong relationships, and leading change activity that helps people and organisations move successfully to a new way of working.

You will bring:

  • significant experience supporting or delivering change in complex programme, transformation, reform or organisational environments

  • strong practical experience in change impact analysis, readiness assessment, stakeholder engagement, communications, learning, transition support or adoption activity

  • strong analytical skills, with the ability to gather information, identify themes, assess implications and present clear findings

  • sound judgement and the ability to turn complexity into practical actions, advice and usable outputs

  • strong relationship and collaboration skills across different disciplines, organisations and stakeholder groups

  • confidence facilitating workshops, conversations and engagement with affected groups and senior stakeholders

  • clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce concise, audience-focused material

  • the ability to work at pace, manage competing priorities and adapt as delivery needs evolve

  • an understanding of change management approaches and how to apply them in a practical way

  • Ideally you will have experience working within government, public sector reform, or large-scale transformation programmes.

  • We are looking for people with stronger experience leading pieces of change analysis, advising delivery teams and working with senior stakeholders. Ideally, you will have experience working within government, public sector reform, or large-scale transformation programmes.

Working with us

You will work closely with colleagues across the People, Readiness and Change function and the wider programme, bringing the right expertise together to deliver change activity that is coordinated, practical and focused on the needs of the people and organisations affected by the transformation.

This is an opportunity to contribute to a once-in-a-generation reform programme that will have lasting impact across New Zealand. Help shape the future of how communities, environments, and regions are supported across New Zealand. Bring your expertise, curiosity, and passion for transformation, and help us turn reform into reality.

Salary range

Salary range for the Senior Change Analyst roles is $111,827 to $135,738 per annum.

Appointment within these range will be based on skills and experience.

Apply now

Apply directly by completing the online application form and submit your CV and cover letter. Note: your cover letter will be a key part of our assessment process, so please highlight how your experience relates to the key skills required for this role.

The location for this role is Wellington, other major centres considered for the right candidate.

Applications Close - Sunday 18th October 2026

title: CTRS / Therapeutic Recreational Specialist
description:
Our Company

Rehab Without Walls Neuro Rehabilitation

Overview

Are you an Certified Therapeutic Recreational Therapist who values flexibility and functional therapy? At Rehab Without Walls, you’ll provide client-centered, functional therapy in our Home & Community Neurorehabilitation program in Dallas, TX, with the autonomy to design your schedule and the support of a collaborative team. Help clients work toward real-life goals while enjoying clinical autonomy, schedule flexibility, and a supportive team environment. Apply today!

Responsibilities

  • Performs comprehensive evaluations, assessing the needs of the patients, and sets measurable objectives and goals that are formulated in conjunction with the rehabilitation team
  • Adjusts treatment to achieve maximum results in independence and/or function
  • Plans, organizes, and coordinates recreation activities, functional leisure skills, and leisure education
  • Interviews the patient to assess capabilities/interests/barriers. Monitors progress and recommends changes/modifications to program as necessary
  • Designs community reintegration activities to assist the patient with their physical and cognitive needs during physical recreational/leisure activity Assists the patient in understanding their various needs and limitations and how to manage them during function
  • Regularly re-assesses effectiveness of treatment plan, progress of patient towards goals and the need for modifying goals or treatment
  • Communicates patient’s needs and progress to the treatment team, physician, patient, family members, and others as applicable
  • Observes/documents and reports changes in the condition/status of the person receiving services to the Clinical Coordinator, Program Manager or DCM, attending physician and other treatment team members
  • Consults with medical providers regarding patient evaluation & treatment, progress of the patient & discharge from treatment
  • Maintains and submits evaluation, treatment and billing documentation in the format and timelines required by the Company, facility, funding source, local, state and federal regulation
  • Adheres to standards of the Company's Code of Business Conduct, policies, HIPAA and Corporate Compliance programs and appropriate professional practice standards and applicable state/federal laws
  • May work with rehabilitation specialists in fulfilling the patient’s treatment plan through instruction in patient-related activities to be carried out by the rehabilitation specialist with supervision provided by the Therapeutic Recreation Specialist
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Therapeutic Recreation Therapy, or the equivalent
  • Maintains certification as a Certified Therapeutic Recreation Therapist (CTRT) through the National Council for Therapeutic Recreation Certification (NCTRC)
  • Maintains professional license and/or certification if required by the state in which the CTRS practices
  • Minimum of two years therapeutic therapy experience and therapeutic recreation program design
  • Experience working with patients with neurologic or orthopedic injuries or conditions
  • Demonstrates effective and professional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Able to work independently and part of a team
  • Demonstrates strong organization skills and attention to detail
  • Has reliable transportation and can travel to/from multiple assignments/locations on a daily basis

About our Line of Business

Rehab Without Walls, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, is a revolutionary neurorehabilitation program that moves individuals outside the walls of institutional settings and into their natural home and community environment through a continuum of care. It is designed to significantly help people who have primarily experienced a brain injury, spinal cord injury, or stroke/CVA through accident or illness regain functional capabilities. By providing care in the home, community, workplace, or school, Rehab Without Walls promotes greater health through the recovery process, all with industry-leading outcomes that dramatically improve functional skills and independence for patients. For more information, please visit www.rehabwithoutwalls.com. Follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn.

title: Telecommunications Engineer
description:
Flexible location: Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide

Support critical satellite and microwave networks for aviation

Permanent TP2A or TP2B opportunity with national impact and specialist technology

Summary

As a Telecommunications Engineer, you'll play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the satellite, microwave and communications systems that support Air Traffic Control and Aviation Rescue Fire Fighting Services across Australia.

Based in Brisbane, Melbourne or Adelaide, you'll provide specialist technical expertise, solve complex telecommunications challenges and contribute to the safe and reliable operation of nationally significant aviation infrastructure.

The Organisation

Airservices Australia is a government-owned organisation responsible for the safe and efficient management of 11% of the world’s airspace and provision of aviation rescue & fire fighting services at Australia’s busiest airports.

Our people are our greatest asset with a dynamic and diverse team operating from locations across the country - from bustling cities to regional and remote locations. This team is helping to secure the future of Australia’s skies and keep it among the safest in the world.

We connect people with their world safely – linking family and friends, generating economic activity, creating jobs, and facilitating trade and tourism. Every emergency vehicle, rescue boat and critical response asset we maintain contributes to aviation safety and national emergency readiness.

Airservices is committed to fostering a culture that is diverse, inclusive, and respectful. We encourage motivated individuals who love what they do, value a service first mindset and embrace a challenge to explore a career with Airservices. In return you will be a valued team member, be offered flexibility and experience a meaningful career in an exciting, ever-evolving aviation industry.

The Role & The Team

Working within the Network and Telecommunications team, you will be responsible for supporting and managing critical telecommunications services and systems, including satellite and microwave communications networks that underpin Airservices' operational environment.

You will investigate and resolve complex technical issues, provide specialist advice to stakeholders, contribute to telecommunications projects, and support the ongoing improvement of communications services across the organisation.

This role provides exposure to highly specialised telecommunications technologies operating within a 24/7 safety-critical environment, where reliability and performance are essential to Australia's aviation network.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Investigating, analysing and diagnosing telecommunications issues and implementing effective solutions.
  • Supporting and maintaining satellite and microwave communications systems.
  • Providing technical advice and guidance to internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Preparing technical reports, specifications, procedures and operational documentation.
  • Contributing to projects involving telecommunications infrastructure and services.
  • Managing incidents, problems and changes through platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve telecommunications systems, processes and service delivery.
  • Working collaboratively with engineering teams, project teams, vendors and operational stakeholders.
  • Travelling to Airservices sites across Australia as required.

Please see the link below to view the full Position Description:

Position Description - Satellite Links -TP2 - Telecommunications Engineer- 2026 (1).pdf

The Person

If you're looking for an opportunity to apply your telecommunications expertise to infrastructure that supports the safe operation of Australia's aviation industry, we'd love to hear from you.

The successful applicant will have:

  • A relevant degree in Engineering from an Australian tertiary institution, or certified equivalent qualification (for overseas qualifications).
  • Eligibility for registration as a Professional Engineer in a relevant engineering field.
  • Australian Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 Security Clearance.
  • A minimum of 3 years' experience supporting microwave communications links, satellite systems or related telecommunications technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience in radio frequency (RF) electronics and telecommunications engineering.
  • Experience investigating, troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to a range of audiences.
  • Experience preparing technical documentation, procedures, specifications and reports.
  • The ability to work independently and exercise sound technical judgement with limited direction.
  • An understanding of working within a 24/7 operational, safety-focused environment.

The following experience would be highly regarded:

  • Satellite communications systems.
  • Microwave communications network design and implementation.
  • ITIL or Service Management practices.
  • Information Security Manual (ISM), ISO27000, COBIT or similar frameworks.
  • Aviation, defence, emergency services or other critical infrastructure environments.
  • ServiceNow or similar workflow and incident management platforms.

Security Clearance

To be eligible to apply, you must be an Australian Citizen as an Aviation Security Identification Card (ASIC) is required for this role. Please refer to the security check requirements successful applicants will be required to undertake as part of the recruitment process.

Why join Airservices?

Purpose - Support the telecommunications systems that enable safe and efficient aviation operations across Australia.

Technical Challenge - Work with specialised satellite, microwave and RF communications technologies within a complex operational environment.

Impact - Contribute directly to technology supporting Air Traffic Control and Aviation Rescue Fire Fighting Services nationwide.

Career Development - Build expertise across critical communications infrastructure, complex technical projects and nationally significant systems.

Flexibility – Work in Brisbane, Melbourne or Adelaide.

Stability - Join an organisation responsible for essential national infrastructure with long-term career opportunities and meaningful work.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airservices Australia, we embrace and thrive on diversity of thought, perspectives and capabilities because we know the benefits of having a workforce that is representative of the community we serve.

We actively encourage and welcome candidates from all cultural backgrounds, gender identities, people living with disability, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to apply.

How to Apply

To apply for this position please lodge an application online before 11.55pm (AEST) Sunday 18th October 2026.

Join Airservices Australia and help maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps Australia's skies safe.

title: Applied AI/ML Modeling - Senior Associate
description:
Our Branch Network Modeling team develops advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that inform high-impact decisions across physical location strategy and field workforce effectiveness.

As an Applied AI Modeling Senior Associate in Branch Network Modeling team, you will build advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) models that directly shape high-stakes decisions impacting Chase’s branch network and the bankers who serve our customers. Your models will help optimize our branch network, using geospatial AI and graph-based models to determine where Chase should invest, grow, or reposition its physical footprint, or will empower our bankers in the field to serve our customers using techniques like reinforcement learning and behavioral science.

Job responsibilities

  • Develop and launch AI and ML models that solve complex, ambiguous business problems in Consumer Banking, spanning areas such as retail network optimization, investment optimization, resource allocation, and sales effectiveness.
  • Participate in modeling engagements end-to-end, including interfacing with business, governance, UX, and technology stakeholders; articulating clear business use cases; delivering on project plans; and working with large, complex datasets — including geospatial, demographic, transactional, and behavioral data — to formulate testable business hypotheses.
  • Translate technical model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical business partners in Real Estate, Finance, and Market Strategy.
  • Partner with governance teams to expedite fair and thorough model reviews, track performance metrics, and maintain adherence to regulatory compliance standards.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Advanced degree (master’s or PhD) in a quantitative or spatial discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or Geography, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on, relevant industry experience in developing and deploying AI/ML models, including statistical modeling, ML, reinforcement learning, or optimization algorithms.
  • Proficient in Python with hands-on experience in ML and deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and libraries (e.g., NumPy, Scikit-Learn, Pandas). Strong working knowledge of Jupyter Notebook/Lab and cloud computing.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following, with meaningful exposure to at least one other:
    • Geospatial analytics, spatial statistics, or spatial optimization
    • Graph neural networks, network science, or graph-based optimization
    • Reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, or online/continuous learning
    • Behavioral modeling, adaptive intervention design, or human performance optimization

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Hold a PhD in a relevant discipline.
  • Experience developing advanced AI or ML models in consumer finance, logistics, major retailers, or AI-native platforms.
  • Experience with at least one of the following: geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., GeoPandas, PySAL, H3, Esri/ArcGIS, Carto, Wherobots, QGIS), graph ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch Geometric, DGL, NetworkX), RL libraries (e.g., RLlib, Stable Baselines, Vowpal Wabbit).
  • Familiarity with behavioral science concepts (e.g., nudge theory, decision theory) or experience building adaptive, continuous learning, or recommendation systems.
  • Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms.

title: Private Client Banker - Waukegan and Three Lakes Branch - Northbrook, IL

You have a passion for taking care of our customers and employees and making them feel welcomed and valued by building lasting relationships, doing the right thing, exceeding expectations and having a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. Here at Chase, you will have the opportunity to help people experience our Customer Promise -- helping people make the most of their money so they can make the most of their lives by providing education and advice tailored to suit their financial needs.

As a Private Client Banker in Branch Banking, you are the main point of contact for a select group of Chase’s affluent clients as well as other customers in the Branch. You will manage their complete banking relationship across the company, utilizing a proactive and disciplined approach to generate growth in their balances. You will help acquire new clients by actively soliciting referrals and developing internal and external sources.

Job responsibilities

  • Shares the value of Chase Private Client with clients that may be eligible
  • Actively manages their banking relationship through an advice-based approach, ensuring each client receives the best products and services for their needs
  • Partners with Specialists (Private Client Advisors, Mortgage Bankers and Business Relationship Managers) to connect customers to experts who can help them with specialized financial needs
  • Makes lives of clients more convenient by sharing and setting up self-service options to access their accounts 24 hours a day/ 7 days a week
  • Adheres to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Demonstrated success using a value-added, relationship-oriented approach to acquire and deepen client relationships
  • 1+ year Branch Banking Banker or equivalent experience in financial services, with verifiable success in new client acquisition, cultivating, and maintaining customer relationships and revenue generation
  • Beginning Oct. 1, 2018, if you are not currently registered, the Securities Industry Essential (SIE) exam, FINRA Series 6/7, state registration (including 63 or 66 if required) and Life licenses are required - or must be successfully completed within 180 days of starting the role
  • Compliance with Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act*
  • High school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent
  • Adherence to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements
  • Ability to work branch hours, including weekends and some evenings

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Excellent communication skills
  • College degree or military equivalent
  • Experience cultivating relationships with affluent clients
  • Strong team orientation with a commitment of long-term career with the firm

Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act

This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.

In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008. As such, upon active employment with JPMorgan Chase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorgan Chase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorgan Chase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter.

Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm. Any of the completed information you provide during the Chase on-line application process may be transferred, on your behalf, to NMLS by JPMorgan Chase. Please carefully review the information you provide to Chase for accuracy and consistency and with any current NMLS record, if applicable, before submitting. title: Product Engineer — Vault Platform
description:
As one of the first Product Engineers at Pure, you’ll own key parts of our Vault Platform, from customer vault accounts to the systems our operations team uses to receive, verify, store, and ship high-value physical assets. You’ll help decide what to build, make technical decisions, and stay responsible for how your work performs after launch. You’ll work directly with operations, customer support, compliance, and partners to understand their needs and turn them into working software.

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of products and services from the initial idea through development, launch, and ongoing improvements.

  • Build customer-facing tools for vault accounts, asset management, shipments, and transfers with TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

  • Design and maintain backend systems for asset intake, verification, inventory, storage, and shipping.

  • Be responsible for keeping asset ownership records, custody history, and movement accurate and traceable.

  • Work directly with warehouse and logistics teams to improve how assets are received, authenticated, stored, and fulfilled.

  • Build and maintain APIs, webhooks, and integrations that marketplaces, financial institutions, and other partners depend on.

  • Identify gaps in internal tools with Customer Support and Operations, and carry improvements through to completion.

  • Work with Compliance and Risk to implement identity verification, permissions, and custody controls.

  • Use customer feedback and operational data to set priorities and measure whether your changes solve the problem.

  • Make technical decisions across the stack and take responsibility for reliability, maintenance, and delivery.

Who You Are

  • You have 3+ years of experience building software products, ideally at a startup.

  • You’re comfortable owning a product area, deciding what needs attention, and seeing work through without waiting for a detailed specification.

  • You have strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

  • You’ve built backend APIs and services with Node.js or a similar stack, using PostgreSQL.

  • You enjoy understanding how people work and building software that makes their jobs easier.

  • You can design systems that keep records accurate, enforce permissions, and make changes easy to trace.

  • You communicate clearly with engineers, operations teams, customer support, and business partners.

  • You take responsibility for what you ship, follow up on how it’s used, and address problems when they come up.

Bonus

  • Experience building logistics, warehouse management, inventory, or fulfillment systems.

  • Experience building developer platforms, APIs, OAuth integrations, or webhook infrastructure.

  • Experience with event-driven systems and workflow automation.

  • Experience building financial infrastructure, custody platforms, or software for regulated businesses.

  • Experience designing audit trails, permission systems, or safeguards for data integrity.

What We Offer

  • Flexible work arrangements: remote, hybrid, or in-office in Los Angeles

  • Medical and dental coverage

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • Daily lunches and a wellness stipend

title: Bull Evaluation Program Manager, Middle TN AgResearch & Education Center at Lewisburg: UTIA
description:
Position is solely responsible for assisting in performing technical, research/demonstration and field-related duties in support of the center’s Beef Unit/Bull Evaluation programs, operations, and mission. Oversee and direct beef cattle/Bull Evaluation forage production, pasture management, and infrastructure development and maintenance, as well as, assist in forage and beef cattle unit research. Perform routine tasks and conducts routine procedures associated with maintaining efficient operations in support of center's forage, beef cattle production and research programs and infrastructure. In addition, the position is responsible for proper implementation, accurate analysis and effective communications concerning all beef cattle research/demonstration projects and communication between lead primary investigator, producers and the center director.

Implementing research/demonstration protocols and production practices within Beef Cattle/Bull Evaluation unit:

  • Take lead in the beef cattle research and demonstration program at MTREC including; organization of needed resources, land, livestock, feedstuffs, and necessary supplies for data collection. Also, implementation of research/demonstration design and protocols as provided by the PI's workplan, collection of appropriate data as directed by the PI and workplan, analysis research project's data and timeline in order to make informed recommendation to PI and center director concerning beef research programming.

  • Oversight of the center's production practices involving the beef cattle/Bull Evaluation program, as this is a primary resource for MTREC's research and Outreach program. Responsibilities on a daily bases include; Health and nutritional oversight and assessment, forage/pasture management including soil testing and analysis of results for proper nutrient application.

Act as primary communicator with center director related to program needs; feed, health and marketing:

  • Input and manage record keeping system for beef cattle/Bull Evaluation program.

  • Assist State Beef Cattle Specialist in all performing Beef Cattle Management Training courses by managing livestock resource needs as well as all supplies and materials required.

  • Assist PLF Coordinator with management and implementation for associated research trials.

  • Assist Tennessee Beef Heifer Development Program at critical times of operations, delivery, monthly weights, breeding dates and sale dates.

Assists Center Director with daily production and management:

  • Acquisition of feed, seed, fertilizer and equipment associated with beef production and research/demonstration programs.

  • Acquisition of animal health products for beef unit.

  • Facilitate collection of required data points and provide interpretation of resulting measures related to production decision.

  • Implementation of animal health protocols.

  • Assistance in IACUC and AAALAC compliance, records and inspections.

Assists with other livestock and production-related agricultural tasks in support of beef unit and leading the management of pasture heath, fencing integrity and facilities upkeep and safety.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education:

    • High School Diploma or GED

  • Experience:

    • At least 5 years of agriculture experience.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

    • Knowledge of animal agricultural operations.

    • Ability to accurately record data related research and production activities.

    • Ability to work safely and confidently around large farm animals.

    • Knowledge and ability to care for beef cattle related needs/welfare and carryout stewardship practices.

    • Ability to recognize equipment or maintenance problems.

    • Ability to operate large agricultural equipment.

    • Ability to perform agricultural/manual labor in inclement weather conditions.

    • Ability to work well with others on a daily basis. Self-motivated individual.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without need now or in the future for sponsorship for employment-based visa status.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education:

    • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

    • Agricultural production practices specific to beef cattle, forage, infrastructure design.

Work Location:

  • Location: Lewisburg, TN

  • Onsite

Compensation and Benefits:

  • UT market range: MR05

  • Find more information on the UT Market Range structure here

  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions:

To express interest, please submit an application with the noted below attachments.

  • Resume

  • Cover Letter

About The College/Department/Division: This Middle Tennessee AgResearch and Education Center is a 1,265-acre facility located in beautiful Spring Hill, Tennessee, and maintains a diversity of resources and opportunities for UTIA researchers and educators. The Center enjoys the presence and a cooperative working relationship with several different departments and faculty at the University of Tennessee.

title: CS Accommodation A/S - Projektleder - Offshore- og maritime projekter
description:
Projektleder - Offshore- og marineprojekter

Kan du se dig selv som projektleder i en vækstorienteret virksomhed, hvor du får ansvar for spændende offshore- og marineprojekter – og samtidig kan være med til at præge processer, struktur og daglig drift?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til CS Accommodation i Esbjerg. Virksomheden oplever stigende aktivitet og styrker derfor organisationen med en erfaren og selvstændig projektleder.

CS Accommodation – Improving life at sea

CS Accommodation A/S leverer komplette indkvarteringsfaciliteter til offshore- og marineindustrien. CSA’s mission lyder:Improving life at sea – skabe sikre, komfortable og funktionelle rammer for offshore-personale, og virksomheden har således stor erfaring med indretning og etablering af de områder, hvor besætning og offshore‑personale bor, arbejder, spiser og opholder sig.

Virksomheden har gennem årtier udviklet sig til en global leverandør, der håndterer alt fra små reparationsopgaver til store, komplekse nybyggerier, med stor know how inden for gulve, paneler, lofter, døre, møbler, vådrum, teknisk isolering, køkken- og spisefaciliteter, som lever op til særlige standarder og krævende miljøer. CSA’s særkende er kvalitet & håndværksstolthed, sikkerhed og struktur, fleksibilitet og en dynamisk og agil organisation. Virksomheden er i vækst og i gang med en spændende proces, hvor organisationen styrkes og processer optimeres. Læs mere på:

Ansvar for spændende projekter

Som projektleder hos CSA får du en nøgleposition i en nichevirksomhed, der arbejder med aptering og indkvarteringsløsninger til offshore- og marine-sektoren. Du får ansvar for dine egne projekter – fra opstart til levering – og bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og fleksibilitet er i fokus.

Projekterne varierer i omfang og varighed og afvikles nogle gange, mens site er i drift - andre gange i forbindelse med større renoveringer i dok/havn. Der arbejdes efter internationale maritime regelsæt og direktiver med stor fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og klassificerede og certificerede materialer.

Du får en hverdag med korte beslutningsveje, stor handlefrihed og mulighed for at sætte dit personlige præg på både projekter og interne processer.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Planlægning, styring og gennemførsel af egne projekter og dermed sikre, at projekter leveres til tiden, med rette kvalitet og god økonomi.

  • Involvering i tilbudsgivning, indkøb og ressourceallokering

  • Koordinering med kunder, leverandører og interne teams

  • Opfølgning på fremdrift, tid, ressourcer, økonomi og kvalitet

  • Bidrage til løbende procesoptimering samt udvikling af arbejdsgange, materialevalg og logistik

  • Daglig kontakt og koordinering med on-site supervisors, produktion og eksterne samarbejdspartnere

  • Sikre sikkerhed, struktur og dokumentation gennem hele projektet

  • Rejseaktivitet ca. 30 dage årligt (kan dog variere).

  • Arbejdssted Esbjerg.

Din baggrund

Vi søger en erfaren projektleder gerne med erfaring fra offshore- eller marineprojekter, hvor du har arbejdet inden for aptering, interiør eller tekniske installationer. Vi ser gerne, at du har en uddannelse som ingeniør, konstruktør eller maskinmester.

Du har et godt drive, arbejder struktureret og skaber fremdrift i dine projekter. Du er proaktiv og løsningsorienteret og har altid blik for kvalitet og detaljer. Du er god til at holde dine stakeholders informeret og har generelt gode kommunikative færdigheder. Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk på et professionelt niveau.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med at planlægge og gennemføre projekter i krævende omgivelser med f.eks. begrænset plads, støjrestriktioner og høje sikkerhedskrav.

Du kan forvente

  • En central rolle, hvor du får reel mulighed for at præge udviklingen i en mindre, vækstorienteret virksomhed

  • Høj grad af selvstændighed og ansvar, med plads til at tage beslutninger og drive projekter i mål

  • En flad organisation med korte beslutningsveje, hvor dialogen er uformel og samarbejdet tæt

  • Fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kolleger, der står klar med sparring og støtte, når du har brug for det

  • En varieret projektportefølje, der giver både faglige udfordringer og muligheder for personlig udvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med stærke værdier, hvor kvalitet, sikkerhed og ordentlighed altid er førsteprioritet.

Skal du med på holdet i en vækstorienteret virksomhed?

CS Accommodation samarbejder med konsulentfirmaet GML om denne rekruttering. Du er velkommen til at kontakte Partner Søren Laigaard-Andersen på 2074 4492. Enhver henvendelse behandles fortroligt.

title: Monitor Tech
description:
The Monitor Tech provides appropriate telemetry monitoring based on patient’s age and rhythm. Demonstrates knowledge of arrhythmia identification and analysis. Other related duties as assigned.

General Functions:

• Selects, sets-up, calibrates and adjusts monitoring equipment in accordance with physician’s order

• Ensures continued proper functioning of equipment; troubleshoots equipment problems identified as necessary.

• Collects, transmits and documents pertinent patient data to the Registered Nurse with correct interpretations and interval measurements on each patient at required intervals every shift and with any significant rhythm change

• Maintains current monitored patients in the Central Surveillance computer system; confers with nursing staff to determine correct validation counts and alarm parameters for patients on computer monitor, as necessary

• Maintains small equipment log

• Reports alarms and changes of rhythm to RN staff; documents on logs and monitors strips per policy

• Greets, screens and processes incoming unit/dept calls, patients, visitors and messages

• Transcribes physician orders, enters tests, treatment requests into computer system

• Assembles and maintains patient medical records including posting of results

• Monitors requisitions, tracks and reports supplies, equipment, maintenance and repair services

• Exhibits service excellence and demonstrates Studer Principles and “must haves”

• Utilizes resources efficiently and effectively

• Maintains safe environment

• Participates in Performance Improvement activities

MINIMUM EDUCATION: High School graduate or equivalent.

PREFERRED EDUCATION: Completion of an ECG course is preferred.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Previous monitor tech experience

REQUIRED COURSES/COMPLETIONS (e.g., CPR): Basic Dysrhythmia Competency within 30 days of hire.

title: Account Representative - Fort Worth/Tarrent, TX (54233)
description:

As we continue to grow, we’re excited to expand into the Fort Worth/Tarrent, TX market while seeking a passionate and experienced Medical Sales Professional (Account Representative) to join our team.

The ideal candidate will have experience in home medical equipment or respiratory services. They recognize the importance of cultivating genuine, authentic relationships within the medical community.


The Account Representative will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships within the medical community to promote our home medical equipment and respiratory services. This role requires a motivated professional who understands the importance of patient advocacy and values providing exceptional service.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in home medical equipment (HME) or respiratory therapy services
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Proven ability to identify new business opportunities and drive market growth
  • A genuine passion for helping patients and improving lives

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, team-oriented environment where you’ll be valued and heard
  • Ongoing training, mentorship, and professional development

  • Responsible for developing relationships with new referral sources.
  • Conduct educational in-services, trainings, and presentations for healthcare providers.
  • Work with internal staff to obtain documents from providers necessary for prompt and accurate billing.
  • Deliver oxygen equipment to patients in the hospital for discharge along with education on the use and care of the equipment.
  • Market Performance Home Medical’s disease management programs.

title: Branch Operations Lead - Cleveland East Market - South Euclid, OH
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Branch Operations Lead in a Chase Branch, you'll be at the heart of our branch operations, working closely with the Branch Manager, branch employees, and our team of experts. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our clients' financial transactions are handled with precision and care, all while adhering to our policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Your leadership will ensure that our branch not only meets but exceeds control expectations, setting a positive tone for everyone who walks through our doors.

Job responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Branch Manager to create a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere in the branch, ensuring every client enjoys an exceptional experience and feels part of a dynamic community.
  • Greet clients warmly as they enter the branch, making them feel valued and appreciated. Demonstrate genuine care and concern during interactions, assisting with transactions, managing lobby flow, and scheduling meetings to build trusted relationships.
  • Engage clients with clear, polite communication to understand and help them effectively. Anticipate their needs while checking them into the waiting queue, ensuring a smooth visit.
  • Lead branch operations, including managing cash devices like the cash vault and ATM. Resolve any client issues quickly and effectively, paying attention to detail and striving for consistency while adhering to all bank policies and procedures.
  • Introduce clients to our friendly branch team, who collaborate to deliver seamless service with care and sincerity. Work together to build lasting relationships and assist with any specialized financial needs, elevating the client experience.
  • Simplify clients' banking experience by sharing self-service options, allowing them to access their accounts anytime, day or night.
  • Work closely with the Branch Manager to support all aspects of branch operations, including maintaining high standards for loss control, compliance, and audits, ensuring the branch operates smoothly and securely.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You take pride in adhering to policies, procedures, and regulatory banking requirements, ensuring everything runs smoothly and efficiently.
  • You are committed to maintaining a keen eye for detail and staying organized, which helps you juggle multiple tasks effectively.
  • You are proud of your leadership skills and operational proficiency, ensuring transaction accuracy while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
  • You have a strong passion for educating the branch team and partners, helping them stay connected and informed.
  • You excel at building meaningful connections and engaging with clients, always ready to educate them and refer them to our team of experts when needed.
  • You have 1+ years of retail banking experience.
  • You have a high school degree, GED, or foreign equivalent.
  • You have the ability to work branch hours including weekends and evenings.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • You have 6+ months of Associate Banker (Teller) experience.
  • You have a college degree or military equivalent.
Training and Travel Requirement
  • You’ll successfully complete our Branch Operations Lead Training Program before being considered for placement as a Branch Operations Lead.
  • You’ll need to be able to travel as required for in-person training and meetings.

title: Software Engineer/C Developer-PGD
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer/C Developer – PGD based in Switzerland.

This is a fully remote EMEA opportunity focused on developing and evolving a high-availability distributed PostgreSQL solution.
You will work on a multi-master database technology designed for geographically distributed, enterprise-scale workloads.
The role spans architecture, software development, testing, documentation, performance optimization, and production support.
You will contribute to technically complex challenges involving replication, consistency, fault tolerance, and distributed systems.
The position offers the opportunity to work on a large, long-lived codebase alongside an internationally distributed engineering team.
You will collaborate closely with other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, debugging, and continuous improvement.
This role is well suited to an experienced C developer with strong PostgreSQL knowledge and a passion for reliable distributed database systems.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, test, and document new capabilities for a multi-master distributed PostgreSQL product.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions for distributed database functionality.
  • Maintain, enhance, and optimize existing capabilities to improve performance, reliability, usability, and scalability.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into clearly defined, executable engineering tasks.
  • Investigate complex software and database issues and provide high-quality production support to enterprise customers.
  • Diagnose performance and reliability problems using systematic debugging and analysis techniques.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to maintain strong engineering standards.
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across a globally distributed development organization.
  • Work effectively with multi-version and multi-branch codebases, including active backporting and release workflows.
  • Contribute to build, testing, CI/CD, and software delivery processes.
  • Help maintain high standards for technical documentation, testing, maintainability, and production readiness.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C programming and experience developing production-quality systems software.
  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL internals, such as the storage engine, WAL, replication, catalog system, or extension development.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including replication topologies, consensus, conflict resolution, eventual consistency, and failure modes.
  • Experience working with large, long-lived codebases that use multiple branches, versions, and backporting workflows.
  • Familiarity with modern build systems and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong Git skills and experience working with complex branching strategies.
  • Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and performance analysis capabilities.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex database and distributed-system behavior.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with a globally distributed engineering team.
  • Prior contributions to PostgreSQL or other open-source database projects are a plus.
  • Experience with logical replication, logical decoding, or custom replication solutions is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of distributed consensus algorithms such as Raft is a plus.Familiarity with the PostgreSQL extension API and hook system is beneficial.
  • Experience with high-availability architectures and failover mechanisms is an advantage.Experience with Python and/or Rust is a plus.
  • Experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with Ansible, Docker, and Kubernetes is an advantage.

Benefits

  • 100% remote work within the EMEA region.
  • Opportunity to work on advanced distributed database and PostgreSQL technologies.
  • Exposure to complex challenges involving high availability, geographic distribution, replication, and enterprise workloads.
  • Collaboration with a globally distributed team of experienced software and database engineers.
  • Access to health and wellness resources, including CuraLinc.
  • Wellness Fridays available through December 2026.
  • Additional region-specific benefits and perks depending on location.
  • Opportunity to contribute to open-source database technologies and develop deep expertise in distributed systems.
  • Remote-first environment designed to support collaboration and work-life balance.

title: Dietary Assistant
description:
Dietary Aide - PRN (on-call)

Department

Food and Nutrition Services

Reports to

Director of Food Services/Executive Chef/CDM

Reporting to this position

None

Job Classification

Department Staff

Position Purpose

Provide assistance in all food functions as directed/instructed and in accordance with established food policies and procedures.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

The dietary aide works with the facility’s CDM/Executive Chef of Food Services as necessary and implements recommended changes as required. Performs other duties, as assigned.

Ensures that food procedures are followed in accordance with established policies.

The dietary aide assists with the service and delivery of food trays to designated areas, cleaning of the kitchen per established protocols, and proper washing and cleaning of food utensils and dishes.

title: Staff Incident Response Commander
description:
Salary: $1200 - $1235 p.d. + (incl Super)

  • 12-month Sydney contract with a global software company
  • Hands-on forensics across Kubernetes, AWS and GCP
  • Senior IC role shaping process, tooling and mentoring


About the client

Our client is a global software and digital media company whose products are used by individuals and enterprises around the world. It's cyber defence centre protects the company's products, platforms and customers, working closely with engineering, product and partner teams. The incident response team handles serious, high-visibility security events across modern cloud and application environments. It is a team that values sound judgement, composure and genuine technical depth.

About the role

This is one of the most senior incident command roles in the team, and it stays hands-on. You will lead the most complex security incidents from first alert to closure while doing the forensic investigation yourself, across web applications, APIs, containers and multi-cloud infrastructure. You will bring order to incidents that span many internal teams and external partners, and move comfortably between deep technical analysis and clear briefings for senior leadership. Beyond live incidents, you will help shape how the team responds through better process, tooling, exercises and mentoring.

Duties

  • Command complex security incidents across the full response lifecycle, coordinating internal teams, external partners and their security operations centres.
  • Personally investigate web application, API, cloud and container compromises, including credential and data-exposure scenarios.
  • Collect, preserve and analyse forensic evidence across hosts, networks, cloud platforms and large log sources, keeping defensible records throughout.
  • Brief senior leadership clearly under pressure, and assign and drive remediation across multiple teams and organisations.
  • Build tooling for evidence collection at scale, and lead retrospectives, tabletop exercises, training and mentoring for responders and commanders.


Requirements

  • Extensive front-line incident response and digital forensics experience across many major incidents, with proven command of the full incident lifecycle.
  • Hands-on investigation of web application and API compromises, such as broken access control, authentication and authorisation bypass, IDOR, API abuse and CMS exploitation.
  • Cloud-native and container forensics, including Kubernetes and ephemeral infrastructure, with strong AWS and GCP experience across logging, identity and authorisation models.
  • Deep host and network forensics, including Linux internals and Windows and macOS artefacts.
  • EDR at scale (for example CrowdStrike Falcon), complex SIEM analytics, and log and data analysis across large platforms and data warehouses.
  • Scripting in Bash and at least one interpreted language, such as Python.
  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR and PCI.
  • Willingness to join an on-call rotation and respond to critical events.
  • Highly regarded: Azure, malware triage and reverse engineering, GCFA, GCIH, GNFA or cloud security certifications, and a government or law-enforcement investigation background.


How to apply

If this sounds like the kind of work you do best, we would love to hear from you, apply now.

title: Shared Inbox Coordinator
description:
Shared Inbox Coordinator

Office Administration | Shared Inbox | Remote | Full-time | 61,360–64,480 per year

An internal request is easy to miss when it lands in a shared inbox and no one knows who owns the next step. This position helps the team keep those requests visible. You will identify the topic, enter the relevant details in an online task record, and route the message to the appropriate colleague according to the employer’s instructions.

Where the work begins

  • Check the assigned inbox for new requests and replies to existing ones.
  • Read enough context to avoid opening a second task for the same issue.
  • Identify missing details that prevent the request from moving ahead.
  • Assign or forward the item under the team’s routing instructions.
  • Update the task record when information or ownership changes.
  • Keep unresolved messages visible for the appropriate person.
  • Close a task only when the record shows a finished result or approved handoff.

Requests can be simple: a colleague needs a current form, a customer-facing team asks for a document, or a scheduling change needs to reach the person maintaining the calendar. You will not be expected to settle every request yourself. Your job is to understand what the sender needs and make sure the right person has a complete, useful handoff.

If the inbox contains an unclear message, ask a focused question through the approved channel or flag the issue for review. Keep the original wording available rather than replacing it with an assumption. A short, accurate note about why something is pending can save another colleague from repeating the same investigation.

For example, a reply may arrive after an item has already been routed. Read the new information before forwarding it again. Update the existing task so the person responsible can see that something changed. If the message belongs to a different request, keep the two issues separate instead of merging unrelated histories.

What a well-run queue looks like

Every open item should have a visible status and, when the process calls for it, a person or team responsible for the next action. You may compare the latest reply with an existing task, update a due date only when instructed, or move a completed message into the correct folder. A request that has merely been forwarded is not necessarily finished; check the team’s process before marking it complete.

The role combines office administration with good written customer service habits. Even internal email benefits from direct questions, polite replies, and a clear explanation of what happens next. You should be able to distinguish an informational note from an action request and notice when a message relates to private material that needs careful handling.

What you need at the start

Basic computer confidence, organized written communication, and the ability to follow routing instructions are more useful here than a particular job title. Experience with shared email, customer service, or office administration is a plus, not a requirement. Beginners are welcome. The employer can train you on its task categories, tools, and escalation route. If you have kept a group project, school activity, or volunteer inbox organized, that experience may also be relevant.

This is remote computer-based work and is full-time. A private home office or comparable suitable workspace can help you handle internal requests carefully.

A shared inbox can contain several versions of the same internal request. You would check whether a colleague has already replied before assigning or forwarding it. A request about an office document belongs with the person responsible for that document; a request asking for a decision needs the decision maker, not a guessed answer from the inbox. When a sender provides the missing reference later, connect it to the earlier thread and update its status. The goal is an inbox that shows what is awaiting action, who owns it and what the requester has already been told.

To apply

Make it easy to find relevant examples of organizing messages, tracking tasks, or passing information accurately on your resume. Direct shared-inbox experience is welcome but not needed. An applicant who is new to office work can still show careful follow-through from another setting. If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. We will look for someone prepared to learn the team’s process and keep requests from getting lost.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in structural and vibration analysis, as well as experience with thermal and CFD modeling, military environmental standards, and opto-mechanical systems.

  • Conduct shock and dynamic analyses, including steady-state and transient vibration regimes.

  • Conduct CFD analyses to evaluate system performance in highly dynamic fluid flow events.

  • Develop finite element models and simulations using ANSYS Workbench, verifying analytical results through test data correlation.

  • Analyze and design electronic packaging and structural components for extreme operational conditions.

  • Work closely with Mechanical, Optical, Electrical, Product, and Systems Engineering teams to develop integrated, flight-qualified hardware.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant military and aerospace standards, including MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-516, AS9100, and MMPDS specifications.

  • Support environmental test procedure development and assist in the execution and oversight of testing programs.

  • Participate in design reviews, documentation generation, and technical reporting for internal and customer stakeholders.

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Civil Engineering.

  • Strong leadership skills with a proven track record of successful team leadership, team building and project leadership.

  • 10+ years of experience in stress and structural analysis for aerospace or military systems.

  • 10+ years of experience using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software.

  • Proven experience in vibration and shock analyses, including steady-state and transient regimes.

  • Experience with electronic packaging and structural integrity assessment for aerospace applications.

Communication Skills:

  • Must have the ability to effectively read, write and communicate in English with employees and customers.
