title: Senior Risk Specialist - Investments
description:
We’re all about helping our members make the most of their money. And while they go after their goals, you can too. As a Senior Risk Specialist - Investments, you'll operate as a key member of the Line 1 Risk function within Investments, providing specialist risk expertise across investment activities, business change initiatives and strategic programs. You'll help strengthen investment risk frameworks, operational resilience, governance and controls while partnering with senior stakeholders to support sound decision-making and sustainable member outcomes.

Working closely with Investment teams, Investment Operations, Group Risk and Compliance, and Internal Audit, you'll provide practical and commercially focused advice on complex and emerging risk matters. You'll drive continuous improvement across governance, controls and operational resilience while supporting the business to identify, assess, manage and monitor risk effectively.

You'll lead risk initiatives that support investment activities, transformation programs and strategic change, ensuring risk considerations are embedded into decision-making, governance processes and business operations. You'll also play a key role in enhancing operational resilience practices and strengthening the maturity of the Investments risk and control environment.

Success in this role will come from your ability to balance commercial outcomes with effective risk management, influence stakeholders, challenge constructively and drive positive risk outcomes across a sophisticated investment environment.

This role is a permanent opportunity and is based in Brisbane or Sydney.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Act as a senior Line 1 Risk specialist within Investments, partnering with business leaders to manage risk in line with ART's Risk Management Framework and risk appetite.
  • Lead the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of investment risk and control frameworks, risk profiles, key risk indicators and governance processes.
  • Provide practical and commercial risk advice to investment teams, supporting informed decision-making and accountability for risk management outcomes.
  • Challenge, influence and support business leaders to identify, assess, manage and monitor risks within their areas of responsibility.
  • Drive ownership of controls across Investments, monitoring effectiveness and facilitating the timely remediation of control weaknesses and gaps.
  • Lead risk assessments for investment activities, new initiatives, business change programs and strategic projects, ensuring risks are appropriately understood and managed.
  • Champion the embedding of risk management into business-as-usual activities, investment processes and governance forums.
  • Drive operational resilience initiatives across Investments, including service provider oversight, business continuity planning and alignment with CPS 230 requirements.
  • Manage the assessment, investigation and remediation of issues, incidents and near misses, identifying root causes and opportunities for systemic improvement.
  • Coordinate Investments' participation in audits, assurance reviews and regulatory activities, ensuring timely and sustainable outcomes.
  • Prepare high-quality risk reporting, metrics and governance papers that provide meaningful insights into the Investments risk profile.
  • Partner closely with Line 2 Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit while maintaining clear accountability for Line 1 risk ownership and outcomes.
  • Foster a strong risk culture through coaching, education and capability building across the Investments business.
  • Identify opportunities to improve governance, risk management practices and operational resilience outcomes across Investments.

It goes without saying you'll be a great communicator with top notch interpersonal skills. We'll also expect you to pick up problems and come up with quick, creative ways to solve them. It's quite likely you tick some of the following boxes too:

  • You have extensive experience operating within a Line 1 Risk function in investments, superannuation, banking, asset management or financial services.
  • Your track record demonstrates the successful implementation and ongoing management of risk and control frameworks within a business-owned risk environment.
  • You'll bring strong knowledge of financial markets, investment products, investment operations and the associated risk landscape.
  • You're experienced partnering with senior business leaders to support risk-informed decision-making while providing constructive challenge and influence.
  • You have demonstrated success embedding risk management disciplines into business processes, strategic initiatives and transformation programs.
  • Your experience includes ownership of risk assessments, control assurance activities, issue management and remediation programs.
  • You'll possess strong understanding of operational risk management, control frameworks, CPS 230 operational resilience requirements and contemporary risk practices.
  • You're able to balance commercial outcomes with effective risk management, providing pragmatic and solutions-focused advice.
  • You have exceptional stakeholder management skills and can build trusted relationships across business, risk, compliance and audit functions.
  • Your ability to analyse complex information, identify emerging risks and communicate insights to senior stakeholders is highly developed.
  • You'll hold tertiary qualifications in finance, business, risk management or a related discipline, with RMIA, FRM, CFA or similar credentials viewed favourably.
  • You're comfortable operating in a highly accountable environment where Line 1 ownership of risk, controls and remediation outcomes is critical.

title: Controls Room - Product Owner - Vice President
description:

Join our agile, future-focused, and collaborative team that values continuous improvement and operational excellence!

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team’s objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing and monitoring firmwide risk-based intelligence into all lines of business and corporate functions.

The Controls Room gathers information from key business and technology partners in order to:

  • Present roadmaps, technology solutions, and status updates on various forums with senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Advanced experience translating complex user requests to clear technical requirements using agile methodology and management tools such as JIRA.
  • Deliver iteratively using agile practices and small, empowered teams (e.g., Pizza POD), accelerating time-to-value through rapid prototyping, partnering tightly with design and engineering, and continuous feedback loops.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development and prototyping tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) in line with approved tooling/controls.

  • Hands-on experience incorporating AI-enabled capabilities into products (e.g., orchestration, decision support, human-in-the-loop review) with an emphasis on control, transparency, and auditability.
  • Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria are well-defined, testable, and aligned to outcomes (and evolving approach as the firm evolves the software development lifecycle).
  • Establish and track success metrics to measure ROI and business value, leveraging data to guide prioritization and investment decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills; must be able to communicate with a wide variety of functional groups at various levels. Enthusiastic, self-motivated, effective under pressure and willing to take personal responsibility/accountability.
  • Flexible, adaptable to shifting priorities; able to work in a fast-paced, results driven environment. Effective time management and multitasking skills.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

  • Experience in financial industry, auditing, compliance, or consulting and an understanding of risks & controls management is beneficial.

description:

Under the Aquatics Director, the Coordinator- Aquatics is responsible to maintain a safe aquatic environment.     • Must have contact with victim within 10 seconds
    • Remain within 2 feet of the pool at all times
  • Perform appropriate rescues
  • Administer First Aid, CPR, AED or 02 as necessary
  • Conduct Lifeguard Drills including securing victim, observing staff and debriefing

  • Minimum age of 18 years of age
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a lifeguard
  • Current YMCA Swim Lesson Instructor certification or American Red Cross WSI (must crossover to YMCA within 6 months)
  • Current YMCA or American Red Cross Lifeguard Training (must crossover to YMCA in 6 months)
  • Lifeguard Instructor certification, desirable
  • Current First Aid for Public Safety Personnel and must be from one of the following certifying organization: American Red Cross, American Heart
  • Association or American Safety & Health Institute.
  • Current CPR PRO/AED and must be from one of the following certifying organization: American Red Cross, American Heart Association or American Safety & Health Institute.
  • Current O2 certification and must be from one of the following certifying organization: American Red Cross, American Heart Association or American Safety & Health Institute.
  • Current CPO certification within 60 days of employment
  • Previous experience in supervision of staff
  • Must pass written and practical skills prior to duty

title: Strategic Account Director
description:
Our Mission

SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡

We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.

  • Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.

  • Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.

At SPAN, we believe in:

  • Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy

  • Making electrification upgrades possible

  • Building more resilient homes with reliable backup

  • Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid

The Role

The Strategic Account Manager serves a critical role, driving partnership success of SPAN’s largest nationwide installer partners. This role owns and grows partnership outcomes covering both tactical operations and execution as well as strategic program management and roadmap. We are looking for someone who can operate without a playbook and has a passion for seeding and scaling new offerings within a large, complex organization. The right candidate will have experience and comfort operating across every level of a partner organization, from executive leadership to regional sales and field installation teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive overall revenue contribution from SPAN’s largest solar and storage partners, including week-to-week task management, training & sales enablement, marketing & events, product/program roadmap alignment, and strategic initiatives to maximize SPAN adoption and installations.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the partnership, fostering and maintaining a robust, trusted relationship to understand the partner’s needs and deliver customized energy management solutions that grow their business.

  • Develop fluency with partner business operations, reporting structure, and strategic priorities, and ensure ongoing alignment of SPAN engagement plan

  • Lead regular business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) with partner counterparts and leadership

  • Track partnership performance across various markets, products, and use cases, and steer activation priorities and resourcing accordingly.

  • Define and execute joint programs, promotions, and offerings, and integrate them into the partner’s commercial operations.

  • Interface with the SPAN Product team to represent partner priorities and feedback, and coordinate joint roadmaps, release timelines, and launch plans.

  • Maximize high-impact training and activation events across the partner’s field sales organization.

  • Work with leadership to prioritize markets, events, and messaging, and measure the sales and conversion impact of these efforts.

  • Provide accurate sales forecasts that meet and exceed quota for the account and monitor performance to ensure financial objectives are met.

  • Manage and oversee operational cadence across forecasts, orders, deliveries, and inventory management

  • Work cross-functionally with SPAN teams (Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance) to consistently align on strategy and deliver on partnership commitments.

About You

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic account management, channel partnerships, or B2B sales/operations with contractors in the solar & storage or broader home services industry

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a large, complex partner account—balancing forecasting, order management, program execution, and relationship management simultaneously

  • Comfort working with corporate leaders and cross-functional teams as well as regional and field-level stakeholders at a large national organization

  • Strong commercial instincts, combined with analytical and operational skills to help a partner incorporate SPAN into their business and commercial operations

  • Strong technical aptitude with experience selling or supporting both hardware and software solutions

  • Ability to build and execute joint program roadmaps and engage key stakeholders to deliver on them

  • Ability to get things done in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Strong team-player with a proven track record of working effectively with all stakeholders, including Product, Operations, and Marketing

  • Proficient in Salesforce CRM with a strong track record of leveraging the tool to support sales forecasting, account, and opportunity management

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Positive mindset and attitude, strong team player, and a passion for rapidly scaling residential energy management solutions

  • Up to 50% travel may be required

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience working for a product manufacturer in the renewables or HVAC markets in a two-step distribution sales model

  • Experience managing a top-tier or flagship account within a larger channel or partnerships organization

Life at SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges.

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.

The Perks:

⚡ Competitive compensation + equity grants at a well-funded, venture-backed company

⚡ Comprehensive benefits: 100% employee premiums for base plans on medical, dental, vision with options for additional coverage. Parental leave up to twenty four (24) weeks depending on eligibility

⚡ Comfortable, sunny office space located near BART and Caltrain public transit

⚡ Strong focus on team building and company culture: Employee Resource Groups, monthly social events, SPANcakes recognition breakfast, lunch, and learns

⚡ Flexible hours, one holiday per month, and flexible time off

Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

title: Principal Product Manager, Sandboxes
description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Products Team at Docker is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead components of Docker Sandboxes. You will own and drive this strategic product area from high-level concept design through delivery, adoption, and operation. You will help shape how developers and AI agents use fast, secure, isolated environments across local and cloud workflows. You will work closely with developers inside and outside of Docker, our customers, and our partners to expand our open ecosystem offering and provide value. As the company and ecosystem grow, you will help foster teams eager to continuously build, measure, and learn.

To thrive in this role, you will need experience working with developers, deep technical fluency in systems and developer infrastructure, and prior experience as a software engineer. You will need to understand containers, sandboxes/microVMs, virtualization technologies, hypervisors, the software development lifecycle, and how untrusted or agent-generated code can be safely executed and orchestrated. You will need a relentless drive to try new things and an eye for detail. Your long-term success will depend on your ability to own the product roadmap, earn the trust of the developer community, and scale reliable services. Most importantly, you will need to be comfortable taking ownership of big objectives with big goals, working with a cross-functional team, and maintaining a bias for action.

Responsibilities

  • You own Docker Sandboxes, its long-term vision, roadmap, revenue, adoption, and results.

  • You believe in and can succinctly articulate our customers, their workflows, and their pain points. You empathize with the world they live in and the security, performance, compatibility, and cost constraints they work through.

  • You will engage deeply with developers building AI agents, coding environments, CI and testing systems, and other workloads that require secure, isolated execution, finding solutions for today while optimizing for tomorrow's vision.

  • You enjoy building infrastructure products that are easy to adopt and use. You will turn complex tradeoffs across isolation, startup time, performance, density, networking, storage, and cost into simple product experiences.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and will guide product definition, feature prioritization, and scope in concert with engineering, design, security, operations, and go-to-market teams.

  • You are a fan of iterative development, working with customers and cross-functional teams to hypothesize, measure adoption and impact, learn from releases, and continually improve the roadmap.

Qualifications

  • You have deep empathy for the needs of developers and are obsessed with talking to your users.

  • You have prior professional experience as a software engineer, ideally in systems, infrastructure, platform engineering, developer tools, or cloud.

  • You have strong technical familiarity with sandboxes/microVMs, containers, virtualization technologies, and hypervisors, including the isolation and security boundaries each provides.

  • You understand the building blocks of modern developer infrastructure, including Linux, container runtimes, orchestration, networking, storage, APIs, and cloud services.

  • You have experience designing, building, or operating systems that execute customer-provided, untrusted, or agent-generated code at scale.

  • You are comfortable interacting with a command-line interface and discussing APIs, SDKs, and technical architecture with engineers and developers.

  • You have experience building B2B or SaaS products, or a background in public cloud and developer infrastructure.

  • You understand software supply chain and software security concerns, including multi-tenant isolation, identity, secrets management, observability, and reliability.

  • You can break down complex technical problems into small, releasable, user-valuable features.

  • You can explain complex ideas simply and communicate effectively in writing, verbally, and visually across diverse stakeholders.

  • You can analyze qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, define success metrics, and prioritize investments.

  • You have a collaborative approach, experience running products from greenfield to scale, and the ability to work with fast-moving, distributed, cross-functional teams. You are a doer as well as a strategist; we are small and need all hands on deck.

What to expect
First 30 days

  • Get to know Docker: our vision, mission, and values.

  • Understand the Docker Sandboxes team's mission, product strategy, and technical architecture.

  • Meet the team along with peers across the business unit and company.

  • Work closely with designers, researchers, engineers, security partners, and customers to understand user needs and current pain points.

  • Work with your manager and team to review and create quarterly goals.

  • Understand the product roadmap, key technical and business tradeoffs, and the data available to make data-driven decisions.

First 90 days

  • Understand the company's and business unit's product vision and how Docker Sandboxes contributes to it.

  • Provide clarity on product vision, target users, priority use cases, and how the team contributes to the overall success of Docker.

  • Develop a deep understanding of our developers and customers, how they use isolated environments, and why they choose Docker.

  • Shape the team roadmap and product strategy in close collaboration with design, engineering, security, and go-to-market peers.

  • Lead the definition of team OKRs and success metrics for the quarter, and provide clear progress reports.

One Year Outlook

  • Lead product initiatives across cross-functional teams that make secure, isolated execution simple and valuable for developers and AI agents.

  • Drive the long-term direction of Docker Sandboxes, including improvements to adoption, ecosystem integration, reliability, scale, unit economics, and ARR.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

Canada CA$255,500 - CA$365,000 + equity

United States: $184,100 - $263,000 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

title: Director of Security (Guest Relations)
location: The Standard Spa, Miami Beach - MIAMI BEACH, FL 33139
description:
Director of Guest Relations

Company Background

The Standard is one of the most culturally engaged hotels in the world. Hotels with real cultural life, an inclusive spirit and true creative attitude. A destination layered with events and amusements that leaves you with an uplifted feeling.

The Standard's irreverent and playful sensibility, combined with a careful consideration of design, detail and service, have established its reputation as a pioneer of hospitality, travel, dining, nightlife, and beyond. The Standard Hotels are known for their taste-making clientele, their pioneering design, and their unrelenting un-Standard-ness.

Mission Statement

To create experience by embracing and empowering a diverse collective of team members, collaborators, and guests, who choose to call The Standard home.

Our Purpose

The Standard’s commitment is to being an anchor for each neighborhood in which we reside as well as a platform for culture and creativity. Bringing people together in its spaces to interact with each other in genuine ways.

Our promise is to ensure that a stay is an experience and that a memory means making friends and having stories to tell. To understand why it exists, is to understand that The Standard, is a platform for people to meet, to engage, to learn, to dine, to sleep, to dance, to hideaway, to make believe and to do so whilst being yourself and having fun doing it.

We think of ourselves as a stage, not just a hotel. Here, you can become whoever you like, even if for just a night. Here, you will meet new friends, find new challenges, eat new food, stay up late, sleep in later, and at times, never even leave the property. We are unapologetically comfortable with disrupting expectations. It’s WHO WE ARE!

Why You’ll Love Your New Lifestyle

We know the kitchen life is demanding, so we’ve curated a benefits suite that helps you recharge and stay inspired:

  • Recovery & Wellness: After a long shift, take advantage of full Access to our world-class Spa & Gym Access. Reset your body with up to 3 complimentary fitness classes every week.
  • Summer Sanctuary: Cool off on your days off with Designated Employee Pool Days throughout the summer.
  • Taste the Property: Enjoy generous Restaurant Discounts at all our on-site dining venues, plus Spa Discounts for those much-needed treatments.
  • Style & Gear: Get exclusive Boutique Discounts for all your retail needs.
  • Competitive Pay & Security: full suite of benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, and a 401(k) plan.

The Role

The Director of Guest Relations leads the team responsible for safety, security, loss prevention, and incident response across the property. This leader brings a calm, visible presence to guest and employee interactions, reduces preventable losses, and builds a consistent, capable team through clear procedures, training, and accountability. The role partners with department leaders to protect people and property while preserving the guest experience.

What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable the Guest Relations team across shifts; set clear expectations, prepare schedules, and build strong shift handoffs.
  • Maintain a visible presence throughout the property and position coverage based on guest activity, events, and operational risk.
  • Develop practical loss prevention measures to reduce theft, property damage, unauthorized access, and other preventable incidents; review trends and address recurring gaps.
  • Set consistent standards for patrols, access control, keys, restricted areas, lost and found, incident escalation, and report writing.
  • Train employees through onboarding, regular refreshers, and realistic scenarios in de-escalation, guest interaction, documentation, and emergency response.
  • Respond to significant safety, security, guest, or employee incidents with composure; guide de-escalation and coordinate an appropriate response.
  • Ensure incident reports are timely, factual, complete, and supported by available statements, photographs, video, and other evidence; review and correct reports before closure.
  • Lead or oversee investigations and protect the confidentiality and integrity of reports, footage, evidence, and sensitive information.
  • Oversee CCTV use, footage retention, access devices, patrols, and safety inspections in accordance with property procedures.
  • Analyzes procedures that have risk continuously and improves SOP oversight and training.
  • Coordinate responses to medical emergencies, fire alarms, severe weather, evacuations, and other critical events; keep emergency plans and team training current.
  • Work with police, fire rescue, emergency medical services, and other outside agencies when appropriate.
  • Partner with department leaders on special events, high occupancy, guest concerns, employee matters, and corrective actions arising from incidents.
  • Support hiring, performance management, recognition, and employee development in partnership with Human Resources.
  • Keep records, training logs, and equipment organized; provide leadership with timely updates on major incidents, loss trends, and recommended improvements.

What You Bring

  • At least five years of progressive experience in hotel security, loss prevention, guest relations, or a related field, including at least two years leading a team. Luxury hospitality experience is preferred.
  • A proven ability to train, coach, and hold a team accountable while building trust and consistent execution across shifts.
  • Strong judgment, emotional control, and a calm presence when de-escalating sensitive or tense situations.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to produce objective, thorough, and timely incident reports.
  • Working knowledge of investigations, CCTV, access control, evidence preservation, emergency response, and loss prevention practices.
  • Strong organization and discretion when managing multiple priorities and confidential information.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with guests, employees, executives, and outside agencies.
  • First Aid, CPR, and AED certification, or the ability to obtain them during the established introductory period. Availability for evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and emergency response; additional languages are welcome.

Physical Requirements

This role requires extended periods of standing and walking throughout the property, including indoor and outdoor areas; the ability to respond quickly during incidents; and the ability to lift or carry up to 25 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation. Work may involve variable weather and emergency conditions.

title: Ambtelijk Secretaris Cliëntenraden
description:
Bied jij effectieve ondersteuning aan de cliëntenraden, zodat zij de belangen van onze cliënten zo goed mogelijk kunnen behartigen?

Onze cliënten en vertegenwoordigers denken mee over het beleid van Bartiméus. Zij geven advies, hebben instemmingsrecht en toetsen het beleid aan de praktijk. Zo weten wij of onze dienstverlening aansluit bij de zorgbehoefte. Een belangrijke taak. Waar ze jouw hulp en ondersteuning als ambtelijk secretaris goed bij kunnen gebruiken.

Jouw rol als Ambtelijk Secretaris voor de Cliëntenraden Senioren Ambulant en Verblijf bij Bartiméus in Ermelo en Zeist

Bij alles wat wij doen staan onze slechtziende en blinde cliënten centraal. Niet vreemd dus dat zij een belangrijke stem hebben in hoe wij onze dienstverlening vormgeven. Die stem kunnen zij laten horen via de verschillende cliëntenraden van Bartiméus, die georganiseerd zijn per locatie en klantgroep. Dit doen zij door regelmatig in gesprek te gaan met de managers van de klantgroepen. Wat gaat er goed? Wat kan er beter? Hoe kunnen we ideeën en wensen van cliënten vertalen naar nieuwe ontwikkelingen? Als Ambtelijk Secretaris heb jij hierin een cruciale rol. Jij zorgt dat in overleg met de voorzitter van de raad de juiste onderwerpen op de agenda staan, dat zij beschikken over alle informatie en dat afspraken gemaakt en nagekomen worden. Je doet dit in een team van in totaal zes ambtelijk secretarissen van cliëntenraden, ondernemingsraad en medezeggenschapsraad. Samen coördineren jullie de beleidsmatige, organisatorische en ondersteunende werkzaamheden voor de diverse cliëntenraden en realiseren jullie een goed besluitvormingsproces.

Jij gaat de cliëntenraden Senioren Ambulant en Senioren Verblijf ondersteunen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol bij:

  • Het na afstemming met de voorzitter van een cliëntenraad en de klantgroepmanager voorbereiden en afhandelen van vergaderingen en overleggen.

  • Het verzamelen van documentatie en informatie over de door de raad aangegeven onderwerpen, indien nodig (ongevraagd) adviseren, bewaken van de planning en ondersteunen bij het stellen van prioriteiten.

  • Realiseren van een goede samenwerking tussen de cliëntenraden onderling en met collega’s binnen de organisatie.

  • Procesmatig en administratief ondersteunen van de cliëntenraden. Onder andere door het vastleggen, beheren en actueel houden van afspraken, opstellen van adviezen, instemmingsbrieven en andere correspondentie en documentatie.

  • De raad inhoudelijk adviseren en coachen over de Wmcz.

Wij zijn Bartiméus

Wij zijn Bartiméus. Met zo’n 1.900 medewerkers en ruim 850 vrijwilligers zijn we er voor mensen in Nederland die slechtziend of blind zijn. Ook als ze een meervoudige beperking hebben of problemen ervaren met zien door bijvoorbeeld niet aangeboren hersenletsel. We zijn er voor hun naasten en voor de professionals om hen heen. Zij kunnen terecht bij ons expertisecentrum, bij onze ambulante dienstverleners, in onze scholen en woonvoorzieningen, en bij de verschillende vormen van dagbesteding die we bieden. We stellen alles in het werk om mogelijk te maken dat mensen met een visuele beperking het leven kunnen leiden dat bij hen past en zich voluit kunnen ontplooien. Want het gaat niet om hoeveel procent je ziet. Het gaat om hoeveel procent je leeft. Bartiméus. 100% leven.

Wie ben jij?

Natuurlijk ben jij helemaal in je element als je jouw kennis van medezeggenschap kunt combineren met je organisatorische talenten. Maar jouw hart gaat pas echt sneller kloppen als je dit mag doen voor een bijzondere doelgroep, de (seniore) cliënten van Bartiméus. Met jouw enthousiasme en teamspirit zet jij alles op alles om samen met je collega’s de cliëntenmedezeggenschap bij Bartiméus onder de aandacht te brengen. Hierbij kun je vertrouwen op je uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Jij bent de verbindende factor voor cliënten en organisatie. Ook heb je:

  • Minimaal een mbo-diploma en hbo-werk en denkniveau,

  • Ervaring als ambtelijk secretaris en/of ervaring in een ondersteunende of secretariële functie in de zorg is een pre, waarbij je in het laatste geval kennis hebt opgedaan met cliëntenrechten en belangenbehartiging. Bij voorkeur heb je de opleiding voor ambtelijk secretaris van het LSR, LOC of NCZ afgerond of ben je bereid die te volgen.

  • Kennis van de Wmcz en de veranderende wet- en regelgeving binnen de langdurige gezondheidszorg en de vaardigheid om die in te brengen bij zowel de cliëntenraden als de organisatie.

  • Een flexibele beschikbaarheid. Vergaderingen vinden soms in de avonduren plaats, zowel in Zeist als in Ermelo.

Wat bieden we jou

  • Een uitdagende baan waarbij je samen met de raad het verschil maakt voor een bijzondere doelgroep.

  • Een jaarcontract voor circa 16-20 uur per week met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Salaris passend bij je ervaring. Op basis van de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg is min. €3.113,- en max. €4.347,- (FWG 45) bruto per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.

  • Vakantietoeslag van 8%, een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% én een aantrekkelijk meerkeuzesysteem arbeidsvoorwaarden, waarmee je profiteert van fiscaal voordeel op aanschaf van onder andere een (lease)fiets, sportabonnementen, uitjes, museumjaarkaart en cadeaubonnen.

  • Volop ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden in de vorm van een uitgebreid inwerktraject en een online aanbod ondersteunende trainingen van 'GoodHabitz'.

Enthousiast? Solliciteren is heel eenvoudig

Gebruik de link op onze vacaturepagina en de rest wijst zich vanzelf. Reageren op deze vacature kan tot en met 25 oktober 2026. De eerste gesprekken kunnen gedurende de looptijd van deze vacature plaatsvinden.

Liever eerst meer informatie? Neem voor inhoudelijke vragen contact op met de voorzitters van de CRSA - Bea Keuper op tel. 06 - 83 70 29 69 of CRSV - Toos Nansink op tel. 06 - 44 69 72 32 of met Marcel Dopper, secretaris Raad van Bestuur op tel. 06 - 54 22 69 66.

Voor algemene vragen bel of app met Andrea van Diermen (Recruiter) op tel. 06 - 81 36 06 24.

Ter aanvulling - Om bij ons aan de slag te gaan is het aanvragen van een VOG nodig. Daarnaast zijn een diploma- en referentiecheck ook onderdeel van de procedure.

title: Senior Product Analytics Engineer
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You'll Do:

Horizon3 is investing in a company-wide data strategy to make our data trusted, governed, and built to power revenue growth. The Senior Product Analytics Engineer sits at the center of that effort: you're the bridge between how product data is modeled and built and how it's trusted and used across the company.

You'll work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to help shape the canonical product data layer at the source, with the emerging Data Governance function to get metrics certified and documented, and with the Product analysts and PMs to turn that foundation into self-service, decision-ready data products. You're equally comfortable writing a dbt model, troubleshooting a pipeline, and helping a non-technical stakeholder define a company wide KPI.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines and data models that translate raw product usage and event telemetry into trusted, well-documented analytics assets.

  • Partner with Product Engineering on the canonical product data layer — ensuring product usage cohorts and behavioral signal definitions are built on accurate, governed source data, not just what's convenient downstream.

  • Partner with the new Data Governance function: support taxonomy definition work, prepare metrics for certification, and maintain documentation to governance standards (including AI/machine-readable structure).

  • Build and own the semantic layer and self-service data models for Product Analytics, so internal stakeholders can query with confidence without needing a SQL expert in the room every time.

  • Own data quality monitoring and anomaly detection for product usage data specifically, partnering with Data Engineering when issues trace back to pipeline or platform-level causes.

  • Contribute analytics engineering support to the expansion/upsell cohort work, building the pipelines and models that turn usage thresholds, feature adoption, and seat utilization into certified, production-grade metrics.

  • Collaborate with data people across the company to help define analytics standards and tooling enablement and then ensure Product Analytics' practices align with the company-wide methodology as it matures.

  • Present technical data concepts and their business implications clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.

  • Drive engineering best practices within the Product Analytics team's data assets.

What You'll Bring:

  • A builder's mindset for data — you enjoy shaping how product data is modeled at the source, not just querying what already exists

  • Comfort moving fluidly between technical and business conversations

  • A governance driven approach to data. You default to documenting, defining, and getting alignment on what a metric means, rather than shipping something that "mostly works"

  • Bias toward self-service, you build data models assuming someone else will need to understand and trust them without you in the room

  • Curiosity and ownership when something looks off in the data

  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving data environment and comfortable building foundational structure while priorities and requirements are still taking shape

Required Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • 7+ years of experience spanning data engineering and analytics, ideally in a role bridging both

  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with dbt

  • Hands-on experience building both production data pipelines and stakeholder-facing analytics/dashboards

  • Experience translating ambiguous business requirements into governed, well-documented data models

Preferred Education/Experience:

  • Proven experience partnering directly with product/engineering teams on instrumentation and source data design — not just consuming what's handed downstream

  • Experience standing up or contributing to a data governance or metrics-certification process

  • Familiarity with BI/visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data pipelines

  • Regular use of AI in coding/development workflows (agents, memory files, copilots)

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range is $142,718-$186,560. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Customer Email Response Assistant
description:
Customer Email Response Assistant

Customer Service | Email Enquiries | Remote | Full-time or part-time | 29.25–31.00 per hour

Help customers get a useful answer

This remote role is centred on an assigned customer email inbox. You will read everyday questions, look up the information available to the support team, and write a reply that answers what you can. When an issue needs another person’s review, you will record the question and make a clear handoff. The aim is to prevent a customer from having to repeat the same details in every exchange.

The opening may be part-time or full-time.

A useful email reply also has to survive a second reading. Before sending it, check that a link opens the page you meant to share and that the subject line still describes the conversation. If the message includes a question for another department, identify that question in the handoff and leave the original email attached. The customer should not receive a vague promise that somebody will reply immediately unless the team has confirmed that timing. This attention to the record is what allows another colleague to pick up the exchange without asking the customer to start again.

The kind of correspondence you will handle

A customer may want to know where to find a service document, whether a routine request has been received, or which online page explains the next step. You would check approved guidance and any relevant history before replying. If the message covers several questions, separate the answer into short parts rather than responding to only the easiest one. A reply should tell the customer what is known, what remains open, and whether someone else will need to follow up.

Some requests arrive without enough detail to locate a record. Ask for only the information needed under the employer’s process, and leave the request marked as pending until that detail arrives. If a customer sends a new email about an open issue, connect it with the earlier conversation when you can. That prevents duplicate replies and helps the team see the full exchange.

There may also be a question you cannot resolve from the material in front of you. In that case, let the customer know the request has been passed along when the process allows it, and give the receiving colleague enough context to continue. Avoid suggesting that a decision has been made simply because the email was forwarded.

Accuracy matters as much as tone

Good written customer service is more than sounding friendly. It means using the correct name, avoiding unsupported promises, and keeping an explanation clear to someone unfamiliar with the company’s systems. You may use approved response material, but adjust the wording to address the actual question. If the guidance does not cover a situation, flag the gap rather than making up an answer.

Routine office administration is part of the job too: marking an inquiry’s status, attaching the relevant email to the right record, and leaving a short note after a handoff. Before closing a request, check that the customer received either an answer or a specific next step. The record should make sense to a colleague who did not see the first message.

Skills that will help

Clear writing, careful reading, and comfort using browser tabs and an online inbox are important. You should be able to organize several open questions without confusing customer details. Prior customer service or office administration experience is welcome but not required. Applicants new to this kind of role are encouraged to apply; the employer can train you on its guidance, inbox, and recordkeeping process. Experience from study, volunteering, or another job where you explained information clearly can also transfer.

For remote work involving customer information, you will need a suitable private workspace. A home office is one possible setup. The employer will confirm the actual schedule and any specific equipment requirements for its opening.

Interested in the role?

Your application can highlight writing, customer communication, or experience organizing requests, even if it came from outside a formal support job. A particular email platform is not a requirement. We are interested in applicants who know when to check a fact before sending a reply.

If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. Your relevant skills and willingness to learn will be considered alongside any direct experience.

title: Front Office Supervisor
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE: FRONT OFFICE SUPERVISOR

USUAL TIME OF WORK SHIFT: Varies with facility needs. Full-time or part time positions, variable hours per week.

BREAKS: Two breaks, and one ½ hour lunch, depending on shift.

OVERTIME: As necessary

MACHINES USED: Office machines, tools, and equipment, i.e. desktop or laptop computer, fax, copier, printer, shredder, credit card reader, company vehicle (automatic transmission equipped).

TOOLS USED: General clerical office tools and equipment, cell phone, calculator, etc.

ASSISTIVE DEVICES: Wheeled pushcarts, luggage carts, dollies, raingear, etc.

SAFETY CLOTHING/EQUIPMENT: Company uniform only, consisting of dress or casual shirt, pants

SKILLS & ABILITIES REQUIRED: Speak, read, write, and understand the primary language(s) used in the workplace. Previous experience in staff management; Bilingual a plus.

DESCRIPTION OF WORKPLACE/WORKSTATION:

The work takes place at a variety of office locations within a hotel facility. The surfaces at the office locations are level, carpeted, tiled, or have wood flooring. All of the work locations are well-lit and temperature controlled. The Front Office Supervisor may be exposed for limited periods of time to various weather conditions when ambulating from parking lot to office areas, building to building or other outdoor areas. The position may require the operation of a motor vehicle, as assigned.

DESCRIPTION OF JOB TASKS/PURPOSE:

The Front Office Supervisor performs a variety of services for guests. Primarily, he/she registers arriving guests, assigns rooms, and checks guests out at the end of their stay. The Front Office Supervisor also keep records of room assignments and other registration information in a computer database. When guests check out, the Front Office Supervisor prepares and explains the charges, as well as processes payments. He/She represents the establishment, and attitude and behavior greatly influence the public’s impression of the establishment. When answering questions about services, check out times, the local community, or other matters of public interest, the Front OfficeSupervisor must be courteous and helpful. Should guests report problems with their rooms, the Associate contacts members of the housekeeping or maintenance staff in order to correct them. When necessary, the Associate will deliver basic necessities (i.e., toiletries) to guests if no other staff member is available. The Front Office Supervisor is responsible for performing most major managerial decisions. (With proper authorization.) Depending on the property, additional supervisory responsibilities may include: Front Office Operations, Information and Services; basic bookkeeping; Advance Reservation Agent; cashier; and telephone multiline operation.

Major Job Functions:

1. Provide the highest quality of service to the customers at all times.

2. Greet customers immediately with a friendly and sincere welcome.

3. Utilize guest's names in interactions whenever possible.

4. Promptly respond to all guest-related concerns including but not limited to complaints and special requests.

5. Have a thorough knowledge of emergency and security procedures.

6. Know how to clean guestrooms to standards.

7. Know how to perform basic routine maintenance as well as how to properly operate all mechanical units within the guestroom.

8. Know how to operate all laundry equipment.

9. Keep maintenance personnel informed of all maintenance needs.

10. Proper uniform attire must be worn at all times in accordance with the Company and your hotel's brand standards.

11. Personal cleanliness and neat appearance are required. Shoes must be low heeled and have heels and toes closed.

12. Practice safety standards at all times.

13. Be able to move miscellaneous items weighing up to 40 lbs. Please inform property management if you are unable to meet this requirement so they can determine if a reasonable accommodation can be made.

14. Associates may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel.

15. Regular attendance in conformance with the standards, which may from time to time be established by The Victus Group is essential to the successful performance of this position.

16. Check guests in and out in an efficient and friendly manner.

17. Post guest changes and compute guest bill using the brand specific PMS. Collect payment and make change for hotel guests following all cash handling procedures as required by Company standards.

18. Promote the hotel’s marketing programs..

19. Track business via the recording of appropriate corporate/leisure information within the PMS system.

20. Maintain a positive, interactive relationship with any property-based sales personnel.

21. Handle guest mail and messages per established procedures.

22. Develop a thorough knowledge of hotel staff, room locations, room rates, amenities and selling strategies. May assist in parking lot guest activities

23. Take reservation requests efficiently.

24. Answer switchboard in accordance with standards of proper telephone etiquette.

25. Block rooms and handle special requests.

26. Monitor room availability.

27. Handle safe deposits by guests per established procedures.

28. Keep lobby and guest areas clean and presentable.

29. Offer and properly handle wake-up calls.

30. Open and close shift; make cash drops.

31. Ensure all credit cards, cash, and change fund are balanced throughout each shift.

32. Ensure we have appropriate signatures/authorization prior to processing any credit card transactions.

33. Monitor the intake of currency to protect against counterfeit bills.

34. Inform management of any guest or systems related complaints or problems.

35. Communicate with incoming staff and management by logging pertinent information in the front desk log.

36. Pass on guest lost and found inquiries to management.

37. Monitor and maintain an adequate amount of office supplies such as folio paper, registration slips, and pens to ensure smooth and continuous operations.

38. Develop and maintain a working knowledge of local attractions, restaurants, and area business.

39. Develop and maintain a basic knowledge of major interstates and other roadways to assist in offering directions.

40. Send and receive facsimiles for guests.

41. Other duties deemed necessary by management that are within the associate’s abilities.

42. Must have a valid drivers license and a clean driving record

Associate must adhere to all work rules, procedures, and policies established by the company including, but not limited to, those contained in the Associate handbook.

Must be willing to perform other duties as assigned, of which the associate is capable

This employer participates in E-Verify. E-Verify is a program used to verify employment eligibility for new hires. As part of E-Verify, we will check your employment eligibility by comparing the information you provide on Form I-9 with records of the Social Security Administration (SSA) and/or Department of Homeland Security (DHS). You have the right to know if your employer uses E-Verify and to be informed if your E-Verify case results in a tentative nonconfirmation (mismatch). You also have the opportunity to take action to resolve a mismatch. You can start and continue working while resolving a mismatch.

title: Private Client Banker - Flower Estates Branch - Covington, LA
description:

Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act

Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.

In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008. As such, upon active employment with JPMorgan Chase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorgan Chase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorgan Chase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter.

Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm. description:

Working Environment

Tasmania Prison Service (TPS) has prison facilities located at Risdon Vale, Hobart, and Launceston. This position is part of our Human Resource and Training unit based at our Risdon Vale site

The Risdon Vale site offers a corporate working environment without the hustle and bustle of city centre offices, free on-site parking and access to the on-site staff gym (or head across the road to Risdon Brook Dam for a walk at lunch time). The Training Building has an attached outdoor area where we can enjoy our lunchtimes... weather permitting! The Human Resources and Training Unit encompasses recruiting, training, rosters, absence management and general human resources support for the TPS. We are a small team and work closely and collaboratively with the Department of Justice’s central human resources team, and other Outputs.

title: Pharmacy Tech II
description:
The Pharmacy Technician II assists in preparing, packaging, delivering and charging of medications under the supervision of a licensed pharmacist. Completes established competencies for the position within designated introductory period. Other related duties as assigned.

General Functions:

  • Accurately fills medication orders with correct strength, dosage form, and quantity in a timely manner.
  • Assures all medications are checked by a pharmacist prior to dispensing.
  • Responds appropriately to requests for STAT orders, routine orders, department requests and ADC stock out bulletins.
  • Refills emergency crash carts, boxes and kits accurately and timely.
  • Accurately stock ADCs in a timely manner.
  • Prepackages and labels oral medications and extemporaneous preparations.
  • Prepares IV sterile admixture solutions and IV products accurately consistent with IV policies and procedures.
  • Restocks medications in IV room and conforms to IV cleaning schedule
  • Performs distribution duties and adhere to pharmacy technician operational workflow and delivery schedule
  • Interprets medication labels to compounds, prepares and maintains records of transactions.
  • Prepares outpatient prescriptions for review by pharmacist
  • Prepares unit dose tablets capsules and liquids, and surgical drugs and other specialty drug trays
  • Assists the pharmacist with the dispensing of controlled substances to patient care areas and maintains records
  • Maintain adequate medication stock levels and proper storage of medications
  • Stock medications into pharmacy inventory
  • Other duties as assigned

Department/Business Unit Functions:

  • Performs and prepares IV admixture, chemotherapy and parental nutrition accurately consistent with IV policies and procedures (USP797 and USP800)
  • Reports suspected adverse drug reactions and medication occurrences.
  • Recommends improvement in pharmacy or facility processes that will decrease the potential for adverse outcomes.
  • Follow proper process for handling of controlled substances and report any variances to Supervisor or pharmacist-in-charge, m)
  • Ensure patient accounts are properly charged.
  • Performs inspections of nursing unit floor stock and pharmacy stock to insure security, potency of medications and removes expired medications from stock.
  • Assists the pharmacists in the provision of pharmaceutical care.
  • Maintains formulary and cost savings by minimizing non-formulary procurements and utilizing courier services unless indicated for immediate patient care.
  • Assists with report generation and information retrieval.
  • Participates in and performs activities that support the medication use process.
  • Interacts with nursing staff to facilitate pharmacy services.
  • Maintains stock in automated dispensing units at adequate levels and performs inventory and ordering functions.
  • Performs daily billing and charge functions as required, recognizing errors when they arise.
  • Utilizes resources efficiently and effectively
  • Maintains safe environment
  • Address patient population-specific needs
  • Participates in Performance Improvement activities
  • Comply with state and federal regulatory requirements, Joint Commission standards and Tenet and hospital policies and procedures notify Pharmacist/Supervisor of any deviations from standards

MINIMUM EDUCATION: High School Graduate or equivalent; accredited training in sterile products preparation.

MINIMUM EXPERIENCE: Pharmacy experience

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Two years hospital experience

REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSURE: Possession of current Texas State Board of Pharmacy Technician License; Pharmacy Technician Certification (depending on state regulations) required. IV Certification.

title: Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The mission

You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites.

Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer (L4-L5), you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites.

You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management.

Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed.

What you'll do

  • Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

  • Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends.

  • Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root-cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions.

  • Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready.

  • Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1–L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR.

  • Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere.

  • Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen.

About you

  • 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands-on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred).

  • End-to-end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to escalate.

  • Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root-cause analysis.

  • Deployment experience: you've taken racks from delivery to production, with concrete examples to show for it.

  • Vendor fluency: you've managed hardware vendors — RMAs, field replacements, escalations — to concrete outcomes.

  • Impeccable safety and discipline: ESD/LOTO/PPE without exception; clean, labeled, auditable work.

  • Communication & mentoring: clear status updates and handovers; able to coach engineers during live incidents with composure.

  • Mobility: willing to visit our other sites in the Paris region as needed.

Nice to have

  • GPU-dense platform experience: NVIDIA H-series (H100/H200) or GB-series rack deployments.

  • High-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), RAID/storage (NVMe/SAS/SATA), vendor tooling (iDRAC/iLO/IPMI).

  • Automation (Python/Bash) for ops tooling and reporting; ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory/RMA flows.

  • Hardware qualification, burn-in or factory validation background.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: AI Developer
description:
About Live Events x Pyrotecnico

At Live Events and Pyrotecnico, we create unforgettable live experiences. Our teams produce fireworks, special effects, drone light shows, lighting, audio, video, rigging, and full-scale event production for major concerts, festivals, sporting events, corporate gatherings, and community celebrations across the country.

We deliver end-to-end production solutions that bring creative visions to life. From high-energy touring shows to large-scale special events, we combine precision, innovation, and technical expertise to make every moment extraordinary.

If you're driven by the thrill of live production and want to work alongside the best in the business, you've come to the right place.

Position Summary / Objective

The AI Developer builds, deploys, and maintains production AI agents, integrations, and data pipelines across the company's ERP, CRM, and cloud systems. This hands-on role requires strong Python, direct LLM API development, and Google Cloud Platform experience. The ideal candidate can independently take projects from concept through deployment and support, with a focus on shipping practical solutions quickly and delivering measurable business value.

This role may be based at any Live Events or Pyrotecnico office. Final reporting location will be discussed during the interview and hiring process.

Role Responsibilities

The following duties represent the primary responsibilities of the role. This list is not exhaustive. The individual in this position will perform additional tasks as assigned, adhere to all provisions of the Employee Manual, and participate in company initiatives and projects.

Technical Execution & Code Construction

  • Design, build, and maintain production AI agents, prompt management, context handling, and orchestration using Python and direct LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Vertex AI) without reliance on heavy frameworks.
  • Deploy and operate workloads on Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, Cloud Storage) using GCP CLI tools (gcloud builds submit, gcloud run deploy), service accounts, and secure IAM permissions.
  • Build robust REST API integrations (OAuth, webhooks, rate-limiting), optimize SQL/BigQuery workflows, and maintain reliable data pipelines across ERP, CRM, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Own the entire lifecycle of software solutions—from initial code commit through testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and long-term maintenance.

Business Acumen & Solution Design

  • Work with business data (finance, sales, inventory, operations) to translate broad operational challenges and business goals into practical, codable AI and automation solutions.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to balance architecture with speed to market, shipping high-impact, practical tools quickly while avoiding unnecessary complexity.
  • Design workflows that integrate seamlessly with real-world operations, including approval steps, escalation paths, and audit trails to ensure safe and valuable AI deployment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders and leadership across departments to scope projects, uncover automation opportunities, and clearly communicate the impact and trade-offs of technical decisions.
  • Partner closely with internal IT, operations, and business units to ensure AI agents and data integrations seamlessly align with existing systems and user workflows.
  • Clearly document code, API specs, deployment procedures, and operational guidelines so non-technical stakeholders and peer team members remain informed and aligned.

Work Environment

Regular computer-based work and collaboration with business and technical stakeholders. The position primarily operates in an office environment and may occasionally interact with warehouse, event-production, or operational environments.

Physical Demands

This position primarily involves sedentary, computer-based work and requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods. The employee must be able to communicate effectively through virtual and in-person meetings and may occasionally move through office, warehouse, or operational environments.

Position Type / Expected Hours of Work

Full-time. Standard business hours, with flexibility as needed to support production systems, deployments, critical integrations, and business priorities.

Travel

Limited travel may be required for company meetings, operational support, or project-related activities.

The position serves as the institutional negotiator on assigned agreements and as the point of contact for sponsors and partner institutions during negotiation.

  8. Serves as the institutional contact for sponsor and partner counterparts during negotiation.
  9. Identifies routine agreement types and processes that may be appropriate for template standardization or automation.

Four (4) years of contract administration, research administration, or comparable experience; OR Master’s Degree two (2) years of contract administration, research administration, or comparable experience; OR a combination of related education and work experience to equal eight (8) years.

  • Knowledge of intellectual property, publication, confidentiality, indemnification, and data use provisions.
