title: Junior QA Tester
description:
Salary: $58,000 – $65,000 per year

About Writer’s Toolbox

Writer's Toolbox is a multi-award-winning education technology company, delivering school writing improvement programmes globally and proven to more than double national writing outcomes. With teams across New Zealand, Australia and the UK, Writer's Toolbox has built an internationally recognised programme, combining thirty years of pedagogy research with educational AI to lift student writing at scale.

We’re looking for a Junior QA Tester to join our team to help us maintain strong testing practices across Writer’s Toolbox (WTB) and several internal web-based applications. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their QA career who wants to develop strong manual testing skills while progressively learning test automation.

About the Role

As a Junior QA Tester, your initial focus will primarily be on manual testing, working closely with Product and Development to ensure new functionality works as expected and existing functionality continues to operate correctly. You will be supported and mentored by an experienced QA Manager. As you become more confident in the role and understand our products and testing practices, you will progressively develop your automation skills. The longer-term goal is for you to contribute to creating, running, and maintaining automated tests alongside your manual testing responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Manual Testing

· Create and maintain test scenarios and test cases based on user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria.

· Execute functional, exploratory, smoke, and sanity testing of web-based applications.

· Perform cross-browser testing and verify functionality across supported environments, user roles, and permissions.

· Re-test defects following fixes from developers and test new functionality prior to release.

· Identify areas of risk and consider scenarios that may not be covered by original requirements.

· Maintain clear and accurate test documentation and support regression testing as your experience develops.

Defect Management

· Identify, reproduce, and document software defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps, expected/actual behaviour, and supporting evidence.

· Work closely with developers to investigate, clarify, and follow defects through to resolution.

· Communicate testing progress, issues, and risks clearly to the wider team.

Working With Product & Development

· Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Developers throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

· Develop a strong understanding of the product, its users, and common user workflows.

· Ask questions, raise quality concerns early, and contribute to improving the team’s testing practices.

· Develop a practical understanding of Agile software development and QA's role within it.

Developing Automation Skills

(Note: Automation is not the primary focus upon joining. During your first few months, you will focus on mastering product knowledge and manual QA practices.)

· Identify manual test scenarios that are suitable candidates for automation.

· Learn our team’s chosen automation framework with structured mentorship.

· Convert manual test scenarios into automated scripts, run existing test suites, and investigate test failures.

· Maintain and update automated tests as product functionality evolves over time.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Qualifications

· 0–2 years of commercial QA/software testing experience OR a relevant degree/qualification with practical tech experience.

· Understanding of basic software testing principles, test case creation, and bug reporting.

· Strong written/verbal communication skills and a logical approach to problem-solving.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and Product team members.

Automation & Technical Skills (Nice to Have)

Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Bonus if you have:

· Exposure to programming/scripting (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or similar).

· Familiarity with browser developer tools or web application architecture.

· Exposure to any test automation framework.

Tools & Environment

Previous experience with these tools is helpful but not essential (you will work with):

· Jira & Confluence

· Web-based testing environments & Browser Developer Tools

· Our automated testing framework (introduced as part of your role)

Personal Qualities

We are looking for someone who is:

· A Strong Spoken and Written Communicator: Ability to clearly document steps and discuss technical issues with developers.

· Curious & Analytical: Eager to understand how software works and naturally thinks about edge cases or potential failures.

· Detail-Oriented & Organised: Efficient at catching details others miss and managing test evidence cleanly.

· Collaborative & Proactive: Communicates issues clearly, asks questions early, and takes ownership of product quality.

What Success Looks Like

· First 3 Months: Understand core WTB user workflows and QA processes; confidently create and execute manual test scenarios and write clear defect reports in Jira.

· 3–6 Months: Independently manage testing for smaller features, contribute to regression testing, and begin learning the automation framework to create basic scripts with guidance.

· Longer Term: Independently handle testing for assigned features, maintain reliable manual/automated test suites, and contribute to expanding our QA process.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to build your QA career in a supportive environment with direct access to experienced QA leadership. You won’t be expected to know everything on day one—we’ll help you develop strong testing fundamentals first, then progressively build your technical and automation skills as your confidence grows.

How to apply

Please respond with a CV and cover letter explaining why you would be suitable for the role.

  • Must be experienced with coaching and training lower classification employee in safe and productive work procedures.

  • Oversee work related to each project and assume full responsibility for its quality and completion deadline.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

title: Information & Referral Coordinator, Spanish & English
description:
Information and Referral Coordinator, Spanish & English

The Arc of King County serves individuals with intellectual and other developmental disabilities (IDD) and their families across the lifespan, from prenatal diagnosis through end-of-life care.

Our programs include:

  • Information and Family Support for individuals with IDD, their family members, and community;
  • Supported Living Services for adults living in the community; and
  • Public Policy and Civic Engagement for people who want to ensure communities and public services work for people with IDD

The Arc promotes and protects the human and civil rights of people with IDD, actively supporting their full inclusion so that they can live, learn, work, and play in the community – making the world a better place for us all.

For more information about the organization, visit our website at

POSITION DESCRIPTION

The Information and Referral (I&R) Coordinator, Spanish & English:

  • Responds to questions from individuals, families, and community about disability services and supports, in Spanish or English as needed
  • Informs and provides outreach about developmental disabilities, disability support services, special education services, and other related topics through workshops and community events;
  • Collaborates with all outreach and advocacy teams to support individual, family, and systems advocacy

This is a full-time, non-exempt position.

ORGANIZATIONAL REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

Department: Information and Family Support

Supervisor: Multicultural Family Support Program Manager, working closely with the Information and Referral Program Manager

Other Key Relationships: Director of Information and Family Support, all members of The Arc of King County’s outreach and advocacy teams

DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of services and resources, including Early Supports for Infants and Toddlers; special education services (preK through grade 12 and transition); services administered by DSHS Developmental Disabilities Administration such as personal care, supported employment, community residential and respite; as well as related state and federal supports that the IDD community relies on
  • Ensures questions are accurately and quickly answered or referred to other team members. Information and referral questions may come through in-person events or office visits, email, phone, or social media connections.
  • Answers questions and provides outreach and education through 1:1 consultation via phone, email, video, or in-person
  • Conducts or assists with workshops and provides outreach at community events where information about The Arc and IDD resources are shared.
  • Helps create, maintain, and organize resources and materials, including our online resource guide and relevant event notices
  • Provides culturally appropriate support and plain language information on how disability systems work
  • Makes program activities and resources accessible to people with disabilities and to diverse cultural communities in terms of accommodation, language access, location, and other cultural considerations utilizing The Arc’s diverse team and interpreters, as needed
  • Supports people in Spanish and English. We anticipate 3 days in Spanish and 2 days in English
  • Supports program evaluation
  • Ensures program documentation and materials are up to date, including on-going timely, accurate Salesforce data entry.
  • Critically evaluate program activities for effectiveness and regularly consult with supervisor
  • Proactively participate in team, department and agency meetings to achieve program goals
  • Maintains good relationships with community stakeholders
  • Partner with the civic engagement team to share resources and opportunities
  • Other duties as assigned to fulfill program goals and/or contractual requirements

title: Edge | Creator Partnerships Coordinator | Spanish -Speaking
description:
Do you love Influencer Marketing and Creator Partnerships, and speak fluent Spanish? This will be an exciting role for you!

ZURU is on a mission to disrupt industries, challenge the status quo, and catalyse change through radical innovation and advances in automation. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; and ZURU Edge is pioneering new-generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.

Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5,000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.

One of the largest toy companies in the world, our globally recognised and award-winning brands include Bunch O Balloons, Mini Brands, XSHOT, Rainbocorns, and Smashers. Our global FMCG brands include MONDAY Haircare, Rascals, NOOD, BONKERS, and Gumi Yum Surprise.

Position Overview

The Creator/Influencer Partnerships Coordinator – Spanish-Speaking will lead influencer and creator collaborations for ZURU Edge brands across Spain and Mexico. You'll drive high-impact partnerships that fuel brand awareness, engagement, and sales. The role is dedicated to building and managing relationships with Spanish-speaking creators, from micro-influencers to large-scale content partners, to deliver authentic, brand-aligned content that resonates with local audiences.

You will work closely with the Brand Marketing and Brand Engagement teams to identify, negotiate with, and manage creators who can bring our brands to life across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms in the Spanish and Mexican markets.

Roles & Responsibilities

Creator Sourcing & Onboarding

- Identify, vet, and onboard Spanish-speaking creators in Spain and Mexico who fit our brand personalities, audience demographics, and campaign goals.

- Build and maintain a strong creator network across Spain and Mexico, from micro to macro influencers, covering a range of platforms and formats.

- Negotiate deliverables, usage rights, and contracts in Spanish, working with the legal and procurement teams.

Campaign Planning & Execution

- Turn brand briefs into creator-specific strategies for the Spanish and Mexican markets, with clear deliverables and timelines.

- Work with creators to produce engaging, on-brand Spanish-language content for both organic and paid amplification.

- Brief creators in Spanish on brand guidelines, key messages, and creative direction. Adapt the messaging to local culture and leave room for each creator's own voice.

Relationship Management

- Maintain ongoing relationships with top-performing creators in Spain and Mexico, and turn them into long-term brand advocates.

- Foster a professional and collaborative environment where creators feel valued and supported.

- Regularly engage with creators' content to build genuine partnerships.

Performance & Reporting

- Track creator, influencer, and campaign performance metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, conversions, and ROI.

- Deliver post-campaign reports with insights and recommendations for future activations.

- Work closely with the India-based influencer team so that all creator campaigns launch on schedule and meet performance expectations.

- Monitor Spanish and Mexican social trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity to inform strategy.

Team Coaching

- Provide daily direction, feedback, and development support to India-based influencer team members.

- Partner closely with the India-based Team Lead to coach, mentor, and upskill the team on influencer sourcing, campaign execution, and creator communication best practices.

- Provide structured feedback and regular training sessions to raise execution quality and analytical capability in India.

- Monitor progress against KPIs and deadlines, and address performance gaps early through coaching or process changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Brand Marketing Managers and the wider Brand Engagement team to align creator campaigns with brand launches and seasonal campaigns in Spain and Mexico.

- Collaborate with Social Media Executives and Content Editors to integrate creator content into channel strategies.

- Liaise with the Paid Media team to boost high-performing creator content for maximum impact.

Skills & Experience

- Fluent or native Spanish (written and spoken), plus professional-level English.

- A solid understanding of the creator and social media landscape in Spain and/or Mexico, including cultural nuances and local content trends.

- Around 1–2 years' experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or social media campaign management.

- Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging social platforms.

- Proven ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills.

- A data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret analytics and make informed decisions.

- Excellent organisation skills.

- Flexibility to work across time zones to connect with creators in Spain and Mexico.

WHAT WE OFFER

🌱 Culture for Growth

🧘 Health Benefits

🌎 Global Opportunities

💡 Surrounded by an A-player team

💰 Competitive Remuneration

🍓 Lots of fresh fruit, coffee, pals fridge and more

ZURU – Reimagining tomorrow 🚀

title: AI Product Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Remote (North America; San Francisco or Austin preferred) · Full-time
Compensation: $140K–$180K base + competitive equity

About the Company

Our client is an early-stage, venture-backed AI infrastructure company that helps enterprises trust their voice AI agents. Their platform covers testing before launch, adversarial stress-testing, and monitoring of live calls in production. They already serve enterprise customers in regulated industries such as healthcare, financial services, and telecom, and revenue has grown quickly over the past year.

Early stage · ~15 people · Industry: AI, Developer Tools, B2B, Enterprise

The Role

We're looking for an early-career engineer who wants to split their time between building product and working directly with customers. You'll sit with the technical teams who use the platform, figure out what they actually need, and then build and ship it yourself. The team ships several times a day, the founder still writes code, and there are no handoffs between the person who hears the problem and the person who solves it.

What you'll be doing

  • Working closely with enterprise engineering teams to uncover gaps, then scoping and shipping the fix yourself
  • Taking features from first conversation through prototype, launch, and iteration, across both frontend and backend
  • Acting as a hands-on technical partner during pilots and after the sale
  • Turning one-off customer solutions into reusable parts of the platform
  • Using AI coding tools as a normal part of how you build, so you can move at startup speed

Tech stack: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, Codex, LiveKit, WebSockets, Pipecat, Temporal, AWS, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Figma, Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs

Requirements

  • Up to about 3 years of experience in a role that mixes coding with customer contact, such as product engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or running your own startup
  • Something you built and shipped that real people used, whether at work, as a founder, or as a side project
  • Time spent at a startup, founder-led company, or fast-moving team where you owned work from start to finish
  • A degree from a top-tier computer science or engineering program (our client recruits from a defined list of leading universities)
  • AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex are part of your everyday workflow, and you can explain concretely how they change the way you plan and ship
  • Solid TypeScript and Python, with the range to work across APIs, data, and user interfaces to deliver a complete feature
  • Strong ownership and clear writing: you start with whatever context is available, move quickly, and keep everyone updated on progress and next steps
  • An entrepreneurial streak, such as founding something, applying to an accelerator, or growing a side project with real traction
  • Willingness to travel roughly 10 to 20 percent of the time for customer visits, conferences, and team offsites

Nice to Haves

  • Some experience working with enterprise customers, or a clear interest in growing into that kind of work

Why Join

  • Work at the infrastructure layer of voice AI, one of the fastest-growing areas in applied AI
  • A company with real customers, real usage, and real revenue, not a pre-product bet
  • A small, senior-leaning team where more than half the people have founded companies
  • Genuine ownership from your first week and direct influence on the product roadmap
  • Competitive salary and equity at a company early enough for that equity to matter

Details

  • Location: Remote within North America (San Francisco or Austin preferred)
  • Work policy: Remote-first, with 10 to 20 percent travel
  • Compensation: $140,000–$180,000 + equity
  • Visa sponsorship: Open to visa transfers (for example H-1B transfer or OPT); unable to sponsor new visas
  • Employment type: Full-time

title: Environmental Planner Remediation I, II, III, or Senior
description:
Responsible for compliance focused on remediation, solid waste and groundwater in the operation, decommissioning, and closure/post-closure of Tri-State facilities and its subsidiaries. Responsible for regulatory analysis and application of Comprehensive Environmental Response Compensation and Liability Act (CERCLA), Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA), RCRA Subtitle D Coal Combustion Residuals (CCR) rule, Clean Water Act (CWA), Colorado and New Mexico solid waste regulations, and other laws to the assigned facilities. Assist with obtaining necessary permits and approvals, conducting monitoring and inspections, data analysis, technical report writing, managing contractors, and project management.

Note:
There is one position available and the position will be filled at one of four job grade levels: Environmental Planner Remediation I, job grade 7; Environmental Planner Remediation II, job grade 8, Environmental Planner Remediation III, job grade 9; or Senior Environmental Planner Remediation, job grade 10. Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Work Schedules including compressed work week and telecommuting opportunities to work remotely up to 40%, Life Insurance, 401K, Long Term Disability (LTD), Short Term Disability (STD), Employee Assistant Program (EAP) and Paid Leave Benefits.

Hiring Salary Range: $109,000-139,000

Environmental Planner Remediation II
Hiring Salary Range: $88,000-$111,000
Environmental Planner Remediation I
Hiring Salary Range: $80,000-$99,000

  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws by inspecting and monitoring landfills, ponds, stormwater runoff, surface water, and groundwater at the Colowyo, Escalante, New Horizon and Nucla facilities (as well as other assigned facilities) during operations and closure/post-closure, including reclamation. Monitoring includes, but is not limited to, groundwater and surface water sampling of wells and ponds, and maintenance of all required sampling equipment and systems.

Prepare technical specifications and bidder evaluations for assigned projects. Project management includes planning, directing, and coordinating on all project tasks, preparing budgets and tracking, and communicating project status to management and other assignees, as needed.

  • Conduct and/or review Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments (ESA) for assigned facilities and properties.
  • Lead the planning, developing, finalizing and submitting of environmental studies and reports to appropriate regulatory agencies.

  • Manage obtaining all required agency approvals and permits to construct, operate, maintain and decommission (including closure and post-closure) facilities.
  • Interface with Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment (CDPHE), New Mexico Environment Department (NMED), New Mexico Office of the State Engineer (NMOSE), U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and other regulatory agencies as necessary.

OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform other related duties as assigned

SUCCESS FACTORS/JOB COMPETENCIES:

  • Planning: ability to think ahead and plan within timelines and resources; develop scopes, plan and schedule work; set priorities and goals; anticipate and adjust for problems; evaluate workloads; measure and evaluate performance against established goals.
  • Time management: ability to successfully plan and implement objectives within established timelines and work schedules.

  • Demonstrate behavior consistent with company values.

Education and Training

Knowledge, Skills, and Ability:

POSTING NUMBER: 26-18-S

TITLE: IAC Program Assistant/Outreach Specialist

Part-Time / Hourly Temporary Employee Service (TES)

Maximum of 944 hours per fiscal year

ISSUE DATE: October 5, 2026

CLOSING DATE: October 19, 2026

SALARY: $36.60 / per hour

LOCATION: Hamilton, New Jersey or Newark, New Jersey

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Mission Support Bureau manages New Jersey’s statewide domestic extremists, foreign terrorist organizations, targeted violence, hostile foreign intelligence threat intake and coordination process and maintains critical relationships with New Jersey’s public and private-sector partners.

The selected candidate will facilitate statewide outreach by connecting the Interfaith Advisory Council (IAC) with Counter-Threat Coordinator/Municipal Counter-Threat Coordinator (CTC/MCTC) programs and NJOHSP resources through partner coordination, meeting and event support, scheduling, travel management, and follow-up activities. This position is essential to ensuring the unit can provide timely and consistent support to faith-based organizations and community partners across the state. Duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Assist in the administrative, analytical, and professional work to promote the planning, operation, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of various programs and services.
  • General outreach with faith-based partners, developing strategic relationships across the state within the faith-based community.
  • Identify areas to grow the IAC program, gather, and disseminate information provided through the IAC to appropriate bureaus.
  • Identify resources within OHSP and with partners for faith-based communities.
  • Schedule general member and executive committee meetings.
  • Build meeting agendas, securing meeting venues, and other necessary responsibilities to enhance and support the IAC program.
  • While a certain percentage of time will require administrative/office work, a significant amount of time will be spent outside the office. This position requires travel across the state of New Jersey and region, and within the various faith-based communities.

This position requires flexibility. The selected candidate will be assigned to the north or south region of New Jersey. You must be available to work after typical business hours on weekdays and must be available on weekends for events/meetings with interfaith communities within the region assigned. There is administrative work which would be done during the week during business hours. This position will be eligible to use office pool car for business travel with a valid driver's license.

The ideal candidate will have strong interpersonal skills, ability to develop and maintain professional relationships, good time management skills, strong communication skills including public speaking ability, and experienced in working with Microsoft Office. Foreign language skills is a plus.

TES/944 employees are limited to working 944 hours in a fiscal year (July 1- June 30).

TES/944 employees are not eligible for telework.

REQUIREMENTS

Applicants must meet one of the following or a combination of both experience and education. Thirty (30) semester-hour credits are equal to one (1) year of relevant experience.

Five (5) years of professional experience in planning, monitoring, coordinating, implementing, modifying and/or evaluating agency programs and services. OR

Possession of a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university; and one (1) year of the above-mentioned professional experience. OR

Possession of a master's degree from an accredited college or university in a discipline appropriate for the position.

Note: “Professional experience" refers to work that is creative, analytical, evaluative, and interpretive; requires a range and depth of specialized knowledge of the profession's principles, concepts, theories, and practices; and is performed with the authority to act according to one's own judgment and make accurate and informed decisions.

License: Appointees will be required to possess a driver's license valid in New Jersey only if the operation of a vehicle, rather than employee mobility, is necessary to perform essential duties of the position.

Preference: Preference will be given to those with law enforcement background.

Resume Note: Eligibility determinations will be based upon information presented in resume only. Applicants who possess foreign degrees (degrees earned outside of the U.S.) are required to provide an evaluation indicating the U.S. equivalency.

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT: Applicants should be aware that all NJOHSP employees must be a U. S. Citizen due to the fact that they need to be eligible to obtain a Secret or Top-Secret Clearance from the federal government. U. S. citizenship is a requirement for obtaining such clearance. Additionally, a criminal and personal background investigation is conducted on all NJOHSP personnel. The inability to obtain or maintain the required clearance will be a basis for dismissal from employment.

NJ RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT: In accordance with the New Jersey First Act P.L. 2011 c70, effective September 1, 2011, new public employees are required to obtain New Jersey residency within one (1) year of employment.

NJ ETHICS REQUIREMENT: Applicants accepting employment with NJOHSP are required to adhere to the Conflicts of Interest Law N.J.S.A. 52:13D-12 et seq., the Uniform Ethics Code N.J.A.C. 19:61-1.1. et seq., and LPS Supplementary Ethics Code which may limit or preclude outside activities and/or outside employment. Employees in certain positions are required to annually file financial disclosure statements.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY: NJOHSP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to inclusive hiring and dedicated to diversity in our staff. We strongly encourage people from all groups and communities to apply.

NJ SAME Program Applicants: If you are applying under the NJ “SAME” program, you must submit any of the supporting documentation specified in N.J.S.A. 11A:7-13.3 along with your resume by the closing date indicated above.

NJOHSP provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

If you have any questions regarding the SAME Program or if you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application hiring process, please notify the agency via careers@njohsp.gov or by telephone 609-584-4000 and request the ADA Coordinator contact you.

TO APPLY: Interested applicants should submit a cover letter, resume, and State of NJ Application for Employment. All submissions must be received no later than 4 p.m. on the closing date. Failure to submit all required documentation may result in your disqualification from consideration.

title: Sterile Proc Tech Apprentice Prog
description:
Overview

The Sterile Processing Tech Apprentice Program job is a trainee position subject to the terms and conditions of the program, in addition to the job duties listed here. Responsible for the proper care and handling of all general and specialty instruments including the cleaning, decontamination, instrument identification, assembly, quality inspection, function testing, packaging and distribution, and sterilization of surgical instrumentation.

The goal of the Sterile Processing Tech Apprenticeship program is to prepare staff for a future career as a Sterile Processing Tech.

About Fairbanks Memorial Hospital

Fairbanks Memorial Hospital is a non-profit facility owned by the Greater Fairbanks Community Hospital Foundation. A Joint Commission-accredited facility with 152 licensed beds, Fairbanks Memorial Hospital is the primary referral center for residents of Alaska's interior with a strong patient-to-nurse ratio and Shared Leadership Infrastructure. In addition to our exceptional clinical environment, our location offers incomparable lifestyle rewards away from work. In Fairbanks, small-town living, spectacular natural beauty and endless recreation combine to create a one-of-a-kind place to live, work and play.

Pay & Benefits:

  • Compensation: $20 hourly wage
  • Additional Pay: Shift Differential, Annual Increases, Paid Time Off
  • Benefits: medical, vision, dental, 401k with employer match
  • Education Benefits: FHP Tuition Assistance, Student Loan Forgiveness
  • Other Benefits: Onsite Gym, Wellness Programs, Discount programs
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday: Varied shifts

Shift Differentials Available: $2.00/hr. Weekend- $2.50/hr. Evening - $6.00/hr. Night

Responsibilities

  • Decontaminates, assembles and packages all instruments following established protocols as well as perform necessary repairs, reassembles and stores specialized surgical instruments. Prepares all order requests as necessary for replacement parts for instruments and additional equipment as necessary or upon request of physicians.
  • Maintains a clean and safe environment by adhering to Standard Precautions and Infection Control practices. Staff will don proper Personnel Protective equipment (PPE), follows protocols for decontamination process referencing Instructions for Use (IFU) supplied by the manufacturers.
  • Identifies instruments for all specialties and assures proper function. Follows protocol for repair or replacement of instruments that are not functioning properly. Assembles and packages all instrumentation and sets according to dept. protocol. Utilizes equipment according to the manufacturer’s recommendations and hospital policy.
  • Operates steam autoclaves and Hydrogen Peroxide sterilizers. Maintains appropriate logs and records relating to the sterilization process, including Sterilizer Load Records and Biological Monitoring Records.
  • Responds to service recovery calls from the Operating Room and performs preliminary investigation. Determines priority level of instrumentation and equipment requests and other hospital needs. Directs services in a competent and professional manner while assuring OR priorities are completed in a timely manner.

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards. Provides all customers of Foundation Health with an excellent service experience by consistently demonstrating our core and leader behaviors each and every day.

Qualifications

Must sign the sterile processing tech apprentice program agreement and consent to all terms and conditions outlined in the aforementioned document.

High school diploma/GED required.

Must have mechanical aptitude with the ability to break down moving parts, clean, lubricate and reassemble, problem solve incomplete trays and missing instrumentation and have effective organizational, communication and human relation skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Job Title: Enterprise Data Architect – Customer Data Platform (Azure Databricks Lakehouse)

*********This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires working on-site three (3) days per week and remotely two (2) days per week. **************

Why this role

Our Azure Databricks Lakehouse is the system of record for replicated Customer Information System (CIS) data for approximately 4.6 million electric utility customers. It feeds billing, rates, credit management, payments, service orders, and metering and usage reporting, and it is the foundation for our analytics, data science, and AI work.

As the technical authority for this platform, you will set the architecture, standards, and roadmap, and you will serve as the final architectural approval authority for the Customer Data Platform ecosystem. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role where reliability and auditability matter, and where your decisions shape how a major utility uses its customer data for years to come.

About the role

You will lead the design, governance, and evolution of the Lakehouse, working at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data engineering, and utility business operations. You will define how CIS data is replicated, secured, and consumed across the enterprise, supporting both batch and near-real-time needs, and you will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, cybersecurity, vendors, and business stakeholders to turn business priorities into scalable solutions.

What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and strategic direction of the Lakehouse, from ingestion through consumption, including medallion design patterns and Delta Lake implementation.
  • Architect near-real-time and batch replication of CIS data, and lead decisions on Change Data Capture (CDC), streaming, and integration technologies to meet defined service level objectives.
  • Guide data engineers who are defining logical and physical data models and the standards that support operational reporting, business intelligence, advanced analytics, data products, and regulatory needs.
  • Establish standards for data quality, lineage, cataloging, observability, and metadata management using Unity Catalog and enterprise metadata tools.
  • Design and govern the integration patterns that downstream operational, analytical, and regulatory applications use to consume customer, billing, metering, and premise data.
  • Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance teams on access control, encryption, masking, and regulatory controls, and design for high availability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Work with data engineers, and data science and analytics teams to create architectural patterns for machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics that stay within governance and security standards.
  • Provide technical governance for vendor, consulting, and system integration partners, building collaborative relationships grounded in shared accountability.
  • Lead and mentor data engineering teams through architecture reviews and design guidance, and maintain reference architectures, architecture decision records, and multi-year roadmaps.
  • Optimize platform capacity and cost across Databricks and Azure, support major incident investigations and root cause analysis, and evaluate emerging technologies that improve the platform.

What Success looks like

  • A trusted, governed, and highly available CIS data ecosystem.
  • A scalable Lakehouse architecture that supports enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational workloads.
  • Consistent data standards, quality controls, and architectural governance across data domains.
  • Reusable architecture patterns that reduce integration complexity.

  • Clear roadmaps that align technology investment with business priorities, with platform performance and cost kept in check.

What you bring (required)

  • Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, and at least 8 years of progressive experience in data architecture, data engineering, or analytics platform engineering, including at least 3 years in a senior architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Platform: You have led the architecture of a production, enterprise-scale Azure Databricks Lakehouse, with hands-on depth in Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
  • Data movement: You have designed and delivered CDC and replication from a transactional source system into a lakehouse or warehouse, supporting batch and near-real-time loads (for example, with Qlik Replicate, HVR, Fivetran, Debezium, GoldenGate, or equivalent tools).
  • Modeling and governance: You are strong in data modeling (dimensional, Data Vault, or canonical models) and in governing data quality, metadata, lineage, and security controls such as role-based access, classification, and masking.
  • Standards leadership: You have established architecture standards, run architecture reviews, and driven adoption of engineering practices across multiple delivery teams.

  • Communication: You communicate and influence effectively with executives, engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders, and you can balance business priorities, risk, and cost in your decisions.

What sets you apart (preferred)

  • Experience with a utility CIS such as Oracle Customer to Meter (C2M), Oracle CC&B, SAP IS-U, or Cayenta. Experience with comparable high-volume customer or billing platforms in telecom, financial services, healthcare, or retail also translates well.
  • Knowledge of utility processes such as billing, collections, meter-to-cash, revenue assurance, rates, and regulatory reporting, and familiarity with NERC CIP and state public utility commission requirements.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Live Tables, Structured Streaming, Databricks Workflows, Event Hubs, or Kafka.
  • Experience with platform resiliency, FinOps, and capacity planning on Azure and Databricks.
  • Experience with Agile, SAFe, and product-oriented delivery models.
  • Master’s degree, or Azure, Databricks, or architecture certifications.

What we value

  • Business value mindset. You deliver business outcomes, not just technical solutions.
  • Ownership and accountability. You take personal responsibility for commitments and follow through without needing close oversight.
  • Collaborative leadership. You build trust across business and technology teams and influence constructively at every level.
  • Constructive courage. You challenge assumptions and raise concerns early, with diplomacy and candor, even when it is unpopular.
  • Stewardship and integrity. You act as a trusted steward of enterprise data, holding to high standards of security, compliance, and integrity.

First 12 months

  • Close the highest-risk gaps in data quality, latency, lineage, and access control.
  • Stand up a working architecture-review practice so new pipelines and data products follow the standard.
  • Baseline platform reliability and cost and use that baseline in capacity and design decisions.
  • Craft a written roadmap that ties the next platform investments to customer and revenue priorities.

This job description does not, nor is it intended to represent an exhaustive listing of all duties, tasks or responsibilities for the position listed. Based upon individual experience and team workload, responsibilities are assigned in varying degrees.

The University of Maine at Farmington is seeking an innovative, collaborative, and forward-thinking Emerging Technology Coordinator to lead our campus-wide efforts in exploring, evaluating, and thoughtfully adopting new technology, from AI to the next tools on the horizon.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys exploring what’s next, and helping others turn new technology into meaningful opportunities. You’ll serve as a central resource for emerging technologies at UMF, partnering with faculty, staff, students, and campus leaders to build digital and AI literacy, support innovative teaching and learning, and help the University navigate a rapidly changing technological landscape.

What You’ll Do:

  • Leading campus efforts to identify and evaluate emerging technologies including AI and responsible-use practices.
  • Creating engaging training and related professional development on these new technologies for faculty, staff, and students.
  • Working one-on-one with faculty to explore effective practices in the use of emerging technologies, including in areas such as AI-supported course design and alternative assessments.

title: Lead Generator Installer – Branch Lead
description:

Job Type: Full-Time
Pay: $28.00–$40.00 per hour, depending on experience and licensing

About the Role

Grasten Power Technologies is growing its Dallas branch and is looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead Generator Installer – Branch Lead to help lead the way.

This is an installer-first leadership position. Most of your time will be spent in the field leading a crew through residential standby generator installations from set to startup. You will also take on growing branch responsibilities, including job preparation, inspection coordination, inventory, branch organization, and communication with the Head of Installs.

As our Dallas operation grows, this position offers a clear opportunity to advance into broader branch leadership.

What You'll Do

Lead Generator Installations

  • Lead an installation crew on residential standby generator projects and take ownership of each installation from start to finish.
  • Complete generator installations of varying difficulty while meeting company quality, safety, and code standards.
  • Direct, train, and coach Generator Install Technicians and Helpers.
  • Delegate work effectively while developing the skills of your crew.
  • Ensure proper morning load-out procedures are followed and crews leave prepared for each job.
  • Take and review completed-installation photos before leaving the jobsite.
  • Identify and resolve installation issues while minimizing callbacks.
  • Complete callbacks promptly when needed.
  • Communicate job progress and next steps with customers and the Head of Installs.
  • Maintain a professional presence on every jobsite and provide an excellent customer experience.

Support Dallas Branch Operations

As the Dallas branch continues to grow, you will gradually take on additional branch coordination responsibilities with support from the Head of Installs, including:

  • Prepare upcoming jobs in company software and communicate daily plans to the installation crew.
  • Schedule same-day or next-day inspections with local inspection agencies.
  • Coordinate electrical disconnects and reconnects with the Install Coordinator.
  • Review upcoming installations two to three weeks in advance to identify potential site, equipment, or material issues.
  • Maintain an organized and clean office, warehouse, company vehicles, and equipment.
  • Complete branch inventory orders and submit them to Purchasing as scheduled.
  • Assist Permitting, Sales, Administration, and Service teams when branch support is needed.
  • Participate in weekly meetings with the Head of Installs to review branch performance, upcoming needs, and opportunities for improvement.

Career Growth

We believe in promoting from within and developing leaders from the field. This position is designed as a pathway into leadership as the Dallas branch grows.

The progression may include:

Lead Installer – Branch Lead: Lead your installation crew while developing branch coordination experience.

Senior Lead – New Branch: Oversee installation operations at the branch, manage Lead Installers and crews, and report to territory leadership.

Branch Coordinator: Oversee branch installation operations, scheduling, logistics, and development of future Lead Installers as the branch reaches the appropriate size.

You will receive ongoing coaching from the Head of Installs and will be expected to help develop and mentor other members of the installation team.

title: Online Form Review Assistant
description:
Online Form Review Assistant

Customer Service / Forms Intake / Remote

Full-time or part-time
Compensation: 28.25–30.00 per hour

Check that a submitted form is ready for the next person

In this role, you will review incoming online forms for the basic information the next team needs. You will not decide whether an applicant, customer, or request qualifies for a service. Your work is to notice missing fields, unclear attachments, and details that do not match the supplied instructions, then make the submission ready for the appropriate reviewer.

A form arrives

  • Open the assigned submission and check its required fields.
  • Compare names and reference details within the material provided.
  • Confirm that an expected attachment is present and readable.
  • Mark which information is missing without guessing at the answer.
  • Use the approved process to ask for a correction or route the item.
  • Update the submission status so another person can continue.

Some submissions will be complete on arrival. Others may have an empty contact field or an attachment that cannot be opened. You would identify the specific issue and use the employer’s instructions for the next step. When an applicant replies with the missing page, connect it to the existing submission rather than creating an unrelated record. The useful result is a clear file that a reviewer can understand without retracing the whole email exchange.

Consider a submission with a complete name and address but an attachment that opens as an unreadable image. Mark the particular file as the issue, request a readable copy using approved language and keep the original submission pending. If a correction arrives, compare it to the existing reference before adding it. A separate case for every reply makes the reviewer's task harder. You will learn the employer's required fields and escalation route during training; no prior experience deciding whether an application qualifies is expected.

Why the details matter

A form can look finished while still being unusable. A name may differ across documents, an online checkbox may be left blank, or an email address may have a typing error. Your review should follow the stated requirements and stop short of making decisions the form cannot support. If two pieces of information conflict, flag the difference and let the appropriate person decide what it means.

The handoff

  • Indicate what was received and which check was completed.
  • Identify the particular field or file that needs attention.
  • Keep supplied documents with the correct submission.
  • Leave an item pending when a response is still needed.
  • Send a complete file to the designated next step under instructions.

The work is remote and computer-based. You may use a form dashboard, email, and simple tracking records. Customer service habits help when asking someone to supply a missing detail: the message should be polite, specific, and easy to act on. Office administration habits help you keep a submission from being mistaken for a different person’s file.

Could this suit you?

  • You read instructions carefully and check a file before marking it complete.
  • You can write a short message explaining exactly what is missing.
  • You are comfortable moving between online forms and attachments.
  • You know when to ask rather than filling in a blank yourself.
  • You can handle private details in a suitable home office setting.

Experience in customer service, office administration, admissions, or data entry is helpful but not required. Beginners with good attention to detail are welcome, and the employer can train you on its form requirements and workflow. The role does not require you to judge eligibility or interpret policy independently.

Submitting your application

Your resume can point to any experience checking documents, following instructions, or communicating about missing information. Examples from school or other responsibilities count when they show those skills. You do not need experience with the employer’s particular form system.

If you’re selected for the next step, you may be asked to complete an application on the hiring company’s website. The hiring team will confirm the details of the actual opening during its process.

What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. Job Purpose

The Supplier Process Sr. Engineer position supports supplier delivery and characteristic improvement activity with automotive part suppliers in North America. Responsible for evaluating negative delivery, production, inventory management, plant/equipment, sub-supplier management, packaging control and/or workforce trends within the supply base; and developing and implementing systemic countermeasures to ensure acceptable delivery characteristics for Honda products and parts. This includes cross-functional collaboration in areas within Supply Chain Management, as well as New Model, Procurement, and Supplier Assurance to drive supplier characteristic improvement.

• Support supplier improvement activity as part of Department Business plan, reporting performance measurables and targets, forecast impact, monitor results & develop gap elimination plans to achieve Department goals
• Identifies problems on a systemic level and conducts problem analysis / situation appraisal, which may include analysis on a specific part or assembly process (Tooling / Equipment Spec / Part Drawing Spec or Evaluation / OEE / Volume Assessment, etc.) to develop effective countermeasures to correct problems or potential problems to avoid impacting delivery performance

• Champion engagement strategies for suppliers that are causing impact/risk to Honda. Performing deep root cause analysis through individual supplier Situational Analysis, engage with supplier top management, and work collaboratively to understand supplier SA and develop an overall activity SAP.
• Coordinate activity with concerned suppliers to understand current progress to overall SAP. Monitor, report on, and escalate suppliers that are not capable of meeting project milestones within the timeframe established.

Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.

Role Overview

We build headless commerce platforms for enterprise retail brands on Next.js, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and Shopify Plus — and we need a senior engineering leader who owns people, architecture, and delivery for their teams while shaping engineering standards across the organization. You operate at director level: owning outcomes across multiple squads and client engagements, representing Engineering in senior client conversations, and shaping standards that other teams build against, while remaining hands‑on enough to lead architecture on key initiatives. Your direct reports are engineering managers, leads, and architects — you build the leadership layer, define architecture patterns, and drive delivery outcomes across multiple squads in a distributed, async-first environment. Hands-on contribution is roughly 20–30% of your time, enough to stay credible and unblock architectural problems, but your impact comes from the leaders you develop and the systems you put around them.. As a Director, you will have the opportunity to expand your scope across additional teams, domains, and strategic accounts as the organization grows.

Essential Functions

  • Own delivery outcomes and velocity across your delivery teams — diagnose systemic bottlenecks, not just immediate blockers
  • Hire, develop, and performance-manage engineering managers, leads, and architects — build the leadership layer that builds the team
  • Define front-end architecture patterns, rendering strategies, and performance standards that multiple delivery teams build against
  • Drive story refinement and documentation standards that enable your leads, architects, and their teams to execute reliably
  • Establish the standards, documentation habits, and workflow patterns that make AI agents effective across your squads — shaping how teams decompose work for reliable agent execution
  • Partner with PMs and stakeholders across time zones, managing competing priorities across client engagements while maintaining delivery quality
  • Coach your managers on cross-cultural communication, proactive async collaboration, and the ability to represent technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in engineering management with experience managing managers, leads, or architects — not just ICs
  • Architectural judgment in modern frontend systems: defining Next.js architecture patterns, state management, and performance standards that teams build against
  • Delivery ownership in agency or professional services — you've run client engagements across competing priorities and kept quality high
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll collaborate with stakeholders across the US, Europe, and LATAM, and develop your managers' communication skills across cultures
  • Evidence of shaping how teams work with AI agents — not just personal tool usage, but establishing the standards and workflow patterns that make agents effective across a squad: spec-driven development, code review for AI-generated output, and coaching engineers to decompose work for reliable agent execution
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (headless SFRA, OCAPI/SCAPI) or Shopify Plus/Hydrogen
  • Preferred: Familiarity with composable commerce patterns (MACH architecture, headless CMS platforms)

Tools

  • React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence

What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.

Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

title: Addiction Recovery Specialist
description:
Lifepoint Behavioral Health
Addiction Recovery Specialist
Facility Name: Jefferson Regional Specialty Hospital
Schedule: 5x8 | Days | Monday to Friday | 8am – 5pm

Your experience matters

Lifepoint Behavioral Health is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As an Addiction Recovery Specialist joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

How you’ll contribute

As an Addiction Recovery Specialist who excels in this role:

Will provide person-centered peer support and mentorship to individuals experiencing mental health and re-occurring challenges.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct person-centered, one-on-one coaching utilizing evidence-based practices.

  • Lead peer-led support groups focused on mental health coping strategies, emotional regulation, resilience, and secondary substance use awareness.

  • Attend multidisciplinary treatment team meetings to present patient perspectives and advocate for self-determination and dignity in care.

  • Apply trauma-informed care and active listening to provide calming presence and aid clinical staff during patient distress.

  • Assist patients in building discharge wellness plans and bridging transitions to local community mental health centers, outpatient care, housing, and regional peer networks.

  • Adhere strictly to the Arkansas Peer Recovery Code of Ethics, maintaining rigorous boundaries, patient confidentiality, and proper electronic medical records (EMR) documentation.

Why join us

We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Multiple levels of medical, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time employees.

  • Financial Protection & PTO: Life, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, short- and long-term disability, paid family leave and paid time off.

  • Financial & Career Growth: Higher education and certification tuition assistance, loan assistance and 401(k) retirement package and company match.

  • Employee Well-being: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs).

  • Professional Development: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

What we’re looking for

Applicants should have a high school diploma or GED equivalent. Additional requirements include:

  • Lived Experience: Minimum two (2) years of sustained, personal recovery from mental health conditions, substance use disorder, or co-occurring disorder.

  • Arkansas State Credential:

    • Must hold an active Core Peer Recovery Specialist (CPRS) or Advance Peer Recovery Specialist (APRS) credential issued via the Arkansas Peer Recovery Program/NAADAC.

    • Alternative: Must be actively registered as a Peer-in-Training (PIT) with a documented path to complete required 500 experience hours and pass the national exam within six (6) to twelve (12) months of hire.

title: Radio Technician
description:
CSE Crosscom is a leading supplier and integrator of two-way radio and telecommunications products, infrastructure & services. We work with major industrial, government, transport, mining, resources, and utilities across Australia and New Zealand.

We design, supply and install telecommunications solutions to help our clients keep their workforce safe and manage their most critical assets. CSE Crosscom is part of the CSE Global Group of Companies, operating in over 20 countries and listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange.

As a Service Technician at CSE Crosscom, you'll play a vital role in supporting and maintaining mission-critical communications systems across a wide range of industries — including mining, emergency services, transport, utilities, and more. You'll be out in the field, working hands-on with cutting-edge radio technologies like DMR, TETRA, P25, LTE and a variety of IP-based networks, as well as CCTV, telephony, and PAGA systems.

You’ll troubleshoot and resolve issues, plan and implement system upgrades, and contribute to the seamless delivery of technical services our clients rely on as well as:

• Deliver end-to-end servicing of two-way radio systems, including analogue, DMR, TETRA, and P25 networks

• Install, test and commission radio networks, IP systems, CCTV, PAGA, telephony, and associated infrastructure

• Troubleshoot and repair equipment faults across diverse environments – both in the field and in-house

• Configure and program radio equipment, including maintenance of code plugs and firmware updates

• Conduct site assessments and surveys, prepare implementation plans, and produce detailed reports

• Maintain detailed service records, compliance documentation, and ensure workshop tools and vehicles are field-ready

• Mentor apprentices and junior team members, helping develop a capable, agile and responsive workforce

• Contribute to continuous improvement, toolbox meetings, safety procedures, and internal training programs

About you:

• Certificate III or higher in Electronics, RF Engineering or similar

• Hands-on experience with radio spectrum, P25, TETRA, DMR, and networked systems

• Confidence working at heights, with EWP or tower climbing (current high-risk licence required)

• Experience with telephony, CCTV, UPS, access control, PA systems, and more

• Strong troubleshooting skills & calm under pressure

• Knowledge of ACMA regulations

• A true team player who takes pride in great customer outcomes

In return CSE Crosscom can offer an excellent opportunity to grow your career, in a stable and expanding environment.

On top of:

• Attractive renumeration package and benefits

• Excellent personal development opportunities with training, education, mentorship and upskilling

• Career growth with a fast-growing company

• Numerous employee benefits and HR resources

• Excellent stability and long-term prospects with expansion of clients and services in every state.

At CSE we are committed to creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where all employees can thrive, which are reflected in our values.

title: Hardware Engineer (Projecten)
description:
Hardware Engineer Projecten

MBO 4 / HBO | Elektrotechniek of Industriële Automatisering | 32-40 uur | De Klomp

Ontwerp jij de elektrische basis van onze hightech robot- en verpakkingsmachines?

Van de eerste klantvraag tot een draaiende machine op locatie: jij zorgt ervoor dat alle elektrotechnische systemen perfect samenwerken. Je vertaalt technische uitdagingen naar slimme hardware-oplossingen en ziet jouw ontwerpen uiteindelijk werkelijkheid worden in machines die wereldwijd worden ingezet binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie.

Word jij enthousiast van elektrotechniek, machinebouw en industriële automatisering? Vind je het leuk om klantspecificaties te vertalen naar complete elektrische ontwerpen die daadwerkelijk gebouwd en getest worden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Jouw impact bij PWR

Als Hardware Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen onze engineeringprojecten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het complete elektrotechnische ontwerp van geavanceerde robot- en verpakkingsmachines.

Je werkt vanaf de conceptfase mee aan nieuwe projecten en vertaalt functionele eisen naar elektrische schema's, componentselecties en technische documentatie. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met Mechanical Engineers, Software Engineers, Commissioning Engineers en Project Managers.

Het mooie? Je ziet jouw ontwerpen niet verdwijnen in een la.

Onze machines worden namelijk volledig in eigen huis gebouwd, getest en vervolgens wereldwijd in bedrijf gesteld.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwerpen en uitwerken van elektrische schema's in EPLAN.

  • Vertalen van klantspecificaties naar slimme en betrouwbare hardware-oplossingen.

  • Opstellen van machine-, netwerk- en systeemoverzichten.

  • Ontwerpen van paneelindelingen met EPLAN Pro Panel.

  • Berekenen en valideren van veiligheidscircuits met SISTEMA en/of PAScal.

  • Controleren van projectdocumentatie zoals elektrische tekeningen, IO-lijsten en spare parts-lijsten.

  • Bestellen van projectmaterialen via ons ERP-systeem Ridder.

  • Ondersteunen van assemblage, testafdeling en commissioning bij technische vraagstukken.

  • Uitwerken van aanpassingen, revisies en serviceprojecten.

  • Bijdragen aan standaardisatie en doorontwikkeling van onze machines.

Van klantvraag naar technisch ontwerp

Bij ieder project begint het met een technische uitdaging.

Samen met het projectteam analyseer je de klantspecificaties en bepaal je welke hardware-oplossingen nodig zijn. Bij standaardprojecten ben je vanaf de definitiefase betrokken. Bij complexere projecten neem je een reeds uitgewerkt concept over van de Lead Engineer en werk je dit zelfstandig verder uit.

Zo zorg je ervoor dat elk project start met een solide technische basis en eindigt met een betrouwbare machineoplossing.

Samen bouwen aan innovatieve machines

Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams waarin verschillende specialismen samenkomen. Door intensief samen te werken met Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, Purchasing, Project Management en Commissioning bewaak je niet alleen de kwaliteit van het ontwerp, maar ook de technische haalbaarheid.

Je denkt actief mee, deelt kennis met collega's en ondersteunt waar nodig tijdens de bouw en inbedrijfstelling van de machine.

Want uiteindelijk bouwen we samen aan één doel:

een machine die bij de klant direct presteert.

Groei door specialisatie

Bij PWR krijg je de ruimte om expert te worden binnen een vakgebied dat jou aanspreekt.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Machineveiligheid

  • Besturingstechniek

  • Servo- en aandrijfsystemen

  • Industriële netwerken

  • Elektrotechnische componentselectie

  • Standaardisatie van machineplatformen

Zo ontwikkel je jezelf niet alleen als engineer, maar word je ook een inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor collega's en leveranciers.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Minimaal een afgeronde MBO 4- of HBO-opleiding richting Elektrotechniek, Industriële Automatisering of vergelijkbaar.

  • Ervaring met EPLAN.

  • Ervaring met EPLAN Pro Panel is een pre.

  • Interesse in machinebouw, robotica en industriële automatisering.

  • Affiniteit met machineveiligheid en relevante normen is een pre.

  • Je kunt technische documentatie lezen, interpreteren en opstellen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal voldoende om met internationale collega's en klanten samen te werken.

  • Je bent analytisch, nauwkeurig en denkt in oplossingen.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Werken aan innovatieve robot- en verpakkingsmachines die wereldwijd worden ingezet.

  • Veel technische uitdaging en afwisseling binnen projectmatige machinebouw.

  • Direct zichtbare resultaten van jouw werk: van ontwerp tot werkende machine.

  • Ruimte voor opleiding, ontwikkeling en specialisatie.

  • Samenwerken met een enthousiast team van engineers dat graag kennis deelt.

  • Marktconform salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Een informele en no-nonsense werksfeer waarin techniek centraal staat.

Over PWR

PWR ontwikkelt en bouwt geavanceerde robot- en verpakkingsoplossingen voor de internationale voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Met circa 100 collega's werken we dagelijks aan innovatieve automatiseringsoplossingen die productieprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder maken.

Vanuit onze locatie in De Klomp realiseren we complete machines: van concept en engineering tot assemblage, testen en wereldwijde inbedrijfstelling.

Interesse?

Ben jij klaar om jouw elektrotechnische kennis toe te passen in uitdagende machinebouwprojecten?

Solliciteer direct en ontdek hoe jij kunt bijdragen aan de volgende generatie verpakkings- en roboticaoplossingen van PWR.

Of vraag voor meer info via onze recruiter Bob Jansen via Recruitment@pwrpack.com.

title: Senior Engineer - FLUX
description:
About Netwealth

Netwealth isn't just a company. We're shaping the future of wealth in Australia. Our award-winning platform and NextGen technology empower advisers and investors to achieve more, and we're proud to be recognised as one of Australia's most innovative FinTech businesses.

Since 1999, we've grown rapidly by challenging the status quo. We move fast, think big, and stay agile. Free from unnecessary bureaucracy so we can deliver smarter solutions for our clients and create real impact.

But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We're a team of curious, optimistic and courageous individuals who collaborate to make life better for more Australians.
