title: Communications Associate (Office Based) [Open to Internal and External applicants]
description:
Tier Decription
Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026
Tier 1: Other UNDP/ UNCDF/ UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed term (FTA) appointments (defined as “internal” candidates)
Tier 2: UNDP/ UNCDF/ UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
Tier 3: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates”

Background:

Suriname's mangrove ecosystems are among the country's most valuable natural assets. Covering nearly 86,000 hectares and accounting for approximately 0.6% of the world's mangrove area (SBB, 2023; FAO, 2023), they provide critical habitat for biodiversity, support fisheries, strengthen climate resilience, and sustain coastal livelihoods and community well-being in areas where nearly 90% of the country's population resides (ABS, 2024). They also provide a foundation for sustainable economic opportunities through tourism, research, education, and other nature-based sectors.

UNDP has been a key development partner of the Surinamese Government and its people since 1994 and continues to support Suriname through its three broad programmatic areas: Democratic Governance, Social Development, Environment, Climate Change and Natural Resource Management. The three programmatic areas are interlinked, integrating nature-based solutions, justice and social services with the engagement of stakeholders that are relevant to all three programmatic areas.

UNDP in partnership with the European Union has been supporting Suriname in preservation and conservation of mangrove forests, especially through the two phases of the Global Climate Change Alliance (GCCA+) programmes; phase one: from March 2016 to August 2019 and phase 2: 2020- 2023. In 2024, UNDP and EU launched a new initiative Protection, Restoration, and Sustainable Use of Mangrove Forest (PRSUMF) project (2024 to 2027).

The PRSUMF project builds on the results achieved in strengthening mangrove protection and conservation by the GCCA+ programme. The PRSUMF project aims to support Suriname in building the resilience of target coastal communities through inclusive, gender-responsive coastal zone management, mangroves conservation, and sustainable use.

SBB. 2023. Mangrove Monitoring System: Total Mangrove Forest Area per District in Suriname (2023).

FAO. 2023. The World's Mangroves 2000-2020.

ABS. 2024. Population and Housing Census (Census 9), population distribution by district.

The project aims to achieve this objective:

a) By strengthening coordination, legal and strategic frameworks, for integrated coastal zone management, water management, coastal defense, and governance.

b) By enhancing the meaningful participation of local communities in the co-management of mangroves and Multiple Use Management Areas (MUMAs) and

c) By increasing sustainable income generation with a focus on women and youth, from mangrove-based value chains such as honey, fisheries, and mangrove ecosystem based-tourism.

Through the above approach, the project aims to support mitigation of rising sea levels impact, frequent flooding, and support the country’s population to adapt to climate change by playing a central role in mangrove protection, restoration and sustainable use through nature positive economic activities.

The project is implemented through a Project Management Unit (PMU) headed by the Project Manager. The Communications Associate will be part of the project management unit.

Scope of Work:

The incumbent will contribute to stakeholder engagement, knowledge sharing, visibility, and public awareness efforts that support achievement of project outputs and donor communication requirements. S/He will work under the direct supervision of the Project Manager, and the overall guidance of the Deputy Resident Representative of UNDP Suriname. The Communications Associate will also work in close collaboration with the Technical Officer of the PRSUMF project.

The Communication Associate will design and implement specific targeted public relations (PR) and media activities highlighting project activities, results and accomplishments, including related products and articles for social media distribution.

Key functions and responsibilities of the Communication Associate include:

a. Implement and revise the Media/Communication and Visibility Plan as needed:

  • Monitor implementation of and periodically update the Project Communication and Visibility Plan based on emerging communication needs, project progress, and donor requirements.
  • Based on the Communication and Visibility and Communications Plan, develop a Media/Communication Action Plan and relevant budget in close collaboration with the Project Manager and supporting PMU members.
  • Develop graphic designs for third party production (audiovisual and or print) in support of project branding communication and visibility, in line with UNDP and EU communication guidelines and requirements.
  • Maintain and expand the network of project stakeholders and media and maintain regular contact with and provide information to media on project activities and project progress.
  • Ensure and monitor visibility through the proper and correct use of logo’s during events, in photo-, audio-, and video productions and on all publication materials, equipment, materials and goods financed by the project as agreed with donors.
  • Ensure that the project related information and communication materials are regularly updated on UNDP Suriname website, Facebook page, X and other social media platforms.
  • Support the PRSUMF PMU in the organization and implementation of all project events and facilitate media coverage thereof.
  • Advise and assist Project Manager and other project staff on aspects related to awareness and stakeholder engagement; dialogues and other stakeholder awareness activities.

b. Lead knowledge management and dissemination:

  • Plan and prepare publication of articles, human interest stories, quarterly newsletters, and project results, this includes the gathering of supporting visual, audiovisual material and basic editing for publication.
  • Liaise with specific sector specialists and technical resource persons for the development of folders, brochures and presentations and other communication material on climate change, mangrove conservation, sustainable use of mangroves for economic development.
  • Develop and maintain a repository of communication, visibility, and knowledge products, ensuring accessibility and institutional memory for the project.

c. Support awareness and training activities of the project:

  • In collaboration with project team, Support the design of behaviour-change and awareness campaigns tailored to local communities, women, youth, entrepreneurs, and other stakeholder groups.
  • Assist with developing training material in general and specifically for policy makers; coastal communities, entrepreneurs and media professionals.
  • Enable the production of video records of project activities and results achieved, as well as provide support for script writing; editing and formatting allowing for multiple media applications of the raw footage that will be captured.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement:

The Communications Associate will work under the direct supervision of the Project Manager of the PRSUMF project and under the overall guidance of the Deputy Resident Representative/Head of Office and collaborate closely with the PRSUMF project team and all other CO units.

Competencies:

Core

Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline.

Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements.

Learn Continuously LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback.

Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media, and other appropriate channels.

title: MDS Education & Audit Specialist
description:
MDS Education & Audit Specialist

Cascades Healthcare

Department: Clinical / MDS
Reports To: Vice President of MDS

Location: Utah (Corporate) / Multi-Facility Support

Travel: Regular travel to company facilities is required and may vary based on operational, training, and audit needs.

Position Summary

The MDS Education & Audit Specialist is an experienced MDS professional who supports the Vice President of MDS across all company facilities through accuracy and validation audits, education and training, and ongoing clinical support for facility MDS nurses.
This position requires a minimum of three years of dedicated skilled nursing MDS
experience. The Specialist independently evaluates completed MDS assessments and supporting resident documentation, identifies accuracy and compliance concerns, delivers meaningful education, and helps strengthen MDS practices throughout the organization.
The Specialist works collaboratively with the Vice President of MDS, facility MDS nurses, Directors of Nursing, Administrators, therapy teams, and other members of the interdisciplinary team to promote accurate assessments, regulatory compliance, and consistent MDS practices across all facilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
MDS Accuracy and Validation Audits

  • Conduct detailed accuracy and validation audits of resident medical records and
    previously completed MDS assessments.
  • Evaluate MDS coding and supporting clinical documentation for accuracy,
    completeness, and compliance, including identification of unsupported coding, under-coding, over-coding, documentation gaps, and inconsistencies that may affect regulatory compliance, quality measures, or reimbursement.
  • Evaluate assessments for compliance with current RAI Manual requirements, CMS guidance, PDPM requirements, and organizational standards.
  • Review assessment timing, Assessment Reference Dates, completion requirements, submission requirements, and other MDS-related deadlines.
  • Validate documentation supporting PDPM components, including diagnoses,
    functional status, nursing services, therapy, non-therapy ancillary conditions, and other applicable clinical factors.
  • Evaluate Section GG documentation and coding for accuracy and consistency with supporting clinical documentation.
  • Review care plans and other resident documentation when necessary to validate assessment findings.
  • Document audit findings clearly and communicate identified trends and concerns to the Vice President of MDS.
  • Assist the Vice President of MDS and facility leadership with the development and monitoring of corrective action plans when audit findings identify recurring or significant concerns.

Education and Training

  • Provide structured onboarding and training for newly hired MDS nurses throughout the organization.
  • Assist new MDS nurses in developing competency in the RAI process, MDS coding, PDPM, care planning, documentation requirements, assessment scheduling, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Provide ongoing continuing education for facility MDS nurses.
  • Develop and deliver education based on audit findings, regulatory changes, identified trends, and organizational needs.
  • Provide individual coaching, targeted education, and remediation when knowledge or performance gaps are identified.
  • Assist in developing standardized training materials, tools, reference resources, and MDS processes for use across facilities.
  • Support facility MDS nurses in interpreting changes to CMS guidance, the RAI Manual, PDPM requirements, and other MDS-related regulations.
  • Promote consistent MDS practices and expectations across all facilities.

Facility and Clinical Support

  • Serve as a clinical MDS resource for facility MDS nurses and interdisciplinary team members.
  • Provide guidance on complex MDS coding, assessment timing, documentation, PDPM, and care-planning questions.
  • Partner with facility leadership to identify and address MDS documentation and process concerns.
  • Assist with preparation for and response to regulatory surveys, audits, medical reviews, and other MDS-related reviews as directed by the Vice President of MDS.
  • Support facilities experiencing MDS staffing transitions, new-hire training needs, or identified performance concerns.
  • Assist the Vice President of MDS with special projects, organizational initiatives, and other MDS-related activities as assigned.
  • Maintain awareness of changes in federal and state regulations affecting skilled nursing MDS requirements and communicate relevant changes to appropriate team members.
  • Promote collaboration between MDS, nursing, therapy, business office, and other interdisciplinary departments.
  • Protect resident confidentiality and comply with HIPAA requirements.

Authority and Organizational Scope

  • This is an organization-wide position supporting MDS operations across all company facilities. It is focused on audit, validation, education, training, and clinical MDS support rather than routine completion of a facility's day-to-day MDS workload.
  • The Specialist does not function as the assigned MDS Coordinator for a specific facility except when temporarily assigned by the Vice President of MDS.
  • The Specialist does not directly supervise facility MDS nurses or facility clinical leadership.
  • The Specialist identifies issues, educates, coaches, and reports findings to the Vice President of MDS, who determines any further action.


Qualifications
Required

  • Current, unrestricted RN license with multistate privilege where applicable, or ability to obtain required licensure or practice privileges in states supported by the position.
  • Minimum of three years of dedicated MDS experience in a skilled nursing setting.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) and MDS process.
  • Strong working knowledge of PDPM and its relationship to skilled nursing
    reimbursement.
  • Demonstrated ability to review completed MDS assessments and supporting clinical documentation for accuracy and compliance.
  • Strong understanding of CMS requirements and current RAI Manual guidance.
  • Working knowledge of MDS-based Quality Measures and the relationship between MDS accuracy, quality reporting, and facility performance.
  • Experience educating, training, mentoring, or coaching MDS nurses or clinical staff.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: C Lineman - Transmission (Dominion)
description:
Position Summary

The Class C Lineman is an entry level line worker position to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

The compensation range for this position is between $18.60 - $30.91

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Help install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Two (2) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKEfamily.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric,LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: GCP Infrastrukturspecialist – Byg vores GCP-fundament fra bunden
description:
Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre?

Hos LB Forsikring er vi i gang med en spændende cloud-rejse, og vi søger en erfaren GCP Infrastrukturspecialist, der kan være med til at etablere vores fundament i Google Cloud Platform – og samtidig bidrage til driften af vores Microsoft-baserede løsninger.

Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig.

Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?
Som GCP Infrastrukturspecialist bliver du en del af IT Teknologi & Infrastruktur, hvor vi moderniserer vores tekniske landskab. I IT Teknologi & Infrastruktur er vi 13 kollegaer, hvor vi er vi drivkraften bag moderniseringen af LB Forsikrings tekniske landskab. Vi arbejder med cloud, sikkerhed, identitet og infrastruktur og sikrer, at vores platforme er robuste, skalerbare og klar til fremtidens krav. Nu søger vi en GCP Infrastrukturspecialist, der vil være med til at forme vores Google Cloud Platform-rejse og sætte retningen for morgendagens cloud-løsninger.

Dine væsentligste opgaver i stillingen vil være:

  • Designe og implementere GCP-ressourcehierarki og infrastruktur
  • Automatisere processer med fx Terraform, PowerShell eller lignende
  • Integrere GCP med Microsoft 365, Azure AD / Entra ID
  • Bidrage til cloud governance, sikkerhed og compliance
  • Samarbejde med applikationsteams om optimal anvendelse af cloud-ressourcer samt bidrage med din erfaring inden for etablering af monitorering og robusthed i løsningerne
  • Overvåge og sikre driften

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?
Vi ønsker, at du trives, og at vi når vores mål sammen. Derfor kigger vi blandt andet på, om du har følgende faglige og personlige færdigheder til jobbet:

  • 3-5 års erfaring med infrastruktur i enterprise-setup
  • Praktisk erfaring med Google Cloud Platform
  • Erfaring med Microsoft 365, Azure og Windows Server
  • Kendskab til netværk, sikkerhed og automatisering
  • Erfaring med Service Management (ServiceNow, TopDesk)
  • Lyst til og erfaring med at arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteams i et agilt set up

Certificeringer i GCP (fx Professional Cloud Architect eller Associate Cloud Engineer) er en fordel – men ikke et krav.

Vi har spurgt tre af dine kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB:_
”Det giver energi at kunne se formålet med det, vi laver. Det giver en substans i jobbet, når de applikationer, du arbejder på, bliver brugt af andre i den anden ende. Uanset, om det så er digital selvbetjening til medlemmerne, dokumenthåndtering til kollegerne eller noget helt tredje”._

”Det er rigtig meget LB at være der for andre. Fællesskabet er en del af vores fælles sjæl. Det fede ved det er, at det ikke kun gælder for os som medarbejdere. Medlemmerne støtter jo også op om hinanden ved at tilvælge dækninger”.

”De fleste vil sige, at vores arbejde handler mere om fakta end om sanser. Det er også rigtigt i den tekniske problemløsning. Det kræver til gengæld sans for både forretningen og for andre, når der skal vælges, hvad vi løser først, og hvor langt, vi går. Du skal kunne skabe forståelse for, at vi ikke løser hele problemet, fordi det bliver meget dyrere og tager længere tid at løse det sidste”.

Interesseret?
Vi samarbejder med Right People Group om denne rekruttering. Send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt - vi indkalder løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsansvarlig Mashiah Moltrup-Ryom på mmr@rightpeoplegroup.com.

Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Strategic Sourcing Specialist
description:
I. Job Summary

The Strategic Sourcing Specialist is responsible for reducing the overall cost of externally purchased materials, goods and services while maintaining or improving quality and service delivery using the strategic sourcing process to identify and eliminate waste and inefficiencies upstream and downstream in the supply chain for one or more spend categories or subcategories. This role is also responsible for on-going category management for assigned categories or subcategories.

II. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Analyze and understand the company’s historical spending patterns for assigned spend categories or subcategories
  • Establish and facilitate cross-functional teams to determine requirements and participate in the overall sourcing process as Subject Matter Experts, stakeholder representatives, etc.
  • Analyze and understand the market for potential solutions to satisfy the requirements identified
  • Develop sourcing strategies and tactics based on the empirical results of the requirements and market analysis, for low to medium complexity sourcing events, that will result in the best overall value and TCO for the company
  • Present sourcing strategy and tactics recommendations to supply chain leadership, and key stakeholders
  • Execute the sourcing strategy and tactics to select the source. This may include: development of RFPs, use of eSourcing tools, bid evaluations, supplier evaluation, development of negotiation strategy, negotiation documents, supplier performance metrics, and contracts.
  • Present results of the source selection process to supply chain leadership and key stakeholders
  • Develop a detailed implementation plan that includes: the transition process and timing, communication plan identifying purpose, target audiences, key messages, frequency, duration, delivery medium(s), responsibilities, schedule, program utilization and user satisfaction metrics
  • Develop and document savings calculations and any other impact metrics
  • Determine reporting frequency and report savings
  • Ongoing management of suppliers in assigned spend categories

  • Ongoing contract management, program utilization tracking and reporting, internal requirements monitoring and market dynamics monitoring

title: Post-Doctoral Research Fellow
description:
Overview

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

Fred Hutch has more than 200 postdoctoral fellows working in labs across all five research divisions. We provide postdocs with the opportunity to work on the cutting edge of biomedical research in a supportive, collaborative environment with faculty and staff who are dedicated to helping their trainees achieve their career goals. In addition, both the Student/Postdoc Advisory Committee and the Office of Scientific Career Development offer diverse mentoring and career development opportunities.

A Post-Doctoral Research Fellow position is immediately available in the Zhuang lab at the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center. Aging is the greatest risk factor for cancer, yet the molecular mechanisms by which aging dictates tumor initiation, progression, and therapeutic response remain poorly understood. Our laboratory studies how aging reshapes the cell of origin and its surrounding microenvironment to regulate cancer development and treatment response. By integrating aging, stem cell, and cancer biology, we seek to uncover fundamental principles that can be translated into new strategies for precision oncology. The laboratory places a high emphasis of novel discoveries and academic development.

Responsibilities

For this position, the applicant will utilize murine and human genetics, pre-clinical models of lung cancer, 3D organoid/tumor sphere culture, spatial and single-cell transcriptomics, functional genomics and various cellular and molecular assays to understand how the aging alters lung regeneration and tumorigenesis.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • We are looking for exceptional candidates with a recent PhD and/or MD, a record of productive research, and the ability to work independently as well as in collaborative research efforts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A strong background in mouse genetics, cancer/aging/stem cell biology, lung regeneration/pulmonary biology, cancer immunology, and/or computational biology are highly desirable.

To apply, please submit a CV and a cover letter describing how your background and interests align with our research.

The annual base salary range for this position is from $80,172 to $95,014, and pay offered will be based on experience and qualifications.This position may be eligible for relocation assistanceAlthough Fred Hutch is not sponsoring most H-1B visas at this time, candidates who already hold an H-1B sponsored by another organization and are currently in the U.S. may be eligible for this position.Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center offers employees a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits include medical/vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, life, disability, retirement, family life support, employee assistance program, onsite health clinic, income-based child care subsidy, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation (22 days per year), paid sick leave (up to 30 calendar days per occurrence of a qualifying reason), paid holidays (13 days per year), and paid parental leave (up to 4 weeks).

Additional Information

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, political ideology, or membership in any other legally protected class. We desire priority referrals of protected veterans. If due to a disability you need assistance/and or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to Human Resources at hrops@fredhutch.org or by calling 206-667-4700.

description:

Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act

title: Person In Charge (PIC)
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Grocery Fourth Person

Reports to: Store Director

Salaried or Hourly: Hourly

Job Code: 16376

Department: Front End

Date: December 2022

Position Purpose: Exemplifies and ensures strong customer service in all aspects of the job. Directs and controls the operation of the Front End in the absence of store management to achieve sales and profit objectives.

Job Description: As a primary contact for customers, the Grocery Fourth/Person In Charge (PIC) provides friendly, courteous, and helpful service. During the absence of the Store Manager and the First & Second Assistant Managers, the PIC is in charge of the store, with analogous authority to make necessary decisions to operate the store at maximum profit, efficiency, and superior customer service. When in charge of the store (generally at night) the PIC will supervise the store employees. The PIC also acts as a Cashier-Checker (see job description). May be required to work in many of the departments within the store.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

  • Provide customer service as currently defined by the employer within the scope of the position and within company policy.

  • Responsible for appropriately handling emergencies, customer complaints, employee or customer accidents and supervising all store personnel.

  • Maintains high level of familiarity with company policies and procedures.

  • Supervises the sales floor to monitor service and replenishment of products.

  • Replaces stock in displays surrounding the checkout area.

  • Assists in maintaining a clean and safe work environment within the store.

  • Assists other cashiers with computer, register, and scanner problems.

  • Responsible for performing basic office functions to assist customers and personnel.

  • Operates electronically scanning cash register to total customers’ final bill.

  • Receive payment for customer purchase and count back correct change.

  • Bag groceries in paper, canvas, or plastic bags. Lift bags into grocery cart. Offer customer assistance with carry out, and perform that task if a Courtesy Clerk is not available.

  • May be responsible for completing close of day function in the office.

  • May be responsible for counting out of stock product.

  • May count tills when other cashier-checkers leave.

  • Other duties as assigned.

JOB RELATED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to follow company customer service procedures. Demonstrated prior customer service skills or related experience.

  • Ability to interact with customers and co-workers.

  • Ability to understand and follow instructions.

  • Knowledge of all positions within the store.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Desired: Prior experience as a clerk or manager.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

All store employees during the absence of the Store Director or Assistant Store Director.

PERMITS/LICENSES:

Varies depending on store location and state/county requirements.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

%Inside: 100%%Outside: Rare

Temperature Extremes: N/A

Chemicals: Seldom (mild detergents or glass cleaner)

MACHINES, TOOLS, AND EQUIPMENT:

six-wheeled cart, grocery cart, box cutter, pens and pencils, spray bottle, rags, mops, broom, telephone/intercom, cash register, credit card scanner, computer, pallet jack, bailer

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Constant (over 70% of the time)

Frequent (30-70%)

Occasional (10-30%)

Seldom (1-10%)

Lifting:

Constantly lifts 1-10 lbs. Frequently lifts 11-20 lbs. Seldom lifts 21-35 lbs.

Carrying:

Occasionally carries 1-10 lbs. Seldom carries 11-50 lbs.

Pushing/Pulling:

Constantly pushes/pulls 1-10 lbs. Occasionally pushes/pulls 11-20 lbs.

Reaching:

Constant knee to shoulder reaching. Seldom overhead and at or above shoulder level reaching.

Standing:

Constant standing while on job. Sitting allowed on breaks.

Walking:

Frequent walking while on job.

Climb/Balance:

Seldom. May use step stool while stocking/facing product on high shelves.

Trunk Functions:

Frequent neck rotation and bending of head. Occasional bending/stooping, twisting, crouching, and squatting. Seldom kneeling.

Upper Extremity:

Constant handling/grasping and repetitive motion while checking, facing, and replacing stock. Frequent fine finger manipulation.

Vision:

Use of peripheral vision and depth perception to move around store and push carts in aisles. Near vision used to operate scanner, make change, and troubleshoot equipment.

Hearing:

To converse with customers, provide service, and receive questions from employees and customers. Answer pages and telephone.

Speech:

To respond to customers and employees and use intercom/telephone.

Safety – Sensitive Position:

Job responsibilities include tasks or duties that could affect the safety or health of the employee performing the task or others.

Starting rates will vary based on things like location, experience, qualifications and the terms of any applicable collective bargaining agreement. Dependent on length of service, hours worked and any applicable collective bargaining agreement, benefits include medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, sick pay (accrued based on hours worked), PTO/Vacation pay (accrued based on hours worked), paid holidays (9 days annually), bereavement pay, and retirement benefits (pension and/or 401k eligibility).”

DISCLAIMER:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by employees assigned to this job. If you have questions regarding your ability to physically perform the listed job duties and requirements – e.g. lifting, standing, bending, etc. - please speak to your Store Director. All team members must comply with Company, Division, and Store policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified may vary within each store and from store to store.

title: Business Systems and Reporting Analyst
description:
Business Systems and Reporting Analyst

First Century Bank has an exciting career opportunity for a curious and analytical Business Systems and Reporting Analyst. This position supports the Business Analytics and ACH team by helping the Bank understand its data, maintain accurate and useful reporting, investigate questions, test system changes, and improve business processes.

We are looking for someone who wants to understand not only what the data shows, but why it matters. The successful candidate will ask thoughtful questions, approach problems logically, and build knowledge through active participation and collaboration. This is a developmental role that will work closely with experienced analysts, business departments, IT, project managers, and third-party partners while gaining exposure to reporting, banking systems, payments, and product implementations.

This entry-level position is designed for candidates with 0–3 years of relevant experience and requires a bachelor's degree in a related field.

Applicants must currently live within commuting distance of Commerce, GA. The schedule includes three days per week in our Commerce office and two days working from home.

Duties and responsibilities can include:

  • Reporting and analysis: Create, modify, and maintain operational, management, monitoring, and reconciliation reports using SQL, Excel, Power BI, Crystal Reports, Cognos, or other available reporting tools.
  • Business understanding: Demonstrate understanding by interacting with senior analysts and business stakeholders to create and define reporting and data needs, identify the purpose behind each request, and help determine the most useful way to present the information.
  • Data validation: Review reports, data extracts, file loads, and other outputs for completeness and accuracy. Compare information across sources, identify inconsistencies, and escalate potential data-integrity concerns.
  • Research and troubleshooting: Investigate reporting, data, and system questions; document findings; and work with the appropriate team to resolve or escalate issues.
  • Testing and change support: Perform user acceptance testing for reports, system enhancements, scripts, and new processes. Prepare test cases, compare expected and actual results, record evidence, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Process improvement: Provide feedback on design and improvement of reporting, data collection, monitoring, and business processes. Suggest ideas to make recurring work more accurate, efficient, and sustainable.
  • Implementation support: Support new client, product, vendor, and system initiatives by confirming requirements, completing data mapping, generating reporting, performing testing, creating readiness reviews, and completing post-implementation validation.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain report definitions, procedures, data-flow documentation, test results, issue summaries, and other materials needed to preserve knowledge and support consistent processes.
  • Ticket and project support: Document issues and requests in the Bank's ticketing systems, maintain supporting evidence, track progress, validate corrections, and participate on project teams as assigned.
  • Cross training and team support: Develop working knowledge of the Bank's reporting environment, ACH and other payment products, banking portals, and related systems so the position can provide flexible analytical and project support as priorities evolve.

Perform other duties that may be assigned or that inherently and logically belong with the position.

Exemplify FCB's values while supporting its mission, organizational goals, and priorities.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, data analysis, finance, accounting, computer science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • One to three years of related experience is preferred; relevant internships, coursework, or project experience may also be considered.
  • Strong Excel skills and a foundational understanding of SQL, relational data, and common data-validation techniques.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to ask questions, learn unfamiliar systems, and understand the business purpose behind reports and processes.
  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to research an issue carefully and reach conclusions supported by evidence.
  • High attention to detail when working with financial data, transactions, and sensitive information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document work so that others can understand and repeat it.
  • Ability to organize assignments, balance recurring responsibilities with project work, and seek guidance when priorities or results are unclear.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business departments, technology teams, project managers, and external partners.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, Crystal Reports, Cognos, or other reporting and visualization tools.
  • Experience with financial services, banking, payments, reconciliations, file processing, workflow automation, or system testing.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, ticketing systems, and collaborative project environments.

Work Arrangement

This is a hybrid position. The employee may work remotely and will also be expected to work from the Commerce, Georgia office as needed for training, collaboration, and team development.

Equal Employment Opportunity

First Century Bank is an equal opportunity employer. It is the Company's policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all qualified persons without regard to race, color, sex, gender or gender identification, religious creed or religious beliefs, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, military or veteran's status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by state or federal law.

title: Internal Communications Lead,  Enterprise & Growth
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports OpenAI’s mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI. The Internal Communications team aims to create clarity, trust, and shared understanding that inspires our employees to do their best work. We partner across the company to craft clear, compelling narratives about what’s being built, why it matters, how it aligns to our strategy, and most importantly, how it advances our mission.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced internal communications leader to own the strategy for our Enterprise & Growth portfolio, spanning B2B, Revenue, Partnerships, Marketing, Enterprise Engineering, Ads, Commerce, and Consumer Verticals. These teams are changing how businesses operate, bringing AI into working life, and expanding access to its benefits. This work is central to our mission of ensuring AGI benefits all of humanity: helping people and businesses everywhere put AI to use in ways that improve their lives and livelihoods.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with executives to help employees understand where the business is going, why decisions are being made, and how their work ladders up. You will draw on a deep understanding of the teams you support and leverage strong relationships across the company to shape the communications approach and deliver the writing and programs that bring it to life.

A central part of this role is helping employees understand how our technology reaches people and businesses – and what we learn when they use it. You will bring user and customer experiences into companywide conversations, help employees understand the products and capabilities we’re building for businesses and the problems they solve, and help leaders communicate through rapid growth and change.

We’re looking for someone with sharp editorial instincts, boundless creative ambition, and the sound judgment to handle sensitive, confidential, and consequential work with care. You should be equally comfortable setting the communications direction, writing an executive message that addresses what’s on employees’ minds directly and transparently, and hosting a live conversation that invites candid questions and open discussion.

OpenAI is a unique and fast-moving working environment. Priorities can shift quickly, and important work often begins before every detail is settled. You will often need to get up to speed on unfamiliar topics, recommend a path with incomplete information, and adjust as decisions evolve. We’re looking for a pro who takes initiative, understands what matters to employees, and anticipates tough questions and pain points early enough to help leaders address them.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Set and deliver the communications strategy for Enterprise & Growth. Understand the portfolio’s priorities, identify where communications can make a difference, and lead programs from initial recommendation through execution and evaluation.

  • Advise senior leaders and shape their communications. Develop leadership updates, narratives, and presentations. Offer clear recommendations on framing, timing, and delivery, holding a high bar for accuracy, clarity, and transparency with employees.

  • Guide communications through complex and sensitive changes. Develop plans for leadership transitions, organizational changes, and evolving business priorities. Work with People, Legal, External Comms, and XFN partners to explain decisions, prepare leadership, and address questions employees are likely to have.

  • Lead company-wide user and customer storytelling. Build programs that show how people and organizations use our technology, how it benefits them, and what employees can learn from their experiences. Develop creative formats that bring these stories to life, encourage engagement, and spark new ideas for what we could build next.

  • Bring employee perspectives into communications decisions. Synthesize questions and feedback from Slack, leadership forums, and other channels. Help leaders understand where employees need more context, recommend responses, and assess whether communications are improving understanding, morale, and trust.

  • Keep work moving as priorities change. Move quickly, adapt as new information comes in, and keep everyone involved informed about decisions and next steps. Respond to feedback, adjust course without losing momentum, and bring a constructive, collaborative attitude to challenging moments.

  • Strengthen the broader Internal Communications function. Contribute to shared priorities, provide thoughtful ideas and feedback, and turn successful approaches into practices others can use.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in internal or executive communications, marketing communications, operations, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex communications programs. People Management experience (1-2 years minimum) is required.

  • Experience advising senior leaders. You have built trust through preparation, discretion, and thoughtful and strategic recommendations, and can navigate disagreement with confidence and utmost respect.

  • Excellent writing and editorial judgment. You can explain business strategy and complicated decisions clearly, adapt to different leadership voices, and identify the details that make a message trustworthy and credible. You can produce strong work on a short timeline and incorporate detailed feedback without losing the purpose/“the why” of the message.

  • Curiosity about how businesses grow and how people use technology. You can connect commercial priorities, product developments, and customer experiences to our mission and the questions and themes employees care about.

  • Strong program leadership, ownership, and adaptability. You bring structure to ambiguous work and carry it through with limited direction. You can move between strategic planning and hands-on execution, learn an unfamiliar part of the business quickly, and revise your approach when new information changes the picture.

  • Sound judgment and resilience under pressure. You stay constructive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented through compressed timelines, candid feedback, and changes in direction. You can rethink a draft or plan quickly, raise concerns early, and make thoughtful decisions about when to move and when to pause for more context. Your partners have deep trust in your judgment and look forward to working with you on the most challenging projects.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description:

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Engineer to join a large-scale technology transformation program within a secure and highly regulated environment.

This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for building, automating and supporting Azure cloud platforms, enabling application teams to rapidly and securely deploy workloads while maintaining alignment with enterprise security, governance and operational standards.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary cloud team, you will collaborate with architects, security specialists, developers and infrastructure engineers to deliver scalable, secure and automated cloud solutions.

  • Design, provision and support Azure infrastructure and platform services.

description:

title: CMM Operator (50931)
description:
Position Summary

The Entry-Level CMM Operator is responsible for assisting with dimensional and visual inspection of manufactured components to ensure products meet customer specifications and company quality standards. This position operates Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) equipment using established programs and procedures and utilizes various precision measuring instruments.

This is an entry-level position designed for an individual who is detail-oriented, mechanically inclined, and interested in developing a career in manufacturing quality. Previous CMM experience is not required; training will be provided.

Essential Job Duties

  • Operate CMM equipment using established programs and procedures.
  • Properly position, align, and secure parts and fixtures for CMM inspection.
  • Run established CMM programs and review inspection results.
  • Measure finished parts to verify conformance to specifications.
  • Learn to properly use precision measuring equipment, including micrometers, calipers, depth micrometers, height gauges, and other quality gauges.
  • Read and interpret CMM inspection reports.
  • Accurately record and enter inspection results.
  • Assist with first-piece, in-process, and final inspections.
  • Identify measurements or conditions that do not meet specifications and notify appropriate Quality or Production personnel.
  • Identify, document, and properly handle non-conforming product.
  • Perform visual inspections and identify product defects.
  • Assist Quality personnel with dimensional inspections for PPAPs and sample layouts as trained.
  • Assist with gauge calibration activities and documentation as assigned.
  • Follow established drawings, work instructions, control plans, and inspection procedures.
  • Support Production personnel with basic inspection and measurement questions.
  • Maintain accurate and unbiased inspection results.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area and follow 5S standards.
  • Follow all company safety, quality, and work procedures.
  • Perform other Quality-related duties as assigned.

These responsibilities are adapted from the inspection, measurement, calibration, non-conforming product, production support, and 5S responsibilities in the existing position.

The temporary position is in the Operations and Advocacy Division, Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). OCHA is part of the United Nations Secretariat, responsible for bringing together humanitarian actors to ensure a coherent response to emergencies. OCHA also ensures a framework for each actor to contribute to the overall response efforts. OCHA's mission is to mobilize and coordinate effective and principled humanitarian action in partnership with national and international actors to alleviate human suffering in disasters and emergencies, advocate the rights of people in need, promote preparedness and prevention and facilitate sustainable solutions.

This temporary vacancy is for the position of Information Management Associate, based in Caracas, Venezuela.

Within the delegated authority, the Information Management Associate will be responsible for a variety of tasks such as data analysis, content management, assessments, mapping, GIS tasks and data visualization. This position requires good general information management and coordination skills.

Under the general supervision of the Head of Information Management, the Information Management Associate supports data collection, information analysis and the implementation of various operational and logistical activities. The Information Management Associate promotes a customer-centric and results-oriented approach.

The Information Management Associate works closely with the Information Management Team and staff of other United Nations agencies to share information and ensure consistent service delivery.

title: Assembler
description:
About Meridian

Meridian Bioscience is a fully integrated life science company that develops, manufactures, markets and distributes a broad range of innovative diagnostic products. Job Summary

The Assembler position requires the employee to learn how to safely assemble, manufacture, and package regulated medical devices and kits in a performance driven environment under the supervision of higher-level operators / Supervisors / Managers. The employee will work to understand and meet all quality standards and adhere to all cGMP standards.

Key Duties

Major Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain a safe work environment by complying with all safety and environmental policies including the use of PPE.
  • Expand upon limited knowledge of departmental operations to understand the equipment and processes.
  • Perform manual and automated assembly/packaging of diagnostic kits & sensors.
  • Read, understand, and comply with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Learn to operate automated production equipment with direct supervision of a trained operator or higher.
  • Complete daily documentation required for production procedures and supplemental documentation as needed.
  • Audit own paperwork for corrections, missing, and/or incomplete information ensuring that it is neat, accurate, and legible, following GDP practices.
  • Comply with all OSHA, FDA, ISO, Quality system, Company and departmental requirements.
  • Learn to perform calibrations and routine process monitoring as needed.
  • Conduct in process sampling and/or inspections and document per procedure.
  • Notify supervisor of any manufacturing material that may be running low.
  • Identify and communicate any / all abnormal components and deviating events to the Group Leader/Supervisor/Manager.
  • Learn to use necessary computer programs for the required job tasks and managing job benefits, such as time & attendance.
  • Demonstrate willingness to work with other departments and employees as required and accept instruction from higher level positions.
  • Operator or higher-level employee attention is required at this level.
  • Other duties as required.
  • Must be able to demonstrate cross-training ability as set forth by management.

Job-Specific Responsibilities (but not limited to):

Kit Assembly

  • Perform related duties, under general supervision, following clearly prescribed standard practices
  • Operate shrink wrapper machine to wrap packages to obtain proper wrapping.
  • Perform inventory checks and pick parts from stock room for kitting operations according to job order.
  • Confirm lot number on each job with Quality Control, and process paperwork on each order/lot
  • Inspect reagent tubes, capillaries, droppers, buttons and other associated kit components for shipments.
  • Assemble kits under supervision of operators or manager.
  • Under supervision of higher level operators run or assist in running automated equipment to produce kit components.

Sensor Assembly

  • Label vials, take inventories, keep records, and perform related duties under general supervision, following clearly prescribed standard practices.
  • Assemble product in accordance with written specifications and procedures, ensuring lot number conformity and other quality requirements are satisfied.
  • Move boxes of product in area, stock shelves with specified items, take inventories of all items in storage area and keep related records.
  • Confirm lot number on each job with Quality Control and process paperwork on each order/lot.
  • Provide Quality Control with samples of products for appropriate testing, etc.

Analyzer Assembly & Test:

  • Complete all required documentation following GDP guidelines.
  • Perform a variety of assembly operations associated with instrument production, which include hand assembly of components onto printed circuit boards.
  • Perform critical cleaning procedures, mixing and injecting epoxy and testing equipment used in instrument production.
  • Able to follow direction of senior operators in work cell for instruction.

Other Duties/Physical Requirements

  • Must have the ability to inspect, analyze and concentrate throughout the course of the work shift.
  • Must be able to concentrate and problem solve routinely throughout the course of the work shift.
  • Must have fine manual dexterity to ensure precise assembly of medical devices.
  • Must have the ability to lift up to 25 pounds of supplies or finished product throughout the work shift.
  • Ability to stand and/or sit for long periods, stoop, reach, bend, push and pull carts and hand jacks throughout the course of the work shift.
  • Ability to wear all required personal protective equipment (lab coat, safety glasses, hair coverings, latex or nitrile gloves)
  • Must be able to identify and differentiate color and color changes on diagnostic devices and device components.
  • Must be able to read, navigate, and operate controls systems screens and written documents throughout the course of the workday.
  • Must be able to detect audible and or visual alarms.

Qualifications

Minimum Education or Equivalent Experience Required/Preferred:

  • High School Diploma or general education degree (GED) preferred.
  • Prior manufacturing and/or assembly experience preferred.
  • Prior experience in an FDA regulated production environment preferred.

Competencies Required or Preferred:

  • Learn and retain good documentation practices.
  • Computer literacy / skills required (e-mail and Windows).
  • Must have basic math skills and be able to perform step by step arithmetic calculations.
  • Must show initiative, have critical attention to detail, and be organized.
  • Develop interpersonal, organizational, written, comprehension, and oral communications skills.
  • Ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality requirements.
  • Must be able to work overtime and weekends to support production efforts as needed.
  • Develop problem solving and troubleshooting skills.

Required Travel%

  • None

description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. title: B Lineman - Transmission (Dominion)
description:
Position Summary

The Class B Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

The compensation range for this position is between $30.92 - $40.49

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Three (3) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric,LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Central Intke & Ref Spec
description:
Under direction from the Central Intake and Outreach Coordinator, responsible for receiving and processing referrals to home visiting and early intervention programs in 17 counties in Northwest Ohio as part of the statewide central intake and referral system. Involves live data entry into multiple data systems, tracking performance indicators, and generating follow up communication to parents/caregivers and referral sources. Also responsible for providing information to potential program participants, providers, and referral sources about available programs and services in the region for expectant parents and parents/caregivers of young children.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  1. On a daily basis, receive referrals for home visiting and early intervention programs in the Northwest Ohio Region of central intake through telephone, fax, email, and statewide electronic data system(s).

    1. Respond to telephone calls from families, referral sources, and service providers;

    2. Check fax, email, and data system(s) regularly for new referrals;

    3. Enter referral information in data systems;

    4. Assign new referrals to agencies following Bright Beginnings policy and procedures;

    5. Make verbal or written contact with the family within required timelines;

    6. Assist referral sources with questions about referral forms/process;

    11. Complete risk assessments with sensitivity

    13. Make referrals to other community programs when applicable

  2. Provide current and accurate information about home visiting, early intervention, and community resources to families and professionals who contact central intake.

  3. Identify any potential problem areas and report to Central Intake & Outreach Coordinator.

  4. Complete required and recommended training based on central intake Professional Development Plan and individual performance appraisals.

  5. Participate in outreach events in NW Region when requested by supervisor.

  6. Participate in monthly supervision and team meetings with central intake and all-staff meetings with Lucas County Family Council.

  • High School Diploma or GED and four years of supervised experience in Customer Service, Social Service or Human and Family Development fields; OR holds an associate's degree, from an accredited college or university in any field AND has at least two years of supervised, paid experience in case management.

title: General Superintendent
description:
Company Overview

Upchurch is a rapidly growing, full-service building engineering company providing mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical services across the southeastern United States. Founded in 1970 and headquartered in Horn Lake, MS, Upchurch has grown through both organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, establishing a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and service excellence. We offer end-to-end solutions—from design and installation to ongoing maintenance and emergency support—helping clients maximize building performance, energy efficiency, and equipment lifespan.

Position Summary

Upchurch is seeking an experienced General Superintendent to lead field operations for our DFW construction projects. Based out of our Arlington office, this position will oversee the execution of mechanical and plumbing work across multiple active projects throughout the market.

The General Superintendent will provide leadership to project superintendents, foremen, and field teams while partnering closely with Project Managers and Operations leadership to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with schedule, quality, and budget expectations.

This role is intended for an experienced mechanical construction leader who understands large-scale HVAC, piping, and plumbing installations and can provide strong operational oversight across multiple projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee field operations across multiple mechanical and plumbing construction projects in the DFW market.

  • Lead, mentor, and support project superintendents, foremen, and field leadership.

  • Coordinate manpower needs and field resources across active and upcoming projects.

  • Partner with Project Managers and Operations leadership on project planning, scheduling, sequencing, and execution.

  • Conduct regular jobsite visits to evaluate progress, productivity, quality, safety, and field conditions.

  • Identify and address field challenges that may impact schedule, labor performance, or project execution.

  • Ensure field teams understand project drawings, specifications, scope, and installation requirements.

  • Provide guidance on mechanical and plumbing installation methods, constructability, sequencing, and coordination.

  • Support project teams with labor planning, equipment needs, material readiness, and overall field logistics.

  • Maintain consistent field standards and expectations across DFW construction projects.

  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure company and project-specific safety requirements are followed.

  • Work closely with project teams to identify potential risks and resolve issues before they impact project performance.

  • Support project startup, preconstruction handoff, scheduling, and operational planning efforts.

  • Assist in developing and evaluating field leadership and identifying opportunities for advancement within the organization.

  • Participate in recruiting and interviewing key field leadership positions as needed.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with General Contractors, trade partners, vendors, and project stakeholders.

  • Represent Upchurch professionally while reinforcing accountability, communication, teamwork, and quality throughout field operations.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive field experience in commercial mechanical and plumbing construction.

  • 5+ years of experience in a Superintendent, General Superintendent, or similar senior field leadership role.

  • Strong experience overseeing large and complex commercial construction projects.

  • Extensive knowledge of HVAC, hydronic piping, mechanical piping, and plumbing systems.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical construction sequencing, installation methods, and field coordination.

  • Experience managing self-perform field labor across multiple projects.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead superintendents, foremen, and skilled trades professionals.

  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, schedules, and project documentation.

  • Strong knowledge of construction safety practices and OSHA requirements.

  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound operational decisions in a fast-paced construction environment.

  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel regularly to project sites throughout the DFW area.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large commercial, healthcare, industrial, manufacturing, mission critical, or data center projects.

  • Experience managing both mechanical and plumbing scopes.

  • Experience working for a mechanical contractor with significant self-perform capabilities.

  • Experience developing field leadership and implementing consistent construction standards across multiple projects.

Leadership Expectations

The General Superintendent should be a highly visible field leader who provides direction, removes obstacles, and holds teams accountable for safe and successful project execution. This individual will play a key role in maintaining consistency across DFW construction projects while supporting the continued growth and development of Upchurch's mechanical and plumbing field operations.

Benefits:

  • Competitive pay based on experience.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid time off and holiday pay.

  • Opportunities for professional development and certification assistance.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Upchurch Companies provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Lasten teho-osasto Laakso Uusi lastensairaala
description:
Sairaanhoitajaksi Lasten Teho-osastolle – Tule mukaan huippuosaajien tiimiin!

Kiinnostaako sinua työ, jossa jokainen työpäivä on merkityksellinen ja täynnä oppimista? Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa Uuden lastensairaalan lasten teho-osastolle Laaksoon, jossa hoidetaan kaikkein vaativinta tehohoitoa tarvitsevia lapsia Suomessa. Potilainamme ovat 0–16-vuotiaat lapset kaikilta erikoisaloilta. Meille on keskitetty mm. vaativa sydänkirurgia, elinsiirrot ja ECMO-hoito – tehtäviä, joita ei muualla pääse tekemään.

Haemme sairaanhoitajaa perhevapaan sijaisuuteen 9.12.26-9.8.27 väliselle ajalle.

Miksi meille?

  • Työ, jolla on sydän – kohtaat perheen kokonaisuutena ja teet työtä aidosti yhdessä heidän kanssaan.
  • Monipuolisuus ja haasteet – työpäiväsi sisältävät potilaan voinnin tarkkailua, lääke- ja nestehoitoa, sekä erilaisia hoitotoimenpiteitä
  • Tiimi, joka tukee – olet osa motivoitunutta ja yhteen hitsautunutta työyhteisöä.

Me arvostamme sinua

  • Saat 300 € ePassi-saldoa vuosittain hyvinvointisi tueksi.
  • Tarjoamme työnohjausta, työterveyshuollon ja mahdollisuuden työsuhdeasuntoon.
  • Palkka määräytyy SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan: 3218,18 €/kk + vuorolisät ja kokemuslisät.

Sinulta toivomme

  • Motivaatiota työskennellä vaativissa tilanteissa eri ikäisten lasten parissa.
  • Erinomaisia tiimityötaitoja ja kykyä kohdata perheitä empaattisesti.

  • Valmiutta intensiiviseen ja vaihtelevaan työympäristöön.

Tule mukaan iloiseen ja lämminhenkiseen joukkoomme tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys – lasten parhaaksi.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja liity joukkoomme!

Hae meille viimeistään hakuajan loppuun mennessä. Sijaisuus täytetään sopivan sijaisen löydyttyä.

HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.


Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 mom. mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rekisteriote.
