title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Department of Chemistry - UTK
description:
The Department of Chemistry at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Associate whose appointment will be divided between serving as the Department’s X-ray Scientist and conducting synthetic chemistry research in Dr. David Jenkins’s group (X-ray/ICP center director). The X-ray Scientist responsibilities will include operation and maintenance of the department’s single-crystal X-ray diffractometer, structural analysis and service crystallography, and training and supporting departmental users. The research component will involve independent and collaborative research in organic, inorganic, or organometallic synthesis, with projects spanning areas such as homogeneous catalysis, porous frameworks, and surface modification. The position is open to candidates who have completed and submitted their PhD dissertation before the start of employment.

Approximately 50% of job as the department’s X-ray scientist includes:

  • Operating and maintaining a Bruker single crystal X-ray diffractometer.

  • Training members of the department on the use of the Bruker single crystal diffractometer.

  • Mounting crystals, collecting data, and solving crystal structures for members of the department (i.e., service structures for PIs).

  • Repairing the instrument (when feasible). Working with technicians to ascertain what repairs are required.

  • Maintaining the X-ray facility in the Department of Chemistry, including safety protocols, logbooks, and user lists (for compliance with Radiation Safety).

  • Billing PIs and maintaining the X-ray cost center. Communicating with relevant accounting personnel about surplus or deficits.

Approximately 50% of job as chemist in Dr Jenkins group includes:

  • Expertise in organic, organometallic, or inorganic synthesis is required.

  • Ability to contribute to one or more current research projects within the Jenkins group.

  • Analytical skills that match synthetic areas of expertise (e.g. NMR, MS, PXRD or similar).

Required Qualifications

  • Education: By first day of appointment, earned a PhD in Chemistry or closely related field
  • Experience:

    • Strong knowledge of small molecule single crystal X-ray diffractometry

    • Expertise in organic, organometallic, or inorganic synthesis is required.

    • An excellent track record of productive and creative research demonstrated by publications in peer reviewed journals.

    • The postdoctoral candidate must have strong verbal and writing skills. The candidate must be willing to work independently and collaboratively with group members, and preferably also with experimental collaborators. The candidate must also be willing to mentor the graduate students in the group from time to time.

    • Motivated and safety conscious.

  • Knowledge, Skills, Abilities: Ability to set priorities, multi-task and adapt to ever changing needs with the proven ability to function well in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience: Knowledge of powder X-ray diffraction techniques is advantageous. Proficiency with air-free synthesis is highly valuable.

Work Location

  • Knoxville, TN

  • Onsite

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $50,000
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

Since the position primarily entails a strong requisite knowledge of small molecule single crystal X-ray diffractometry, candidates should submit:

  • CV

  • Cover letter

  • A list of published crystal structures that have been solved and their references. Knowledge of powder X-ray diffraction techniques or ICP is highly advantageous but not required. Applicants who have a background only in powder X-ray diffraction or ICP will not be considered.

The position is a contract for one year and is renewable (based on performance) for at least one additional year. The position begins on December 1, 2026 or on a mutually agreeable later date.

Questions about the position can be directed to Dr. Jenkins at djenki15@utk.edu. For full consideration, candidates must submit the requested documents via the UTK HR website.

Please be prepared to have 2-3 letters of recommendation submitted upon request. Formal review of applications begins on November 1, 2026 and will continue until the position is filled.

About The Department

The University of Tennessee in Knoxville is the flagship educational institution in the State of Tennessee, and the Department of Chemistry is its oldest PhD granting Department. We offer a long-standing tradition of excellence in chemical research and education, stretching from 1947, when the department granted the University’s first PhD degree, to the present. We have people from diverse cultures providing an international business environment.

The city of Knoxville is a hidden gem with a beautiful and walkable downtown, a diverse music scene, active neighborhoods, unique restaurants, and a robust offering of outdoor and cultural activities. UTK is located within easy driving distance to Asheville, Nashville, Atlanta, and the Great Smoky Mountains; and a day’s drive to Memphis, Chicago and Washington D.C. Knoxville and the surrounding counties have a statistical area population of over 850,000 people. title: Director of Content and Communications
description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and amplifying HappyRobot's company narrative, brand voice, and presence in the market. As HappyRobot's first Content and Communications leader, you will build the function from the ground up, establishing the strategy, processes, and team needed to scale it as the company grows. You will work closely with the founders and leadership team to develop their voices, create high-impact media and thought leadership opportunities, and build awareness with customers, talent, investors, partners, and the broader technology industry. This is an opportunity to define the narrative of a high-growth company while building a world-class communications organization from the ground up. You are obsessed with the customer journey and passionate about building world-class content and experiences for groundbreaking brands and products that are redefining their industries.

Responsibilities

  • Own HappyRobot's overall company narrative, messaging, and content strategy, ensuring we consistently communicate an ambitious, differentiated, and compelling vision.

  • Build a world-class B2B content and communications organization that positions HappyRobot as a sophisticated, high-tech industrial company and category leader.

  • Develop campaign narratives for HappyRobot’s ICPs including digital and OOH media.

  • Develop compelling customer stories, articles, blogs, and other content that demonstrate HappyRobot's impact and establish credibility with enterprise audiences.

  • Build and execute a communications strategy around company milestones, growth, product innovation, customer momentum, partnerships, and other major announcements.

  • Develop and lead founder thought leadership, including executive content, speaking opportunities, media engagements, podcasts, and industry events.

  • Build relationships with top-tier journalists, publications, podcasts, conference organizers, and other influential voices to expand HappyRobot's reach and awareness.

  • Identify and create opportunities for HappyRobot and its leadership to participate in high-impact conversations shaping AI, automation, and the future of work.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and leadership to ensure the company narrative is consistent across customer, industry, and corporate communications.

Must Have

  • Proven leadership experience building and leading Content, Communications, or Marketing functions.

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B technology, enterprise software, AI, automation, or a related industry.

  • Exceptional storytelling, writing, and communication skills with the ability to make complex technology accessible and compelling.

  • High creativity to create narratives and campaigns that stand out in a competitive market.

  • Experience developing company narratives and positioning ambitious technology companies for enterprise audiences.

  • Experience working directly with founders and executives to develop thought leadership and executive communications.

  • Strong understanding of B2B audiences and enterprise technology buying environments.

  • Aspirational, pioneering mindset with a sophisticated understanding of how to build a category-defining technology brand.

  • Highly strategic and hands-on, with the ability to set a vision while executing in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a high-growth startup or category-defining technology company.

  • Background in AI, robotics, industrial technology, logistics, supply chain, or enterprise automation.

  • Strong media relationships and a demonstrated ability to generate meaningful PR, podcast, speaking, and thought leadership opportunities.

  • Experience launching a company or product into a new category.

  • Experience building and managing a high-performing communications or content team.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Responsibilities may include operating specialized test equipment, coordinating electrical system operations, analyzing technical issues, and working closely with customers, sales, service, and other internal teams.

Successful candidates will be organized, technically capable, customer-focused, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications

Graduate Engineer BSEE or BSME and four years’ experience or graduate of applicable Electrical Technical School or Military equivalent and eight years minimum same or similar work experience or high school education or equivalent and eight years minimum same or similar work experience.

Strong background and experience in most types of switchgear testing through the 230 kV class. Knowledge of the National Electrical Code and various industry standards, such as OSHA and NFPA.

Certificates, Licenses, RegisterationsValid California driver’s license with acceptable driving record. Valid international passport or the ability to obtain one.

title: Fresh Foods Clerk
description:
About Us

Join us at WinCo Foods, where we're more than just a grocery retailer - we're a growing family of over 140 supermarkets in 10 states with over 22,000 employee owners. Our purpose is to make the lives of our customers and employee owners better by offering the lowest possible prices to feed their families. Currently, WinCo is the second largest Employee-Owned company in the United States. With more than 500 millionaire employee-owners in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our benefits, including top-tier medical plans and tuition support set us apart. In your role, you'll be instrumental in making a real impact in the communities we serve, embodying our purpose every day.

Overview

Job Summary

Assist customers by providing over-the-counter service and customer service throughout the Fresh Foods department. Operates and maintains the fresh food production areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza), prepares the areas for sales, fries food, operates the rotisserie oven, prepares ready-to-bake/baked pizzas, etc. Receives inventory, verifies receipt of ordered product, and stocks in designated areas. Consistently provides friendly, courteous service to internal and external customers. Performs other related work. Generally works 6-8 hour shifts between 5:00 am and 10:00 pm.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities

  • Seeks opportunities to welcome, engage, serve, and thank customers. Maintains an atmosphere of friendly, enthusiastic customer service with an emphasis of taking care of the customer.
  • Takes orders, answers questions, and performs suggestive selling.
  • Prepares, stocks, displays, straightens, and rotates product in fresh food areas (Deli/Seafood/Pizza).
  • Prepare production items according to recipes, food safety procedures, and/or specified cooking times
  • Handles frozen product.
  • Inspects all product for quality and freshness
  • Prepares case by putting the product in fresh pans, rotating product, putting product back, filling, etc.
  • Places proper signage on all products which includes pricing, description, code dating, and COOL information on all required products.
  • Cleans and maintains department equipment such as fryers, slicers, etc. by breaking down and reassembling equipment, operating dish washer and hand washing dishes, cleaning all appropriate parts with sanitizing solution.
  • Maintains clean and sanitary department by washing parts, tables and wrapping stations; taking trash and paper to the appropriate balers; cleans floors and coolers; cleaning and maintaining glass display counters on the inside and out; etc.
  • Receives inventory, stocks, verifies receipt of ordered product and orders.
  • Follows strict sanitary guidelines and completes associated records.
  • Performs other duties as assigned or needed.
  • Understands and follows all food safety procedures and requirements.

Requirements

Ability to:

  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Communicate (hearing & speech) effectively with customers to receive orders and perform customer relation skills.
  • Conduct visual inspections, read and follow production guides, recipes and product labels, log production quantities, temperature readings, etc. on proper forms.
  • Perform basic math (add, subtract, divide and multiply) and compute weights and measures.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, equipment (e.g., knives) and work aides.
  • Complete training course and meet minimum time standards of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear hair net, beard net and gloves and other personal protective equipment as required.
  • Use cleaning chemicals and handle related food products.
  • Stand, walk and move rapidly for extended periods of time.
  • Bend, stoop, twist, turn and reach over the counter and in tight areas frequently.
  • Lift up to 50 lbs. occasionally and reach, push and pull racks.
  • Handle refrigerated goods (-20°F to 28°F)
  • Work around machinery emitting heat (400°F rotisserie and 325°F hot shortening).
  • Must be 16 years of age or older.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Cash Register
  • Film over wrapper, digital scales, etc.
  • Knives and other kitchen utensils.
  • Electric Slicers
  • Deep fryers, ovens, etc.
  • Oil filtering machine
  • Dishwasher
  • Trash compactor
  • Cardboard bailer
  • Hand, pallet jack
  • Conveyor ovens

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

Fraud alert: WinCo advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from WinCo by checking the official WinCo careers website.

Pay Range

USD $14.50 - USD $18.75 /Hr.

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting e-commerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.

About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.

Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable

Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)

Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence

What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

title: Waste Management Specialist (Greening Moonshot) - Home Based -  [Open to Tier 0, 1 & 2 applicants]
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Job Purpose and Organizational Context

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The UNDP Strategic Plan underscores the organization’s dual imperative to deliver development results with greater efficiency and value for money, while leading by example on sustainability, climate action, and responsible resource use.

Within this context, UNDP has committed to continuously improving the efficiency, effectiveness, and environmental performance of its operations, recognizing that internal operational practices directly affect institutional credibility, partner trust, and staff engagement. The Strategic Plan highlights the need to modernize management practices, strengthen data-driven decision-making, reduce waste and inefficiencies, and align operational systems with UNDP’s broader climate and environmental ambitions.

The Greening Moonshot Initiative, hosted by Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) in collaboration with the Bureau for Management Services (BMS), is UNDP’s flagship, inward-facing transformation effort to reduce the environmental footprint of corporate operations. Through the Greening Moonshot, UNDP has committed to significantly reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving resource efficiency, and adopting best practices across energy use, procurement, mobility, buildings, and waste management. The initiative is overseen by the Moonshot Task Force and supported by a dedicated Moonshot Secretariat.

Waste management is a highly visible and material component of UNDP’s operational sustainability agenda. As a leading development actor working extensively on waste, circular economy, chemicals, and pollution issues at the country level, UNDP is expected to “walk the talk” by applying the same principles internally. At the same time, sound waste management and resource efficiency practices are increasingly recognized as cost‑reduction and efficiency levers.

The Waste Management Specialist position is associated with the Greening Moonshot team and is designed to strengthen UNDP’s capacity to provide coherent corporate guidance, practical tools, monitoring approaches, and strategic recommendations that support offices worldwide in improving waste management performance in a cost‑effective, context‑sensitive manner.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Waste Management Specialist will support the design, rollout, and continuous improvement of UNDP’s corporate approach to waste management and resource efficiency. The assignment balances technical rigor, operational practicality, and cost‑effectiveness, in line with UNDP’s Strategic Plan and Greening Moonshot commitments.

  1. Develop and improve corporate waste management guidance and tools
    • Continuously improve and maintain waste management guidance for UNDP offices, covering both non‑hazardous and hazardous waste streams, process to limit waste generation and to assist in designing office-specific strategies.
    • Guidance should reflect sectoral best practices, regional feasibility constraints, and life‑cycle cost considerations, and support offices in making efficient, defensible operational decisions.
    • Tools to be developed by the Waste Management Specialist should leverage advancements in automation, AI and digital solutions to maximize the availability, ease of use and impact of advice and guidance generated for UNDP.

2. Monitoring, data quality, and efficiency improvements

  • Guide and support the integration of waste management considerations into UNDP’s environmental monitoring and reporting systems, including the Environmental Management Tool (EMT).
  • Develop training materials, deliver webinars, and provide targeted support to focal points to improve data quality, consistency, and usability for management decision‑making.
  • Provide on-going support to monitoring and reporting efforts by facilities and COs, assist in developing, testing and maintaining assumptions and calculations to generate valuable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • In the context of UNDP’s Scope 3 Strategy, develop assessment methodologies, coordinate EMT programming and support data collection for project end-of-life waste impacts and support development of subsequent management guidance.

3. Provision of corporate recommendations and strategic alignment

  • Based on EMT data, consultations with Country Offices, and engagement with technical networks, develop evidence‑based recommendations for corporate‑level actions that improve waste management outcomes while reducing operational inefficiencies and avoidable costs.

  • Prepare briefing materials to support senior management endorsement and strategic decision‑making. Support the development and change management aspects of the Waste Management and Resource Efficiency Strategy.

4. Promote staff engagement

  • Guide and support the organization‑wide roll‑out of waste management initiatives through clear communications, consultations with Country Offices, and documentation of lessons learned.
  • Practical implementation, peer learning, and solutions that balance ambition with feasibility.
  • Organize and lead regular webinars and technical-level discussions. Provide bilateral helpdesk support to Country Offices, Regional Hubs and Headquarters as needed.

5. Support to the greening moonshot secretariat

  • Contribute to other Greening Moonshot activities as required, including coordination with procurement, facilities, IT, and programme teams to ensure alignment between operational sustainability objectives, efficiency gains, and UNDP’s broader climate and development commitments.
  • Apply a pragmatic, solutions‑oriented approach that strengthens UNDP’s leadership on sustainable operations while recognizing the diversity of operational contexts across regions and offices.

6. Facilitate knowledge and capacity building, knowledge sharing

  • Identify capacity building needs and opportunities.
  • Ensure appropriate training, project workshops and other relevant activities are organized and implemented in a consultative manner, involving technical experts and stakeholders that may include the government, private sector, NGOs, donors, and/or academia.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

The Waste Management Specialist will work under the guidance of the BMS and BPPS Moonshot Secretariat Managers and report directly to the Moonshot Secretariat Coordinator. The candidate will be responsible for the fulfilment of the duties and responsibilities specified above.

The incumbent will work from home and will be given access to relevant information necessary for execution of the tasks under this assignment. The incumbent will be responsible for providing his/her own working station (i.e., laptop, internet, phone, scanner/printer, etc.) and must have reliable internet connection. The incumbent will engage virtually with the supervisor and/or the team on a regular basis. Given the global scope of the work undertaken during this assignment, the incumbent is expected to be reasonably flexible with his/her availability taking into consideration different time zones.

Competencies

Core
Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact
Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems
Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences
Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands
Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results
Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration
Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

Cross-Functional & Technical competencies

External Relations and Advocacy Communication

Communicate in a clear, concise and

unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the

audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social

media and other appropriate channels

can impact on other parts of the system

specific goals

Business Management Working with Evidence and Data Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making
Business Development Knowledge Generation Ability to research information and to turn it into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need. Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. Knowledge of relevant concepts, conceptual models, and theories that can be useful in addressing new situations.
2030 Agenda: Planet Chemicals & Waste Hub Chemicals and Waste: Waste to Energy

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Environmental Management or Engineering is required. Or
A first-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:

Minimum of 5 years (with master’s degree) or 7 years (with bachelor’s degree) of professional experience working in the field of waste management and corporate environmental management is required.

Desired skills

• At least three years of work experience in UN operations with UNDP experience strongly desired.
• Experience in environmental monitoring systems desired.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and creatively is desirable
• Demonstrated ability to work in high pressure environments and with tight deadlines.

Required Language(s)

Fluency in English is required.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

title: Regional Program Building Director
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Regional Program Building Director for our Nashville, TN office location to work with our Southeast Property & Buildings Region.

This role will actively participate in the full project cycle with a focus on infrastructure evaluation and replacement work in such fields as healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, labs, and industrial manufacturing projects. Our Engineers work on high quality, high-profile, national and international projects with our practice providing design services for over 30 million square feet of medical facilities.

WSP is a global leader in the practice of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection engineering and related specialty services for the built environment. Our work is embedded in the residences we live in, the healthcare facilities we rely on for routine medical procedures to life saving feats of medicine, the skyscrapers and buildings we work in, and the operations of our buildings. At WSP, we are driven by inspiring the right people to be part of our future-focused business objectives. Our devotion to teamwork has allowed us to build communities and expand our skylines.

Here at WSP, anything is within our reach and yours as a WSP employee. Come join us and help shape the future!

  • Will be responsible for leading pursuits and supporting program / portfolio level management for infrastructure related projects.

title: Communications Specialist
description:
The Communications Specialist serves as a key member of the School of Music's marketing and communications operation. Reporting to the Marketing and Communications Manager, this position supports the development and execution of communications strategies that promote the School's academic programs, faculty, students, ensembles, performances, events, achievements and community engagement.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on communications professional with experience across multiple areas of content production. The position requires a working knowledge of photography, videography, graphic design, social media management, digital content creation, interviewing, editing and event logistics.

The Communications Specialist will be expected to work independently on assigned projects while collaborating closely with the Marketing and Communications Manager, faculty, staff, students and other University partners.

This position will also assist with the oversight of student Federal Work-Study employees, including assigning tasks, providing direction, reviewing work and helping students develop professional skills related to marketing and communications.

The successful candidate will bring creativity, initiative and strong organizational skills to the role and will help the School of Music achieve established marketing and communications goals and objectives.

Marketing & Communications

  • Assist the Marketing and Communications Manager with developing and executing integrated marketing and communications strategies.
  • Support marketing campaigns for concerts, performances, academic programs, recruitment initiatives, special events and School of Music programs.
  • Develop written content for websites, social media, email marketing, newsletters, promotional materials and other communications.
  • Assist with public relations and media outreach efforts.
  • Identify opportunities to promote faculty, students, alumni, ensembles, guest artists, performances, programs and School achievements.
  • Help maintain consistent messaging and branding across communications channels.
  • Assist the Marketing and Communications Manager in achieving departmental goals, campaign objectives and key performance indicators.

Social Media Management

  • Assist with managing the School of Music's social media accounts.
  • Develop and maintain social media content calendars.
  • Create, schedule and publish engaging content across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube.
  • Create social media graphics, reels, stories, short-form videos, photography and written content.
  • Monitor comments, messages and audience engagement.
  • Track social media performance and assist with reporting on reach, engagement and audience growth.
  • Stay current on social media trends and identify opportunities to increase the School's digital visibility.
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice across social media platforms.

Photography & Videography

  • Photograph concerts, performances, rehearsals, students, faculty, events and other School of Music activities.
  • Capture video content for social media, websites, marketing campaigns and promotional materials.
  • Plan and coordinate photo and video shoots.
  • Conduct interviews with faculty, students, alumni, guest artists and other members of the School community.
  • Develop interview questions and assist with visual storytelling.
  • Operate DSLR and mirrorless cameras, lighting, microphones and other production equipment.
  • Organize and maintain digital photography and video assets.

Graphic Design & Editing

  • Create marketing materials using Canva and/or Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Develop graphics for social media, digital advertising, email campaigns, websites, event promotions, signage and print materials.
  • Edit photography and video for digital and promotional use.
  • Utilize applications such as Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator and Premiere Pro as appropriate.
  • Create short-form video content for social media platforms.
  • Resize and adapt creative assets for various digital and print applications.
  • Ensure all creative materials are accurate, polished and consistent with School of Music branding.

Event & Project Support

  • Assist with communications and marketing needs for concerts, performances, recruitment events and special projects.
  • Coordinate photography, videography and social media coverage for events.
  • Assist with event-day communications and promotional activities.
  • Help coordinate schedules, timelines, content calendars and project deadlines.
  • Collaborate with faculty, staff, students, performers, vendors and University partners.
  • Provide occasional evening and weekend support for performances and special events.

Student Employee Oversight

  • Assist the Marketing and Communications Manager with overseeing student Federal Work-Study employees.
  • Assign daily tasks based on departmental priorities.
  • Provide training, direction and feedback to student employees.

title: Sairaanhoitaja Intensiivialueen sissi Lasten ja nuorten sairaudet
description:
Kiinnostaako sinua sairaanhoitajan työ lasten ja nuorten tulosyksikön Intensiivialueella?

Alueella hoidetaan eri erikoisalojen potilaita vastasyntyneistä nuoriin aikuisiin. Meillä on valtakunnallinen vastuu lasten sydänkirurgiasta sekä elinsiirroista ja toimimme lasten ECMO-keskuksena.

Haemme sairaanhoitajaa määräaikaiseen tehtävään sisäisten sijaisten yksikköön (SISSI) 21.12.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Intensiivisissien kiertoalueita ovat Uudessa Lasten Sairaalassa Lasten teho-osasto, Lasten leikkausosasto, Päiväkirurgian osasto, Naistenklinikalla Vastasyntyneiden teho-osasto Saari ja Jorvissa Vastasyntyneiden osasto 1B-C.

Mitä SISSi tekee?

SISSInä työskentelet vähintään kahdella osaamisalueella ja sinulla on mahdollisuus syventää osaamistasi missä tahansa intensiivialueen yksikössä.

Perehdytys ja kehittyminen

  • Saat henkilökohtaisesti räätälöidyn perehdytysohjelman opetushoitajien kanssa
  • Tarjoamme jatkuvaa koulutusta, jotta ammattitaitosi kehittyy ja pysyy

Miksi juuri meille?

  • Meillä on vahva erikoisosaaminen lastenhoitotyössä
  • Työyhteisömme tunnetaan hyvästä yhteishengestä
  • Työpäiväsi voivat olla vaativia – mutta et ole koskaan yksin
  • Eduksi katsotaan kokemus Intensiivialueen kiertoalueen hoitotyöstä.
  • Arvostamme työkokemusta lasten- ja nuortenhoitotyössä, itsenäistä työotetta, ja joustavaa asennetta. Sissin työssä vaaditaan myös hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä valmiutta työskennellä muuttuvissa tilanteissa.
  • Kiinnostus SISSI-yksikköön sitoutumisesta on toivottavaa.

Ketä haemme?

Palkka ja HUSin työsuhde-edut:

Työtehtävän mukainen peruspalkka SISSinä 3218,18 € alkaen, sekä asianmukaiset vuorolisät ja kokemuslisät kuuluvat palkaan.

  • ePassi: kulttuuri, liikunta ja työmatkat
  • Vuokrattavat loma-asunnot henkilöstölle
  • Alennuksia hyvinvointi- ja liikuntapalveluista
  • Tuettu työpaikkaruokailu
  • Työnohjaus

Uusissa työsuhteissa noudatamme kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa - hakemuksen lähettäminen on helppoa!

Haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään hakuajan loppuun mennessä! Haastatteluja pidämme jo hakuaikana.

Hae ja tule tekemään hoitotyöstä vaikuttavaa – potilas kerrallaan, sydämellä ja osaamisella.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu sairaanhoitaja.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevältä vaadittava rikosrekisterilain mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Yhteystiedot

Osastonhoitaja Kirsi Paavonen puh. 040 5232764 kirsi.paavonen@hus.fi

Ylihoitaja Anu Palmgren puh. 050 428 4712 anu.palmgren@hus.fi

Me yli 2000 lastentautien ammattilaista työskentelemme HUSissa päivittäin lasten ja nuorten parhaaksi. Hoidamme kaikkia pääkaupunkiseudun lasten erikoissairaanhoitoa vaativia sairauksia. Monien vaativien lastensairauksien hoito, esimerkiksi sydänkirurgia, elinsiirrot sekä vaikeiden syöpien hoito, on keskitetty Suomessa Uuteen lastensairaalaan.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Knowtex.ai

Technical Product Manager

LOCATION

San Francisco, CA (in office 3 days a week)

TRAVEL

Occasional customer site visits for product feedback and UX research (a few times a year)

REPORTS TO

Chief Technology Officer

EMPLOYMENT

Full-time, individual contributor

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Must be authorized to work in the U.S.; we are unable to sponsor visas for this role

COMPENSATION

$120,000 – $180,000 base salary, commensurate with experience, plus equity and comprehensive benefits

About Knowtex.ai

Knowtex is the first frontier AI lab for healthcare that is building AI to save human lives. We built an AI system that executes the most complex workflows in medicine and empowers clinicians with clinical intelligence capabilities, so every patient can receive the best care possible.

The Opportunity

We're hiring our second Technical Product Manager to own product releases and metrics end to end across the Knowtex application — spanning clinical intelligence, our web and mobile apps, backend, product analytics, and product marketing.

This is not a process-management role. We need someone who can read code, scope an API with an engineer, prototype a workflow in Claude Code or Cursor before lunch, and write the release notes and launch plan by end of day. You'll build the analytics foundation we use to understand adoption and usage, and you'll turn what clinicians tell us on site visits into prioritized, shipped work.

You'll report to the CTO and work alongside our existing TPM on a team of two, partnering closely with Engineering, Customer Delivery and Implementation, and leadership. It's outsized scope with direct access to the founders, on a product that's already in the hands of tens of thousands of clinicians.

What You'll Do

ROADMAP OWNERSHIP & DELIVERY 35%

  • Own the roadmap and execution for projects across the Knowtex application — clinical intelligence, web and mobile (iOS/Android), and backend

  • Write clear specs that engineers can build from directly, and manage delivery from scoping through release

  • Run standups and syncs with engineering, triage tickets, and keep priorities sharp as new information comes in

  • Review builds and QA releases, especially on mobile, before they reach clinicians

PRODUCT METRICS & ANALYTICS 25%

  • Define and instrument our product metrics, building the analytics foundation from the ground up: event taxonomy, tracking, and dashboards

  • Stand up adoption and usage reporting in Amplitude across clinical intelligence, application, and backend

  • Track and report core KPIs — adoption, active usage, note completion, and retention — and use them to drive roadmap decisions

  • Write SQL and dig into the data yourself rather than waiting on someone else to pull it

PROTOTYPING & DISCOVERY 15%

  • Use AI coding and design tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma, Claude Design) daily to prototype ideas quickly and test them before committing engineering time

  • Gather clinician feedback through customer site visits and user research, and turn what you hear into prioritized backlog items

  • Bring a working prototype, not just a slide, to product discussions

PRODUCT MARKETING & ENABLEMENT 20%

  • Partner on launches: launch plans, positioning, and go-to-market timing

  • Write release notes and customer-facing product updates

  • Build sales and customer enablement materials so Customer Delivery and Implementation are ready before rollout

  • Contribute to case studies and content that show the product's impact

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP 5%

  • Work with Customer Delivery, Implementation, and leadership to keep what clinicians experience and what we build tightly connected

  • Communicate product decisions clearly in writing, from one-page specs to company-wide updates

Who You Are

PRODUCT EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years as a PM or TPM shipping B2B SaaS, ideally including a mobile app (iOS/Android) in production

  • You've shipped things end to end — not just managed them — and can say "I" when you describe what you built

  • Breadth across a product, not a single narrow feature area

TECHNICAL FLUENCY

  • You can read code, scope APIs and integrations, and work directly with engineers without translation

  • Comfortable discussing architecture and data flows, and writing specs that engineers build from directly

  • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding and design tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma, Claude Design) to prototype quickly

DATA & ANALYTICS

  • Hands-on product analytics experience: defining event taxonomies, building dashboards in Amplitude (or Mixpanel/Heap), and writing SQL

  • You've owned metrics and can name specific ones you moved

  • You reach for data unprompted when making decisions

COMMUNICATION

  • Excellent writer — specs, release notes, and customer-facing product updates are core to this role

  • Clear and concise with engineers, clinicians, customers, and leadership alike

MINDSET

  • High ownership; thrives with ambiguity and owns outcomes without needing detailed direction

  • Energized by a fast-moving, ~25-person startup rather than a large PM org with heavy structure

  • Curious about clinicians and healthcare workflows, and motivated by reducing clinician burnout

  • A track record of picking up work beyond your job description — setting up analytics or writing launch copy because no one else did

Strongly preferred

  • Healthcare or health tech experience (EHR integrations, clinical workflows, HIPAA)

  • Product marketing experience: launch plans, positioning, sales enablement, case studies

  • Exposure to regulated or federal environments (FedRAMP, VA, Section 508/WCAG)

  • Experience running user research or UX studies with clinicians or other professional end users

  • A coding background or CS degree

Key Collaborations

Chief Technology Officer

Your manager and direct mentor; roadmap priorities, technical direction, and escalation point for product tradeoffs

Technical Product Manager

Your peer on a two-person product team; shared planning, coverage, and division of the roadmap across the application

Engineering

Daily partnership on scoping, specs, delivery, QA, and live issue triage

Customer Delivery & Implementation

Clinician feedback loops, release readiness, and the enablement materials that make launches land

Leadership & Founders

Direct access on product strategy, positioning, and the metrics that matter most to the business

Why Knowtex?

Mission that matters

Our product sits inside real-time clinical care. Every workflow you improve gives a clinician time back and makes a patient's documentation safer and more complete.

Already at scale

You'll ship to a deployment spanning hundreds of VA sites and tens of thousands of clinicians, plus a growing commercial base — with impact backed by peer-reviewed research.

Outsized scope

As one of only two TPMs, you'll own product and metrics end to end, with direct access to the founders and no layers between you and the decision.

AI-native ways of working

We're a frontier AI lab for healthcare, and we work like one: AI tooling is part of how you prototype, analyze, and ship every day.

Growth and training

Onboarding on our product, clinical documentation workflows, and customer base; HIPAA and security/compliance training (plus VA/federal training where relevant); shadowing implementations and site visits; and direct mentorship from the CTO.

Knowtex is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team that reflects the clinicians and patients we serve.

Vi söker dig som vill ta ansvar, för sitt team och uppdrag, är strukturerad och bidrar till ett gott samarbete. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, tar initiativ till förbättringar och arbetar säkerhetmedvetet. Du får stöd i din chefsroll, tillgång till ett starkt nätverk av kollegor och möjlighet att växa tillsammans med verksamheten. Tillsammans med ledningsgruppen bygger du en kultur som präglas av samarbete, delaktighet och långsiktig utveckling – där du som ledare är med och visar vägen.

Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning och avser dagtidsarbete med utgångspunkt i Värtaverket, Hjorthagen. Observera att tjänsten är av högre säkerhetsklass och kräver att du har svenskt medborgarskap.

Varför jobba med mig?

Jag värdesätter ett inkluderande ledarskap där alla känner sig sedda. Jag främjar en miljö som uppmuntrar nyfikenhet och ansvar. Jag ger konstruktiv feedback och firar framgångar. Min ledarstil balanserar effektivitet med hållbarhet och hjälper teamet att prioritera rätt.

Ebrahim Raoufi, chef Drift & Underhåll

Vem är du som person?

Alla som jobbar hos oss måste vara nyfikna, ta initiativ och ansvar. För just den här rollen finns några egenskaper som är extra viktiga:

  • Ledarskap: Du leder med passion och motiverar andra att nå gemensamma mål. Du samordnar team och skapar en atmosfär av engagemang och delaktighet.
  • Mål- och resultatorienterad: Ditt arbete präglas av tydliga mål och ett starkt fokus på att uppnå dem. Du prioriterar och agerar med mål och resultat i sikte.
  • Samarbetsförmåga: Du arbetar smidigt med andra och har lätt för att bygga relationer. Du lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.
  • Tydlig: Du kommunicerar tydligt och ser till att alla förstår vad som förväntas. Du följer upp och säkerställe att inger faller mellan stolarna.

Krav

  • Teknisk utbildning inom för rollen relevant inriktning eller motsvarande arbetserfarenhet.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete med el, automation eller annan närliggande teknikområde.
  • God kunskap inom dator- och affärssystem som t.ex. IFS.
  • God kommunikativ förmåga och kan uttrycka sig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
  • God systemvana.
  • God säkerhetsförståelse.

Nyfiken på oss eller våra anläggningar?

– Jag gör så himla mycket olika saker, men ett konkret exempel som jag är stolt över är vårt mentorprogram som vi startade upp år 2019, där våra kvinnliga ledare är mentorer för kvinnliga ingenjörsstudenter på KTH ... men jag jobbar också med hur vi ska ta vara på kompetens som vi redan har eller se med nya ögon på rekrytering. Ett annat av våra initiativ är exempelvis ett jobbspår till drifttekniker för nyanlända med teknikbakgrund, säger Sandra Rosén, chef taktisk drift.

Vi är fler kollegor som gärna vill ge en inblick i vårt arbete. https://www.stockholmexergi.se/jobba-hos-oss/traffa-dina-framtida-kollegor/

Två av våra anläggningar kan du dessutom besöka virtuellt. Gå in på https://web.tours/exergi-vartaverket/ eller https://www.stockholmexergi.se/virtuell-bristaverket Det fungerar i både dator och mobil.

Rekryteringsprocessen

  • Mer nyfiken på hur rekryteringsprocessen går till? https://www.stockholmexergi.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocess/

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 19 december. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tas tillvara. Vi jobbar enbart med inkluderande rekrytering och har en nolltolerans mot diskriminering på våra arbetsplatser. Oavsett religion, ålder, etnicitet. funktionsförutsättningar eller könstillhörighet är du en värdefull och respekterad medarbetare. Bra personer känner ofta bra personer – dela gärna annonsen om du har en vän som skulle älska det här jobbet!

title: Client Service Associate - Registered

title: Locate Investigator
description:
Magna Legal Services is a trusted nationwide partner to law firms, corporations, insurance carriers, and government agencies, delivering comprehensive legal support at every stage of a case. From court reporting and record retrieval to jury consulting, investigations, litigation graphics, and language services, we help our clients navigate complex legal challenges with confidence. Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.

Magna Legal Services is seeking an experienced Locate Investigator to join our Investigations team. This individual will conduct desktop-based investigations to locate individuals and verify relevant information for a variety of legal matters. The role will primarily support plaintiff and defense law firms, often in connection with service of process. This position requires availability to work a schedule aligned with Central Time business hours.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful and persistent investigator who can synthesize information from multiple sources, identify meaningful connections, and determine the most effective next steps. Success in this position requires sound judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.

Primary Responsibilities

    • Conduct comprehensive locate and skip-tracing investigations involving individuals who are missing, difficult to find, or attempting to avoid contact, including debtors, heirs, beneficiaries, witnesses, and other persons connected to legal matters.

    • Search and analyze public records, proprietary databases, social media, and other available sources to identify current addresses, contact information, employment details, associates, and other relevant information.

    • Conduct lawful investigative calls to obtain or verify information while adhering to company policies and applicable legal and ethical requirements.

    • Interview relatives, associates, neighbors, employers, and other individuals who may have relevant information.

    • Review and evaluate information from multiple sources to identify connections, resolve discrepancies, and develop actionable leads.

    • Document investigative findings clearly and accurately, maintaining organized case notes and supporting records.

    • Coordinate service-of-process activities with field investigators and process servers.

    • Provide timely case updates and communicate findings, challenges, and recommended next steps to internal team members.

    • Handle sensitive and confidential information with appropriate care and discretion.

Desired Background

    • Two to five years of relevant experience in investigations, skip tracing, service of process, or a related field.

    • Experience in law enforcement, a law firm, the court system, legal services, collections, or a professional investigative environment is strongly preferred.

    • Demonstrated ability to conduct detailed online research using public records, investigative databases, social media, and other research tools.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess information from multiple sources and develop effective investigative strategies.

    • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple active cases.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills; regular interaction with colleagues, field investigators, process servers, and third parties is a core function of the position.

    • High level of professionalism, persistence, discretion, and attention to detail.

    • Ability to work a schedule aligned with Central Time business hours.

    • Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Psychology, Communications, or a related field is preferred.

    • Bilingual capabilities are a plus.

Magna Legal Services provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Intern, Graphic Design
description:
What to Expect

Heron Power Electronics is building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to remove the bottlenecks holding back the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware—helping accelerate the electrification of everything.

Our first focus goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.

We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.

Job Overview

We believe great design is an important part of building great technology. Heron is more than the machines we build. It is also our spaces, graphics, photography, events, apparel, website, documentation, and all the small details that shape how people experience the company.

We’re building that identity now.

As a Graphic Design Intern, you’ll work closely with Heron leadership to help develop and bring the Heron brand to life across a wide range of projects. You’ll have the opportunity to work on real things that get made, printed, installed, worn, shared, and used.

This is a hands-on role for someone with strong visual instincts who is excited about building a brand—not just maintaining one.

What You’ll Work On

Your projects could include:

  • Developing graphics, layouts, typography, illustrations, icons, diagrams, and other elements of Heron’s visual language.

  • Creating environmental graphics, signage, wayfinding, and visual moments throughout our offices and factory.

  • Designing apparel, swag, stickers, packaging, and other physical brand objects.

  • Supporting the design of presentations, recruiting materials, technical graphics, social content, and company communications.

  • Helping develop graphics and experiences for events, product launches, factory tours, and trade shows.

  • Exploring ways to make complex engineering and energy concepts visually clear, compelling, and approachable.

  • Building and extending templates, graphic systems, and brand tools that help Heron communicate consistently.

  • Working with printers, fabricators, vendors, and other partners to turn designs into real things.

  • Pitching ideas. Making things. Trying things. Helping us discover what the Heron brand can become.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for a designer with strong graphic design fundamentals, good taste, curiosity, high level of craft both digitally and physically, and a desire to make things.

You don’t need to know how to do everything on day one. We care about how you think, what you notice, the quality of your work, and how excited you are to make cool stuff.

Must-Haves

  • Currently studying or recently graduated from a graphic design, communication design, visual design, or related program—or an exceptional portfolio demonstrating equivalent ability.

  • A portfolio showing strong visual thinking and craft.

  • Strong fundamentals in typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, color, and image-making.

  • Comfort working in tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign and/or Figma, etc.

  • Interest in brand identity and how a visual system extends across many different mediums.

  • A willingness to move between big ideas and small details.

  • Curiosity, low ego, initiative, and enthusiasm for working with people from different disciplines.

  • Heart. We are rebuilding the American grid and laying the foundation for more abundant, efficient, sustainable energy. That should mean something to you.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience or interest in environmental graphics, signage, or wayfinding.

  • Illustration, photography, motion, animation, gen-AI tools, or 3D skills.

  • Experience designing apparel, merchandise, packaging, or other physical objects.

  • Interest in industrial design, architecture, manufacturing, engineering, or technology.

  • Experience preparing artwork for print/manufacture or working with fabricators and vendors.

  • An instinct for finding the fun, unexpected, or memorable expression of a brand.

This is a chance to help build the visual world of a young technology company from the ground up. One day you might be designing a graphic for the factory wall, the next a technical diagram, a T-shirt, an event experience, or something we haven’t thought of yet.

If you’re a young designer with great visual instincts who wants to make a lot of real things—and help define what a new American engineering company looks and feels like—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Lead Aviation Project Manager
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is proactively building its Aviation PM/CM team to support anticipated airport and airline opportunities, with an initial focus on Texas and Louisiana. We are seeking an experienced Lead Aviation Project Manager who can serve in key project leadership roles as future assignments develop.

The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading complex capital projects, multidisciplinary teams, and client relationships, along with the flexibility and mobility to support assignments in different locations across the United States. This individual will help establish project delivery strategies, organize and lead teams, manage project performance, and support pursuits for future airport and airline assignments.

Aviation experience is strongly preferred; however, candidates with significant transportation or complex infrastructure experience and demonstrated transferable project leadership skills will also be considered.

Your Impact

  • Serve in lead project management roles on future airport and airline assignments, with an initial focus on opportunities in Texas and Louisiana.
  • Establish project delivery strategies and lead multidisciplinary teams through planning, design, construction, commissioning, closeout, or other phases based on assignment requirements.
  • Lead owner-side program management, project management, and construction management assignments as required by future opportunities.
  • Develop and manage project scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, risk strategies, and delivery plans.
  • Monitor project performance and provide clear reporting on schedule, budget, quality, risk, changes, and key delivery milestones.
  • Coordinate with airport authorities, airlines, contractors, consultants, regulatory agencies, and other project stakeholders.
  • Facilitate project meetings and maintain effective communication with clients, project teams, and senior leadership.
  • Manage project financial performance, resource utilization, contracts, change management, and project controls.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities and support quality management of project deliverables.
  • Identify project risks and lead resolution of technical, operational, commercial, and stakeholder issues.
  • Support aviation pursuits, proposals, interviews, staffing strategies, and development of project delivery approaches.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the growth of WSP's Aviation practice.
  • Mentor project managers and other staff and support development of high-performing project teams.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Aviation Management, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of professional experience managing complex infrastructure, transportation, aviation, airport development, or capital improvement projects.
  • Demonstrated experience serving in lead project management roles on significant capital projects.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary projects and project teams.
  • Experience managing projects through design and/or construction.
  • Experience managing scope, schedule, budget, contracts, risk, staffing, change, and client relationships.
  • Strong understanding of project controls, risk management, change management, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ability to understand and manage technical and project delivery requirements across multiple disciplines.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and client-facing communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with clients, contractors, consultants, regulatory agencies, and internal teams.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively and support project assignments in different locations across the United States, including temporary or longer-term assignments based on project needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Aviation or airport capital project experience.
  • Experience with airport program management, project management, and/or construction management.
  • Knowledge of FAA requirements, airport design standards, and aviation project delivery processes.
  • Experience supporting Airport Capital Improvement Programs (ACIP).
  • Experience with airfield, terminal, landside, roadway, utility, facilities, or other complex airport infrastructure.
  • Experience working with major hub, medium-hub, or commercial service airports.
  • Familiarity with FAA grant processes and airport funding programs.
  • Established professional relationships within the Texas and/or Louisiana aviation market.
  • Active participation in AAAE, ACC, ASCE, SAME, or other relevant aviation and infrastructure industry organizations.

title: Loss Prevention Officer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Patrol all areas of the property; assist guests with room access. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions, perimeter alarm system, duress alarms, and fire life safety system. Lock property entrances when required. Conduct daily physical hazard inspections. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Notify appropriate individuals in the event of accidents, attacks, or other incidents. Defuse guest/employee disturbances. Call for outside assistance if necessary. Complete incident reports to document all Security/Loss Prevention related incidents. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Resolve safety hazard situations. Escort any unwelcome persons from the property without interrupting the orderly flow of property operation. Report to scenes of vehicle accidents/thefts. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Complete a Loss Prevention shift summary/daily activity report. Maintain confidentiality of all Security/Loss Prevention and property reports/documents; release information only to authorized individuals. Conduct investigations and gather evidence. Conduct interviews with relevant parties.

Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely.
