title: PIM Coordinator
description:
The preferred candidate will reside in and work remotely in CO, MN, NV, or PA.

ABOUT WORKSTAND:

Workstand provides commerce software, marketing services, and data solutions to help independent bicycle retailers and suppliers achieve profitable growth. Workstand isn’t your typical software company or your typical bike industry company. We are a privately owned small business serving an important niche, striving for mutual success and sustainability for every retailer and supplier in the cycling industry.

Workstand has been voted one of Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work for six years. We offer fully remote work with an engaging culture, compelling work, and strategic clarity. All clients are in the bicycle industry, so work days are fun and interesting. We support one another and achieve our goals as a team. Each person, at every level, has an impact.

Total Rewards and Perks include; fully remote work environment, flexible scheduling, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision packages for employees and eligible family members, 401(k) plan with employer match, paid volunteering, paid professional development, and discounts on products, bikes, and gear. We offer an accrued PTO program of 14 days in your first year as well as sick time and ten paid holidays. Employees are eligible for bonuses.

JOB PURPOSE:

The Catalog team is responsible for procuring and ingesting product data to build and maintain a comprehensive product catalog for our merchants’ Workstand website and in-store systems. The PIM Coordinator role is primarily responsible for standardizing and enriching raw product data for ingestion and refinement in our PIM. A key focus of this position is supporting the on-going modernization of our tools and workflows by leveraging AI; proposing new technical solutions; and suggesting data structure, product page, and process improvements to improve efficiency and impact of data. Other responsibilities include communicating with client-facing teams and executing ongoing catalog maintenance projects.

REPORTING STRUCTURE:

This position is a part of the Catalog Team and reports to the Catalog Manager and has no direct reports. This is a remote position.

JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Clean, import, and enrich product data into our PIM.

  • Implement and oversee automatic processes to bulk consume data into our PIM.

  • Maintain product data integrity and adhere to Workstand data governance standards.

  • Leverage AI/ML and other tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy of data ingestion.

  • Identify points of friction in team workflows, and/or propose technical solutions to continue on-going modernization of team processes.

  • Execute PIM configuration tasks to support data model improvements.

  • Collaborate with client-facing teams to resolve product listing discrepancies, fulfill one-off merchant requests, and communicate insight on ticket status and/or team process.

  • Provide timely progress updates and communicate blockers with teammates in appropriate channels.

  • Contribute to ongoing data hygiene projects.

  • Proof product data enriched by colleagues and provide constructive feedback.

  • Assist in the maintenance of team workflow documentation.

  • Quickly move from one task to another in response to changing priorities.

This is not a comprehensive list of possible responsibilities, tasks and duties. There are a variety of other duties that will need to be completed on an as needed basis.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cycling (or other outdoor industry) and tech industry experience is preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Excel and Google Workplace suite required

  • Experience with a PIM preferred

  • Experience with a CRM preferred

  • Experience with GenerativeAI preferred

  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills

  • Highly detail-oriented

  • Flexible and able to respond quickly to changes

  • Organized and proficient at managing competing priorities

  • Understands, interprets, and implements feedback effectively

  • Provides feedback effectively

  • Experimental mindset and a willingness to “fail” encouraged

  • Self-motivated with a positive attitude toward work

  • Hard-working, creative, and eager to learn

Limited domestic travel may be a requirement.

We seek talent from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic and best selves to work. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Workstand approaches pay in an ethical and transparent way. Pay ranges are assigned to a job based on market data from 3rd party salary benchmark data as well as balancing internal equity of other roles with similar levels of responsibility. Individual pay within the range can vary for several reasons including, but not limited to, skills, abilities, experience, tenure, performance, and available budget.

Employment Type: Part-Time

Department: Clinical

Our Mission:

Make a real impact. Build real skills. Grow with us.

At Positive Development, we believe every child deserves the chance to grow, learn, and thrive and every burgeoning professional deserves meaningful work that builds real skills for the future.

We work one-on-one with autistic children, helping them build communication, social, and daily living skills through play-based, relationship-focused interactions.

This isn’t a passive “observe and assist” job. You’ll be actively coaching, connecting, and helping children grow; while gaining experience that’s highly relevant for careers in:

  • Psychology

  • Social Work

  • Occupational Therapy

  • Speech Language Pathology

  • Education and Special Education

  • Counseling

  • Medicine and Health

This work is deeply rewarding, but it requires patience, emotional maturity, and commitment. You’ll be supported every step of the way by experienced clinicians and supervisors who are invested in your growth.

We’re especially excited to meet candidates who are:

  • Passionate about working with children and teens

  • Curious about human development and learning

  • Patient, empathetic, and enthusiastic

  • Reliable and committed to a consistent schedule (kids depend on consistency!)

  • Comfortable working directly with families in home-based setting

Great fits include:
Education majors, psychology students, pre-meds, nursing students, OT/SLP hopefuls, behavior technicians, camp counselors, teacher’s assistants, childcare providers, direct support professionals, and caregivers.

You'll work one-on-one with children in their homes and/or center based to:

  • Build communication, social, and daily living skills through play, conversation, and shared activities

  • Create meaningful connections that help children think, create, and engage with the world

  • Follow a relationship-based intervention model designed to achieve strong outcomes with fewer session hours

  • Track progress by documenting session notes and goal outcomes

  • Collaborate closely with clinicians and supervisors to build clinical skills and confidence

o Playing on the floor/ground for up to two-three hours per session

o Sitting, kneeling, crouching, or moving quickly to ensure child safety

  • Strong communication skills and professionalism with families and teammates

Training, growth, and career development:

title: Software Engineer- Inference Performance
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We're looking for inference performance engineers who want to make the world's most demanding AI workloads run faster and more efficiently. You'll work across the stack, from the inference engine and runtime through scheduling, serving, and routing. Along the way you'll apply techniques like prefill/decode disaggregation, speculative decoding, and KV-cache management. You'll reason from first principles about where time and memory go, find what's holding performance back, and close the gap. Your work directly impacts how fast our customers' models run and how efficiently we serve them. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to make significant contributions to the exciting field of LLM inference.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

You'll get to work on these types of projects as an Inference Performance engineer:

  • Agentic Kernels in Production

  • How we built the new fastest API for GLM-5.2

  • Live draft model training for speculative decoding

  • Making Kimi K3 Tokenization 18x faster

  • The Baseten Inference Stack

  • Driving model performance optimization


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement and productionize cutting-edge inference techniques, working deep in runtime internals. That includes quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, chunked prefill, LoRA, guided generation for structured outputs, and custom scheduling and routing algorithms.

  • Profile and optimize inference end to end, from kernel launch overhead and memory layout up to request scheduling, prefill/decode disaggregation, and cache-aware routing. Run cross-layer investigations, such as tracing a tail-latency regression from request timing through routing and batching down to a kernel.

  • Turn performance into cost savings. Improve tokens per GPU-hour, raise utilization, and give customers and internal teams clear latency/throughput/cost tradeoffs.

  • Bring up and tune new model architectures on new hardware quickly, often in the same week they're released.

  • Build benchmarking frameworks that measure real-world performance across model architectures, batch sizes, sequence lengths, and hardware configurations.

  • Contribute upstream to open-source inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), and partner closely with model, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to ship wins.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

  • Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages, such as Python or C++.

  • Familiarity with LLM optimization techniques (e.g., quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching).

  • Strong familiarity with ML libraries, especially PyTorch, TensorRT, or TensorRT-LLM.

  • Demonstrated interest and experience in LLMs.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Proficiency in enhancing the performance of software systems, particularly in the context of large language models (LLMs)

  • Contributed to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or another inference engine.

  • Worked on large-scale distributed serving: autoscaling, load balancing, multi-region or multi-cloud capacity.

  • Written or optimized GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or similar)

  • Worked on quantization (FP8/FP4, AWQ, GPTQ) or speculative decoding in production.

  • Deep understanding of software engineering principles and a proven track record of developing and deploying AI/ML inference solutions.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

  • (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

title: Deputy Project Manager
description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Deputy Project Manager for a rail transportation project in the New York City region.

The Deputy Project Manager supports the Project Manager in the day‑to‑day technical, commercial, and coordination activities required to successfully deliver a complex design‑build transportation project. This role acts as a key integrator between engineering disciplines, construction, testing & commissioning, safety, quality, and the client, ensuring that scope, schedule, cost, and contractual obligations are met throughout the project lifecycle.

Your Impact

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Coordination

  • Support the Project Manager in overall project execution, planning, and reporting across design, installation, testing, and commissioning phases.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams (signaling, communications, track, traction power, systems engineering) to confirm alignment with contract scope and interfaces.

  • Track progress against schedule and milestones, identify risks and issues, and support mitigation planning.

  • Prepare inputs for internal and client progress meetings, dashboards, and executive reviews.

Project Controls & Performance Monitoring

  • Support implementation of Project Controls Plan, including:

    • Schedule control and progress measurement

    • Cost tracking, forecasting, and burn rate monitoring

    • KPI development and performance oversight

  • Review and challenge Design‑Builder schedule updates, productivity assumptions, and recovery plans.

  • Support earned value / progress measurement where applicable.

  • Track early warning indicators to proactively identify delays or cost risks (aligned with PMC performance oversight expectations

Technical Oversight & Systems Integration

  • Support systems engineering activities, including requirements management, design reviews, and technical stage gate readiness.

  • Confirm design deliverables are consistent with contract requirements, applicable standards, and approved concepts of operations.

  • Assist in managing technical interfaces between subsystems and external stakeholders.

Construction, Installation, Testing & Commissioning

  • Coordinate with construction and installation teams to confirm engineering intent is correctly implemented in the field.

  • Support planning and execution of installation, testing, cutover, and commissioning activities, including review of procedures and reports.

  • Track and help resolve field issues, NCRs, and technical clarifications in coordination with engineering and quality teams.

Commercial & Contract Management

  • Support change management, variation evaluation, and claims analysis.

  • Assist in review and validation of:

    • Payment applications

    • Change orders / equitable adjustments

    • Contractor correspondence

  • Confirm all actions align strictly with contract requirements rather than informal agreements.

  • Oversight of logs maintained by PMC:

    • RFIs

    • Submittals

    • Changes / NOCs

  • Support independent cost estimating and negotiation preparation (where required).

Safety, Quality & Compliance

Confirm compliance with:

  • System Safety Certification process - Quality Management Plan; Environmental and regulatory requirements

  • Support audits, readiness reviews, and certification milestones.

  • Verify Design‑Builder adherence to approved procedures and standards.

Stakeholder & Governance Interface

  • Interface with:

    • MTA C&D leadership

    • NYCT operations (Service Delivery, OCC)

    • Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs)

  • Support preparation for executive-level briefings and decision forums.

  • Maintain clear and professional communication aligned with PMC’s role as owner’s representative.

Document Control & Reporting

  • Confirm all project documentation is: Properly tracked, reviewed, approved, and archived; Aligned with Document Control Plan requirements.

  • Oversee completeness of:

    • Submittals

    • Technical deliverables;

    • Close-out documentation

  • Support traceability across requirements, design, and testing artifacts.

  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (electrical, systems, civil, mechanical, or related discipline), architecture, or Business Administration or Project Management or equivalent.

  • Minimum of 7–10 years of experience on large mission critical infrastructure or rail projects, preferably in a design‑build environment. Preferably rail transportation and/or CBTC projects or projects that involve complex system integration. Experience with rail systems, signaling, CBTC, communications, or complex systems integration is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting project management functions on multidisciplinary engineering projects.

  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to interface between engineering and project management.

  • Solid understanding of project delivery and lifecycle management.

  • Excellent coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, safety‑critical environment.

  • Proficient in project reporting tools, document control systems, and standard engineering software.

  • Exposure to AI and AI tools (such as AI agents) for Project Management / delivery of projects

  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Reporting Relationship

  • Reports to: Project Manager/ Program Director

  • Acts as delegate for the Project Manager when required.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation

Expected Salary Range: $122,700- $182,200

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

title: Staff / Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AV Core
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Team

The Core Model Safety team builds foundational capabilities for assisted and automated driving - collision avoidance, model understanding, and robustness under failure. You'll work in a focused, high-impact senior team with strong ownership, access to large-scale training and fleet data, and close partners in research, simulation, evaluation, and applied engineering.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer in Wayve's AV Core organization, you will lead the technical direction and delivery of learned emergency manoeuvre prediction and collision detection models. Emergency manoeuvres are rare, high-consequence events that place unusual demands on data, modelling, and validation. You'll take the programme from problem definition through modelling, evaluation, integration, and evidence for deployment.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Drive Core Model Safety roadmap themes, owning the full lifecycle from research to offline/online experiments to technology transfer.

  • Train and deploy end-to-end AV 2.0 models for emergency manoeuvre prediction and collision detection on our global fleet, using large-scale, diverse data to validate capabilities and improve generalisation across vehicles, markets, and driving conditions.

  • Collaborate on online occupancy models for geometric and semantic perception.

  • Build high-value open-loop and closed-loop evaluations for core capabilities and representation learning.

  • Align priorities and learn from the organisation — with AV Core, Evaluation, and Product Engineering on roadmaps and failure modes; from fleet, simulation, and product feedback; and through mentoring others on the team.

  • Maintain awareness of the wider business context — division and company priorities, near-term product programmes, and how Core Model Safety work enables them.

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

  • You have a strong track record of ML engineering, including pathfinding in ambiguous problems — from scoping and evals to establishing a direction (and knowledge transfer) for others to build on.

  • You have hands-on experience with ML systems deployed in the real world.

  • You're proficient in Python and PyTorch, with strong software engineering practices and hands-on experience building reliable machine learning training and evaluation systems.

  • You have excellent experimental judgement: able to turn an ambiguous behavioral problem into falsifiable hypotheses, useful metrics, disciplined ablations, and clear technical decisions.

  • You bring senior-level ownership and collaboration: able to lead a substantial technical area, work across research and engineering boundaries, and bring others along through clear written and verbal communication.

Desirable

  • Prior experience in autonomous vehicles or robotics with hands-on deployment and closed-loop validation on physical systems.

  • Experience in 3D scene understanding and representation learning for geometric and semantic perception, large-scale semantic enrichments.

  • Experience mining, generating, or evaluating rare events using simulation and fleet or heterogeneous real-world data.

  • Experience with transformer-based and multimodal architectures, including vision-language models (VLM), vision-language-action models (VLA), or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in C++, CUDA, distributed training, or performance optimization for production machine learning systems.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen [30 mins]

  • Competency Interviews [hiring manager interview and applied ML interview; 2 hours total]

  • Deep-dive technical interviews [programming, systems design, PyTorch debugging/ technical leadership interviews; 3 hours total]

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment [Director or VP interview; 45 mins].

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Lead Product Manager, Compliance Audit
description:

Who We Are:
NCC has led the automotive industry for over 30 years, providing award-winning software, credit and compliance solutions, and cutting-edge data. Our solutions help dealerships streamline operations, improve finance and insurance (F&I) processes, and drive profitability. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a high-growth environment.

Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Lead Product Manager to own Compliance Audit, an AI-powered automated auditing platform that reviews a complete retail deal jacket in 30 seconds, replacing a manual process and cutting processing time by roughly 95%. The product extracts and maps data across 100+ automotive form types and tests every deal against 200+ programmed compliance rules, catching data anomalies, verifying fair lending markups, flagging missing signatures, and enforcing FTC Used Car Rule disclosures before a deal is submitted to a lender.

You will own an identified $18.5M SOM opportunity across roughly 3,079 dealer rooftops, sitting inside NCC's Credit, Compliance & Fraud pillar alongside Real-Time Compliance AI, Data Hygiene, and Lender Handshake. This is a high-impact role for a product leader who thrives on regulatory nuance, AI-native product delivery, and protecting dealers from compliance exposure without slowing down the deal.

What You’ll Do:
Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Own the roadmap for Compliance Audit, including the standalone document-upload path and integration into the broader deal workflow.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance to evaluate new FTC, fair-lending, and disclosure guidance and translate it into product requirements ahead of enforcement.
  • Define success metrics for audit turnaround time, rule coverage, and compliance exception rate.
  • Own compliance sign-off and audit-readiness for every Compliance Audit release.
Discovery & Delivery
  • Conduct dealer and compliance-officer interviews to surface gaps in the current 200+ rule set and new document types to support.
  • Write clear specs and acceptance criteria for the dedicated CCF Engineering Pod.
  • Partner with Data Science on the machine learning and document-recognition models that extract and map deal jacket data.
  • Own launch readiness, including compliance sign-off, support documentation, and dealer-facing training.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner with the Real-Time Compliance AI and Lender Handshake product managers to keep compliance logic consistent across the platform rather than duplicated per product.
  • Represent Compliance Audit's compliance posture and roadmap to executive leadership and, where needed, to lender and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Continuously assess regulatory, technical, and adoption risk, and recommend pivots or course corrections as needed.

What You’ll Have:
Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (MBA preferred).
  • 5-8 years of product management experience, with direct experience in compliance automation, audit workflows, or regulated lending products.
  • Hands-on experience with the FTC Used Car Rule, fair lending, and disclosure compliance requirements.
  • Experience building AI-native products where AI is the core value proposition, not a bolt-on feature.
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable with SQL, dashboards, and product analytics tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate regulatory requirements into clear, testable product specs.
Preferred
  • Experience in automotive retail technology, dealer software, or closely adjacent regulated fintech/lending.
  • Familiarity with document recognition/extraction ML models and deal-jacket or contract-review workflows.
  • Background working directly with F&I compliance officers, DMS providers, or lender integrations.

What We Offer:

  • Unrestricted PTO
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Professional development opportunities and continuous training.
  • A supportive and dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth and advancement.

title: Safety and Health Specialist
description:
This is an exciting time to join the corporate office of Express Employment International. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Underwriting Supervisor & Safety and Health Specialists to coordinate and support safety and health initiatives. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to franchise locations, providing expert guidance on safety-related matters and handling complex inbound underwriting inquiries, particularly those related to code and rate issues.

You will also lead the development, implementation, and oversight of programs aimed at minimizing risk and ensuring compliance with safety, health, and environmental regulations. Key responsibilities include conducting risk analyses, performing safety audits, delivering training sessions, and ensuring alignment with company policies as well as state and federal regulations. This role plays a critical part in reducing potential losses and fostering a proactive safety culture across the organization through strategic cross-department collaboration.

Express Employment International believes in the value of in-person collaboration to support teamwork, creativity and connection. Employees in this position are expected to work a four (4) day in-office schedule, with the flexibility to work remotely one (1) day each week, based on business and department needs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Safety and health programs: Administers safety and health programs through the guidance of the Health & Safety Program Manager incorporating a proactive approach to safety and health, educational training to franchises and reinforcement of implementation at franchise level, sometimes in person on location.
  • Underwriting: Administers underwriting activities including taking referral underwriting calls, collecting and organizing information to maintain the risk guidelines for underwriting, and analyzing workers’ compensation coding to determine proper code use and if action is needed.
  • Regulatory compliance and communication: Stay updated on relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to safety and health. Ensure that the organization remains compliant with all applicable safety regulations. Liaise with regulatory agencies during inspections and audits. Serve as a subject matter expert on safety and health matters during corporate meetings and strategy sessions. Communicate safety initiatives and updates to senior management. Delivers information to franchises and assists with the implementation of any changes.
  • Incident investigation and OSHA reporting: Work with franchises to ensure investigations are conducted into workplace incidents, accidents, and near-misses to determine root causes and confirm preventive measures. Maintain detailed reports of incidents, including documentation of hazard mitigation. Advise franchises of OSHA reporting requirements, including reporting a fatality or severe injury. Collaborate with Legal and Workers Compensation departments on OSHA issues.
  • Audits and inspections: Perform regular safety audits and inspections across various departments to ensure compliance with safety standards and regulations. Identify areas for improvement and recommend corrective actions. Monitor the implementation of corrective actions to ensure timely resolution of issues. title: Property Claims Examiner III
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Claims Examiner III processes insurance claims for property losses based on coverage, appraisal, and verifiable damage. They interact with independent adjusters and policy holders, review claim forms and other records to determine insurance coverage. This person will make payment recommendations and settlements in accordance with company practices, procedures, and Fair Claims Settlement Practices regulations.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Investigate, evaluate, and resolve claims, applying technical knowledge and human relations skills to promote fair and prompt settlement of claims.
• Adjust reserves and provide reserve recommendations to ensure reserving activities are consistent with company policies.
• Enter claim transactions, in a clear and concise manner.
• Examine claims inspected by independent adjusters, including further investigation of questionable claims, verification of coverage, and timely issuance of payments to policyholders.
• Conduct daily diary reviews on claim files to ensure status letters are sent to policyholders in accordance with Department of Insurance regulations.
• Pay and process claims within designated authority level.
• Supervise independent adjusters to ensure adherence to CFP IA Guidelines.
• Maintain compliance with the Department of Insurance and Company policy and procedures.
• Create correspondence to policyholders that is accurate and complete. Communicate with insureds and/or others involved to secure missing information.
• Promptly negotiate settlements, making sure that the settlement reflects the actual insured losses while ensuring that the insurer is protected from invalid claims.
• Confer with Claims Management and legal counsel on claims involving litigation.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Claims Examiner III: This role may include handling the entire claim (except inspection), or may be responsible for specific coverage, such as Personal Property or Fair Rental Value. This role will focus on claims over $300,000 in damages, but the Claims Examiner III may receive smaller claims when necessary.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
• Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Working experience with MS-Office (especially Word and Excel) is required.
• 2 + years property claims experience and excellent customer service.
• Certified in CEA and Fair Claims Settlement Practices.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS (PRIOR EXPERIENCE)
Claims Examiner III: 5 years total claims experience, 2 years handling HO claims over $300,000.
2 Years Carrier experience required.

Salary: $90,000-$100,000

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Nuclear Reactor Engineering and Safety - UTK
description:
This position involves computational research on nuclear power plant operation, design, and safety. Focusing on flexible operation of nuclear energy by improving integration with other energy sources, including advancing the technology readiness of control capable of dividing thermal and electrical power to support electricity grids while increasing plant revenue.

The successful candidate will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, and partners like other universities and National Laboratories to support nuclear engineering programs. The appointment would be a limited term appointment, approximately 1 year with the possibility of renewal for future years. The end goal after the appointment would be for you to secure a permanent position that is compatible with your interest.

Development and evaluation of models for nuclear power plants and systems using open information. The work includes developing and applying general and plant-specific light water computational tools that can be used to help design, test, and optimize dynamic thermal energy extraction and delivery and electricity dispatch. This includes normal operation, anticipated operational occurrences, and accident scenarios. Work with multi-disciplinary teams to apply modeling and simulation techniques for flexible operation of nuclear power plants. Publishing papers in high-quality refereed journals. Actively collaborating with industry, academia, government labs, and applications developers in a variety of venues.

Required Qualifications: Position requires a Ph.D. degree in Nuclear Engineering, or an equivalent field. A well-established track record of research in nuclear engineering.

Preferred Qualifications: Programming experience for workflow development, scientific computing, and data analysis and visualization. Excellent interpersonal skills, oral and written communication skills. Motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and to participate creatively in collaborative teams across the laboratory. Ability to function well in a fast-paced research environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to ever changing needs.

Work Location

  • Location: Knoxville, TN

  • Onsite

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $70,000 - $75,000
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

Interested candidates should submit and online application with the follow materials:

  • A letter of interest

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Contact information for three professional references

For questions or inquiries please contact Prof. Brown, email: nbrown49@utk.edu.

Review of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. The best application date is October 23, 2026.

About The Department

The Department of Nuclear Engineering at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, established in 1957, was the first of its kind and is considered one of the most prestigious in the United States. Its mission is supported by internationally recognized faculty and advanced research programs, enhanced by close ties with institutions such as Oak Ridge National Laboratory, the Y-12 Nuclear Security Complex, UCOR, and the East Tennessee Technology Park, as well as over one hundred nuclear-related companies within fifty miles of Knoxville. The department offers programs, with its graduate program consistently ranked among the top in the nation by U.S. News and World Report.

title: Service & Delivery Technician III
description:
Service & Delivery Technician III

About the company

Albertsons Companies is at the forefront of the revolution in retail. With a fixation on raising the bar with innovation and building belonging through our culture, our team is rallying our company around a unique purpose: to create joy around each table and inspire a healthier tomorrow for every community.

Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with over 2,200 stores in 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners include Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw's, Acme, Tom Thumb, Randalls, United Supermarkets, Pavilions, Star Market, Haggen, Carrs, Kings Food Markets, and Balducci's Food Lovers Market. We support our stores with 22 distribution centers and 19 manufacturing plants.

Bring your flavor

Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.

What you will be doing

As a Service & Delivery Technician I, you will be supporting our stores throughout Oregon and SW Washington, with an emphasis on Salem south and Eastern Oregon regions. There will be times when you will need to support stores further, which at times will require overnight stays.

In this role, you will be helping with projects ranging from our quarterly IT deployments to remodels that require IT components to get updated and or re-installed.

Main responsibilities

  • Support standard hardware platforms and systems installed throughout Safeway retail stores and district offices.
  • Installation of new hardware and software components, such as desktops, iPads, servers, UPS battery backup’s, self-checkout’s, printers, scanner scales, counter scales, and network equipment.
  • Maintain equipment inventory controls and policies.
  • Travel will be required to store locations for installations, at times requiring overnight stays.
  • Installation schedules can vary by deployment, including some which occur overnight.

What we are searching for

We believe the successful candidate has these qualifications and experience:

  • High school graduate, AA/AS/BA/BS degree preferred or 1+ year's technical/training/hardware certifications preferred.
  • 1+ years’ retail business experience preferred.
  • 1+ years’ experience with retail store systems, technology systems and hardware preferred.
  • 1+ years’ experience with installation and configuration of desktop and peripheral technology preferred.
  • Excellent telephone, customer service and problem-solving skills with the ability to gather important information to resolve issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively present technical information and tailor responses for customer understanding.
  • Working knowledge of IT hardware, installation models, Windows, MS Office, and related applications.
  • iOS and Android knowledge.
  • Self-checkout experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow written/verbal instructions, define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and be a strong collaborative partner in a matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn beyond formal training with a strong aptitude for delivering quality products under minimal supervision.
  • Understanding of how hardware/software systems inter-relate.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds of equipment, some twisting and turning with equipment installs.
  • Must have a good, safe driving record. Must have a vehicle.
  • Solid mechanical skills.
  • Flexibility to work a variety of shifts, day, evening and overnight. This role is primarily scheduled M-F, however, at times Sunday evenings may be required.
  • Strong sense of urgency, business ethics, dependability and follow through.

What is it like at Albertsons?

Our 290,000 associates have a passion for great service and building lasting relationships with our customers. Through a companywide focus on innovation, we are continually enhancing our digital and product offerings, making it easy for customers to get what they need, wherever they are.

The Associate Director, Proposal Development and Review, leads the institutional proposal review and submission. The position supervises the Research Administrator ladder, allocates the proposal portfolio by complexity rather than by availability, and holds delegated institutional approval authority for submission within the threshold set by the Authorized Organizational Representative. The Associate Director is accountable for submission timeliness, for the quality and consistency of institutional review, and for the working relationship between this office and college and department research administrators who prepare proposals.

  1. Exercises delegated authority to approve proposals for institutional submission within the threshold established in writing by the Authorized Organizational Representative.

  5. Establishes and monitors proposal turnaround standards and reports service performance.
  6. Identifies recurring causes of submission delays and partners with colleges and system staff to address root causes.
  7. Maintains the deadline management approach for high-volume sponsor submission cycles.
  8. Develops and delivers training for the college and department research administrators on proposal preparation, budget development, and sponsor requirements.
  9. Contributes to institutional policies and procedures for proposal submission and review.
  10. Identifies opportunities to automate routine review activities while ensuring professional judgment is focused on complex, high-risk, and institutionally significant matters.
  11. Performs other related duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Research Administration Science, Health Administration, or a related field. (Master’s Degree preferred.) (TRANSCRIPT REQUIRED)

EXPERIENCE: Seven (7) years of related responsible, sponsored research administration experience; OR Master’s Degree and five (5) years of related responsible, sponsored research administration experience; OR a combination of related education and work experience to equal eleven (11) years.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of proposal preparation, budget development, and sponsor requirements across federal and non-federal sponsors.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Work within a nationally recognised research institute focused on addressing major chronic disease challenges.

  • Advance research into chronic disease and co-morbidities
  • Engage with national and international research networks and partners
  • 3-year fixed-term academic position based in Hamilton

Ngā kōrero mō te tūranga – About the role

The Institute for Chronic Disease Research (ICDR) seeks to appoint an outstanding and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow to contribute to our growing programme of research focused on chronic disease prevention, management, and health outcomes.

The Postdoctoral Fellow will undertake and contribute to a range of research projects aligned with the strategic priorities of the Institute for Chronic Disease Research. Working closely with senior researchers and collaborators, the successful candidate will be involved in all stages of the research process, including study design, data collection and analysis, dissemination of findings, and preparation of funding applications.

The appointee will play a key role in advancing the Institute's research programme and contributing to its national and international research profile.

This is an opportunity to contribute to transdisciplinary research that examines chronic disease, co-morbidities and intersecting conditions, including research grounded in culturally specific and place-based knowledge. The role will also support collaboration across the University and help build research capability within the ICDR.

Salary will be based on the skills, knowledge and experience brought to the position. This is a full-time role (37.5 hours a week), fixed term for 3 years, based on our Hilcrest Campus.

For more information on the role please see the position description. Applicants should submit a cover letter addressing the selection criteria, a current curriculum vitae and the contact details for at least two academic referees.

For a confidential conversation about the role, please contact Professor Ralph Maddison, Director, Institute for Chronic Disease Research, at ralph.maddison@waikato.ac.nz. All applications must be submitted through the online portal, emailed applications will not be accepted.

Ko wai koe? – Who are you?

You will have a PhD in a relevant discipline, such as public health, epidemiology, health sciences, medicine, biostatistics, health services research or a related field, together with demonstrated experience conducting independent research.

You bring a track record of peer-reviewed publications appropriate to your career stage, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and experience preparing scientific reports, publications and presentations. You can contribute across the research process, from developing research plans and methods through to data collection, analysis, interpretation and reporting.

You are an effective communicator who can build productive relationships with academic colleagues, research partners and other stakeholders. You work well both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, manage projects and competing priorities effectively, and bring a proactive, professional and collaborative approach to your work.

Experience in chronic disease research, advanced quantitative or qualitative methods, large health datasets or clinical research projects would be an advantage. Experience contributing to grant applications, and supervising or mentoring students or early career researchers, would also be valuable.

You will also demonstrate commitment to equal opportunity and to the University’s partnership with Māori as intended by the Treaty of Waitangi.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Research shows that some people are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At The University of Waikato, we’re committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and genuine workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly match every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be just the right person for this or another opportunity on our team.

The Institute for Chronic Disease Research is the first research institute in New Zealand to focus on the combined factors that contribute to chronic disease. The ICDR supports cutting-edge, transdisciplinary and transformational health research. Its interwoven structure of platforms and pillars enables research into co-morbidities and intersecting chronic disease, including cardiovascular disease, mental health and cancer. The Institute builds on existing research strengths, supports collaboration across the University and helps develop researchers from postgraduate level through to future research leadership.

We want you to be part of our success! Our university stands proudly on the world stage as a provider of future-focused, international education and an active player in global research. Ko Te Tangata – For the People

The University of Waikato prides itself on the quality of its engagement with the communities that it serves, the provision of a world-class education and the national and international impact of its research. Our policies are guided by the principles of the Treaty of Waitangi and equal opportunity for all.

title: Android Engineer, Plugin Developer Platform

The Plugin Developer Platform team builds the APIs, SDKs, and tools that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, connectors, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and interactive apps.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. On the MarTech team reporting to the Vice President, Marketing Technology & Enablement, you will own the enterprise MarTech product portfolio. Working across Marketing, Loyalty, Technology, Data, Commercial Services, Finance, Legal, and Privacy teams, you will ensure Hilton's technology investments drive measurable business value, operational efficiency, guest engagement, and sustainable competitive advantage.

What you'll do during a typical day:

  • Own Hilton's annual and multi-year MarTech strategy, target-state capability architecture, product portfolio, and investment roadmap.

  • Develop a strong understanding of competitor and adjacent-industry capabilities through research, conferences, networking, vendor engagement, and reading.

  • Build and develop a high-performing team of MarTech product and transformation leaders while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Deliverables you'll take ownership of:

title: Kaksi lähihoitajaa HUS Nuorten kehitysvammapsykiatrian osastolle ja Hämeenlinnan kehitysvammapsykiatrian osastolle
description:
Kiinnostaisiko sinua tehdä mielenkiintoista, vaihtelevaa ja ammatillisesti monipuolista työtä? Haluaisitko tulla osaksi moniammatillista työyhteisöämme?

Haemme yhteensä kahta lähihoitajaa HUS Nuorten kehitysvammapsykiatrian osastolle sekä Hämeenlinnan kehitysvammapsykiatrian osastolle vakituiseen tehtävään 9.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.

HUS Nuorten kehitysvammapsykiatrian osastolla sekä Hämeenlinnan kehitysvammapsykiatrian osastolla hoidetaan psykiatrisia potilaita, joilla on myös kehitysvamma. Työ osastolla on monipuolista, sillä hoidamme kaikkia psykiatrisia sairauksia. Osastolla toteutetaan myös tahdosta riippumatonta erityishuoltoa.

Meillä työskentelee ammattitaitoinen henkilöstö sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinnon suorittaneita lähihoitajia ja sairaanhoitajia. Meillä työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä.

Nuorten osastolla potilaat ovat iältään 13–17 vuotiaita ja aikuisten osastolla hoidetaan yli 18-vuotiaita potilaita. Meidän tehtävämme on löytää toimivia ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja potilaan ongelmalliseen elämäntilanteeseen ja arvioida potilaan tarpeet siten, että hänen on mahdollista palata omaan asuinympäristöönsä. Potilaat saavat meiltä yksilöllistä palvelua ympärivuorokautisesti, teemme työtä aamu-, ilta- ja yövuoroissa. Työskentelyosasto katsotaan oman mielenkiinnon ja aikaisemman kokemuksen mukaan.

Sinä voit olla alalla jo pitkään työskennellyt tai juuri alalle valmistunut – me arvostamme kaikenlaista osaamista. Etsimme motivoitunutta ja kehittämishaluista lähihoitajaa tekemään tärkeää työtä kanssamme. Työssä vaativien potilaiden kanssa tarvitset vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja sekä asiakaslähtöistä ja rohkeaa työotetta. Eduksi on, jos sinulla on kokemusta psykiatrisesta hoitotyöstä sekä hyvä ja reipas asenne.

Työ on kolmivuorotyötä.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2935,15 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai perushoitajan tutkinto.


Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain pykälien 48 ja 48 a mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista. Tarjoamme palveluita alaikäisille potilaille ja tämän vuoksi edellytämme rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettua otetta rikosrekisteristä ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista.


Yhteystiedot

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa osastonhoitaja Sanna Kuivalainen, p. 040 304 8104 (sanna.p.kuivalainen@hus.fi) Haku päättyy 22.10.2026 kello 23.59. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuprosessin aikana.


Tietoja meistä

HUS Helsingin yliopistollisessa sairaalassa työskentelee lähes 27 000 ammattilaista potilaiden parhaaksi. Vastuullamme on 24 jäsenkunnan asukkaiden erikoissairaanhoito. Lisäksi meille on keskitetty valtakunnallisesti useiden harvinaisten ja vaikeiden sairauksien hoito. HUSissa hoitoa saa vuosittain noin 680 000 potilasta. Yliopistollisena sairaalana tutkimme ja kehitämme jatkuvasti hoitomenetelmiämme sekä toimintaamme.

HUS on Suomen suurin terveydenhuoltoalan toimija ja maan toiseksi suurin työnantaja. Meillä pääset liittymään kansainvälisesti tunnettuun ja tunnustettuun osaajajoukkoon. Tuemme työhyvinvointia liikunta- ja kulttuurieduilla sekä työsuhdematkaedulla. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden vuokrata henkilöstöhintaan lomamökkejä. HUS on savuton työpaikka. Tarjoamme ePassilla liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja 300e/vuodessa. Jatkokoulutusmahdollisuudet tukevat hyvin osaamisesi päivittämistä.

HUS – Vaikuttavinta hoitoa

Yhdenvertaisuus on yksi arvoistamme. Edistämme aktiivisesti monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössämme. Haluamme, että meillä HUSissa työskentelee eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuoliin sekä eri kieli-, kulttuuri- ja vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvia ammattilaisia. Meille olet tervetullut omana ainutlaatuisena itsenäsi.

title: Respiratory Student
description:
Schedule: Approximately 4-8 hours per week | Shifts vary based on the intern’s availability. No holidays are required, and weekend work is optional.

Your experience matters
Conemaugh Memorial Medical Center is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As a Respiratory Student joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

More about our team
We examine and treat patients with breathing-related conditions, perform diagnostic testing, and collaborate with physicians to develop and implement treatment plans. We also provide patient education on therapies and medication use; perform physiotherapy and related treatments.

How you’ll contribute
A Respiratory Student who excels in this role:

  • Participate in clinical research projects as required.

    Maintain accurate records as required by department standards.

  • Communicate with all other healthcare personnel regarding the care of the patient.

  • Perform chest physiotherapy according to department standards.

  • Assist in the transport of patients requiring respiratory support.

  • Administer therapeutic gases such as oxygen as prescribed or according to departmental procedures.

  • The intern must demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the area of the patients served and know the principles of growth and development over their lifespan.

  • Perform flutter valve therapy according to department standards.

  • Document interactions with and care given to the patient in the medical record and/or hospital information system.

  • Perform arterial punctures (radial and brachial arteries only) and analyze samples maintaining asepsis and quality as per department standards.

  • Personal cleanliness and courtesy is a must at all times.

  • Administer IPPB therapy as prescribed or according to departmental procedures.

  • Perform simple bedside pulmonary function testing and calculation.

  • The intern must possess the ability to assess and interpret patient data needed. to identify each patient's requirements related to his or her age specific needs.

  • Transport and change respiratory equipment on the general patient units throughout the hospital and maintain associated records in an organized and legible manner.

  • Clean, disinfect and/or sterilize all respiratory equipment.

  • Complete all mandatory and hospital competencies.

  • Exhibit and practice service excellence by actively seeking, listening and responding to the needs of patients, their family, physicians, staff and others

  • Administer BiPAP/CPAP as prescribed or according to department policy/procedure.

  • Utilize Customer Relations principles.

  • Prepare and administer humidification and nebulization therapy under controlled temperature and saturation levels.

  • Perform evaluation of therapy objectives to determine the patient's needs.

  • Provide equipment for the therapy mentioned above and perform minor repairs, maintenance and calibration as per department standards.

  • Participate in cardiopulmonary resuscitation to include the establishment of an airway, ventilatory support and external cardiac massage.

  • Perform incentive spirometry according to department standards.

  • Perform PEP therapy according to department standards.

  • Prepare and administer aerosolized drugs and drug mixtures as prescribed (i.e. bronchodilator, antibiotics, antibacterials, wetting agents, enzymes, steroids, etc.).

  • Must be familiar with and follow the hospital and department policies and procedures.

  • Attend and participate in department meetings, conferences and in-services as able upgrading your knowledge of respiratory and/or related fields to a level as acceptable as department standard.

  • Ensure that all patient charges are entered daily.

  • Perform resting, titration, exercise and nocturnal oximetry studies.

  • Replace oxygen and other compressed gas cylinders used for the respiratory care of patients and monitor and change the compressed gas cylinder banks when indicated.

  • Disassemble and prepare respiratory equipment for cleaning, disinfection and/or sterilization.

Why join us
We believe that investing in our employees is the first step to providing excellent patient care. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

  • Financial & Career Growth: Higher education, 401(k) retirement package, and company match.
  • Employee Well-being: Mental, physical, and financial wellness programs (free gym memberships, virtual care appointments, mental health services and discount programs).
  • Professional Development: Ongoing learning and career advancement opportunities.

What we’re looking for
Applicants should have a High School diploma or GED. Additional requirements include:

  • Currently enrolled in a school of Respiratory Care.
  • The Intern must have completed one semester of clinical rotations in a school of Respiratory Care.
  • Certified in CPR.

More about Conemaugh Memorial Medical Center
Conemaugh Memorial Medical Center is a 537 inpatient, behavioral health, rehabilitation, and transitional care beds hospital. Conemaugh Memorial Medical Center, a Duke LifePoint hospital, is the flagship hospital of Conemaugh Health System. A regional referral hospital known for clinical excellence, Conemaugh Memorial is home to the highest level of care designations for Neonatal Care (Level 3) and Trauma Care (Level 1). Conemaugh Memorial has received recognition by the American Heart Association with the Stroke Gold Plus Quality Achievement Award. Conemaugh Memorial is proudly committed to being a teaching hospital including seven medical residency programs, School of Nursing, and Allied Health education programs.

EEOC Statement

title: Director, Finance of Product & Engineering
description:
What You'll Do

Avalara is seeking a Director, Finance & Strategy – Product & Engineering to serve as the embedded finance leader for Product & Engineering, the largest single organization within TCO. This role partners directly with senior Product and Engineering leaders to connect product strategy, roadmap decisions, headcount planning, and operating spend into a clear financial view of what it costs to build and maintain Avalara’s products and what return those investments are generating.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership opportunity for a finance leader who wants to operate as a true business partner to technical executives, not simply as a reporting layer. The Director will help shape investment decisions, improve roadmap-to-P&L linkage, strengthen forecasting rigor, and ensure Product & Engineering’s cost structure is translated into credible, decision-ready financial narratives for Finance leadership.

#LI-Remote / #LI-Onsite)


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Product & Engineering Finance Partnership

  • Serve as the primary finance partner to the senior leaders across Product & Engineering, owning the day-to-day finance relationship for each aligned leader across budget, forecast, roadmap, and investment decisions.

  • Build trusted relationships with technical executives and translate product and engineering priorities into financial implications, tradeoffs, and recommendation paths.

  • Own the financial plan, forecast, and long-range view for the covered organization, ensuring roadmap changes are reflected prospectively in headcount and cost expectations rather than identified after the fact.

  • Lead roadmap-to-P&L linkage by translating product roadmap decisions into forward-looking forecasts for headcount, cost, and resource allocation.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership on investment prioritization, resource tradeoffs, and reallocation decisions across the portfolio.

  • Develop a clear view of product-development economics, including the cost to build and maintain products and the return profile of major investment areas.

  • Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews for the covered organization, delivering clear driver-based narratives on performance, risks, opportunities, and required actions.

  • Build and maintain KPI and assumption frameworks that connect roadmap execution, hiring plans, productivity, and spend performance into decision-useful financial insights.

Forecasting, Modeling, and Operational Rigor

  • Produce category forecasts for the organization to the team’s reporting standards and cadence, and participate fully in category-owner accountability mechanisms.

  • Model and stress-test forecast inputs using a clear assumption framework such as rate, volume, timing, and mix, rather than accepting unsupported topline figures.

  • Ensure variances are explained at the driver level, with timing variances tied to an expected landing period and structural changes reflected in run-rate expectations.

  • Surface emerging forecast risk early and proactively, and partner with business leaders to align on implications and mitigation actions before escalation.

  • Apply the same analytical scrutiny to favorable and unfavorable variances, reinforcing a culture of forecast accuracy and operational accountability.

Cross-Functional Finance Integration

  • Validate Cost of Revenue-tagged cost centers within the organization’s scope and provide the validated inputs required for consolidated gross-margin and cost-to-serve views.

  • Validate headcount data for shared headcount-governance and consolidation processes, ensuring consistency with Finance standards and organizational operating reality.

  • Partner with adjacent Finance teams on targeted cross-functional workstreams where Product & Engineering operational context is required, while maintaining clear ownership boundaries and a streamlined support model.

  • Represent Product & Engineering in Avalara’s broader FP&A, annual operating plan, and long-range planning processes, ensuring the organization’s financial story is well integrated into company-level narratives and decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

  • Roadmap-to-P&L linkage is live, credible, and actively used in real investment or reallocation decisions.

  • Forecasts for Product & Engineering are accurate, driver-based, and improve over time, with repeat misses on the same underlying driver eliminated.

  • Product & Engineering leaders view Finance as a trusted partner in resource allocation and roadmap tradeoff decisions.

  • Consolidation inputs for headcount, Cost of Revenue, and category forecasts are delivered accurately and on cadence.

  • Business reviews and executive updates clearly connect strategic choices, operating performance, and financial outcomes.

  • Finance leadership has a clear and decision-ready view of product-development cost structure, forecast risk, and emerging investment opportunities.


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or business-unit finance, ideally including direct support for Product, Engineering, R&D, or other technical organizations in SaaS or enterprise technology environments.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required; MBA, CFA, or CPA preferred.

  • Demonstrated success serving as a direct finance partner to senior business leaders, with the executive presence and judgment to build credibility quickly with SVP-level stakeholders.

  • Experience building and owning driver-based forecasting models, including headcount-to-cost, roadmap-to-cost, or related resource-planning models.

  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to move from ambiguous inputs to structured assumptions, scenarios, and recommendations.

  • Comfortable pushing for clarity on assumptions and decisions while partnering from curiosity, influence, and business judgment.

  • Experience leading planning, forecast, and business-review rhythms in complex, matrixed organizations.

  • Strong systems and data fluency, including comfort working from shared data models and planning tools rather than building disconnected offline reporting.

  • Experience with planning platforms such as Anaplan, Adaptive, or Pigment and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar; SQL a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate modeling, reporting, analysis, and synthesis while maintaining strong financial judgment.


Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Rental Supervisor - Power
description:
Hunton Services, a division of the Hunton Group, is seeking a Rental Power Supervisor to oversee the daily leadership, maintenance, readiness, deployment, and field support of its rental power generation fleet. This position leads Power Field Technicians, Power Shop Technicians, and Power Utility Technicians while ensuring generators and associated electrical equipment are inspected, maintained, tested, and prepared for reliable customer use.

Come work for an industry leader that has been recognized both locally and nationally as one of the Top Places to Work!

Responsibilities

  • Provide daily leadership and direction to Power Technicians and Utility Technicians, communicating work priorities, project requirements, and safety expectations.
  • Coordinate with Operations to support technician assignments, manpower needs, equipment availability, dispatch priorities, delivery and pickup requirements, and project schedules.
  • Monitor technician productivity, workmanship, documentation, and job completion; provide technical coaching and hands-on training.
  • Identify training needs and assist management with performance evaluations, development plans, recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and skills assessments.
  • Oversee inspection, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and testing of diesel and natural-gas generators and associated rental power equipment.
  • Maintain fleet readiness for portable, towable, and large mobile generators, load banks, automatic transfer switches, transformers, distribution panels, breakers, disconnects, cables, cable ramps, cam-lock equipment, spider boxes, fuel systems, battery chargers, and generator controls.
  • Establish and maintain equipment check-in and check-out standards, ensuring that the equipment is clean, properly labeled, inspected, tested, fueled as required, and documented before dispatch.
  • Prioritize repairs based on fleet demand and upcoming projects; coordinate parts, major repairs, warranty work, and outside vendor support as needed.
  • Provide technical oversight for engine, alternator, fuel, cooling, battery, charging, emissions, voltage regulation, breaker, control, and communication-system diagnostics.
  • Review technician findings, determine appropriate repair actions, maintain equipment service history, and escalate major failures to technical or fleet leadership.
  • Support temporary power projects from preparation through installation, startup, commissioning, service, and decommissioning.
  • Review generator capacity, voltage, phase, frequency, load requirements, cable sizing and quantities, distribution equipment, breaker protection, transformers, grounding, fuel needs, redundancy, equipment placement, and site access.
  • Verify temporary power configurations are appropriate for the application and coordinate review by qualified engineering personnel when required.
  • Confirm equipment and accessories are prepared before dispatch and provide field leadership during complex or high-risk deployments.
  • Ensure installations follow company procedures, manufacturer requirements, project specifications, and applicable safety requirements.
  • Oversee startup and commissioning inspections, including fluid levels, batteries, fuel systems, controls, voltage, frequency, phase rotation, breakers, grounding, cables, and connections.
  • Verify operational testing, required load-bank testing, alarm and shutdown checks, commissioning documentation, and customer operating orientation are completed before equipment enters service.
  • Provide remote and on-site technical support for equipment failures, alarms, shutdowns, electrical distribution problems, and customer operating concerns.
  • Support emergency response, prioritize service needs based on customer impact and operational risk, and participate in after-hours and on-call coverage as required.
  • Perform equipment audits, review completed repairs, investigate repeat failures, and implement corrective actions to improve fleet reliability.
  • Enforce company safety policies, electrical safety practices, lockout/tagout procedures, personal protective equipment requirements, and job hazard assessments; stop work when unsafe conditions exist.
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of inspection forms, maintenance records, repair work orders, time entries, service tickets, parts requests, commissioning records, load-bank reports, and equipment damage reports.
  • Communicate equipment status and significant repair needs to Operations and Fleet Management.
  • Provide technical support to Sales regarding equipment capabilities, generator applications, installation requirements, and field conditions. Sales retains responsibility for customer ownership and commercial terms.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
