title: Urban Planner (Designer)
description:
Stantec’s Buildings team is on a mission to become the world’s leading integrated design practice. Our architects, engineers, interior designers, consultants, sustainability specialists, and technologists are passionate about the power of design. Our collaborative culture and our innovative, sustainable approach to projects help us create buildings that matter to our world. Together, we are enhancing the quality of life globally through design. Join us and design your place with Stantec.

Your Opportunity

Stantec’s San Francisco office is seeking a motivated Campus / Urban Planner to join our Planning team. This role will support planning efforts for college and university campuses, with opportunities to contribute to related urban and community planning projects. The ideal candidate will have an educational background in both planning and design (architecture, landscape architecture, or urban design). Data analytics experience is preferred but not required.

Stantec’s Campus Planning practice is a national leader in higher education planning, delivering projects across a wide range of types and scales, including campus master plans; research, innovation, and medical district plans; and housing and student life studies. The firm also maintains a nationally recognized space analytics practice, providing space utilization and programming studies at the campus and building scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and manage planning projects for colleges and universities, including campus master plans, district plans and site studies, as well as specialized planning studies.
  • Conduct research related to campus and urban planning topics.
  • Provide technical support to planning projects, including GIS mapping, data collection and analysis, report writing, and preparation of planning deliverables such as plans, maps, diagrams, and graphics.
  • Prepare graphic and written materials, including presentations, reports, and visual communication.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including planners, architects, landscape architects, urban designers, engineers, and other planning and design professionals.
  • Coordinate with campus clients, public agencies, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
  • Facilitate campus and community engagement activities, such as workshops, charrettes, and stakeholder meetings.
  • Support proposal development and other business development efforts.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Professional planning experience ideally in a higher education or institutional context.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in collaborative, multidisciplinary teams on planning or design projects.
  • Strong work ethic with a high level of organization and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in standard planning and design software tools, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, Adobe Acrobat, Bluebeam, SketchUp, Rhino, Photoshop, Illustrator, and AutoCAD (working ability with AI tools is preferred).

Professional certification / licensure or ability to obtain with one or more of the following: AICP, NOMA, AIA, LEED, LEED-ND, Sites AP, or other pertinent credentials.

title: Senior Multi-Line Coverage & Litigation Specialist | National Accounts (Remote)
description:
Overview

Multi-Line Claim Specialist – National Accounts (Complex Coverage Focus)

Location: RemoteSchedule: Full-TimeSalary Range: $95,000 to $115,000

Build Your Career With Purpose at CCMSI

At CCMSI, we partner with global clients to solve their most complex risk management challenges, delivering measurable results through advanced technology, collaborative problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to their success.

We don’t just process claims—we support people. As the largest privately-owned Third Party Administrator (TPA), CCMSI delivers customized claim solutions that help our clients protect their employees, assets, and reputations. We are a certified Great Place to Work®, and our employee-owners are empowered to grow, collaborate, and make meaningful contributions every day.

Job Summary

The Multi-Line Claim Specialist is responsible for the investigation, coverage analysis, and strategic management of high-exposure, complex, and heavily litigated liability claims, with a primary focus on Workers' Compensation Employers Liability (WCEL), complex liability coverage issues, contractual risk transfer, and catastrophic loss exposures within a national accounts environment. This role manages claims from assignment through resolution and serves as a technical expert in coverage interpretation, litigation strategy, and claim resolution involving significant legal, coverage, and exposure concerns.

This position is designed for highly experienced professionals with 8+ years of multi-line claims experience and a demonstrated ability to handle complex losses with significant legal involvement. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong litigation management skills, and the ability to navigate nuanced coverage issues, including contractual risk transfer.

This is not a transactional claims role. Success in this position requires strategic thinking, advanced negotiation skills, and the ability to partner closely with clients and legal counsel to drive optimal outcomes on high-stakes claims.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, evaluate, and manage complex, high-exposure multi-line claims in accordance with CCMSI standards, client-specific instructions, and applicable state laws
  • Lead claim strategy on heavily litigated files, working closely with defense counsel to drive resolution
  • Perform detailed coverage analysis, including policy interpretation and application
  • Analyze and apply contractual risk transfer, including indemnity and additional insured provisions
  • Establish and manage significant reserves, including ongoing reserve strategy and exposure evaluation
  • Direct and oversee defense counsel, expert witnesses, and vendors to ensure effective claim progression
  • Negotiate high-value settlements in alignment with legal strategy, client expectations, and authority guidelines
  • Review and approve complex legal, medical, and damage-related invoices for accuracy and relevance
  • Provide clear, strategic communication and reporting to clients, including claim status, exposure analysis, and resolution strategy
  • Coordinate with excess and reinsurance carriers, including reporting and collaboration on large-loss files
  • Identify and pursue subrogation opportunities where applicable
  • Maintain comprehensive and defensible claim documentation within the claim system
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor for less experienced adjusters when needed
  • Ensure full compliance with corporate claim handling standards and client service commitments

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of multi-line claim handling experience
  • Minimum 5+ years manageing complex, high-exposrue, and heavily litigated liability claims
  • Strong expertise in litigation management, defense counsel oversight, and claim resolution strategy
  • Advanced knowledge of WCEL, complex liabiltiy coverage analysis, contractual risk transfer, indemnity, additional insured provisions, and umbrella/excell liability exposures
  • Exceptional analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive-level client interacation
  • Ability to independently manage highly complex claims with minimal supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Current adjuster license in home state (multiple licenses strongly preferred)

Nice to Have

  • Strong legal background
  • Prior TPA experience handling national accounts
  • Experience with construction defect, construction liability, general liability, or large commercial trucking losses
  • Experience handling CROP claims
  • Industry designations such as CPCU, AIC, or ARM
  • New York and Hawaii Licenses

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • 4 weeks (Paid time off that accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy) + 10 paid holidays in your first year
  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • Retirement plans: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Career growth: Opportunities for advancement into leadership or highly specialized technical roles
  • Culture: A supportive, team-based work environment with a focus on expertise and ownership

How We Measure Success

At CCMSI, great adjusters stand out through ownership, accuracy, and impact. We measure success by:

  • Quality claim handling – thorough analysis, defensible decisions, and strategic file management
  • Litigation outcomes – effective partnership with counsel and favorable resolution of complex claims
  • Financial accuracy – strong reserve management and cost containment
  • Client partnership – proactive communication and trusted advisor relationships
  • Professional judgment – sound decision-making on high-exposure matters

Compensation & Compliance

The posted salary reflects CCMSI’s good-faith estimate in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal equity. This role may also qualify for bonuses or additional forms of pay.

CCMSI offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Paid time off accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy, with paid holidays and eligibility for retirement programs in accordance with plan documents.

Visa Sponsorship: CCMSI does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

ADA Accommodations: CCMSI is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and hiring process.

Equal Opportunity Employer: CCMSI complies with all applicable employment laws, including pay transparency and fair chance hiring regulations.

Background checks, if required for the role, are conducted only after a conditional offer and in accordance with applicable fair chance hiring laws.

Our Core Values

At CCMSI, we believe in doing what’s right—for our clients, our coworkers, and ourselves. We look for team members who:

  • Lead with transparency We build trust by being open and listening intently in every interaction.
  • Perform with integrity We choose the right path, even when it is hard.
  • Chase excellence We set the bar high and measure our success. What gets measured gets done.
  • Own the outcome Every employee is an owner, treating every claim, every decision, and every result as our own.
  • Win together Our greatest victories come when our clients succeed.

We don’t just work together—we grow together. If that sounds like your kind of workplace, we’d love to meet you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

At Solace, we are building the data foundation that will power patient outcomes. We are a small but growing team where everyone wears many hats and moves fast. We are looking for a Data Engineer who loves solving hard problems with clean, maintainable code and thrives in this high-growth startup environment.

In this role, you will architect the infrastructure that allows us to scale. You will be a core builder of our data platform, establishing the frameworks, standards, and best practices that will define our engineering culture for years to come. From raw data ingestion to complex modeling, your work will ensure that our data is not just available, but trusted, reliable, and ready for action. You'll also help own the FastAPI data API that puts that data to work inside our application, powering data-driven decisions for our users.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect Robust Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines using Airflow, Python, dbt, and Snowflake. You will replace brittle manual processes with resilient, automated workflows.

  • Build Infrastructure as Code: Manage and evolve our cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) using Terraform, ensuring our platform is reproducible, secure, and scalable.

  • Elevate Code Quality: Write clean, production-grade code for complex data processing. You will champion engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and CI/CD.

  • Optimize Data Models: Collaborate with analysts to design performant SQL transformations and data models in Snowflake (experience with dbt is a huge plus).

  • Own Our Data API: We run a data API built on FastAPI that drives data-driven decisions within the application. You'll help own it and everything that comes with it, including endpoint design, performance, deployment, monitoring, and reliability for the product teams that depend on it.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Strong Python Proficiency: You are comfortable writing modular, testable, and efficient Python code for data processing and automation.

  • Advanced SQL & Snowflake: You have deep expertise in SQL and cloud data warehousing (Snowflake preferred), understanding how to optimize queries for performance and cost.

  • Orchestration Mastery: Proven experience building and maintaining complex workflows using Airflow (or similar tools).

  • Infrastructure Mindset: Familiarity with Terraform and cloud services (AWS or GCP). You understand how to provision and manage the resources your pipelines run on.

  • Security & Stewardship: You understand the gravity of handling sensitive medical data. You are experienced in properly handling PHI and PII, implementing secure access controls (RBAC), and adhering to strict governance standards.

  • Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done.

  • Communication Skills: You can translate complex technical challenges into clear options for non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus Points

  • dbt Expertise: Experience using dbt to manage transformations and implement testing/documentation standards.

  • Healthcare Background: Experience working with healthcare data standards or strictly regulated environments (HIPAA) a plus.

  • Containerization: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for deploying data applications.

  • Backend Development & MLOps: Exposure to building backend services or APIs (e.g., FastAPI, Flask), or to MLOps practices such as model deployment, versioning, and monitoring.

Our Tech Stack

  • Compute & Storage: Snowflake, Postgres

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Infrastructure: Terraform, AWS/GCP

  • Transformation: dbt, SQL, Python

  • Backend: FastAPI data service (owned by our team)

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Director of Event Operations
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Manages all event service, banquet and event technology operations and staff on a daily basis. Core area of responsibility is the event operation team, including the Senior Banquet Managers, Banquet Managers, Senior Event Service Managers, Event Service Managers, Event Technology and Operations Managers. Position ensures the highest level of service throughout the event phase. Maximizes revenue opportunities by up-selling during the event phase and maximizes profit by effectively managing costs. The position is responsible for achieving guest and employee satisfaction and for managing the financial performance of the Event Operations Department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, sales and marketing, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the event management, food and beverage, sales and marketing, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Event Management Operations and Budgets

• Works with the management team to develop and implement the business plan and long term strategies for event operations.

• Establishes and monitors measurable goals for the department.

• Champions all standards, policies and procedures in the Event Operations departments.

• Oversees the execution of event logistics for all events.

• Oversees the administrative processes associated with the event phase of a function and the associated transitions between all event phases as they relate to the service delivery team.

• Ensures function space and corresponding heart of the house areas are cleaned and maintained.

• Ensures furniture and equipment is maintained and inventory levels are kept in accordance to corporate guidelines.

• Communicates and executes departmental and property emergency procedures and ensures staff are trained in safety procedures.

• Participates in MVP audits and level certification for all technicians.

• Ensures employees maintain required certification.

• Assists with implementation and execution of all event related corporate initiatives and promotions.

Managing Profitability

• Ensures department is working within budget and adjusts expenditures according to revenues.

• Maintains awareness of current trends in event management and integrates into the operation in a timely manner.

• Reviews effectiveness of event operations annually and makes appropriate adjustments.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Consult with customers in order to determine objectives and requirements for events such as meetings, conferences, and conventions.

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Maintains customer satisfaction to insure retention and growth of business through referrals and repeat events.

Leading Event Management Teams

• Leads execution of activities in Event Operations to support the Event Management strategy.

• Leads event management/operations meetings.

• Coordinates the Event Operations members of Event Delivery teams.

• Works with culinary team to ensure compliance to food handling and sanitation standards.

• Works with Human Resources to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

• Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in all areas of event operations.

Maintaining Relationships with Property Stakeholders

• Communicates effectively with property departments outside of Event Operations.

• Maintains a strong working relationship with guests/clients, vendors and competitors.

Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service and operational needs are met.

• Works with direct reports to review scheduled events and troubleshoot potential challenges/conflicts.

• Attends pre-event meetings to understand group needs, set appropriate expectations and gather critical information to communicate to Event Operations Team.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Salary: $150K-$160K

Reapit – Who are we?

Reapit is the original, end-to-end business technology provider for estate agencies of all sizes. We’ve been helping sales and lettings agents to build relationships and grow their businesses for more than 25 years. Our technology connects property professionals in Europe, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand with buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords to power the relationships that change lives.

In Australia, Reapit stands as the preferred technology choice among the nation's leading estate agents and agencies. Tailored to the unique demands of the Australian property market, Reapit provides successful leaders with unparalleled tools across sales, property management, client relations, and data analytics, reinforcing their position at the pinnacle of real estate excellence.

What you’ll be doing

Reporting to the ANZ DevOps Lead you’ll be responsible for implementing automation initiatives dealing with software development and operations, improving communication, calibration and integration between the development team and infrastructure. You will also be involved in the following;

  • Influence design efforts for the secure and scalable environments that satisfy both operational and product needs.

  • Influence and lead efforts and processes for continuous deployment cycles.

  • Drive resolution of issues identified via application and system monitoring. Resolve emergent service problems and build automated tools to identify/prevent problem recurrence.

  • Perform hands-on automation tasks to treat infrastructure as code.

  • Provide execution of activities related to infrastructure, security, continuous deployment, IT operations and metrics.

  • Communicate with key stakeholders on infrastructure and deployment details.

  • Lead code reviews

  • Mentor other DevOps Engineers and Developers

Who we're looking for

At Reapit, we prioritise hiring individuals who share our values and possess the right attitudes and behaviours for success. Whilst some of the listed requirements may be important, don’t worry if you don’t meet all of them, we’d still like to hear from you.

Essential:

  • Tertiary qualification in an area of Information Technology and/or relevant experience

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Linux, Docker and Scripting languages (JavaScript/Typescript/Node.js/Python)

  • Experience with using Ansible, Terraform, AWS CDK or other infrastructure as code tools.

  • Experience with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

  • Proven ability to identify problems and implement effective solutions.

Desirable:

  • Experience in building and maintaining Kubernetes clusters.

  • Experience in Serverless infrastructure.

  • Experience in Data warehousing technologies.

  • Experience in cloud networking technologies.

  • Experience in running .NET applications in production environments.

  • Experience with mentoring junior DevOps Engineers and/or other development team members would be an advantage

What your impact and success looks like

We expect your success and impact in the early stages of your career with us to look something like this:

Within 1 Month

  • Complete onboarding with demonstrated understanding of our key systems, infrastructure architecture, deployment processes, and on-call procedures

  • Successfully respond to and resolve production incidents independently for at least three core services, creating or updating runbooks based on your experience.

  • Become the go to person for our main Australian system

Within 3 Months

  • Own incident response end-to-end for your assigned systems, including leading post-mortems and driving remediation work to completion

  • Deliver at least two substantial automation or tooling improvements that measurably reduce operational overhead, improve deployment speed, or enhance system reliability

  • Implement monitoring and alerting enhancements for critical services that improve observability, reduce alert fatigue, or decrease mean time to detection

Within 6 Months

  • Deliver a major operations project to production (such as: delivery of a new product/system, infrastructure migration, disaster recovery implementation)

  • Demonstrate quantifiable improvements in reliability metrics for systems under your ownership

  • Establish yourself as an expert in your assigned systems, helping team members, influencing operational decisions, and contributing to technical improvements

We operate a Flexible Working Policy and we would like for you to work from our Brisbane or Sydney office as required.

Don't tick all the boxes? Neither do we

We care about our industry and want it to become a more inclusive and diverse place to work. So, we’re driven by hiring not only by experience and relevance for the role but by sharing our values and the right attitudes and behaviours for success. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. We feel we have an empowering environment where everyone is supported and respected, and we want you to feel this too. We welcome new ideas, thinking and approaches, whilst listening to all our employees.

title: Spa Director
description:
Cibola Vista Resort and Spa in Sedona is hiring a Spa Director. This role will lead the strategic, financial, operational, and regulatory performance of the Cibola Resort.

The Spa Director grows membership and service revenue, strengthens market awareness and social presence, delivers exceptional member and guest experiences, and maintains disciplined oversight of people, systems, facilities, and compliance while championing HGV’s People First philosophy, supporting team member wellbeing, and fostering a respectful, inclusive workplace where every Team Member feels valued and a sense of belonging

  • Day 1 Health Benefits Eligibility: Excellent health care options, including medical, dental, and vision
  • Recognition Programs and Rewards
  • Travel Discounts Program
  • Outstanding Paid Vacation Program and Paid Sick Days
  • Employee Assistance Program that supports your physical and mental wellbeing
  • 401(k) program with company match
  • Tuition reimbursement programs
  • Employee Stock purchase program
  • Numerous learning and advancement opportunities
  • And more!

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Responsibilities Include:

What will I be doing?

  • Create and execute an annual sales, marketing, social media, and community engagement plan that promotes the Sedona Spa to current and prospective members, resort guests, HGV owners, local residents, and community partners through campaigns, packages, referral opportunities, seasonal offers, on-property promotions, approved digital content, events, member benefits, and wellness education.
  • Establish measurable financial and operating goals; manage membership sales, treatment revenue, retail sales, utilization, average ticket, capture rate, payroll, product cost, inventory, discounts, budgets, forecasts, purchasing plans, and variance explanations; and implement corrective actions to improve revenue, profitability, and cost control.
  • Ensure effective retail execution, including product presentation, merchandising, inventory management, promotion of retail sales, reconciliation of monthly sales reports, retail inventory controls, and clear performance goals for retail sales.
  • Maintain accurate and current membership records, including member status, contact information, billing details, benefit eligibility, freezes, cancellations, renewal dates, monthly dues, annual fees, failed payments, past-due balances, adjustments, refunds, reconciliation, and follow-up in coordination with Finance and approved systems and procedures.
  • Develop and evaluate member and guest communications, events, wellness programming, open houses, community activations, and promotional experiences that sustain interest, deepen relationships, promote member benefits and renewal opportunities, and generate incremental revenue.
  • Lead daily spa operations, including staffing, scheduling, service standards, treatment protocols, front desk execution, reservations, retail execution, inventory controls, opening and closing procedures, payment oversight, and facility readiness.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, coach, schedule, support, and recognize spa providers and support Team Members; establish clear expectations for productivity, service quality, consultation, rebooking, retail recommendations, member engagement, open communication, wellbeing, inclusion, belonging, trust, and respectful leadership consistent with HGV’s People First philosophy.
  • Ensure all required staff trainings are completed and documented in accordance with Company, departmental, safety, and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain hazard communication practices, including proper maintenance, storage, and accessibility of Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for products used within the department.
  • Maintain documented provider license and credential verification, required establishment licenses, permits, postings, records, sanitation practices, infection-control procedures, health and safety requirements, and inspection readiness applicable to services offered; coordinate promptly with Human Resources, Risk Management, and property leadership when a compliance concern is identified.
  • Maintain sanitation, infection control, and required postings in accordance with Arizona State Barbering and Cosmetology Board regulations.
  • Work with Engineering and Housekeeping to maintain a clean, safe, functional, compliant, and guest-ready facility; document, escalate, and follow up on equipment, maintenance, sanitation, infection-control, or life-safety concerns.
  • Respond to member and guest concerns professionally and promptly, identify recurring themes, and implement service-recovery and continuous-improvement actions.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Embodies the Hilton Grand Vacations Values of Hospitality, Integrity, Leadership, Teamwork, Ownership, Now,
  • Completes all required Company training/compliance courses as assigned.
  • Adheres to Company standards and maintains compliance with all policies and procedures.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

To fulfill this role successfully, the individual should possess the following qualifications, knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience:

  • Business development, membership growth, marketing execution, community outreach, and revenue management in a spa, wellness, hospitality, fitness, or membership-based environment.
  • At least 3 years experience of supervisory or management experience in a similiar industry and 3-5 years experience of related experience.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as schedule needs dictate
  • CPR certification required
  • Working knowledge of spa operations, treatment scheduling, provider utilization, retail and inventory controls, budgeting, forecasting, payroll management, and financial reporting.
  • Ability to maintain detailed membership, payment, licensing, credential, and compliance records with accuracy, confidentiality, and consistent follow-through.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, relationship-building, and digital communication skills, including the ability to develop professional promotional content and member campaigns.
  • Ability to interpret operating results, identify trends, establish action plans, and hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes.
  • Sound judgment, organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a guest-facing operation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and the ability to work with / learn Book 4 Time spa scheduling, point-of-sale, membership, payment, reputation, and social media platforms.

title: Apulaisosastonhoitaja Siltasairaalan leikkausyksikkö
description:
Etsitkö työtä, jossa pääset yhdistämään kliinisen hoitotyön, esihenkilötyön ja toiminnan kehittämisen? Apulaisosastonhoitajan tehtävä tarjoaa juuri tämän mahdollisuuden! Lue lisää ja jätä hakemus!

Haemme leikkausyksikön hoitotyön ammattilaista apulaisosastonhoitajan vakituiseen toimeen Siltasairaalan anestesia- ja leikkausyksikköön. Työn aloitus 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Uusissa työsuhteissa noudatamme enintään kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Mitä tehtäviisi kuuluu?

Anestesia- ja leikkausyksikön apulaisosastonhoitajana huolehdit ensisijaisesti päivittäisjohtamisesta, kehität hoitotyötä ja toimit osastohoitajan tukena. Vastuullasi on leikkaussalien ja/tai anestesiatoiminnan koordinointi, henkilöstön osaamisen kehittäminen ja varmistaminen sekä muut yksikön toimintaan liittyvät tehtävät. Tehtävänkuvaan kuuluu myös osallistuminen kliiniseen hoitotyöhön sekä osastonhoitajan sijaistaminen tarvittaessa. Apulaisosastonhoitajan työaika on jaksotyö painotteun pääosin arkiaamuvuoroihin. Edellytämme kuitenkin valmiutta tehdä kliinistä työtä virka-ajan ulkopuolella.

Me HUSissa haluamme olla johtamisessa edelläkävijöitä. Apulaisosastonhoitajana olet myös merkittävä osa tätä tavoitetta ja haluatkin kohdata työkaverit ja tiimiläiset aina positiivisella asenteella. Luot ympärillesi luottamuksen ilmapiirin myös kiireen keskellä ja edistät työhyvinvointia omalla esimerkilläsi.

Siltasairaalan anestesia- ja leikkausyksikkö on yksi HUSin 24/7 päivystävistä leikkausyksiköistä, jossa hoidamme ortopedian ja traumatologian, neurokirurgian sekä käsikirurgian erikoisalaan kuuluvia potilaita. Päivystyksellisesti hoidetaan lisäksi plastiikkakirurgian sekä suu- ja leukakirurgian potilaita. Tarjoamme lisäksi anestesiapalveluita leikkausyksikön ulkopuolelle. Leikkaustoiminta on jaettu toiminnallisesti kahteen moduuliin. Leikkausyksikön hoitotyön esihenkilötiimiin kuuluu kaiken kaikkiaan kaksi osastonhoitajaa ja viisi apulaisosastonhoitajaa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen, vaihtelevan työn sekä yhteisöllisen ja ammattitaitoisen esihenkilö- ja työyhteisötuen. Perehdytyksen jälkeen sinulla on mahdollisuus täydentävään ammatilliseen koulutukseen.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:


• Epassin liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja työmatkaedun
• maksuttomat HUSin vastaanottokäynnit
• työsuhde- ja loma-asuntojen vuokrauspalvelut
• mm. edullisen kuntosalin käyttömahdollisuuden

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Tehtävässä vaaditaan anestesia- ja/tai leikkaushoitotyön kliinistä kokemusta ja asiantuntemusta sekä ymmärrystä leikkausyksikön päivittäisjohtamisesta. Odotamme sinulta vastuullista ja itseohjautuvaa työotetta, erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityöskentelytaitoja sekä joustavaa asennetta. Edellytämme potilaslähtöistä ja kehittävää työotetta sekä kiinnostusta ja pitkäjänteistä sitoutumista muutosjohtamiseen. Eduksi katsomme molempien, anestesia- ja leikkaushoitotyön, osaamisen, kokemuksen päivystysluonteisesta leikkausyksikön hoitotyöstä sekä näytön leikkausyksikössä tapahtuvasta kehittämisestä.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Kelpoisuusehtona apulaisosastonhoitajan toimeen on:


• soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto ja soveltuva kokemus tai
• alempi korkeakoulututkinto täydennettynä soveltuvilla johtamisen tai hallinnon opinnoilla tai sisältyen tutkintoon ja soveltuva kokemus tai
• aikaisempi hyväksytty osastonhoitajan pätevyys ja soveltuva kokemus tai - alan opistoasteen tutkinto täydennettyinä johtamisen tai hallinnon opinnoilla ja soveltuva kokemus.

Lisäksi valittavan henkilön tulee olla laillistettu terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilö.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Palkka

Palkka määräytyy SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3635 €/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät.

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa - hakemuksen lähettäminen on helppoa!

Haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää – panosta hyvään hakemukseen ja CV:hen, ja kerro osaamisestasi laajasti. Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 20.10.2026 mennessä!

Haastattelut pidämme torstaina 22.10.2026.

title: Senior HR Partner Representative (Hybrid)
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of HR Generalist or equivalent work experience in Human Resources or related field
  • Up to 10% travel as needed
  • Working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements, labor contracts, and union-related practices
  • Demonstrated HR business acumen with the ability to diagnose complex business and workforce challenges, identify appropriate solutions, and drive implementation of effective outcomes
  • Experience utilizing data analytics to interpret workforce trends, generate insights, and support business decision-making
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey information and influence diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to support team success through cross-functional initiatives and organizational goals
  • Experience translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and aligning stakeholders and resources to achieve business objectives
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is a crucial function of the position

Preferred Qualifications

  • Workday experience
  • Airline or aviation industry experience
  • Experience partnering with operational or frontline business teams
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. Apply critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy, and security

Qualifications

About the Job

The Sr. HR Partner Representative serves as an HR Generalist-focused member of the Central Team, supporting enterprise-wide HR initiatives and helping deliver a more consistent employee and leader experience through United’s evolving HR Service Delivery Model. Rather than owning a dedicated business unit, this role provides broad operational HR support across workgroups, including functionally aligned initiatives where needed, and partners closely with named HR Business Partners, HR Operations, Employee Relations and Centers of Excellence. The role helps intake, triage, coordinate and resolve repeatable HR requests through ServiceNow, Workday and other key systems, while escalating matters that require business judgment, strategic consultation, employee relations expertise or leader sensitivity. This position also identifies trends, improves SOPs and knowledge resources, and helps shift routine work to the appropriate tier so HR Business Partners can remain focused on strategic business partnership.

Core Accountabilities

  • Serve as a Central Team HR Generalist responsible for intake, triage, routing and resolution of repeatable HR requests received through ServiceNow, Workday and other designated HR systems; coordinate with the appropriate HRBP, COE, HR Operations or ER partner when escalation is required.
  • Support enterprise-wide HR initiatives and functionally aligned work, including operational execution, case coordination, manager support and follow-through for standard HR processes that do not require dedicated business-unit ownership.
  • Apply established SOPs, decision frameworks and service delivery routing rules to resolve routine and repeatable HR matters at the lowest appropriate tier, while preserving a high-quality employee and leader experience
  • Partner with named HR Business Partners to support leaders and employees on day-to-day HR matters, including manager guidance, HR system navigation, policy/process questions, local execution support and case follow-up.
  • Help execute recurring HR programs and annual processes such as performance, talent, compensation, employee listening and other Workday-enabled activities by coordinating operational steps, tracking completion and escalating risks or exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reporting in ServiceNow, Workday and related tools; analyze case and interaction trends to identify service gaps, process improvement opportunities, knowledge article needs and recurring work that can be standardized or shifted to the appropriate HR tier.
  • Provide flexible support for strategic initiatives, change management activities, launch readiness, hypercare and continuous improvement efforts related to HR service delivery, Workday adoption and enterprise HR operating model changes.

The base pay range for this role is $81,795.00 to $106,602.00.
The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

title: Softgoods Designer
description:
Are you passionate about solving complex problems? Join our dynamic team as a Softgood Engineering Designer and become a vital contributor to support NASA as an Oceaneering Teammate on the JSC Engineering, Technology, and Science (JETS) II contract. As an integral part of our organization, you'll play a crucial role in the Engineering Department on the NASA JSC Engineering, (JETS II) Contract.

This role will give you the opportunity to immerse yourself in the thrilling world of human spaceflight and deep space exploration programs. Your contributions will ensure that our services not only meet - but outperform all standards and expectations. As a Softgood Engineering Technologist, you'll find yourself at the forefront of innovation, collaborating with a passionate team who shares your dedication to excellence. If you're seeking to immerse yourself in an environment where your skills and expertise will make a genuine impact, we invite you to join our team!

We are seeking someone with a keen eye for detail, a strong commitment to owning their work, and providing superior quality. You should be a person who thrives in a diverse environment and who is comfortable communicating at all levels of the organization. To be successful in this role, you should have a sense of genuine, engaging curiosity, and a desire for growth and continuous learning.

The Softgoods Engineering Technologist will:
• Design, develop, fabricate, and support testing of new and innovative functional softgoods articles for advanced exploration space suits and ancillary support softgoods items for the Advanced Suit Team.
• Work at a high level of technical proficiency and with detailed attention to craftsmanship and presentation.
• Collaborate and communicate with engineers, technicians, and other designers to understand requirements of working on a variety of suited space systems and hardware.
• Clearly and thoroughly present design concepts and considerations.
• Take ownership of design tasks and show initiative to complete projects.
• Perform machine maintenance, repair, and custom modifications to tailor the machines for unique operations as required.
• Create patterns and develop mockups for verifying fit and function of Softgoods articles.
• Interpret fabrication drawings to assemble sewn products and other Softgoods.
• Document any new design work and clearly define process and techniques.
• Seek out new manufacturing techniques and innovative materials.
• Keep the lab spaces clean, organized, and well maintained to perform the duties stated above.
• Occasionally travel to other NASA centers or contractors to perform Softgoods fabrication and installation.
• Be able to lift and transport materials and equipment.
• Be able to work in confined spaces, climb stairs, steps, and ladders.
• Perform other duties as required.

Required

• Typically requires a HS diploma and 5 years of experience or BS in Engineering Technology or related field
• Experience in a soft goods development lab environment with emphasis in soft goods design and fabrication.
• Demonstrated capability to successfully devise solutions to complex design challenges independently and by soliciting inputs from other technical experts.
• Expertise in a wide range of hands-on fabrication techniques and sewing processes – sewing machines, laser cutters, fabric welders, 3D printers, bandsaws, drills, hand tools, etc.
• Demonstrated success working with a cross disciplinary team.
• Proficiency utilizing CAD programs and other software's such as Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office Suite.
• Experience in Adobe Illustrator, AutoCAD, and Rhino 8.

Requisition Preferences:


• A BA, BFA, or BS in Industrial Design, Apparel Design, or equivalent is desired.
• Experience in aerospace product design processes including ability to read, understand, and create fabrication drawings.
• Experience with fabricating processes for prototyping Softgoods products.
• Familiarity with softgoods article and textiles testing procedures.
• Ancillary experience in any number of manufacturing, testing, or design processes that could be beneficial to furthering the development of advanced space suit technologies
• Understanding of materials characteristics and properties of advanced space grade textiles and other materials.
• Familiarity with the NASA/JSC Softgoods design and development and the JETS Engineering Life Cycle processes.

Proof of U.S. Citizenship or US Permanent Residency is a requirement for this position.
Must be able to complete a U.S. government background investigation.

title: Fysioterapeut til ortopædkirurgisk team, Ergo- og fysioterapien, SUH Køge
description:
Vi søger en fysioterapeut i vores ortopædkirurgiske team, så har du interesse inden for specialet, lyst til at gøre en forskel for patienter og at være en del af fremtidens akuthospital, så er muligheden der hos os.

Stillingen er med fastansættelse pr. 1. december 2026, på 37 timer ugentligt.

Vi ser, at du
  • trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaver og prioriteringer kan ændre sig, og hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at finde de bedste løsninger
  • kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i tæt samarbejde med kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af faggrupper
  • kommunikerer tydeligt og vil bidrage konstruktivt til den fælles opgaveløsning
  • arbejder fagligt reflekteret, klinisk ræsonnerende og vil anvende ny viden i din kliniske praksis
  • har fokus på den enkelte patient, en helhedsorienteret indsats og har blik for det samlede patientforløb
  • er nysgerrig på udvikling og har lyst til at bidrage til at styrke den fysioterapeutiske praksis
  • møder kolleger og patienter med åbenhed, engagement og interesse for læring og sparring
Dine opgaver

Du vil primært varetage korte, strukturerede og dokumenterede patientforløb med fokus på vurdering af patientens funktionsevne samt behov for genoptræning og rehabilitering.

Sammen med patienten planlægger du det videre forløb gennem undersøgelse, vurdering, instruktion, udlevering af relevante hjælpemidler og vejledning i øvelser. Målet er at understøtte patientens aktive og selvstændige deltagelse under indlæggelsen, og skabe gode overgange til udskrivelse samt videre genoptræning og rehabilitering i kommunen.

Stillingen indebærer weekendvagter efter endt introduktionsperiode. Der er som udgangspunkt vagt cirka hver 8. weekend samt enkelte helligdage. Under vagter dækker vi hele hospitalet, og derfor indeholder onboardingforløbet også introduktion til andre specialer end det, du ansættes i.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du føler dig godt klædt på til opgaverne. Du får derfor et grundigt onboardingforløb, en mentor og tid til læring, så du kan føle dig tryg i rollen.

Hvem er vi?

I Ergo- og Fysioterapien har vi et stærkt fokus på det aktive patientforløb på akuthospitalet. Vi arbejder målrettet med at udvikle vores praksis og understøtte patienternes aktivitet og deltagelse under indlæggelsen. Afdelingen har desuden en klinisk udviklingsenhed, som bidrager til faglig udvikling og implementering af ny viden.

Vi samarbejder tæt med hospitalets øvrige afdelinger og er optagede af at skabe sammenhængende og kvalitetsfulde patientforløb. Samtidig værner vi om et arbejdsmiljø præget af faglighed, engagement, åbenhed, feedback og godt humør.

På matriklen i Køge er vi 10 ergoterapeuter, 22 fysioterapeuter, 1 overterapeut, 1 sekretær og 1 hjælpemiddelansvarlig kollega. Desuden har vi en klinisk underviser og har tilknyttet fysioterapeutstuderende fra Professionshøjskolen Absalon, samt udviklingsterapeuter knyttet til afdelingen.

Du bliver ansat på Sjællands Universitetshospital, som omfatter hospitalerne i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing Falster. I januar 2028 flytter vores kolleger fra Roskilde til det nye universitetshospital i Køge, hvor vi sammen fortsætter udviklingen af fremtidens patientforløb.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

-så håber vi, at du vil søge stillingen, og vil glæde os til at høre fra dig.

Har du spørgsmål eller ønsker at høre mere om jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Lilian Christensen, overterapeut for ergo- og fysioterapeuter, på telefon 23 32 62 10 eller mail lilchr@regionsjaelland.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist d. 20. oktober 2026

Samtaler forventes afholdt d. 26. oktober 2026


Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Energy Engineer
description:
Overview

What You’ll Be Doing

Cadmus seeks an Energy Engineer to join its Energy Services Division.

Cadmus seeks candidates with strong analytical, research, and communication skills, and experience in mechanical or electrical engineering, or a strong technical background from related fields.

Qualified candidates are expected to direct and execute energy projects on behalf of Cadmus’ clients. Typical project activities can include: leading site inspections or investigations; supporting energy audits and decarbonization assessments; deploying temporary monitoring equipment to collect timeseries data; using diagnostic equipment to measure key performance parameters; harvesting trend data from building or equipment control systems; analyzing energy, emissions, financial, or survey data using engineering and statistical methods; and developing deliverables to share findings and recommendations with internal and external clients.

Qualified candidates will also possess excellent communications skills which will support many dimensions of this role. The Energy Engineer will manage peer and junior staff as they support project-specific tasks; monitor project budgets, plans, and deliverables in support of overall project management efforts; develop and present work products to varied audiences including clients, colleagues, conference attendees, and public stakeholders; and generally, collaborate broadly internally and externally.

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with exceptional technical, written, and verbal skills, as well as expertise in engineering and energy. The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented problem solver with a proven ability to manage themselves, collaborating effectively with clients and colleagues, as they execute complex projects and deliver high-quality work products on-time and on-budget.

Who We Are

Cadmus provides government, commercial, and other private organizations worldwide with technology-empowered advisory and implementation services. We help our clients achieve their goals and drive lasting, impactful change by leveraging transformative digital solutions and unparalleled expertise across domains.

At Cadmus, we look for team players and problem solvers who are driven to use their unique perspectives and intellectual curiosity to help deliver breakthrough solutions that achieve transformative goals. As a member of our team, you'll collaborate with leading experts to support our clients across the globe. We offer competitive compensation, outstanding health care and retirement benefits, a vibrant and collaborative work environment, and ample opportunities for professional growth.

Join Cadmus. Together, we are strengthening society and the natural world. For more information, visit cadmusgroup.com.

Responsibilities

  • Lead commercial, industrial, multifamily, and residential site visits to support energy projects. Collect key data and document as-found building conditions using equipment, software, photographs, and forms. Review building equipment and controls systems to understand setpoints, schedules and operating parameters. Use diagnostic tools (e.g., temperature sensors, motor loggers, combustion analyzers, blower doors) to collect key data for demand reduction, energy savings, and emissions analysis. Identify savings opportunities in the field and while reviewing and analyzing data.
  • Analyze collected data using analytical techniques and software tools such as MS Excel, Python, or R; identify trends; optimize weather or production-normalized quantitative models; summarize takeaways, events, and impacts.
  • Quantify impacts from proposed or implemented energy interventions using engineering or statistical methods, industry software, and reference materials. Evaluate project feasibility with economic analyses like return on investment.
  • Support energy projects for a wide variety of technologies including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, exterior envelope, solar photovoltaic (PV), battery energy storage system (BESS), electric vehicle (EV), and specialized process systems (compressed air, commercial kitchen equipment, laboratory systems, etc.).
  • Prepare and present findings through written and oral communications, including reports, memos, and presentations; communicate clearly with varied audiences, including clients, community stakeholders, and peers.
  • Engage clients (e.g., utilities, municipal, and state agencies) to scope out needs, identify key services or products, build partnerships, and implement energy solutions.
  • Manage self effectively, balancing priorities and communicating challenges to leadership; optimize working hours to preserve work-life balance.
  • Manage small teams of consultants effectively, providing leadership and direction while monitoring task quality, budget, and timeline; drive effective outcomes and quality deliverables while building community and shared purpose among colleagues.
  • Support business development and company growth through positive client relationships, industry outreach and networking, and support of project proposals via budget and written content development.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal and external parties, including interdisciplinary teams, supervisors and delegates, clients, peer professionals, and members of the public.
  • Deliver high-quality work on-time and on-budget.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related field.• Between five (5) to seven (7) years of demonstrated professional experience in the energy sector.• Strong analytical, problem solving and decision-making capabilities.• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrating the ability to communicate complicated issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, set priorities, and adapt to changing deadlines in a fast-paced, deliverable-driven environment.• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills.• Self-motivated with the initiative to work independently on assignments, learn new skills, and mentor colleagues.• Intermediate to advanced experience with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.• Willingness for regular travel domestically. Typical trips to client sites may be ½ day or full day and within driving distance. Some trips may require air travel and some trips may extend to 1 or 2 weeks duration. • Valid driver’s license (vehicle ownership not required).

Preferred Qualifications

• Engineering in Training (EIT) credential in mechanical or electrical engineering.• Proficiency in energy simulation modeling (OpenStudio, Energy Plus, eQuest, etc.).• Proficiency in coding with Python, R, and/or SQL.• Experience deploying power metering and data logging equipment.• Electrician license.• AEE Certified Energy Manager or Certified Measurement & Verification Professional certification.• MEP (Mechanical-Electrical-Plumbing) Design experience.• Demand Side Management (DSM) evaluation experience. • Experience with power and energy analysis techniques, including regression models, bin analysis, cross-validation, and parameter tuning/optimization.• Familiarity with project management tools and tactics, such as scheduling software and budget tracking.• Proven ability to self-train through additional training programs and certifications.

Additional Information

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States as a U.S Perm Resident or U.S. Citizen.

Based on eligibility and job status, Cadmus offers an excellent benefits package to include: medical, dental, vision, company paid disability and life insurance, 401(k) program, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, voluntary time off (VTO), tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance program, other optional benefits and various bonus programs.

The salary range for this position is $80,000 - $95,000. The actual salary will be determined by several factors, including relevant work experience, education, skills, and market competitiveness.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Work within a nationally recognised research institute focused on addressing major chronic disease challenges.

  • Advance research into chronic disease and co-morbidities
  • Engage with national and international research networks and partners
  • 3-year fixed-term academic position based in Hamilton

Ngā kōrero mō te tūranga – About the role

The Institute for Chronic Disease Research (ICDR) seeks to appoint an outstanding and highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow to contribute to our growing programme of research focused on chronic disease prevention, management, and health outcomes.

The Postdoctoral Fellow will undertake and contribute to a range of research projects aligned with the strategic priorities of the Institute for Chronic Disease Research. Working closely with senior researchers and collaborators, the successful candidate will be involved in all stages of the research process, including study design, data collection and analysis, dissemination of findings, and preparation of funding applications.

The appointee will play a key role in advancing the Institute's research programme and contributing to its national and international research profile.

This is an opportunity to contribute to transdisciplinary research that examines chronic disease, co-morbidities and intersecting conditions, including research grounded in culturally specific and place-based knowledge. The role will also support collaboration across the University and help build research capability within the ICDR.

Salary will be based on the skills, knowledge and experience brought to the position. This is a full-time role (37.5 hours a week), fixed term for 3 years, based on our Hilcrest Campus.

For more information on the role please see the position description. Applicants should submit a cover letter addressing the selection criteria, a current curriculum vitae and the contact details for at least two academic referees.

For a confidential conversation about the role, please contact Professor Ralph Maddison, Director, Institute for Chronic Disease Research, at ralph.maddison@waikato.ac.nz. All applications must be submitted through the online portal, emailed applications will not be accepted.

Ko wai koe? – Who are you?

You will have a PhD in a relevant discipline, such as public health, epidemiology, health sciences, medicine, biostatistics, health services research or a related field, together with demonstrated experience conducting independent research.

You bring a track record of peer-reviewed publications appropriate to your career stage, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and experience preparing scientific reports, publications and presentations. You can contribute across the research process, from developing research plans and methods through to data collection, analysis, interpretation and reporting.

You are an effective communicator who can build productive relationships with academic colleagues, research partners and other stakeholders. You work well both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, manage projects and competing priorities effectively, and bring a proactive, professional and collaborative approach to your work.

Experience in chronic disease research, advanced quantitative or qualitative methods, large health datasets or clinical research projects would be an advantage. Experience contributing to grant applications, and supervising or mentoring students or early career researchers, would also be valuable.

You will also demonstrate commitment to equal opportunity and to the University’s partnership with Māori as intended by the Treaty of Waitangi.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Research shows that some people are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. At The University of Waikato, we’re committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and genuine workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly match every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be just the right person for this or another opportunity on our team.

Ko wai mātou? – Who are we?

The Institute for Chronic Disease Research is the first research institute in New Zealand to focus on the combined factors that contribute to chronic disease. Its work spans the economic and social impacts of chronic health conditions, with benefits intended for whānau, local communities and wider New Zealand society.

The ICDR supports cutting-edge, transdisciplinary and transformational health research. Its interwoven structure of platforms and pillars enables research into co-morbidities and intersecting chronic disease, including cardiovascular disease, mental health and cancer. Māori and Pacific perspectives are threaded across the Institute’s research, supporting culturally specific and place-based knowledge. The Institute builds on existing research strengths, supports collaboration across the University and helps develop researchers from postgraduate level through to future research leadership.

He aha ngā take me tono mai ai koe? – Why should you apply for this position?

We want you to be part of our success! Our university stands proudly on the world stage as a provider of future-focused, international education and an active player in global research. Our rankings reflect these strengths. Working with us means you’ll enjoy a satisfying work environment with many benefits.

The University of Waikato is distinctive for the diversity of its staff and students and encourages applicants with the relevant capabilities from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants must have the legal right to live and work in NZ in accordance with the NZ Immigration regulations which can be found here.

Ko Te Tangata – For the People

The University of Waikato prides itself on the quality of its engagement with the communities that it serves, the provision of a world-class education and the national and international impact of its research. Our policies are guided by the principles of the Treaty of Waitangi and equal opportunity for all.

Te Au Reka - Improving access to justice for all New Zealanders

Te Au Reka represents the opportunity of a lifetime, making a profound difference to those who work in and interact with our courts and tribunals. We are seeking to modernise the administration of justice by replacing highly manual, time-consuming, paper-based processes with a new digital case management solution, transforming the way people access and experience justice in Aotearoa New Zealand.

Te Au Reka is a large, complex and unique programme spanning the courts and tribunals of New Zealand. Working on Te Au Reka will give you the opportunity to use your knowledge and experience, while developing new ways of working. As a Test Lead, you will be responsible for the ongoing implementation of the testing strategy for Te Au Reka. You will define and lead the overall testing approach, ensuring testing activities are aligned with programme objectives and delivered to a high standard.

Leading a small team of Test Analysts and Test Engineers, you will provide direction, guidance, and support to ensure testing activities are effectively planned, coordinated, and executed across the programme. Working closely with stakeholders, vendors, and delivery teams, you will drive collaboration, manage testing risks and promote continuous improvement to ensure the successful delivery of quality digital products and services.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and develop a team of Test Analysts and Test Engineers, fostering a high-performing and collaborative testing culture

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders, vendors, and delivery teams, providing clear communication on testing progress, outcomes, and risks

  • Experience leading testing for interoperability initiatives and complex API integrations
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing testing teams while fostering a collaborative and positive team culture
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships across a wide range of business and technical groups

  • Knowledge of All-of-Government ICT principles, practices, and service offerings, and an understanding of the machinery of government

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate: Department of Earth, Environmental, and Planetary Sciences - UTK
description:
As part of the Earth and Planetary Materials Group led by PI Nicholas Dygert, and a NASA-funded lunar science research consortium, the successful applicant will investigate the Moon’s evolutionary history. Avenues of exploration may include but are not limited to differentiation, magmatism, and petrogenesis. The candidate will also pursue research related to planet Mercury’s differentiation and evolution. The initial appointment will be for one year, with reappointment contingent upon sufficient progress as assessed in performance evaluations. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

The candidate will pursue lunar and Mercurian research as directed by the PI or as practicable, of their own design, present new results at science meetings, publish in peer-reviewed journals, and seek external employment. The candidate is expected to contribute to a positive and dynamic research climate in the group and department by enthusiastically participating in events, seminars and symposia. Responsibilities may include student mentorship.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Doctorate in Geoscience or a related field at the time of appointment or have completed all their doctoral degree requirements, and a record of at least one peer-reviewed publication.
  • Experience:
    • A publication record in planetary geoscience, broadly defined (including studies relevant to Earth).
    • Experience running high-pressure, high-temperature experiments.
    • Background in experimental petrology.

Work Location

Knoxville, Tennessee, onsite

Compensation and Benefits

  • Anticipated hiring range: $65,000
  • Find more information on UT Benefits here

Application Instructions

For best consideration applicants should submit the below materials before October 15th, 2026

  • Cover letter,
  • Curriculum vitae,
  • One-page research statement
  • Contact information for 3 professional references

About The Department

The Department of Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences maintains a dynamic research climate and has been at the forefront of Lunar and Planetary Sciences for decades. The Department has abundant experimental and analytical resources including a new electron probe microanalyzer and LA-QQQ-ICP-MS system. Knoxville is in the foothills of the Smoky and Blue Ridge mountains; in addition to mountains, East Tennessee has abundant inland waterways and pristine state and national parks. Knoxville is a thriving city with vibrant indoor and outdoor entertainment venues, restaurants, shops, and cultural offerings.

title: Multi-Line Claim Supervisor - Premises / GL - Remote
description:
Overview

Multi-Line Claims Supervisor

Location: RemoteSchedule: Monday – FridaySalary Range: $85,000 – $105,000 annually

Build Your Career With Purpose at CCMSI

At CCMSI, we partner with clients to solve complex risk management challenges through innovative claim solutions, collaborative problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to service excellence.

As the largest privately-owned Third Party Administrator (TPA), CCMSI delivers customized claim management solutions that help our clients navigate complex events, emerging risks, and large-scale claim programs. Our employee-owned culture empowers team members to take ownership, drive results, and make a meaningful impact.

Job Summary

CCMSI is seeking an experienced Claims Supervisor to lead a team of adjusters handling General Liability claims, with a primary focus on hospitality, entertainment, restaurant, and premises liability exposures. This role supervises a team of approximately 5-8 adjusters responsible for investigating, evaluating, negotiating, and resolving complex liability claims through litigation across multiple jurisdictions. The successful candidate will provide day-to-day leadership, technical guidance, operational oversight, and performance management while ensuring quality claim handling, compliance, customer service, and productivity expectations are consistently achieved. The Claims Supervisor serves as a subject matter expert for premises liability and entertainment-related exposures, assisting adjusters with complex coverage, liability, damages, litigation management, settlement strategy, and client communication. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing talent, driving technical excellence, and building a high-performing team within a sophisticated litigation-focused claims environment.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

· Supervise, coach, mentor, and develop a team of 5-8 adjusters handling complex General Liability claims

· Provide technical guidance on hospitality, entertainment, restaurant, and premises liability exposures

· Assist adjusters in managing litigated claims from inception through resolution

· Review liability investigations, damages evaluations, reserve adequacy, litigation strategy, and settlement recommendations

· Conduct regular file reviews and audits to ensure compliance with client requirements, jurisdictional regulations, and company standards

· Partner with defense counsel on litigation strategy, discovery, mediation, and trial preparation

· Assist with complex claim negotiations, settlement authority decisions, and claim resolution strategies

· Monitor inventory levels and allocate workloads to maintain service commitments and quality expectations

· Analyze claim trends, loss drivers, and operational opportunities for continuous improvement

· Communicate claim performance and operational metrics to leadership and clients

· Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, professional development, and technical excellence

What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months, the successful candidate will:

  • · Build credibility and strong working relationships with adjusters, clients, and leadership
  • · Demonstrate effective leadership, coaching, and employee development practices
  • · Maintain a well-managed, engaged, and accountable claims team
  • · Consistently meet quality, compliance, and service expectations
  • · Improve file handling consistency and litigation management practices
  • · Serve as a trusted technical resource for complex hospitality and premises liability claims

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

· Minimum 8 years of experience handling complex General Liability claims through litigation

· Significant experience handling hospitality, entertainment, restaurant, and/or premises liability claims

· Minimum 3 years of supervisory experience leading, coaching, mentoring, and developing claims professionals

· Demonstrated experience managing litigated casualty claims from investigation through resolution

· Strong understanding of:

o Premises liability investigations

o Liability determination

o Litigation management

o Damages evaluation

o Reserve analysis

o Mediation and settlement strategies

o Coverage and risk transfer concepts

· Experience overseeing claim inventories and managing adjuster performance

· Proven ability to balance quality, compliance, customer service, and productivity objectives

· Excellent organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills

· Strong written and verbal communication skills

· Active Adjuster License or Designated Home State (DHS) License required

· Ability to obtain and maintain additional jurisdictional licenses as needed

· Proficiency with claims management systems and Microsoft Office applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-state claims handling experience
  • Multi-state General Liability claims handling experience
  • Experience working with self-insured entities, large deductible programs, or commercial casualty accounts
  • Prior TPA experience
  • Professional designations such as:
    • AIC
    • CPCU
    • SCLA
    • ARM

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • 4 weeks (Paid time off that accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy) + 10 paid holidays in your first year
  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • Retirement plans: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Career growth: Opportunities to advance into senior claims leadership positions
  • Culture: A collaborative, employee-owned environment where leaders are empowered to make an impact

How We Measure Success

At CCMSI, great supervisors create results through leadership, consistency, and service. We measure success by:

  • Quality claim handling and technical excellence
  • Effective litigation management and claim outcomes
  • Development and engagement of team members
  • Compliance with client requirements and Corporate Claim Standards
  • Reserve accuracy and financial stewardship
  • Client responsiveness and partnership
  • Timely claim resolution and operational efficiency
  • Positive team culture and employee growth

Compensation & Compliance

The posted salary reflects CCMSI’s good-faith estimate in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal equity. This role may also qualify for bonuses or additional forms of pay.

CCMSI offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Paid time off accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy, with paid holidays and eligibility for retirement programs in accordance with plan documents.

Visa Sponsorship: CCMSI does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

ADA Accommodations: CCMSI is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and hiring process.

Equal Opportunity Employer: CCMSI complies with all applicable employment laws, including pay transparency and fair chance hiring regulations.

Background checks, if required for the role, are conducted only after a conditional offer and in accordance with applicable fair chance hiring laws.

Our Core Values

At CCMSI, we believe in doing what’s right—for our clients, our coworkers, and ourselves. We look for team members who:

  • Lead with transparency We build trust by being open and listening intently in every interaction.
  • Perform with integrity We choose the right path, even when it is hard.
  • Chase excellence We set the bar high and measure our success. What gets measured gets done.
  • Own the outcome Every employee is an owner, treating every claim, every decision, and every result as our own.
  • Win together Our greatest victories come when our clients succeed.

We don’t just work together—we grow together. If that sounds like your kind of workplace, we’d love to meet you.
